jobs.title: Senior Product Analyst (M/F/X)
jobs.description:
Rejoins une superstar de la foodtech française

Chez HelloFresh, nous bousculons les habitudes alimentaires des français grâce à nos Box à cuisiner !

Notre ambition ? Révolutionner le quotidien de nos abonné.e.s, en promouvant une façon plus durable de cuisiner et en leur faisant découvrir de délicieuses recettes, créatives et équilibrées. L'alliance parfaite entre technologie et gastronomie, pour un maximum de gourmandise.

HelloFresh est présent dans plus de 15 pays. La France est des plus jeunes marchés, lancé en 2019, et nous y avons connu une croissance fulgurante nous propulsant comme leader du marché. rejoindre notre équipe, c’est la garantie d’avoir un impact fort dans l'une des scale-up françaises les plus prometteuses !

Comment rendre tout cela possible ? Grâce à une équipe talentueuse et dynamique, des valeurs fortes de bienveillance et de diversité, et un environnement de travail stimulant.

Si tu souhaites prendre part à cette incroyable aventure humaine, internationale et entrepreneuriale, rejoins-nous !

Le poste :

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un.e Senior Product Analyst pour rejoindre notre équipe Produit. En tant qu'Analyste Produit Senior, tu seras la référence analytique pour les décisions produit en France, à l'intersection des équipes Culinaire, Menu Planning et SPD (Strategy & Product Development).

Il ne s'agit pas simplement de produire des rapports, mais d'un rôle clé où tu pourras façonner directement les décisions stratégiques produit — de l'architecture de menu à l'optimisation des recettes, en passant par la stratégie d'assortiment. Ce rôle se caractérise par sa diversité : tu pourrais passer une journée à analyser la performance client sous l'angle produit, la suivante à construire un outil pour automatiser un workflow, et la troisième à présenter des insights actionnables au management.

Si tu veux être au cœur de la data produit et avoir un impact direct sur ce que des milliers de client.e.s mettent dans leur assiette chaque semaine, alors ce poste est fait pour toi !

Ce que tu feras :

- Business intelligence et reporting produit : concevoir et maintenir des tableaux de bord et rapports récurrents sur les sujets produit (performance du menu, adoption des recettes, rotation d'assortiment, etc.), définir et suivre les KPIs clés, et présenter des synthèses régulières pour alimenter les rituels de pilotage.

- Analyses ad hoc et exploratoires : mener des analyses qui informent directement les décisions produit — architecture de menu, optimisation de recettes, stratégie d'assortiment — et identifier proactivement des opportunités à fort impact.

- Développement et maintenance d’outils analytiques : concevoir et maintenir des outils analytiques internes (scripts, dashboards, automatisations) pour soutenir les workflows des équipes Culinaire, Menu Planning et SPD.

- Analyse de données : extraire, transformer et analyser des données complexes pour soutenir les décisions produit, en garantissant la qualité et la cohérence des datasets.

- Analytique client orientée performance produit : analyser le comportement et les préférences client.e.s sous l'angle de la performance produit (satisfaction, réachat, fidélisation selon les choix de menu ou de recette) pour informer les décisions d'assortiment.

- Pilotage de projets stratégiques : prendre en charge le lead analytique et opérationnel de projets stratégiques visant à améliorer le cœur de produit.

- Collaboration internationale : travailler en lien avec le Global Product Analytics team sur des projets à fort impact, contribuant à la création de valeur sur l'ensemble des marchés HelloFresh.

Ce qu'on recherche chez un.e candidat.e :

- Tu es issu.e d'une top école d'ingénieur, de commerce ou d'une formation universitaire en data/statistiques

- Tu as au moins 4 ans d'expérience en analyse de données, business intelligence ou data science, idéalement dans un environnement e-commerce, FMCG ou food-tech

- Tu maîtrises SQL de façon avancée ; Python est un plus

- Tu as de l'expérience avec des outils de BI (Tableau privilégié) et une excellente maîtrise de Gsheet

- Tu as de l’expérience dans l’utilisation d'outils IA/ML pour des analyses exploratoires (ex. détection d'anomalies) et en usage de LLMs comme accélérateur de productivité analytique

- Tu sais traduire des analyses complexes en recommandations claires, synthétiques et actionnables pour des interlocuteur.ice.s non techniques

- Tu es organisé.e, rigoureux.se, tu portes une grande attention aux détails et sais prioriser entre plusieurs sujets tout en leur accordant le temps nécessaire.

- Tu es proactif.ve : tu identifies les bonnes questions autant que tu y réponds

- Tu parles couramment français et maîtrises l'anglais à l'oral comme à l'écrit

- Bonus : tu as une vraie passion pour la food et une appétence pour les enjeux culinaires ou de grande consommation

Ce que nous t'offrons :

- Un impact réel : tes actions alimentent directement la croissance d'une des plus belles scale-ups européennes

- Une courbe d'apprentissage rapide

- Une équipe bienveillante : une petite team talentueuse et passionnée qui t'aidera à monter en compétence

- Un environnement international : tu travailleras avec des équipes dans 13 pays; c'est une vraie école

- Des bureaux au cœur de Paris (1er arr.), une culture dynamique et entrepreneuriale

- Avantages : réductions HelloFresh, tickets restaurant Swile, accès Gymlib, transport, et tout ce qui fait que c'est cool de venir au bureau

Le déroulé du processus de recrutement :

Nous examinons ton CV et ta lettre de motivation. Si c’est un match, nous t’invitons à une série d’entretiens et à réaliser un case study. Nous nous engageons à organiser rapidement les entretiens, afin de t’accueillir chez HelloFresh au plus vite !

Tes débuts chez HelloFresh :

A ton arrivée, nous te concoctons des sessions d’onboarding qui te permettront de rencontrer chaque manager et de t’imprégner ainsi du fonctionnement de HelloFresh. Tu auras aussi du temps pour faire plus ample connaissance avec ton équipe avant de plonger dans le vif de tes missions !

jobs.title: Operational Excellence Manager
jobs.description:
About The Team:

The Operational Excellence Manager sits within the UK OPEX & Transformation team and takes ownership of our most complex, high-impact programmes - driving the commercial strategy, delivery, and continuous improvement of production technologies, processes, and business propositions across HelloFresh distribution centres in the UK, IE & EU markets. This is not a role where you wait for problems to be defined for you. You spot them, size them, build the case, and lead the charge to fix them.

This is a senior, project-led role for someone who operates with real autonomy across the full transformation lifecycle - from scoping and commercial analysis through to hands-on delivery and lasting adoption on the floor. You will lead multiple medium-to-large scale improvement projects simultaneously, applying rigorous project management and Lean CI methodology to drive measurable results. You'll build the case for change and then see it through yourself, with a relentless focus on the metrics that matter most: Error Rate, Minutes per Box, and productivity.

What You Will Be Doing:

- End-to-End Programme Delivery: Take full ownership of multiple medium-to-large scale projects simultaneously - defining scope, milestones, resource requirements, and success measures, and driving them from initiation through to on-floor implementation on time and within budget.

- Data Analysis & Opportunity Sizing: Analyse complex operational data using tools like Excel, Databricks, Grafana, Tableau, or SQL, translating findings into commercially grounded business decisions, identifying and validating improvement opportunities through financial modelling, and building the investment case to drive prioritisation decisions with senior stakeholders.

- Stakeholder Management & Influence: Deploy effective influencing and negotiation skills to align cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders around project objectives, securing resources and buy-in at every level - from shop floor to leadership.

- Project Governance: Maintain strict quality and change control standards while proactively mitigating risks to keep programs on track and stakeholders informed.

- Change Management & Floor Presence: Maintain a strong, visible presence on the production floor to drive change initiatives, build trust with operational teams, and ensure the sustainable adoption of new processes and technologies.

- Continuous Improvement: Lead projects utilising Lean Six Sigma methodologies to eliminate waste, resolve bottlenecks, and build a sustained culture of continuous improvement across the DC.

- Standardisation & Capability Building: Drive operational standards through clear SOPs, process documentation, and hands-on coaching - developing the CI capability of onsite teams and supporting junior team members in their own project delivery.
jobs.requirements_raw:
Who You Are:

Education & Experience

- Degree: At least a Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, or a technical discipline

- Experience: 3–5 years of relevant experience in Operational Excellence, Industrial Engineering, Process Optimization, or High-Volume Fulfillment, ideally within a FMCG, food manufacturing industry.

- Track Record: Proven experience successfully leading end-to-end, medium-to-large process optimization and cost-saving initiatives across multiple functions.

Technical Skills

- Lean & Continuous Improvement: Deep expertise in process optimization frameworks (Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, TPM, Project Management); Green Belt certification or equivalent practical capability essential.

- Analytics & Systems: Strong proficiency in data analytics tools (Excel, SQL, Google Sheets), AI tools and hands-on familiarity with WMS/WCS environments.

- Commercial & Financial Modelling: Ability to build and present robust business cases, translating quantitative analysis into clear commercial narratives for senior leadership.

Core Competencies

- Leadership & Mentorship: Ability to lead project teams and mentor junior team members without needing formal direct reporting lines.

- Roll-up-Your-Sleeves Attitude: You have a passion for combining analytical thinking with hands-on, real-time problem solving on a fast-paced production floor.

- Stakeholder Influence & Communication: You translate complex operational data into clear, compelling commercial narratives, easily bridging the communication gap between shop-floor teams and site leadership.

- Organization: You are highly organized and detail-oriented, with a proven ability to manage multiple competing priorities simultaneously.

- Low ego, high ownership: You'll get your hands dirty on the floor as readily as you'll present to senior leadership.

- Resilient under pressure: DC environments are fast-moving; you adapt without losing rigour, learn quickly and don't wait for perfect information.

What you will get in return:

● 70% off HelloFresh or Green Chef boxes
● Company pension scheme
● Gym membership
● Bupa private medical insurance (including dental & family cover options)
● Mental health first aiders and an employee assistance programme
● Nursery support scheme
● Cycle to work scheme
● Group Life Assurance

Location: The Windmill SIte, SmartParc, Holme Lane, Derby, DE21 7HW

To be considered for this role, you’ll need to have the independent right to work in the UK, as we're unfortunately unable to provide sponsorship at this time.

Hybrid Working Policy
We offer a hybrid working policy for eligible roles, allowing flexibility to work from home and in the office. For more details on eligibility and how this applies to the role you're applying for, please consult with your recruiter.

Next steps: Your application will be reviewed and if successful, a member of the Talent Acquisition Team will be in touch within 2 weeks.

You are required to cooperate with HelloFresh in all health and safety matters. You are responsible for ensuring you take reasonable care of your own health, and safety as well as others who may be affected by the work activities you undertake. You must report incidents immediately and actively raise health and safety-related concerns to your Line Manager. As part of our commitment to maintaining a safe and secure environment, we will process Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) checks to the successful individual. Failure to disclose relevant information at application or throughout the process could affect your employment with the company.

If you are currently a HelloFresh employee, please make sure you have discussed your application with your Line Manager.

jobs.title: Schichtleiter Warehouse Operations (all genders)
jobs.description:
Deine Rolle

Als Schichtleiter Warehouse Operations (all genders) sorgst Du dafür, dass im Tagesgeschäft im Lager reibungslos läuft und die Unternehmensziele zuverlässig erreicht werden. Du behältst jederzeit den Überblick über sämtliche Abläufe, Ressourcen sowie Prioritäten und stellst sicher, dass Dein Team Prozesse strukturiert, effizient und produktiv umsetzt.

Zusätzlich übernimmst Du Verantwortung für eine starke Sicherheits- sowie Qualitätskultur und gewährleistest, dass Standards eingehalten und kontinuierlich weiterentwickelt werden.

Dein Verantwortungsbereich

- Teamführung: Führung und Coaching von Zeitarbeitskräften inklusive Einsatzplanung und Aufgabenverteilung zur Erreichung aller relevanten Schicht-KPIs sowie Unterstützung der Weiterentwicklung der Mitarbeitenden durch regelmäßiges, konstruktives Feedback und die Förderung einer produktiven, kollegialen Teamkultur

- Operatives Management: Sicherstellung möglichst reibungsloser Abläufe im Lager, Optimierung des Ressourceneinsatzes zur kontinuierlichen Erreichung der Produktionsziele in Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern

- Prozessoptimierung: Kontinuierliche Analyse und Verbesserung der operativen Prozesse und damit verbundenen Kennzahlen zur Steigerung von Effizienz, Produktivität und Kosteneffektivität

- SOPs & Standardisierung: Entwicklung, Implementierung und Überwachung von Standardarbeitsanweisungen (SOPs) in Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams und dem Learning & Development-Bereich

- Compliance & Audits: Durchführung von Audits zur nachhaltigen Sicherung der Standards für Lebensmittelsicherheit sowie Arbeits- und Gesundheitsschutz

- Umgang mit operativen Herausforderungen: Eigenständige Durchführung von Problemlösungsmaßnahmen und bei Bedarf gezielte Eskalation an den Operations Lead

- Projektmanagement: Leitung / Unterstützung von Ad-hoc-Projekten und Koordination der Service- und Supportfunktionen
jobs.requirements_raw:
Dein Profil

- Abgeschlossenes Studium / Ausbildung im Bereich Wirtschaft/Logistik Supply Chain Management oder einem verwandten Bereich

- Erfahrung in der Logistik, einem Distributionszentrum, der Produktion bzw. einem vergleichbaren operativen Umfeld und fundiertes Verständnis für Lager- oder Produktionsprozessen

- Sicheres Anwenden von Software- und Systemlösungen in verschiedenen Anwendungsbereichen

- Erfahrung in der fortgeschrittenen Datenanalyse mit Tools wie Excel, Google Sheets, Grafana oder Tableau sowie in der Interpretation von Daten zur Unterstützung von Geschäftsentscheidungen

- Strukturierte Arbeitsweise und souveräner Umgang mit parallel zueinander anfallenden Aufgaben sowie wechselnden Prioritäten

- Fließende Deutsch- (mind. C1 Niveau) und gute Englischkenntnisse (mind. B2 Niveau)

Vor allem suchen wir Menschen, die HelloFresh besser machen. Wir lieben vielfältige Erfahrungen und glauben, dass es viele Wege gibt, Fähigkeiten zu entwickeln. Wenn Du also nicht alle Kriterien erfüllst, aber glaubst, in dieser Rolle überzeugen zu können, möchten wir gerne mehr über Dich erfahren.

Das bieten wir Dir

- Wohlfühlarbeitsplatz mit tollem Team in Hannover

- Rabatte auf unsere HelloFresh Kochboxen

- Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten durch interne Trainings sowie ein jährliches Team-Budget für Weiterbildung

- Ein umfassendes Onboarding

- 30 Tage Urlaub

- Spaß bei Teamevents

- Vergünstigte Fitnessangebote bei EGYM Wellpass

- Initiativen für das Wohlbefinden durch Kooperationen mit der Headspace-App und Spill

- Betriebliche Altersvorsorge

Bist Du die fehlende Zutat?

Wenn diese Gelegenheit für Dich lecker klingt, freuen wir uns darauf, von Dir zu hören. Wir bemühen uns, Dein Profil zu prüfen und Dir innerhalb von 5 Werktagen zu antworten.

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist, AdTech Tribe, Growth Alliance (f/m/x)
jobs.description:
Work with HelloFresh in Warsaw and its HelloTech organisation, HelloFresh’s global technology backbone with more than 1000 people, building the digital products that power our end-to-end food experience. From meal kits and ready-to-eat meals to specialty offerings like pet food and premium meat & seafood, HelloTech creates the platforms that bring tailored food solutions to millions of customers every month.

Our subscription-based, direct-to-consumer model relies on technology at every step, from customer-facing apps and personalization logic to pricing, forecasting, supply chain optimization, and initiatives that help reduce food waste. While our brands operate independently to serve distinct customer needs, they are united by shared platforms, data, and operational excellence built by HelloTech.

HelloTech works in autonomous, cross-functional alliances, each owning a specific product or domain end to end. By working with our Warsaw office, you will help shape scalable, data-driven products used across our markets, working with a modern tech stack and international teams to continuously improve how people discover, order, and enjoy HelloFresh’s products, today and in the future.

About the role: What's in the Box

Are you ready to drive a huge business impact? As a Senior Data Scientist for AdTech Search Optimization, you will be responsible for maximizing the performance of the Search channels. This work will be crucial to increase return on investment for the marketing budget. Hence, the services provided will have a direct impact on the company’s goals to drive and increase marketing efficiency.

In this capacity, the service provider will design and implement statistical and machine learning models which take into account various data sources, from internal conversion data to external ads platform data.

To succeed in this project, the provider will be a curious, fast learner, who relentlessly prioritizes problem statements and tailors solutions accordingly. Success involves suggesting multiple solutions based on professional experience and prioritizing tasks based on effort and likely impact.

What you’ll do: The Recipe

- Collaborate as an integral part of an amazing and fun team consisting of highly skilled data scientists and engineers.

- Collaborate closely within cross-functional teams (engineering, product, marketing) to translate business objectives into concrete, data-driven strategies.

- Take responsibility for the delivery and execution of scientific optimization models and algorithms, from data collection to operationalization, and closely align them with non-technical stakeholders.

- Experiment and explore opportunities to constantly improve and refine technical approaches.

- Leverage statistical analysis and machine learning algorithms in development and production to enhance incrementality measurement solutions.

- Think out of the box to come up with new ways to improve the data products delivered to stakeholders.

What you’ll bring: The Ingredients

- Proven track record of scientific work in your Bachelors, Masters or PhD in statistics, physics, economics, mathematics, data science or similar.

- Long-term (3+ yrs) work experience as a (senior) data scientist, preferably in an e-commerce environment

- Strong marketing domain knowledge as well as experience with in the Google Search ecosystem and attribution models are a huge plus

- In-depth knowledge how to interpret experiment results, how to handle statistical uncertainties and how to apply statistical models such as regressors and classifiers

- Experience with forecasting algorithms, portfolio optimization approaches, as well as Vector Autoregression

- Fluency and long-term experience in Python, including high familiarity with its scientific stack such as Numpy, Pandas, Scikit-learn, Matplotlib, etc. (experience in Databricks is a plus)

- Ability to retrieve (using SQL), manipulate and analyse large, heterogeneous datasets and build data pipelines

- Familiarity with software development practices and tools (Git, Docker, AWS)

- You love to learn, are a critical thinker and creative problem solver who strives for excellence

- You are a team player who loves to collaborate and work with stakeholders from different backgrounds in an international environment

- Exceptional communication and collaboration capabilities.

What we offer: The Toppings

- Global collaboration at scale: Collaborate with experienced engineers and product partners across HelloTech’s international teams, in a culture of active knowledge sharing.

- Technology with real-world impact: Build and operate modern systems at global scale, supporting 6+ millions of customers and complex supply chain operations.

- Technical/Product/Design leadership: Drive best practices and influence architecture/design, quality, and ways of working in an autonomous, product-led setup.

- End-to-end development/delivery: Drive decisions from problem definition to production, improving systems and enabling long-term scalability.

- Access to workspace at Warsaw Centre Point. The hub offers modern facilities including showers, breakout zones, outdoor space, cycle parking, and refreshments (coffee, soft drinks, and fruit).

Are you the missing ingredient? If this sounds like a tasty opportunity, we’d be excited to hear from you. We aim to review your profile and respond within 5 business days.

#Data

jobs.title: Director, Finance Operations Shared Services (AP/AR)
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about developing new and innovative processes combining finance and operations to increase efficiency and accuracy and reduce waste? If so, this position is for you. Our priority is to identify, scope, and deliver system and process improvements to reduce operating expense, enhance vendor relationships, increase free cash flow, improve business support and establish a high bar for controllership and compliance.

The Director of Finance Operations will be responsible for leading the Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable and Travel & Expense functions for all of our North American brands (HelloFresh, EveryPlate, Chef’s Plate, Green Chef, Factor, Pet’s Table, Good Chop and GDL). This position will be responsible for managing ~35 people based in NYC, CO and offshore in the Philippines.

The Finance Operations organization serves as the operational backbone of the North American business, ensuring suppliers are paid accurately and on time, managing B2B invoicing and collections, driving global finance systems and process improvements, overseeing Travel & Expense operations across North America, and partnering with Accounting and Finance teams to support accurate and timely financial reporting.

This role will be a key member of the Finance leadership team working daily alongside leaders of all levels within our Direct & Indirect Procurement, Marketing, Legal and G&A business groups as well as leaders across the Finance Functions (FP&A, Accounting, Finance Systems, Tax & Treasury). Our team is focused on building a better experience for our business partners, streamlining and automating processes and increasing controllership. This position requires the candidate to diagnose current processes and metrics, identify opportunities, work with business partners to identify and implement improvements and validate the improvement effort.

You will be responsible for identifying the opportunities across the procure to pay and order to cash processes, prioritizing the improvement opportunities and partnering with business and technology leadership to successfully execute improvements. This role requires the ability to demonstrate ownership, interpret data, and effectively influence to drive meaningful results translating to tangible productivity and efficiency gains across multiple departments. To succeed, you must have the ability to engage deeply with diverse business partners, earn trust using facts and data, and have a demonstrated ability to advise and influence the decisions of senior business leaders through effective verbal and written communication. This candidate must possess excellent analytical skills, program management experience, and a track record of delivering projects in a complex and ambiguous environment.

You will...

- Partner with Leadership on strategy, developing solutions and achieving performance targets to support business growth

- Invent and develop significant procure to pay and / or order to cash process improvements

- Managing the team in the day to day operations of timely payment of invoices as well as supporting their career development

- Define key performance indicators – develop operational and business metrics and service level agreements for programs and processes, and track delivery against global objectives

- Partner with and influence Business, Finance, Technology, Operations and other teams to resolve process defects or implement system enhancements

- Identify and drive opportunities for improved cash flow, margin or productivity improvements related to vendor payments and receivables

- Solve critical vendor, process and system escalations effectively to ensure root cause analysis and effective problem resolution

- Identify and quantify financial and operational risks and opportunities

- Support both internal and external audit and ensuring compliance and audit-readiness of all AP/AR processes

- Assisting in the month end close process

- Partner with Internal Audit to strengthen Travel & Expense controls, ensure adherence to company policies, and drive ongoing compliance across the organization

You are...

- Able to work across global time zones and occasional travel may be required

- Able to work comfortably under pressure and work towards tight deadlines

- Filled with a strong sense of ownership and attention to detail.

- Driven to continuously improve and build processes

- Able to manage a high-volume workload efficiently and effectively

- Willing to partner with and support other functions

- Experienced in leading a diverse team

You have...

- 12+ years of finance experience and experience in a high volume AP &/or AR environment

- BA/BS degree or equivalent in Finance, Accounting or other related field

- Experience in e-commerce especially with supply-chain

- Track record of providing advice to senior leaders and driving results

- Experience working with vendors as either a buyer or financial analyst/manager

- Experience in Accounts Payable (procure to pay), Accounts Receivable (order to cash), Travel & Expense Management and/or Customer Service environment

- Experience in managing cross-functional initiatives through influence versus direct management

- Excellent financial modeling and data analytics skills, including Excel, Tableau, Access, SQL, ETL, and other analysis tools

- Experience with AP functionality of ERP systems; Oracle Cloud Fusion knowledge is a plus

You’ll get…

- Competitive salary, 401k with company match that vests immediately upon participation

- Generous PTO, including sabbatical, and parental leave of up to 16 weeks

- Comprehensive health and wellness benefits with options at $0 monthly, effective first day of employment

- Tuition reimbursement for continuing education (upon 2 years of service)

jobs.title: Senior Group Marketing Controller (All Genders)
jobs.description:
The role

The Group Marketing Controller is the primary finance interface for HelloFresh's global marketing function. The role exists to ensure marketing spend is planned accurately, closed correctly, and reported transparently — bridging the gap between marketing execution and the Group P&L.

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What you’ll do

1. Close & Accruals

- Own the month-end close process for marketing cost lines across all markets

- Review and validate marketing accruals submitted by local finance teams

- Identify and resolve booking errors, misclassifications, or missing accruals

- Maintain clean actuals in the income statement for all marketing line items

- Work with SE Finance Controlling to improve and create transparency to the markets on marketing IC charges

2. Budget & Forecast Management

- Consolidate and challenge market-level marketing budgets during planning cycles

- Lead marketing Guidance creation for Business Plan cycles

- Maintain the Group marketing budget with actuals vs. budget vs. forecast

- Flag material variances early and escalate to marketing stakeholders

3. Reporting & Analysis

- Work with Tech and local markets to improve and automate input quality of weekly reporting

- Produce monthly marketing performance reports covering spend vs. budget, phasing, and key variance drivers (Leverage A.I. and Databricks Dashboards)

- Support the CFO/board reporting pack with accurate marketing cost commentary

- Build and maintain performance reports for Global Marketing teams

4. Business Partnering

- Act as the day-to-day finance contact for the Global Marketing teams

- Manage Direct and Indirect spend for the Marketing team

5. Process & Controls

- Document and improve the end-to-end marketing close process

- Ensure consistent cost treatment across markets (e.g. working vs. non-working spend, agency fees, media)

- Identify gaps in how marketing costs are captured and propose fixes

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

- Clean marketing close every month — no material restatements or late accruals

- Stakeholders can trust the marketing numbers without re-checking them

- Variances are explained proactively, not reactively

- Marketing controller processes are standardised across markets

WHAT THE FUTURE LOOKS LIKE

- Manage marketing spend between markets by reviewing ROI, AOR and agreed upon KPI performance

- Centralised and automated marketing controlling at month-end

WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT

- Not a marketing strategist — not expected to have opinions on campaign effectiveness or brand direction

- Not a data analyst — analytical support comes from the Finance Systems team; this role translates outputs into financial conclusions

- Not a local market controller — this role holds the Group view; local controllers own their market execution

jobs.description:
S'more about the team

The Operations Data and Decisions Tribe at HelloFresh is responsible for driving operations planning by creating high quality, reusable data assets, data science models, and algorithmic solutions. Additionally, the tribe. This team has a direct impact on the customer experience and is constantly optimising for various Business KPIs. They build in-house products using modern technologies to handle a massive scale of transactions (>8.5 million active customers) and continuously improve the SDLC for fast flow and continuous delivery.

As a Director of Operations Planning Engineering, you will lead engineering teams (Data Science, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, & Analytics) and Staff Engineers across the mid-term planning domain, supporting their technical decision-making processes. Your responsibilities will include spearheading initiatives that traverse multiple teams and domains, such as those focused on network planning, demand planning, and production planning. Drawing upon your comprehensive understanding of the domain, you will own the planning architecture strategy and drive the long-term vision for how our planning systems should be integrated and scaled.

Lettuce share what this role will be responsible for

- Own the availability and reliability of HelloFresh's planning infrastructure — drive SRE practices, incident management, SLOs/SLIs, and on-call maturity across high-throughput systems serving multiple markets.

- Set technical direction across Python, GoLang, PostgreSQL, Kafka, React, and React Native services on AWS, ensuring systems.

- Partner with Product, Operations, Marketing, and Procurement providers to align engineering priorities with business outcomes.

- Navigate organisational change with maturity, keeping teams focused and motivated through evolving priorities.

Sound a-peeling? Here's what we're looking for

Mastery of a broad range of technical skills relevant to Operations Planning — including planning systems, data science modeling, data engineering, database systems, distributed computing, and backend development frameworks. Hands-on familiarity with full stack application development.

- Systems Thinking. The ability to understand complex systems holistically, recognising how components interact and impact each other, and leveraging this to design scalable, resilient solutions in a high-throughput environment where downtime means direct revenue loss.

Demonstrated ability to lead distributed teams across multiple offices, building trust and maintaining high engineering standards without daily co-location.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration. Exceptional ability to work across engineering disciplines, Product, business stakeholders, and external service providers — fostering alignment towards common goals and translating business outcomes into engineering priorities.

- Effective Communication Across Disciplines. Strong ability to articulate complex technical concepts clearly to diverse audiences, from engineers to senior business stakeholders.

jobs.title: Staff Backend Product Engineer, Shopping AI & Search squad
jobs.description:
Join HelloFresh in Warsaw as part of HelloTech, our global technology organisation of 1000+ people building the digital products behind our end-to-end food experience from meal kits and ready-to-eat meals to specialty offerings like pet food and premium meat & seafood. Our subscription-based, direct-to-consumer model runs on technology at every step: customer-facing apps, personalization, pricing, forecasting, supply chain, and food-waste reduction. Each of our brands serves distinct customer needs, but all are powered by the shared platforms, data, and engineering standards that HelloTech builds. HelloTech is organized into autonomous, cross-functional alliances, each owning a specific domain end-to-end. From our Warsaw office, you'll help shape scalable, data-driven products used across all our markets, working with a modern tech stack and international teams to keep improving how people discover, order, and enjoy HelloFresh's products.

About the role: What's in the Box

You'll join the Shopping AI & Search squad, part of the Shopping Journey tribe within our Consumer Alliance. Shopping Journey's mission is to help customers build lasting habits with HelloFresh, making it effortless to manage a subscription, find and order what they love, and get help when something goes wrong.

Within that tribe, Shopping AI & Search owns a specific bet: building unified AI Assistant experiences for HelloFresh customers inside the chatbot and across the broader shopping journey, including personalized and conversational search and proactive in-app recommendations. The goal is a shopping experience that feels like it understands the customer, wherever they encounter it.

As a Staff Backend Product Engineer, you'll provide technical leadership across this initiative, shaping architecture, driving technical decisions, and helping the squad (and its neighbors) build AI-powered systems that are fast, reliable, and genuinely useful, not just impressive in a demo.

What you'll do: The Recipe

- Lead the technical architecture for unified AI Assistant experiences spanning conversational search, personalized search, and proactive in-app recommendations — so the experience holds together whether the customer is in the chatbot or elsewhere in the app.

- Own end-to-end technical decisions around integrating LLM-powered capabilities into customer-facing systems, weighing quality, latency, and cost at scale.

- Act as the technical bridge between Shopping AI & Search, neighboring squads across Shopping Journey, and product/platform stakeholders, so architecture stays coherent as the assistant expands to new surfaces.

- Define and drive engineering best practices for building and operating AI-powered systems — observability, graceful degradation, and testing strategies for components that are inherently probabilistic.

- Provide technical leadership through architecture reviews, design discussions, and hands-on mentoring that raises the engineering bar across the tribe.

- Use AI coding tools (e.g. Claude, Cursor) as a standard part of how you build, and help shape how the wider team adopts AI-assisted engineering practices.

- Shape the technical roadmap by spotting architectural bottlenecks early and proposing improvements before they become blockers.

What you'll bring: The Ingredients

- 8+ years of backend engineering experience, with deep expertise in distributed systems, microservices, and event-driven architecture (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or AWS SQS/SNS).

- Strong hands-on proficiency in Go, or another modern backend language (Java/Kotlin, Python, or TypeScript/Node.js), with the willingness to work in Go, our squad's primary stack.

- Practical experience integrating LLMs or other AI services into production systems via APIs/SDKs. This isn't an ML engineering role — we're not training foundation models — but you're comfortable designing around how they behave: latency, cost, and non-determinism.

- Genuine, daily hands-on use of AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or similar) that goes beyond casual experimentation, with a practical sense of how the context you give these tools shapes what you get back.

- Solid understanding of modern cloud infrastructure (AWS, Kubernetes) and observability practices, with the ability to set and advocate for standards across the tribe.

- A track record of turning ambiguous product problems — search relevance, recommendation quality, conversational UX — into a clear technical roadmap.

- A collaborative, low-ego approach to problem-solving, strong technical judgment, and a real interest in mentoring other engineers.

- Excellent communication skills and comfort working with senior stakeholders and distributed, international teams.

Prior experience with search or recommendation systems is a plus, not a requirement what matters most is your ability to design and operate reliable, scalable backend systems and reason well about new ones. Above all, we're looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We know there's more than one path to the skills this role needs — if you don't tick every box but think you'd thrive here, we'd still like to hear from you.

What we offer: The Toppings

- Global collaboration at scale: Collaborate with experienced engineers and product partners across HelloTech’s international teams, in a culture of active knowledge sharing.

- Technology with real-world impact: Build and operate modern systems at global scale, supporting 6+ millions of customers and complex supply chain operations.

- Technical/Product/Design leadership: Drive best practices and influence architecture/design, quality, and ways of working in an autonomous, product-led setup.

- End-to-end development/delivery: Drive decisions from problem definition to production, improving systems and enabling long-term scalability.

- Access to workspace at Warsaw Centre Point. The hub offers modern facilities including showers, breakout zones, outdoor space, cycle parking, and refreshments (coffee, soft drinks, and fruit).

Are you the missing ingredient? If this sounds like a tasty opportunity, we'd love to hear from you. We aim to review your profile and respond within 5 business days.

If you’re an experienced claims professional ready for a new challenge beyond managing a high-volume caseload, this is an opportunity to bring your claims expertise into a corporate risk environment. You’ll gain broader exposure across multiple areas of risk management while helping identify trends, improve claims outcomes, support risk mitigation, and contribute to the overall risk strategy of a growing organization.

This role is a great fit for someone looking to make a career move that offers greater variety, broader responsibility, and room to grow beyond traditional claims adjusting.

You will...

- Partner closely with HelloFresh’s claims TPA to support effective claims management, improve outcomes, and help control claim severity.

- Monitor active Workers’ Compensation claims throughout the claim lifecycle, including adjuster and site follow-ups, aging claims, outstanding action items, and next steps.

- Build, maintain, and validate claims dashboards and reports; analyze loss data to identify trends, emerging risks, and recurring root causes, and partner with internal stakeholders on action plans.

- Track Return-to-Work progress and compliance-related activities, including audit support and timely updates across systems.

- Support subrogation and recovery efforts by tracking opportunities, following up on outstanding items, and maintaining required documentation.

- Assist with escalated claims involving complex investigations, litigation, significant injuries, or other high-risk exposures.

- Partner with the internal Legal team and external defense counsel across multiple states to manage and support litigation matters, including claim strategy, documentation, and ongoing case coordination.

- Support insurance program renewals through exposure data collection, analysis, and preparation of supporting information.

- Review claim files and collaborate with TPAs on reserve adequacy, claim strategy, and recommended next steps.

- Partner cross-functionally with internal teams to gather documentation, resolve issues, and facilitate timely and effective claim handling.

- Participate in regular meetings with insurance carriers, brokers, and TPAs to monitor claims, address open issues, and support overall program execution.

- Identify opportunities to automate manual processes, improve reporting, and enhance claims workflows.

- Support additional claims, insurance, and risk management initiatives as needed.

At a minimum, you have...

- 3-4 years of workers’ compensation claims experience, either as a WC claims adjuster at a TPA/carrier or in a corporate risk management function managing a WC program directly

- Strong Excel and data skills; experience with RMIS platforms (Riskonnect or similar) and Power BI is a plus

- Familiarity with TPA workflows, loss run analysis, and claim lifecycle management

About the Role

As a Machine Operator you will work within our Production and Maintenance Team to operate equipment, perform the automation and preventative maintenance programs at our facilities, and work to ensure operation downtime is kept to a minimum along with routine production activities.

What you will be doing:

- Ensure all required efficiencies are achieved and maintained.

- Operate machines to grind, extract, mix, blend, dry, freeze, cook or otherwise process food or beverage products

- Perform pre and post inspection of packaging equipment using the appropriate job plans, procedures, and manuals, in addition to machine calibration.

- Accurately set up equipment and ensure proper and safe operation.

- Complete required documentation and run production reports.

- Troubleshoot and repair equipment failures to ensure Production downtime is kept to a minimum.

- Continuously monitor and adjust the process based on upstream and downstream production needs.

- Maintain and store department inventory, including consumables and keep accurate documentation.

- Responsible for practicing and adhering to Food Safety, GMP’s (Good Manufacturing Practices) and Health and Safety policies.

- Responsible for practicing and adhering to Hello Fresh policies and best practices, including ensuring best possible product quality for our customers.

- Work in compliance with OH&S acts and regulations.

- Use personal protective and safety equipment and clothing as directed by the employer and report workplace hazards and dangers to the supervisor or employer.

- Other duties as assigned.

At a minimum, you have:

- Post-secondary Education in Mechanical or Electro-Mechanical Engineering Diploma or equivalent, or relevant experience

- Knowledge of ProSeal( GTE/ GTR) and Loma Metal Detectors is an asset.

- Minimum of 6 months to 1 year experience operating machinery in a food processing, manufacturing or service industry

- Familiarity with MHE operation is a plus ((Material Handling Equipment's e.g walkie, forklift, stacker, reach etc. )

- Able to stand for prolonged periods of time including regular bending, twisting and walking

- Willing and able to work in a refrigerated environment (0°C to 4°C)

- Willing and able to push, pull, and lift up to 50lbs

- Maintain a high level of attention to detail and accuracy looking consistently for potential food safety or quality deviations

- Ability to communicate in English, both verbal and written

- Minimum requirement of basic computer skills

What you’ll get in return:

- Competitive salary and health benefits

- Shift premiums are available for afternoon and overnight shifts

- 75% discount on HelloFresh or Chefs Plate weekly box subscription

If this sounds like you, please click the "Apply Now" button. If this role doesn't quite match what you're looking for, but you'd like to know more about joining the HelloFresh team, please visit our Jobs page to view our other vacancies. We'd love to hear from you!

The Role

We are looking for an experienced People Technology Engineering Manager to join the HelloFresh People Technology leadership team. This role leads the Engineering discipline within People Technology and is responsible for the architecture, capability and delivery of the technical solutions that connect, automate and increasingly enhance our employee technology landscape.

Today, the squad’s primary focus is Workday integrations and connected enterprise systems. Over time, its remit will expand across workflow automation, low-code development, AI-enabled solutions and modern engineering capabilities. You will act as the engineering architect and design authority for People Technology, setting technical direction, shaping architecture and establishing standards that balance delivery speed, scalability, security, maintainability and long-term sustainability. This includes maintaining strong expertise in Workday integrations and emerging platform capabilities such as Workday Orchestrate and Extend / Build.

You will also lead, develop and performance-manage a team of engineers, building capability across integrations, automation and AI engineering. You will create a high-performing environment grounded in technical quality, accountability and continuous learning, while ensuring the squad has the skills, capacity and ways of working needed to meet both current and future demand. While you may remain hands-on where appropriate, your primary focus will be technical leadership, people development, capability building and delivery oversight.

As the senior business partner for engineering, you will represent the discipline across People Technology and work closely with the People function and stakeholders from across the Group. You will help shape roadmaps, influence prioritisation and investment decisions, and translate business needs into scalable engineering solutions. You will also play a central role in determining where AI, automation and intelligent workflows can create measurable value, both by enabling the squad to deliver faster and by building AI-enabled solutions for the wider People Technology organisation.

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We value diverse experiences and recognise there are many paths into engineering leadership. Even if you do not meet every requirement, we would still like to hear from you if you believe you would thrive in this role.

What You’ll Do

- Act as the engineering architect and design authority for People Technology, owning technical standards, patterns and architectural principles across Workday and connected enterprise systems.

- Shape the end-to-end engineering landscape and make architectural decisions that balance delivery speed, scalability, security, maintainability and long-term sustainability.

- Lead the evolution of the squad from a primarily integrations-focused team into a broader People Technology engineering capability.

- Drive adoption of modern Workday capabilities, including Workday Orchestrate, Extend, Build and future platform innovations.

- Establish AI engineering capability within the People Technology tribe and identify opportunities to apply AI, automation and intelligent workflows.

- Champion AI-assisted engineering practices that improve productivity, quality and delivery speed, while ensuring responsible security, privacy and governance.

- Lead, coach and performance-manage engineers, building capability across integrations, APIs, automation, low-code development and AI-enabled solutions.

- Plan and manage team capacity, resourcing and capability against current priorities and future demand.

- Act as the senior engineering business partner to People Technology leadership, Product Managers, Functional Leads and business stakeholders, shaping roadmaps, prioritisation and investment decisions.

- Translate business needs into scalable technical solutions, resolve complex engineering challenges and maintain oversight of technical debt, dependencies, risks and operational resilience.

About the role: What's in the Box

The Data Privacy team sits within the Order & Subscription Experience Tribe, part of the Consumer Alliance. The team is responsible for the systems and guardrails that let HelloFresh handle customer data responsibly at scale. Consent management, Data subject rights, Data retention and minimization, PII discovery and classification, and privacy-by-design tooling embedded into the Hellofresh flows that touch millions of customers globally.

As Engineering Manager, you'll lead a squad of product/backend engineers building and operating these systems, partner closely with a Product Manager & Stakeholders to translate regulatory and business requirements (GDPR, CCPA, and other regional privacy regulations) into a working roadmap, and stay technically engaged, reviewing architecture and code, joining incident & debugging sessions, without being the primary hands-on contributor.

What you’ll do: The Recipe

- Manage and grow a squad of data privacy, including hiring, performance management, and career development.

- Own the quarterly roadmap for data privacy in partnership with your Product Manager, balancing regulatory deadlines, risk reduction, and platform reliability.

- Drive execution on core privacy capabilities: consent and preference management, automated data subject request (DSAR) handling, data retention/deletion pipelines, and PII discovery/classification across Hellofresh domains & systems.

- Own operational health of privacy systems. SLAs, data deletion guarantees, audit trail completeness and run postmortems when things go wrong

- Partner with Legal, Security, Compliance, and other engineering tribes across the Hellofresh to ensure privacy requirements are embedded early in product and platform design, not bolted on afterward.

- Represent data privacy engineering in cross-tribe forums, managing stakeholder expectations and pushing back on off-roadmap requests when needed.

- Champion privacy-by-design practices and clear, accessible documentation across the org.

- Actively contribute to hiring and capacity planning, conduct regular code reviews, and mentor engineers.

- Drive a continuous improvement culture and promote the HelloFresh DNA.

What you’ll bring: The Ingredients

- Proven people-management experience: hiring, performance management, and developing engineers

- Experience leading a distributed or multi-location engineering team

- Deep experience building scalable microservices and event-driven systems (e.g., Kafka), especially where correctness, idempotency, and data consistency are critical.

- Experience designing and operating high-throughput backend systems that other teams and customer-facing surfaces depend on.

- Experience with DevOps practices and cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud), including observability and production ownership.

- A collaborative mindset and comfort working cross-functionally with product, frontend, and data partners.

- You are an empathetic, strong communicator and active listener.

- You are a self-organized individual who can operate autonomously, solve complex problems, and remove roadblocks.

- You are a humble leader who can motivate a team and drive them to their highest potential.

What we offer: The Toppings

- Global collaboration at scale: Collaborate with experienced engineers and product partners across HelloFresh's international teams, in a culture of active knowledge sharing.

- Technology with real-world impact: Build and operate modern systems at global scale, supporting 6+ millions of customers and complex supply chain operations.

- Technical/Product/Design leadership: Drive best practices and influence architecture/design, quality, and ways of working in an autonomous, product-led setup.

- End-to-end development/delivery: Drive decisions from problem definition to production, improving systems and enabling long-term scalability.

jobs.title: Senior Product Strategy Manager
jobs.description:
HelloFresh Ireland is in an exciting growth phase - expanding customer choice, deepening menu relevance, and driving long-term loyalty in a fast-growing market. As our Senior Product Manager, you will own the product space, driving impact across product strategy, product operations, and culinary workstreams. You will lead a talented, dedicated team and serve as the strategic engine behind what makes our boxes brilliant for Irish customers.

This is not a technology product role. You will work across the full physical product value chain and lifecycle - from ingredient sourcing and culinary development through to menu strategy, editorial execution, and customer experience - making decisions that directly impact what lands on our customers' doorsteps every week. You will need the ability to operate at pace, cut through complexity, and bring teams and stakeholders with you.

What You Will Be Doing:

- Strategic business planning: Reviewing product KPIs and guiding the team to improve the product offering - balancing short-term operations with long-term strategic direction, and owning the product investment calendar to increase retention while optimising for revenue and costs.

- Stakeholder Management: Collaborating and building strong relationships with Operations, Marketing, and international teams - being the voice of the physical product for HelloFresh Ireland, advising on coherent processes between functions, and ensuring a coordinated approach to product initiatives across local and global stakeholders.

- Process optimisation: Identifying opportunities to streamline, automate, and improve how we work - across teams and with key partners - and aligning operational improvements with the strategic direction.

- Analytical decision making: Working with the team to ensure access to the relevant information, analyses, and insights needed to make informed product development decisions and translate the product vision into action.

- Business case development: Developing business cases around physical product improvements and product-related processes (e.g. changes in product offering, tooling, and automations), and making data-led recommendations to Ireland and global teams.

- People management: Leading, developing and inspiring teams spanning Culinary, Physical Product Strategy, and Product Operations - setting clear strategic direction, cultivating a high-performing culture, and supporting each team member's growth across different career stages.
jobs.requirements_raw:

- Senior experience in product, category, or commercial - ideally food, FMCG, meal kits, or subscription.

jobs.title: Category Manager, Strategic Sourcing, Packaging
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced sourcing manager to join our Packaging Strategic Procurement team!

In this role, you will be responsible for developing and executing sourcing strategies to improve our cost structure, the quality of our products, the reliability of our supply chain, and will play a leading role in supporting innovation through new product development. You will have key responsibilities over SKU ideation and onboarding, vendor selection and relationships, price negotiations and contract management, budgetary planning and continuously improving our end-to-end sourcing process.

In this role, you will help drive the strategy and framework for how the business interacts with its supplier base and have a direct stake in affecting bottom line profitability.

You will...

- Take full ownership of assigned categories to develop and optimize our supply network.

- Refine and implement a sourcing and supply chain strategy for a selection of categories that optimizes process, reduces risk, and improves our cost structure

- Build and maintain a strong supplier base that align with our company values; own relationships with our strategic suppliers, including performance management and innovation activities

- Manage cost savings initiatives through our strategic sourcing process to ensure that we hit our targeted budget

- Leverage large internal datasets and industry benchmarks (including market, supplier, and SKU analysis) to drive continuous improvement, identify opportunities for cost reduction, and identify/implement best practices

- Develop a culture of continuous improvement, both internally and externally through data-driven reporting and effective project management to identify and drive opportunities for quality improvement and implement best practices

- Onboard new vendors and new SKUs to drive cost savings and improve customer experience

- Proactively manage quality specifications and potential issues that might impact ingredient standards

- Work with the Procurement Operations Team to set execution plans and develop best practices for tracking contract compliance by our vendors

You are…

- Data-driven – You can organize, explore, and synthesize unstructured data into actionable insights to better inform operational decision-making

- Intellectually curious – You have an insatiable desire to understand how and why things work, identify data-driven insights, and consistently challenge the status quo

- Detail-oriented – You possess strong organizational skills and demonstrate a methodical approach to your work

- A self-starter – You are highly motivated and passionate. You’re eager to take on new projects without knowing exactly what you will uncover

- Agile – You thrive in fast-paced and dynamic environments and are comfortable working autonomously

- A critical thinker – You use logic to identify opportunities, evaluate alternatives, and synthesize and present critical information to solve complex problems.

- An excellent communicator – You can explain complex (often technical) information to a variety of audiences

- Collaborative - You are prepared to work collaboratively across many different HelloFresh teams and functions

- A project manager - You have exceptional project and people management skills

You have...

- 3-5 years of relevant experience working with relevant industries in supply chain operations and strategic sourcing functions; or working in operations strategy focused management consulting

- 3+ years of packaging sourcing experience preferred

- Undergraduate degree preferred or equivalent relevant experience

- Fluent in Microsoft Office applications (especially Excel and Powerpoint) and Google Suite applications (especially Google sheets)

- Experience successfully leading large initiatives and sourcing events through strategic sourcing processes

You'll get...

- Box Discount - Amazing discounts on 1 box per week! 75% discount on weekly HelloFresh and Chefs Plate meal kits AND 50% off weekly Factor meal box.

- Health & Wellness - Health & Dental benefits from day 1, a Health Spending Account, unlimited access to the Headspace app to meet your self-care needs, and 25% discount on GoodLife fitness memberships!

- Vacation & PTO - Time off is also an important part of self-care! We offer generous vacation and PTO to help you create a good work-life balance.

- Family Benefits - A parental leave top-up program for expectant parents.

- Growth & Development - We support your career progression, provide development opportunities, and invest in your continued learning through our organization wide L&D fund.

- Work Hard & Have Fun - From team socials to engaging company days, you’ll have plenty of opportunity to experience the fun!

- Diversity & Inclusion Initiatives - With impactful ERG’s like FreshPride, Women Empowered and LIMES, we are committed to our diversity, equity & inclusion efforts.

- Food Puns - this one is kind of a big dill if you haven’t already noticed. We even have some punny meeting room names!

Flexible Hybrid Approach

At HelloFresh, we know that flexible work arrangements are essential in enabling you to do your best work, while balancing your personal and life needs. Offering remote work flexibility, along with the opportunity to interact and collaborate in the office are all a part of creating a great employee experience.

To meet these needs, we are pleased to provide Flexible Hybrid work. Flexible Hybrid is a people-first approach that is based on choice, trust, personalization, and empowers teams to choose when and how often they work from the office and work from home, in addition to team days and company days. This means a minimum of 2 days in office per week, with most teams in office between 2-3 days a week.

#LI-HYBRID

Working Conditions

It’s no surprise that as a food company, we use many ingredients that may be considered common allergens (i.e. peanuts, tree nuts, milk, etc.). Whether this role is based out of our headquarters or one of our distribution centers, it is possible that you may be exposed to such allergens in this role. If you have any concerns with being exposed to any particular food ingredients, including meat, please disclose this during the hiring process.

Toronto, ON Pay Range

$85,000—$100,000 CAD

jobs.title: Senior Staff Machine Learning Engineer, Menu Personalisation (m,f,x)
jobs.description:
About HelloFresh

At HelloFresh, we want to change the way people eat forever by offering our customers high-quality food and recipes for different meal occasions. Even after celebrating our 10-year anniversary, we continue to see this mission spread around the world and beyond our wildest dreams. Now, we are a global food solutions group and the world's leading meal kit company, active in 18 countries across 3 continents. So, how did we do it? Our weekly boxes full of exciting recipes and fresh ingredients have blossomed into a community of customers looking for delicious, healthy and sustainable options. The HelloFresh Group now includes our core brand, HelloFresh, as well as: Green Chef, EveryPlate, Chefs Plate, Factor_, YouFoodz, The Pets Table and GoodChop.

About the Team

Menu Personalization decides what millions of customers see when they open HelloFresh each week. The team owns the recommender systems that match customers to recipes across our global markets, and brings together Data Scientists, Backend Engineers, Data Engineers, ML Engineers, and Product to take ideas from experiment to production. The work directly shapes customer experience and business growth: when personalization gets better, customers find recipes they love faster, and HelloFresh becomes a stronger weekly habit.

At HelloFresh we are moving away from a model where software developers just execute tickets toward one where engineers are trusted to own customer problems. You take a problem, form a point of view, validate it with customers and data, and ship it using AI as a force multiplier.

About the Role

We are looking for a technical leader for the Menu Personalization ML systems, someone who owns the recommender stack that runs in production. You will set the direction for how we design, build, and operate the ML systems behind menu personalization, while staying hands-on across feature pipelines, training workflows, model serving, experimentation tooling, and the infrastructure underneath. The decisions you make here shape the platform for years, not quarters, and you will be expected to hold a point of view on where personalization at HelloFresh should go and to back it with data and user evidence. You will partner with Data Scientists to take models from notebook to production, with Data Engineers on features and pipelines, with Backend Engineers on online inference paths, and with Product on what to build next. Your influence will reach well beyond Menu Personalization: through the standards you set, the architectural decisions you make, the engineers you grow around you, and the company-wide initiatives you drive to advance ML and data engineering craft across HelloFresh.

What you'll do

- Set the technical direction for the ML systems behind menu personalization, owning the end-to-end stack: feature pipelines, training workflows, model serving, experimentation tooling, and infrastructure.

- Take research and experiments to reliable production systems, partnering with Data Scientists on services that meet real latency, scalability, and observability requirements.

- Shape the personalization roadmap with Product and Engineering leadership, backing your point of view with data and user evidence.

- Operate what you build, instrumenting and improving your systems in production because shipping is the beginning of the learning cycle, not the end of it.

- Raise the technical bar across the team through architecture reviews, mentorship, and the example you set on production ML craft.

- Shape long-term architecture and make platform decisions whose payoff plays out over years rather than quarters.

- Drive engineering excellence beyond Menu Personalization by setting standards other ML and data teams adopt.

- Sync with peers across HelloFresh on best practices and contribute to company-wide engineering initiatives that move the broader ML and data craft forward.
jobs.requirements_raw:
What you'll bring

- 8+ years building and operating production ML systems, with a track record of technical leadership at scale.

- Architectural decisions in your past that held up over multiple years and influenced teams beyond your own.

- Production experience with recommender systems or large-scale personalization is a strong plus.

- Fluency across our data and ML stack (Python, Spark) and our backend and platform stack (Go, Kafka, Kubernetes), with hands-on experience across pipelines, model serving, and observability at scale.

- Statistical literacy to design honest experiments and the judgment to know when a model is actually better versus when the metrics are lying to you.

- Operational judgment to diagnose system misbehavior, find root causes, and ship systems you can debug under real load.

- Hands-on experience with AI tooling (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) beyond casual experimentation; you use AI agents every day and have a practical sense of how the context you provide shapes output quality.

- Product sense: opinionated about what should be built and why, with the ability to back it with evidence and translate it into business value.

- A bias to ship; you take full ownership and finish the last twenty percent.

Let’s cut to the cheese, this is why you'll love it here

- Shape the future of food: Play a key role in transforming how millions of people eat as we grow into a global food solutions company.

- Drive transformational change: Your decisions will have a direct and immediate impact, helping to shape strategy, scale teams, and redefine leadership in a rapidly evolving business.

- Build a global brand: Create deeper, more sustainable connections with our customers, putting them at the heart of every decision.

- Benefit from long-term wealth creation: Your compensation is heavily weighted toward equity, directly aligning your personal success with the company's future through our Virtual Stock Option (VSO) and Restricted Stock Unit (RSU) plans.

- Thrive in a high-performance environment: Work with ambitious, intellectually curious peers on a global scale, enjoying an environment built for empowerment and speed.

- Enjoy a discount: on HelloFresh meal kits, delivered straight to your door.

jobs.title: Senior Product Analyst, Consumer Analytics
jobs.description:
Work with HelloFresh in Warsaw and its HelloTech organisation, HelloFresh’s global technology backbone with more than 1000 people, building the digital products that power our end-to-end food experience. From meal kits and ready-to-eat meals to specialty offerings like pet food and premium meat & seafood, HelloTech creates the platforms that bring tailored food solutions to millions of customers every month.

Our subscription-based, direct-to-consumer model relies on technology at every step, from customer-facing apps and personalization logic to pricing, forecasting, supply chain optimization, and initiatives that help reduce food waste. While our brands operate independently to serve distinct customer needs, they are united by shared platforms, data, and operational excellence built by HelloTech.

HelloTech works in autonomous, cross-functional alliances, each owning a specific product or domain end to end. By working with our Warsaw office, you will help shape scalable, data-driven products used across our markets, working with a modern tech stack and international teams to continuously improve how people discover, order, and enjoy HelloFresh’s products, today and in the future.

There is a requirement for a Senior Product Analyst with deep expertise in web and app analytics to support data-informed product and growth decisions across the organization. This engagement involves working with the analytics and reporting function, providing services globally across Berlin and New York City time zones.

The scope involves solving challenging business problems using digital product usage and customer data to create high-quality digital product experiences. Deliverables will drive user experience design, product development, and customer journey optimization. The provider will be responsible for professional-grade dashboarding and reporting for critical product and growth initiatives at the executive level.

What you’ll do: The Recipe

Partner with the Senior Product organization (Product, Software Engineering, UX leads) to support strategic priorities and evidence-based decision-making.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and define project objectives while utilizing project management skills to plan and execute data-driven tasks.
Design, implement, and analyze A/B tests and experiments to measure product feature impact and optimize user experiences.
Develop automated reporting and dashboards that facilitate data access and enable self-service analytics across the organization.
Build sophisticated analytics solutions to define KPI trees, design measurement frameworks, and track product performance across app and web platforms to identify opportunities for improvement.
Leverage AI and automation tools to increase efficiency in data analysis, reporting, and insight generation workflows.
Communicate complex data and statistical concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders to influence strategic decisions.

What you’ll bring: The Ingredients

- A BS or equivalent in business, computer science, mathematics, economics, statistics, engineering, or a relevant quantitative field.

- Expert-level proficiency with Google Analytics 4 (GA4) / Snowplow, including advanced configuration and custom event tracking; experience with Mixpanel/Amplitude.

- Advanced BigQuery experience, including complex SQL queries, query optimization, data modeling, and large-scale datasets.

- Advanced Python programming skills for data analysis, automation, and building analytical tools (pandas, numpy, etc.).

- Strong Excel skills including advanced formulas, pivot tables, and data visualization.

- Demonstrated track record of leveraging AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, etc.) to increase productivity in analytical tasks.

- Experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau, Looker, or Data Studio.

- Deep understanding of product analytics methodology, including Cookie/Event tracking, user behavior analysis, and experimentation design.

- Proficiency with descriptive and inferential statistics.

- Experience with dbt, Airflow, or other modern data stack tools preferred.

- Previous experience providing services to fast-paced product-led or consumer-facing technology companies.

- A minimum of 5 years’ experience analyzing complex data in a business context, with at least 3 years focused on product or web/app analytics.

- Proven ability to work independently and drive projects from ambiguous problem statements to actionable recommendations.

Above all, we are looking for individuals who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

- Technology with real-world impact: Build and operate modern systems at global scale, supporting 6+ millions of customers and complex supply chain operations.

- Technical/Product/Design leadership: Drive best practices and influence architecture/design, quality, and ways of working in an autonomous, product-led setup.

- End-to-end development/delivery: Drive decisions from problem definition to production, improving systems and enabling long-term scalability.

jobs.title: Asset Protection Manager
jobs.description:
At HelloFresh, we want to revolutionize the way we eat by making it more convenient and exciting to cook meals from scratch. We have offices and operations around the world and deliver delicious meals to millions of people.

We are an industry leader in meal-kit and ready-to-eat subscription services, with a diverse portfolio of brands designed to meet the needs of a wide range of customers.

We are seeking a Manager, Asset Protection – Cluster to lead Asset Protection, security, investigations, and risk mitigation across multiple sites within an assigned market or cluster. This role is responsible for establishing consistent Asset Protection standards, identifying and prioritizing risk, developing site-level capabilities, and partnering with operational leadership to protect our people, products, facilities, and assets.

This is a hands-on, multi-site leadership role requiring strong cross-functional partnership, the ability to operate across different facilities and business environments, and the ability to translate risk into practical solutions that improve security, reduce loss, and support operational performance.

What You Will Be Doing:

- Own Asset Protection strategy and execution across assigned sites, ensuring consistent standards while adapting to local risks.

- Conduct site visits, risk assessments, audits, and operational reviews to identify vulnerabilities and drive improvement plans.

- Lead complex investigations into theft, fraud, workplace incidents, policy violations, and other losses, ensuring proper documentation and evidence management.

- Lead, coach, and develop Asset Protection teams while providing guidance on investigations, incidents, and performance.

- Partner with Operations, HR, Safety, Legal, and site leadership to identify risks and implement practical solutions.

- Drive shrink and loss reduction through data analysis, trend identification, root-cause analysis, and targeted corrective actions.

- Oversee physical security programs, including guards, access control, CCTV, intrusion detection, and other security technologies.

- Lead crisis response, emergency preparedness, new site initiatives, and ongoing risk mitigation while maintaining strong relationships with law enforcement and external partners.
jobs.requirements_raw:
Who You Are:

- Strategic, risk-focused operator who prioritizes resources and translates strategy into practical site-level execution.

- Strong cross-functional partner who influences Operations, HR, Safety, Legal, and leadership through data, relationships, and sound judgment.

- Experienced multi-site leader who balances direct support with developing local ownership.

- People leader who coaches teams, drives accountability, and builds a high-performance culture.

- Results-driven and analytical, using data, metrics, and root-cause analysis to deliver measurable improvements.

- Adaptable and comfortable with ambiguity, building practical solutions in fast-changing environments.

- 5+ years of progressive experience in Asset Protection, Loss Prevention, Corporate Security, Investigations, or related fields, ideally across multiple locations and complex operational environments.

- Proven experience leading investigations, audits, risk assessments, security programs, physical security systems, and cross-functional initiatives, with strong communication skills and willingness to travel.

What you will get in return:

● 70% off HelloFresh or Green Chef boxes
● Company pension scheme
● Gym membership
● Bupa private medical insurance (including dental & family cover options)
● Mental health first aiders and an employee assistance programme
● Nursery support scheme
● Cycle to work scheme
● Group Life Assurance

Location: The Windmill, 1 Holme Lane, Spondon, Derby, DE21 7HW. This role also has travel to Germany.

To be considered for this role, you’ll need to have the independent right to work in the UK, as we're unfortunately unable to provide sponsorship at this time.

Hybrid Working Policy
We offer a hybrid working policy for eligible roles, allowing flexibility to work from home and in the office. For more details on eligibility and how this applies to the role you're applying for, please consult with your recruiter.
