jobs.title: Maintenance Technician I
jobs.description:
As a Maintenance Technician at Factor you will be responsible for the general maintenance and repairs of our building, grounds, and equipment. You will ensure that the facility is maintained at a high level, general cleaning is performed in a timely manner when needed, and safety standards are upheld.

Shift: Wednesday to Saturday - 5:00am to 3:30pm

You will…

- Maintain and repair complex machinery (conveyor system, HVAC equipment, scanners, automatic doors, Dock doors, etc.)

- Maintain and repair production equipment as needed.

- Monitor equipment and perform troubleshooting for problems and breakdowns.

- Maintain and repair facilities including basic carpentry, plumbing, and electrical systems.

- Provide recommendations to repair or replace poorly functioning equipment.

- Efficiently prioritize repair schedule to ensure an uninterrupted production schedule.

- Conduct regular facility inspections.

- Assist personnel as needed. Communicate regularly with personnel to ensure that repairs and maintenance needs are met and coordinated with production schedules.

- Keep management informed of area activities and of significant concerns. Report major concerns or significant problems.

You are...

- Mechanically-inclined: you’ve always had a knack for fixing things and a natural curiosity about how things work; you enjoy taking things apart only to put them back together and are extremely comfortable handling tools and materials

- Programmatic: you’re able to identify the system component that is causing the error, as well as the options available for resolving it and completing the task.

- Bold: you’re adventurous and have a true entrepreneurial spirit; you’re not afraid to take calculated risks and constantly challenge the status quo

- Agile: you roll with the punches and don’t get overwhelmed easily; you have a track record of adapting quickly and driving results in fast-paced, hyper-growth environments

- Problem-solver: you’re a critical thinker who uses logic to identify alternatives, evaluate, and present approaches to solving complex problems while thinking in terms of contingency plans

You have...

- 1+ years general maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair experience within manufacturing/production plant

- High school diploma or GED required, some college preferred

- Qualified to handle electrical components, controls, and HVAC

- Ability to read and interpret blueprints, manuals, and schematics

- Strong mechanical and technical maintenance; able to operate power tools, PIT equipment, and service basic mechanical devices and functions safely and effectively

- Versed in GMP/TPM/LEAN/OSHA with strong continuous improvement and project management

- Exposure to ammonia, refrigeration, and/or PSM compliance systems

- Comfortable working in cold environments with some areas of facility at 40⠁F

- Efficient Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Power Point) and Google app (Gmail, drive, sheets, etc.)

- Ability to work nights, weekends and/or holidays

- Must be able to read, write and speak English.

You'll get...

- Competitive hourly rate, 401K company match that vests immediately upon participation

- Generous PTO and additional sick leave

- Comprehensive health and wellness benefits with options at $0 monthly, effective first day of employment

- Up to 85% discount on subscriptions to HelloFresh meal plans (HelloFresh, Green Chef, Everyplate, and Factor_)

- Access to Employee Resource Groups that are open to all employees, including those pertaining to BIPOC, women, veterans, parents, and LGBTQ+

- Inclusive, collaborative, and dynamic work environment within a fast-paced, mission-driven company that is disrupting the traditional food supply chain

This job description is intended to provide a general overview of the responsibilities. However, the Company reserves the right to adjust, modify, or reassign work tasks and responsibilities as needed to meet changing business needs, operational requirements, or other factors.

jobs.title: Senior Regulatory Compliance Specialist
jobs.description:
Senior Regulatory Compliance Specialist

Job Description

The Senior Regulatory Compliance Specialist supports regulatory compliance across HelloFresh’s Meal Kit and Factor businesses, ensuring products, ingredients, labels, and menu information meet applicable regulatory requirements and internal standards. This role works closely with cross-functional partners to review regulatory information, identify and resolve compliance risks, and support accurate and timely execution in a fast-paced environment.

The position plays an important role in providing regulatory coverage across the business, including Thursday–Monday support for menu changes, ingredient substitutions, labeling updates, and other time-sensitive regulatory needs.

What You’ll Do

-

Review and approve regulatory and labeling information for HelloFresh Meal Kit and Factor products.

-

Support Factor labeling updates and changes, ensuring ingredient statements, allergen declarations, Nutrition Facts, claims, and other required information are accurate and compliant.

-

Review Meal Kit menus, recipes, ingredients, and substitutions for regulatory compliance, including time-sensitive changes that occur later in the week or over the weekend.

-

Evaluate products and ingredients against applicable U.S. regulatory requirements and escalate potential compliance risks when appropriate.

-

Review ingredient specifications, supplier documentation, product information, and supporting regulatory documentation for accuracy and completeness.

-

Partner cross-functionally with Product, Culinary, Procurement, FSQA, Operations, and other stakeholders to resolve regulatory questions and support business needs.

-

Support new product, ingredient, and menu launches by ensuring regulatory requirements are identified and addressed prior to implementation.

-

Maintain accurate regulatory documentation and records to support compliance, traceability, and audit readiness.

-

Provide guidance to internal stakeholders regarding labeling, allergens, claims, ingredient declarations, and other regulatory requirements.

-

Identify opportunities to improve regulatory processes, documentation, workflows, and tools to increase accuracy and efficiency.

-

Provide regulatory support and escalation coverage Thursday through Monday to ensure time-sensitive menu, labeling, ingredient, and substitution issues are addressed quickly and appropriately.
jobs.requirements_raw:
What You’ll Bring

-

3+ years of relevant experience in food regulatory affairs, food labeling, food safety, or a related field.

-

Bachelor’s degree in Food Science, Nutrition, Biological Science, or a related discipline preferred but not required. In lieu of a degree, 3 years of relevant food safety or regulatory experience will be considered.

-

Working knowledge of U.S. FDA and USDA food labeling and regulatory requirements.

-

Experience reviewing Nutrition Facts panels, ingredient statements, allergen declarations, claims, and other food labeling information.

-

Experience interpreting ingredient specifications and regulatory documentation and translating requirements into actionable guidance for business partners.

-

Knowledge of Canadian food labeling and regulatory requirements is an asset.

-

Experience working with labeling, specification, regulatory data, or related software systems.

-

Strong analytical skills and exceptional attention to detail, with the ability to identify potential compliance risks and determine appropriate next steps.

-

Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain regulatory requirements clearly to non-regulatory stakeholders.

-

Ability to manage multiple priorities and respond effectively to changing business needs in a fast-paced environment.

-

Strong cross-functional collaboration and problem-solving skills.

-

Ability to work a Thursday–Monday schedule to provide regulatory support during critical business coverage periods.

Location: United States or Canada
Schedule: Thursday–Monday, with an 8:00, 9:00, or 10:00 AM start time

jobs.title: Supply Chain Planning Working Student (all genders)
jobs.description:
Your role

We are looking for a Supply Chain planning working student for 12 months at the heart of our Product team, where you will be responsible for supporting our operational and strategic needs for our physical product: meal kits. You will be central to our activity and will have a significant influence on our customers' meals.

We are looking for someone capable of assisting us in the operational planning of recipes at HelloFresh. This is a unique opportunity to learn and gain experience within a fast-growing company that is pioneering the food industry.

If you want to be a driving force in the growth of a scale-up, then this position is for you!

Your area of responsibility

- Menu creation and optimization: Assist the team in creating and optimizing menus using our python-based menu-planning algorithm.

- Product Improvement: You will work on several projects and initiatives that focus on improving our product offering aiming to increase customer satisfaction.

- Menu De-Risking: You will lead a number of cross-collaborative initiatives and processes aiming to reduce the menu risk and to ensure ingredient availability by considering the end-to-end value chain of our product.

- Operations support: You support the team in day-to-day operations as well as with administrative and organizational tasks along the supply and menu planning process and have the opportunity to solve concrete problems, make decisions, and learn to manage real-world situations in a dynamic environment.

- Process management: You will participate in projects aimed at optimizing and automating and improving our product processes and supply chain by working with other teams.

- Reporting: You will track the weekly performance of menus and recipes, and conduct analyses on their monthly/quarterly performance.

- Recipe change management in menus: You will select alternative recipes when needed (ingredient shortage, marketing need, etc.).

- Recipe & Ingredient Pool management: You will contribute to the maintenance of the recipe and ingredient database in alignment with the culinary teams.

- Customization: You will support the expansion of our product offering by uploading and managing customized menu options to provide customers with greater choice.

- Excellent command of Excel; knowledge of SQL and Python is a real plus.

- A hands-on mindset and team spirit, which is very important as you will be working with many different people and teams.

- Fluency in English, German is a plus.

- Strong organizational skills, rigor, and great attention to detail.

- A proactive and ambitious mindset, with a desire to be part of a particularly dynamic business.

- Enthusiasm for the world of food and an interest in data are real assets for this job.

jobs.title: Site QA/QC Specialist (f/m/x)
jobs.description:
The role: What's in the Box

We are looking for a Site QA/QC Specialist to join our dynamic, fast-growing team in Bleiswijk. As a key member of the Food Safety & Quality Assurance (FSQA) department, you will drive the initiatives that define the quality of every HelloFresh box.

You will be on the front lines of our fulfillment center, optimizing daily processes and partnering closely with operational teams to ensure a gold standard of quality for our customers. When challenges arise or unannounced audits occur, you are the expert who steps forward to ensure compliance and maintain our high operational momentum.

What you’ll do: The Recipe

- Quality Management Ownership: Act as the primary driver of the Quality Management System (QMS), ensuring the site remains compliant with all internal standards and external regulations.

- Process Optimization: Design, implement, and refine internal quality processes to bridge the gap between high-speed operations and flawless food safety.

- Operational Partnership: Work side-by-side with production and logistics teams to embed a "quality-first" mindset and optimize daily fulfillment workflows.

- Audit Leadership: Take a leading role in conducting internal audits and GMP rounds, while serving as the key point of contact for supervising external and unannounced audits.

- Continuous Improvement Projects: Collaborate with the wider Site Quality team to spearhead strategic projects that drive the evolution of the HelloFresh box.

- Quality Feedback Loop: Manage the investigation and follow-up for supplier non-conformities and consumer complaints, turning feedback into actionable site improvements.

What you’ll bring: The Ingredients

- 2-5 years work experience in a quality function within the food industry.

- You are accurate and goal oriented.

- You are able to present in a fast-paced and continuously changing work environment.

- You enjoy working with other teams.

- You have experience with quality systems such as IFS, BRC or FSSC22000.

- You are fluent in English and Dutch (must).

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. There are many different ways of developing skills, and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

Are you the missing ingredient? If this sounds like a tasty opportunity, we’d be excited to hear from you. We aim to review your profile and respond within 5 business days.

What we offer: The Toppings

Compensation & Financial Wellbeing

- Enjoy 20% off HelloFresh and 40% off Factor_ subscriptions.

- Access the "Benefits at Work" platform for discounts on brands like Nike, Bol.com, and IKEA.

- You'll receive a HelloFresh laptop and, if necessary for your position, a phone.

- Build your future with a pension plan through Aegon Cappital (age-based rates, 50/50 split).

Health & Wellbeing

- Receive a 7,5% discount on additional health insurance at Zilveren Kruis (2026), plus free access to Headspace and OpenUp.

- Get discounts on ClassPass and gym memberships via Bedrijfsfitness Nederland.

Flexibility & Work-Life

- Benefit from a flexible hybrid work setup with a €2.40 daily remote work allowance.

- Start with 24 days of annual leave (pro-rata), plus one additional day per year of service (up to 30 days total).

- Full reimbursement for 2nd-class public transport to the office, and €0.23 per km for car/bicycle travel.

Career & Development

- Access internal/external opportunities aligned with our Job Framework, and join our cross-market mentoring program.

- A dedicated annual budget to help you keep learning, developing new skills, and growing your career.

Culture & Environment

- Enjoy fresh homemade lunches in the office (€20/month), weekly vrij-mi-bo (Friday drinks), quarterly strategy sessions, and team events.

About HelloFresh

HelloFresh is on a mission to change the way people eat, forever!

Since our 2011 founding in Europe’s vibrant tech hub, Berlin, we’ve become the world's leading meal kit provider, delivering to over 4.2 million households worldwide in 15 countries across 3 continents.

jobs.title: Data Engineer, Operations Technology (all genders)
jobs.description:
Work with HelloFresh in Warsaw and its HelloTech organisation, HelloFresh’s global technology backbone with more than 1000 people, building the digital products that power our end-to-end food experience. From meal kits and ready-to-eat meals to specialty offerings like pet food and premium meat & seafood, HelloTech creates the platforms that bring tailored food solutions to millions of customers every month.

Our subscription-based, direct-to-consumer model relies on technology at every step, from customer-facing apps and personalization logic to pricing, forecasting, supply chain optimization, and initiatives that help reduce food waste. While our brands operate independently to serve distinct customer needs, they are united by shared platforms, data, and operational excellence built by HelloTech.

HelloTech works in autonomous, cross-functional alliances, each owning a specific product or domain end to end. By working with our Warsaw office, you will help shape scalable, data-driven products used across our markets, working with a modern tech stack and international teams to continuously improve how people discover, order, and enjoy HelloFresh’s products, today and in the future.

About the Team

The Supply Chain Data Engineering team powers the end-to-end operational backbone of HelloFresh across our global markets. Our core mission is to harmonize supply chain data to enable seamless, data-driven decision-making across enterprise domains - including menu planning, procurement, fulfillment, logistics. We build, scale, and maintain the foundational data assets that power critical operational processes and telemetry. Bringing together Data Engineers, Data Scientists, Operations Analysts, and Product Managers, our autonomous, cross-functional team transforms massive operational data streams into actionable intelligence to optimize forecasting, logistics, kitting, inventory, minimize food waste, and ensure the timely delivery of fresh ingredients to millions of customers worldwide.

About the Role: What's in the Box

As a Data Engineer in Supply Chain Operations, you will take technical ownership of the end-to-end data lifecycle—spanning system architecture, pipeline design, production development, and continuous operations. You will build and scale high-throughput batch and real-time streaming data pipelines that harmonize data streams across menu planning, forecasting, procurement, fulfillment and logistics.

In this role, you play a critical part in driving operational efficiency, cost optimization, and supply chain scalability by ensuring our global data infrastructure is performant, resilient, and mission-critical. Partnering closely with Data Scientists, Operations Analysts, and SCM stakeholders, you will model complex physical domain entities and engineer robust data assets that power real-time tracking, analytics, and automated decision-making across HelloFresh's operational business process.

What You'll Do: The Recipe

- Become an integral part of a high-impact engineering team supporting global supply chain, procurement, and logistics operations.

- Design, build, and maintain robust batch and streaming data pipelines connecting procurement systems, warehouse management systems (WMS), and logistics networks.

- Model complex supply chain domains—including recipe component sourcing, inventory turnover, fulfillment batching, and route optimization—into clean, scalable analytical datasets.

- Develop real-time data integrations for tracking ingredient inventory levels, order assembly status, and carrier shipment tracking across distribution centers.

- Partner with Data Scientists and Operations Analysts to operationalize demand forecasting models, waste reduction algorithms, and safety stock optimizations.

- Ensure high data quality, freshness, and lineage tracking for operational dashboards, executive KPIs, and automated logistics alerts.

- Work with modern cloud data technologies such as AWS (S3, EMR, Glue, Redshift), Apache Spark/PySpark, Kafka, Airflow, Snowflake, and Databricks.

- Collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders in Procurement, Fulfillment Operations, Logistics, and Product to turn physical workflow requirements into data infrastructure.

- Contribute to a collaborative and knowledge-sharing environment, providing technical guidance and coaching to team members and stakeholders.

- Work beyond your specialization when the problem demands it. Your specialization is your anchor, not your boundary.

- Operate what you build. You instrument, monitor, and improve your systems in production. Shipping is the beginning of the learning cycle, not the end.

What You'll Bring: The Ingredients

- Hands-on experience working with AI tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) beyond casual experimentation. You use AI agents every day. You have a practical sense of how the context you provide to AI tools shapes output quality, and how to set boundaries on AI-generated work.

- Proven track record of scientific or engineering work (Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD) in computer science, software engineering or related field.

- 3+ years of work experience as a Data Engineer, including delivery of production data.

- Fluency in Python, SQL, and PySpark for building scalable ETL/ELT data pipelines on a modern cloud data infrastructure.

- Strong data modeling expertise (dimensional modeling, relational architecture, event-driven data streams) applied to physical supply chain or logistics operations.

- Experience with software development practices and tools such as Git, CI/CD, Docker, and AWS.

- Exceptional communication capabilities to bridge technical implementation details with warehouse operators, logistics planners, and business stakeholders.

- You take full ownership. You have a bias to ship. You finish the last twenty percent.

- You have product sense and are opinionated about what should be built and why, and you can back that opinion with data and user evidence.

What we offer: The Toppings

- Global collaboration at scale: Collaborate with experienced engineers and product partners across HelloTech’s international teams, in a culture of active knowledge sharing.

- Technology with real-world impact: Build and operate modern systems at global scale, supporting 6+ millions of customers and complex supply chain operations.

- Technical/Product/Design leadership: Drive best practices and influence architecture/design, quality, and ways of working in an autonomous, product-led setup.

- End-to-end development/delivery: Drive decisions from problem definition to production, improving systems and enabling long-term scalability.

- Access to workspace at Warsaw Centre Point. The hub offers modern facilities including showers, breakout zones, outdoor space, cycle parking, and refreshments (coffee, soft drinks, and fruit).

Are you the missing ingredient? If this sounds like a tasty opportunity, we’d be excited to hear from you. We aim to review your profile and respond within 5 business days.

jobs.description:
Work with HelloFresh in Warsaw and its HelloTech organisation, HelloFresh’s global technology backbone with more than 1000 people, building the digital products that power our end-to-end food experience. From meal kits and ready-to-eat meals to specialty offerings like pet food and premium meat & seafood, HelloTech creates the platforms that bring tailored food solutions to millions of customers every month.

Our subscription-based, direct-to-consumer model relies on technology at every step, from customer-facing apps and personalization logic to pricing, forecasting, supply chain optimization, and initiatives that help reduce food waste. While our brands operate independently to serve distinct customer needs, they are united by shared platforms, data, and operational excellence built by HelloTech.

HelloTech works in autonomous, cross-functional alliances, each owning a specific product or domain end to end. By working with our Warsaw office, you will help shape scalable, data-driven products used across our markets, working with a modern tech stack and international teams to continuously improve how people discover, order, and enjoy HelloFresh’s products, today and in the future.

About the role: What's in the Box

Our HelloTech organisation is HelloFresh Group's global technology backbone — more than 1,000 people building the digital products and internal platforms that power our end-to-end food experience. As part of the IT team in Warsaw, you'll be the go-to person for keeping our Google Workspace environment running smoothly for employees across the Group.

You'll act as the escalation point for tricky Workspace issues, help colleagues get the most out of the tools they use every day (including the AI features built into Workspace), and continuously look for ways to make support faster and more self-service.

What You'll Do: The Recipe

- Serve as the primary escalation point for L2 Google Workspace queries — Gmail, Drive, Calendar, Sites, Meet, and related core services.

- Troubleshoot and resolve complex, non-standard user issues, ensuring fast and clear communication back to the requester.

- Support employees in adopting Gemini for Google Workspace — answering questions, sharing best practices, and helping teams get productivity value out of AI-assisted features in Gmail, Docs, Slides, and Meet.

- Handle day-to-day data support tasks: restoring files and folders, and transferring file ownership when employees leave or change teams.

- Analyse recurring ticket trends and propose improvements to support processes, SOPs, and self-service documentation.

- Write and maintain clear internal documentation and knowledge base articles for both end users and fellow IT staff.

- Liaise with Google support and other third-party vendors on issues that need escalation beyond L2.

What You'll Bring: The Ingredients

Hard skills

- 2-4+ years of hands-on experience administering Google Workspace in a production environment, ideally at mid-level scope.

- Strong working knowledge of Google Workspace's core apps (Gmail, Drive, Calendar, Sites, Meet) and their admin-side configuration, sharing settings, and IAM controls.

- Practical experience with user- and group-level administration — provisioning, org units, and account lifecycle management.

- Working understanding of email fundamentals: DNS records (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), routing, and IMAP/SMTP concepts.

- Professional Google Workspace Administrator Certification (required).

- Genuine interest in and hands-on familiarity with Gemini and other AI features in Google Workspace — you're comfortable exploring new AI tooling and helping others adopt it.

Soft skills

- Advanced Problem-Solving: Demonstrates strong analytical skills to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues effectively.

- Excellent Communication: Fluent in English with the ability to explain complex technical information clearly and concisely to non-technical audiences.

- Strong Collaboration: Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams, including developers, product managers, and other IT personnel.

- Time Management: Proven ability to manage time effectively, prioritizing tasks based on urgency and business impact.

What We Offer: The Toppings

- Global collaboration at scale: Collaborate with experienced engineers and product partners across HelloTech's international teams, in a culture of active knowledge sharing.

- Technology with real-world impact: Build and operate modern systems at global scale, supporting 6+ millions of customers and complex supply chain operations.

- Technical/Product/Design leadership: Drive best practices and influence architecture/design, quality, and ways of working in an autonomous, product-led setup.

- End-to-end development/delivery: Drive decisions from problem definition to production, improving systems and enabling long-term scalability.

- Access to workspace at Warsaw centre. The hub offers modern facilities including showers, breakout zones, outdoor space, cycle parking, and refreshments (coffee, soft drinks, and fruit).

jobs.title: Warehouse Associate
jobs.description:
The Warehouse Associate receives in product for day’s production, checks environmental condition of delivery trucks to ensure they are up to HelloFresh standards, processes BOL’s (Bill of Lading) and PO’s. The Warehouse Associate also picks product from inventory as needed, delivers items to appropriate production area and makes adjustments in computer. The Warehouse Associate prepares completed product for transport by outside carriers.

Shift: Thursday to Sunday - 7:00pm-5:30am

You will ...

- Operate lift trucks or hand trucks to convey, move or hoist materials to proper departments or areas in a safe and timely manner.

- Process received goods and supplies to be used in or to aid in the production/storage of goods destined for sale to our customer base.

- Ensure the accuracy, quality, and safety of received goods by following the company’s defined procedures to inspect both the truck and materials

- Report defective materials or questionable conditions to the department supervisor.

- Assist in the shipping and warehouse areas as needed

- Report food safety and quality problems to personnel with authority to initiate action

- Enforce and follow all safety, GMP and SQF policies/procedures.

- Ensure the accuracy, quality, and safety of received goods by following the company’s defined procedures to ensure FIFO protocols are followed.

- Ensure the proper stocking of all production materials needed for the production line on a daily basis.

- Shrink wraps pallets either manually or utilizing automation in preparation of shipment.

- Responsible for keeping an adequate supply of shipping materials on hand at all times.

- Reports defective materials or questionable conditions to the department supervisor.

- Report food safety and quality problems to personnel with authority to initiate action

You are...

- Able to work in a fast paced environment.

- Are able to use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects and/or tools.

- Able to regularly lift and move up to 25 pounds, and occasionally lift and move up to 50 pounds with or without assistance.

- Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and peripheral vision.

- Able to communicate, both verbally and in writing in English, effectively and professionally with employees at all levels of the organization.

- Are able stand, walk, stoop, reach and lift for a minimum of 10 to 12 hours with or without reasonable accommodation.

- Able to work in a cold prep area kept at 35 degrees

At a minimum, you have…

- Ability to read and write English, follow verbal instructions and use simple math.

- Licensed forklift truck operator, preferable Crown or Raymond stand-up lift.

- Additional Eligibility Qualifications

- Must be at least 18 years old.

- Must be able to count and have basic math skills (addition, subtraction, multiplication, division and fractions).

- Basic computer skills preferred

- Highschool diploma or GED

You’ll get…

- Competitive hourly rate, 401K company match that vests immediately upon participation

- Generous PTO and additional sick leave

- Comprehensive health and wellness benefits with options at $0 monthly, effective first day of employment

- Up to 85% discount on subscriptions to HelloFresh meal plans (HelloFresh, Green Chef, Everyplate, and Factor_)

- Access to Employee Resource Groups that are open to all employees, including those pertaining to BIPOC, women, veterans, parents, and LGBTQ+

- Inclusive, collaborative, and dynamic work environment within a fast-paced, mission-driven company that is disrupting the traditional food supply chain

This job description is intended to provide a general overview of the responsibilities. However, the Company reserves the right to adjust, modify, or reassign work tasks and responsibilities as needed to meet changing business needs, operational requirements, or other factors.

Our company is committed to fair hiring practices and complies with all applicable laws, including the Colorado Job Application Fairness Act (JAFA). In accordance with JAFA, we will not request your age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution on your initial application for employment.

When submitting supporting documents such as a resume, curriculum vitae (CV), or educational transcripts, you may voluntarily redact or omit any information that would identify your age. This includes:

- Dates of birth

- Dates of attendance at educational institutions

- Dates of graduation 

Your decision to redact this information will not adversely affect the consideration of your application. We evaluate all candidates based on their skills, qualifications, and experience. Please be aware that should you receive a conditional offer of employment, we may be required to request this information for legally permissible purposes, such as verifying eligibility for employment or for benefits administration and background checks.

Colorado Pay Range

$18.25—$18.25 USD

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer [GROWTH]
jobs.description:
Senior Data Engineer

This is a Hybrid position to our Toronto HelloFresh Headquarters

The role

The position is part of the Growth Alliance, which has the mission to empower the HelloFresh business to convince more customers to try, recommend, or return to our products. Within Growth, the Customer Value Optimization Tribe maximizes long-term customer value by optimizing pricing, personalizing benefits, forecasting customer value (CLV), and creating compelling incentives that drive retention and revenue growth

Our Data Engineers assume development and operational responsibility for the HelloFresh Platform that enables serving millions of customers globally by providing the best & efficient experience for our customers and internal users.

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What you’ll do

- Take ownership of the end-to-end process, including architecture, design, development, deployment, and operations of data pipelines, applying DevOps practices, pair programming, and other cutting-edge methodologies.

- Be active, solution-oriented member of autonomous, cross-functional agile teams collaborating with Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, Product Owners, Back-end Engineers, Front-end Engineers, Product Analysts, and Business Intelligence teams

- Demonstrate an in-depth understanding of HelloFresh’s core product and architecture, and act as ambassador for software/data solutions offering support and mentorship to colleagues

- Work with state-of-the-art technologies like AWS (EMR, Glue, s3, etc), Kafka, PySpark, Kubernetes, Airflow, Prefect, Tecton, Databricks, as well as our in-house Data Pipeline tools

- Leverage Claude Code and other AI tools as productivity multipliers
jobs.requirements_raw:
What you’ll bring

- Solid data engineering experience with the ability to design, implement, and deliver maintainable, high-quality code in Python and SQL

- Hands-on experience with cloud computing and data processing technologies, including PySpark, Kubernetes, Kafka

- Expertise in data modeling, relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL), object stores (e.g., AWS S3), data platforms (Databricks)

- Proven expertise in making efficient and robust data pipelines, including optimizing their performance

- Passion for leveraging AI tools to streamline collaboration and execution

- Passion for data quality assurance, data monitoring

- Expertise in end-to-end development processes, including unit, integration & functional testing, application tuning/profiling, and continuous integration

- Extensive experience with agile methodologies, with a strong focus on delivery, lean thinking, and quick iterations

- Ability to continuously develop yourself and learn from your peers

- Ability to collaborate and mentor team members, while also sharing practical knowledge and trends

- Familiarity with e-commerce and subscription-based businesses is a plus

Interacting with back-end developers, front-end developers, product analysts, product managers and other teams around the world is very much part of our day-to-day, so communication skills are vital. We are looking for strong problem-solvers who can apply their engineering skills to a wide range of platforms and environments, while also acting as an ambassador to coach team members and stakeholders.

Let’s cut to the cheese, this is why you'll love it here

- Box Discount - Amazing discounts on 1 box per week! 75% discount on weekly HelloFresh and Chefs Plate meal kits AND 50% off weekly Factor meal box.

- Health & Wellness - Health & Dental benefits from day 1, a Health Spending Account, unlimited access to the Headspace app to meet your self-care needs, and 25% discount on GoodLife fitness memberships!

- RRSP Matching - Competitive RRSP matching program offered

- Vacation & PTO - Time off is also an important part of self-care! We offer generous vacation and PTO to help you create a good work-life balance.

- Family Benefits - A parental leave top-up program for expectant parents.

- Growth & Development - We support your career progression and invest in your continued learning through experiences and initiatives owned by our dedicated L&D team

- Work Hard & Have Fun - From team socials to engaging company days, you’ll have plenty of opportunity to experience the fun!

- Diversity & Inclusion Initiatives - With impactful ERG’s like FreshPride, Women Empowered and LIMES, we are committed to our diversity, equity & inclusion efforts.

- Food Puns - this one is kind of a big dill if you haven’t already noticed. We even have some punny meeting room names!

Flexible Hybrid Approach

At HelloFresh, we know that flexible work arrangements are essential in enabling you to do your best work, while balancing your personal and life needs. Offering remote work flexibility, along with the opportunity to interact and collaborate in the office are all a part of creating a great employee experience.

To meet these needs, we are pleased to provide Flexible Hybrid work. Flexible Hybrid is a people-first approach that is based on choice, trust, personalization, and empowers teams to choose when and how often they work from the office and work from home, in addition to team days and company days. This means a minimum of 2 days in office per week, with most teams in office between 2-3 days a week.

#LI-HYBRID

HelloFresh Canada uses AI-integrated technology to help us process and evaluate applications more efficiently. This includes tools that screen and assess candidate qualifications based on the requirements for this role. While these tools assist our workflow, all final selection decisions are made by our hiring team.

This is a posting for an existing vacancy. We are actively seeking to fill this position.

Toronto, ON Pay Range

$170,000—$180,000 CAD

jobs.title: Manager, Performance Creative Strategy
jobs.description:
HelloFresh is seeking an entrepreneurial, strategic, and analytical Creative Strategy Manager to join our Performance and Innovation Team. This role reports to the Head of Creative Production and will partner closely with the Brand Creative team and Growth Marketing teams.

Our Performance Innovation team is an entrepreneurial creative studio focused on delivering a high output of creative assets for our growth partners. You will need to love working in a fast paced environment and enjoy finding creative solutions to drive performance across paid digital channels including Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Google etc.

You will be responsible for working collaboratively with the growth team and the creative performance innovation team to build end-to-end strategy, testing, and creative management to drive results. The ideal candidate will be ready to react to growth briefs by applying data-driven insights and creative solutions for channels, collaborate with the creative team on static + video concepts, ensure brand guidelines are adhered to throughout creative production. You’ll be able to quickly react to data and guide the creative team on producing more conversion driving assets.

You will …

- Partner with Growth teams and GM teams to build strategic creative briefs that drive conversions on paid channels

- Bring learnings and insights to every project to ensure we are delivering best in class creative

- Identify key creative testing opportunities and brief in assets that align with testing goals

- Have a deep understanding of what performs and what does not, and an ongoing push to unlock new growth via paid channels in partnership with product marketing and growth marketing.

- Collaborate closely with the creative team to develop high-quality, compelling content that drives user engagement, conversion, and measurable results

- Monitor and analyze the performance of Performance and Innovation assets, using data-driven to identify areas for optimization and improvement

- Share performance insights and next steps regularly with marketing leadership and creative partners

- Strong collaboration skills with experience working across various functions (e.g., marketing, product, engineering, data) to drive incremental performance across channels

- Stay informed about industry trends, platform updates, and emerging technologies to incorporate innovative techniques that enhance campaign performance

You are…

- Someone with a contagious “can-do” attitude that thrives in fast-paced environments

- Passionate about owning projects from start to finish

- Comfortable leading through ambiguity and digging into the details to solve

- Exceptional with communication skills, both written and verbal

- Fluent in paid social media channels and growth marketing

At a minimum, you have...

- Bachelor's degree in Advertising, Business, Marketing, Communications, or equivalent required

- 5-7 years of creative strategy / marketing experience ideally at a start-up; specifically, on a team that handles high volume of output, and drives results for a fast growing business

- Experience writing creative briefs and providing thoughtful feedback for marketing assets

- Excellent interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills

- Experience in planning and executing marketing campaigns from start to finish

You'll get...

- Competitive Salary & 401k company match that vests immediately upon participation

- Flexible Spending Account (FSA)

- Pre-tax commuter benefits

- Generous parental leave of 16 weeks, PTO, and Holidays

- $0 monthly premium and other flexible health plans effective first day of employment

- 85% discount on your subscription to HelloFresh (as well as other product initiatives)

- 15% discount on friends & family meal kit subscriptions

- In-office snacks, weekly catered lunches, and fun events

- Company-sponsored outings & Employee Resource Groups

- Collaborative, dynamic work environment within a fast-paced, mission-driven company

This job description is intended to provide a general overview of the responsibilities. However, the Company reserves the right to adjust, modify, or reassign work tasks and responsibilities as needed to meet changing business needs, operational requirements, or other factors.

New York Pay Range

$101,430—$138,000 USD

jobs.title: Lead, Photography (x/f/m)
jobs.description:
The role

As a Lead Photographer in the HelloFresh Studio, you are part of our Photography team, working across food, product, lifestyle, and marketing productions. You are first and foremost an exceptional photographer with deep technical and visual expertise, setting the benchmark for photographic quality, craft, and production excellence across the Studio.

You lead through expertise, influence, and example, helping elevate the capabilities of the photography team while maintaining high standards across large-scale asset production. You play a key role in developing photographic talent, evolving ways of working, and driving continuous improvement.

You collaborate closely with Producers, Styling, Culinary, Post-production, and Creative teams to deliver high-quality and scalable visual production across multiple brands. You stay up to date with industry developments and actively support AI direction, experimentation, and content generation initiatives within the Studio and broader organization, helping translate new technologies into practical production workflows.

What you’ll do

- Lead by example and continuously raise the bar for photographic quality and execution across the Studio

- Execute and oversee food, product, lifestyle, and marketing photography to the highest commercial standards

- Coach, mentor, and support photographers through feedback, knowledge sharing, and hands-on guidance to elevate overall team capability

- Define, maintain, and continuously improve photographic standards, shooting guidelines, and best practices

- Work together with Studio leadership to improve production quality, studio efficiency, and scalable ways of working

- Collaborate closely with Art Direction, Styling, Culinary, Post-production, and Creative teams to ensure strong and consistent visual execution

- Support complex productions and solve creative and technical and production challenges on set

- Drive consistency across large asset volumes while maintaining visual excellence and operational efficiency

- Actively contribute to Studio and company AI initiatives by supporting experimentation, developing practical use cases, and helping integrate AI-supported and hybrid content creation workflows

- Act as a trusted expert and escalation point for photographic quality, technical decision-making, and production excellence
jobs.requirements_raw:
What you’ll bring

- You are a seasoned photography professional with 7+ years of experience in commercial photography, ideally including food, lifestyle, product, and high-volume e-commerce content production

- You demonstrate exceptional photography craft and technical excellence. Providing a portfolio is mandatory

- You have deep expertise in lighting, composition, camera systems, color, production environments, and visual storytelling

- You have experience operating in fast-paced production environments and collaborating across multiple disciplines and stakeholders

- You naturally elevate others through coaching, feedback, mentorship, and sharing best practices

- Experience leading photographers or creative production teams is a plus

- You are highly influential, collaborative, and comfortable aligning stakeholders without relying on hierarchy

- You have a strong production mindset and continuously look for opportunities to improve workflows, quality, and efficiency

- You stay current with developments in photography, visual production, and AI-supported content creation, and understand how to apply new technologies in a practical production environment

- You have expert knowledge of Capture One and strong understanding of color grading and image editing. Experience with additional photography, automation, or AI-supported production tools is a plus

- You can interpret and deconstruct creative briefs and translate them into practical photographic approaches, balancing creative intent, production realities, and visual quality

- You have strong verbal and written communication skills in English

_________________

Please include a portfolio of your recent and relevant work.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Growth Alliance (all genders)
jobs.description:
The role

HelloFresh's Onboarding squad owns the highest-leverage window in the customer lifecycle: from the moment a prospect converts to the moment they become a settled, loyal customer. Onboarding is the connective tissue that links the conversion funnel to long-term customer value.

We are hiring a Staff Product Manager to lead the Onboarding squad and define the product vision for how HelloFresh guides new customers from their first delivery into habitual, high-value subscription. You will own the end-to-end early customer experience across web and app — spanning post-checkout confirmation, subscription management, digital engagement, and the critical Box 1→2→3 progression — across all HelloFresh Group brands, including Factor.

The defining product challenge ahead is building and scaling the Next Best Action (NBA) framework: an ML-powered, segment-aware system that identifies the right action for each customer at each moment in their early lifecycle and delivers it seamlessly across web and app surfaces. This is a genuine 0-to-1 build — one that requires both strategic vision and hands-on execution.

This role demands a PM who is obsessed with solving customer pain points and equally obsessed with the cross-squad collaboration required to do it at scale. Onboarding does not sit inside a single product surface — it spans the activation funnel, CRM and lifecycle communications, app and engagement experiences, and Data Science. The PM leading this squad must be a hyper-collaborator: capable of aligning diverse stakeholders across squads and tribes and bringing coherence to an experience that crosses many surfaces and teams.

What you'll do

- Own the product vision and strategy for the end-to-end Onboarding experience across all HelloFresh Group brands — from post-checkout confirmation to Settled Conversion (3 boxes in 4 weeks).

- Lead the build and scaling of the Next Best Action (NBA) framework: a segment-aware, state-aware personalisation system that dynamically surfaces the right customer action at the right moment across web and app.

- Drive measurable improvement in Settled Conversion rate through a high-velocity experimentation roadmap.

- Own the full-surface onboarding experience — welcome dashboard, subscription management, meal selection flows, app onboarding layer, and CRM-triggered touchpoints — ensuring coherence and quality across every channel and surface.

- Partner with Data Science and Engineering to define the data and ML foundations that power personalised, segment-aware onboarding at scale.

- Act as the connective tissue between squads and tribes: align the Activation funnel squad, CRM and Communications tribe, and App and Engagement team around a unified onboarding strategy and shared north-star metrics.

- Build deep consumer empathy through qualitative research, quantitative funnel analysis, and direct customer engagement — and bring the early customer voice into every product decision.

- Define and own success metrics for Onboarding — Settled Conversion rate, Box 1→2 and 2→3 conversion, app adoption rate, and unwanted box rate — and hold yourself and the squad accountable to them.

- Own BAU operations: triage funnel issues rapidly, maintain onboarding health monitoring, and serve as the escalation point for anything threatening early retention performance.

- Drive cross-functional alignment as a single-threaded leader across global tribes and alliances — creating clarity and shared direction needed for the squad to ship at velocity.
jobs.requirements_raw:
What you'll bring

- Customer Lifecycle & Early Retention Expertise: A deep understanding of subscription customer lifecycle dynamics — churn triggers, early retention levers, and the interplay between product experience and commercial outcomes. You think in journeys, not screens, and you can translate moments of friction or delight into business impact across the Box 0→3 window.

- Cross-Surface Product Leadership: Proven experience owning end-to-end product experiences that span web and native app — including the architectural and strategic choices that come with maintaining coherence across channels. You understand how in-product engagement, push notifications, CRM communications, and app surfaces form a single connected customer journey.

- Growth Experimentation at Scale: 6+ years of PM experience at Senior or Staff level, with hands-on expertise running structured growth experiments — A/B and multivariate testing, holdout groups — in consumer subscription products. You know how to design rigorous experiments, interpret results with nuance, and compound learnings into a strategic roadmap.

- Hyper-Collaborative Leadership: Exceptional ability to operate across squad and tribe boundaries — aligning Engineering, CRM, Data Science, Design, and Marketing around a shared goal without direct authority. You create clarity in complexity and sustain alignment across a large, distributed organisation.

- Data and ML Product Fluency: Comfortable partnering with Data Science to define and govern ML-powered personalisation systems. You do not need to write the models, but you can write the spec, challenge the approach, and translate model outputs into precise product decisions.

- 0-to-1 Build Pedigree: Proven experience taking complex, ambiguous product problems and turning them into shipped product at scale — from initial vision through delivery. You have led large-scale, end-to-end launches and know how to orchestrate cross-functional work under uncertainty.

- Consumer Empathy & Insight-Driven Thinking: You combine qualitative empathy with quantitative rigour. You are as comfortable in a customer interview or usability session as in a funnel analytics deep-dive, and you consistently work backwards from user needs to define what to build.

- High Agency & Ownership Mindset: You do not wait to be told what to do. You diagnose, decide, and drive. You are energised by ambiguity, take genuine accountability for outcomes rather than outputs, and raise the bar on the team around you.

What we offer

- Box Discount - Amazing discounts on 1 box per week! 75% discount on weekly HelloFresh and Chefs Plate meal kits AND 50% off weekly Factor meal box.

- Health & Wellness - Health & Dental benefits from day 1, a Health Spending Account, unlimited access to the Headspace app to meet your self-care needs, and 25% discount on GoodLife fitness memberships!

- Vacation & PTO - Time off is also an important part of self-care! We offer generous vacation and PTO to help you create a good work-life balance.

- Family Benefits - A parental leave top-up program for expectant parents.

- Growth & Development - We support your career progression and invest in your continued learning through experiences and initiatives owned by our dedicated L&D team

- Work Hard & Have Fun - From team socials to engaging company days, you’ll have plenty of opportunity to experience the fun!

- Diversity & Inclusion Initiatives - With impactful ERG’s like FreshPride, Women Empowered and LIMES, we are committed to our diversity, equity & inclusion efforts.

Flexible Hybrid Approach

At HelloFresh, we know that flexible work arrangements are essential in enabling you to do your best work, while balancing your personal and life needs. Offering remote work flexibility, along with the opportunity to interact and collaborate in the office are all a part of creating a great employee experience.

To meet these needs, we are pleased to provide Flexible Hybrid work. Flexible Hybrid is a people-first approach that is based on choice, trust, personalization, and empowers teams to choose when and how often they work from the office and work from home, in addition to team days and company days. This means a minimum of 2 days in office per week, with most teams in office between 2-3 days a week.

#LI-HYBRID

HelloFresh Canada uses AI-integrated technology to help us process and evaluate applications more efficiently. This includes tools that screen and assess candidate qualifications based on the requirements for this role. While these tools assist our workflow, all final selection decisions are made by our hiring team.

This is a posting for an existing vacancy. We are actively seeking to fill this position.

#product

jobs.title: Principal Engineer, Growth Mega Alliance (all genders)
jobs.description:
The Role

The Growth Mega Alliance (GMA) builds the platforms that power how HelloFresh acquires, converts, and retains customers across 18 markets and multiple brands, across five pillars: AdTech, Conversions, Payments, Communications, and Customer Value Optimization (CVO).

As Principal Engineer, you are the technical visionary for these platforms. You define architectural direction across all five pillars, lead the most consequential cross-cutting initiatives, and raise the technical bar for the entire organization. This is a hands-on leadership role - you code, review, and design alongside the senior and staff engineers who look to you as the technical lead.

What You'll Do

GenAI & Agentic Engineering Leadership

- Own GMA's GenAI strategy: identify the highest-leverage opportunities across all five pillars where AI/ML unlocks step-change outcomes, for both engineering productivity and customer-facing capabilities.

- Establish agentic development workflows — where specs drive AI-assisted code generation — and scale them from early adopters to standard practice. Build the guardrails and reference architectures that enable squads to work AI-natively.

- Develop and articulate a clear point of view on how engineering teams need to evolve in skills, process, and culture to realize the gains that agentic tools make possible.

Growth Platform Architecture

- Own the long-term technical architecture across GMA's five pillars: real-time personalization, experimentation at scale, AI/ML-driven automation, and cross-pillar data integrity.

- Lead the most complex architectural decisions (shared identity schemas, experiment assignment, AdTech-to-Conversions signal loops, payment authorization flows) and drive migrations with large impact.

- Ensure GMA platforms integrate cleanly with internal infrastructure and meet reliability, latency, and observability requirements at a global scale.

Experimentation & Personalization

- Define GMA's experimentation strategy and execution framework to optimize experimentation-based decision-making at scale.

- Own the data path from customer event to business decision: instrumentation standards, identity resolution, attribution windows, and signal quality.

Technical Strategy & Cross-Alliance Collaboration

- Define GMA's multi-year technical vision and communicate it with the precision engineers need and the clarity executives can act on. Represent GMA in company-wide programs.

- Partner with Intelligent Platforms, Consumer, and Operations Mega Alliances to drive shared architectural standards and prevent fragmentation.

Mentorship & Engineering Culture

- Coach and grow Staff and Senior Engineers across all five pillars. Foster engineering excellence through rigorous design review, strong observability practice, and honest post-incident learning.

- Champion AI-native development workflows, TDD, DDD, and DevSecOps. Set the written communication standard through your design docs and architectural decision records.
jobs.requirements_raw:
What You'll Bring

GenAI & Agentic Engineering

- Practical, hands-on experience with AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, OpenCode) in production or near-production environments — not just experimentation.

- Experience integrating GenAI into customer-facing products or internal business processes at scale, with a clear point of view on the team and cultural changes required to realize the productivity gains.

Growth Domain Expertise

- Deep familiarity with at least two of: AdTech / paid media infrastructure, funnel optimization, payment orchestration, CRM and lifecycle communications, or pricing and incentive optimization.

- Fluent in growth domain constraints: PSP behavior, consent and privacy requirements across markets, deliverability limits, attribution windows, and incrementality measurement. Experience in a multi-market subscription or e-commerce business preferred.

Technical Depth

- ~10+ years in software engineering, with ~5+ years at principal level in a high-growth, cloud-native environment.

- Expert in distributed systems, microservices, and event-driven patterns (Kafka). Deep AWS experience. Strong proficiency in Go, Kotlin, Python, or TypeScript.

- Track record of designing and operating large-scale, multi-region systems. Comfortable doing hands-on architectural reviews and solving critical bottlenecks directly.

- Working knowledge of experimentation design and analysis; able to work directly with data (SQL, BI tooling) and trace the full signal chain from instrumentation to business metric.

Ways of Working

- Exceptional written communication — your documents make complexity smaller, not larger.

- Able to influence without authority; direct, low-ego, and comfortable disagreeing with senior stakeholders while keeping the relationship intact.

- Fluent English. German is a bonus.

What Success Looks Like

3 months — You have mapped GMA's critical architectural dependencies and GenAI opportunities, conducted design reviews across multiple pillars, and established a point of view on the highest-leverage technical bets for the year.

6 months — Your architectural direction is reflected in roadmaps. GMA's first AI-native workflows are in production. At least one cross-pillar initiative is running under your technical ownership with clear instrumentation.

12 months — GMA's platforms are measurably more scalable, observable, and AI-capable. Engineering standards are set and followed. You are the person leaders across HelloTech bring their hardest growth-engineering problems to.

Why Work With Us

- Make an Impact: GMA's platforms touch every customer HelloFresh acquires and every euro it collects. Your decisions move top-line numbers at a company that has changed the way millions of people eat.

- Real Scope: You own technical direction, make consequential architectural calls, and ship things that matter — at a scale that makes the problems genuinely hard.

- AI at the Frontier: You will have the mandate, resources, and organizational support to lead AI-native engineering transformation — not advocate for it from the sidelines.

- Direct Access: You work daily with engineering, product, and business leadership, with the visibility and accountability that implies.

- Learn & Grow: Annual learning budget, HelloFresh Academy, and internal mobility across a large, technically ambitious engineering organization.

The Manager of US Consumer Insights will work directly alongside our Product and GM teams to shape what we build, how we position it, and how we know it's working, across any or all of our primary brands: HelloFresh, Factor, Green Chef, and EveryPlate. If you're energized by translating consumer questions into clear direction, and you want your research to actually move a roadmap, this is the role.

What You'll Do

You'll be a research lead across our US brand portfolio, HelloFresh, Factor, Green Chef, and EveryPlate, partnering closely with Product Managers and GMs to design and execute studies that drive real decisions, not just decks.

- Own the research agenda for US product innovation, from whitespace and macro trend identification through NPD pipeline research, concept testing, and post-launch assessment

Customer-obsessed, not just research-savvy. You think of customers as human beings, not respondents. You're curious about their lives and can help us see our products through their eyes.

Analytical with a "so what" instinct. You move fluidly between qualitative and quantitative data, find the signal in the noise, and lead with the implication, not just the finding.

A confident communicator at every level. You can run a working session with a product team in the morning and present to senior leadership in the afternoon. You write and speak in plain language, not research jargon.

Strategically grounded. You understand that insights don't exist in a vacuum. You connect findings to business context, competitive dynamics, and what it means for the roadmap.

Collaborative and direct. You build trust with stakeholders quickly, solicit hard feedback, and give it back constructively.

Adaptable and fast. You thrive in ambiguity and know how to move quickly without sacrificing rigor. You've had to make judgment calls on methodology under a deadline, and you've been right more often than not.

What You Bring

HelloFresh is looking for a Creative Operations Senior Manager to join our Global Creative Operations team in New York. This role will serve as the operational lead for our fast-growing brands, partnering closely with Marketing, Creative, Production, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver high-impact campaigns, product launches, and always-on marketing initiatives.

Reporting to the Creative Operations Lead, North America, this role serves as the Creative Operations partner for the HelloFresh portfolio of brands, ensuring successful execution of the brand's strategic marketing initiatives while collaborating with the broader North American Creative Operations organization. The ideal candidate is an exceptional operator who thrives in a fast-paced environment, brings structure to complex initiatives, and continuously identifies opportunities to improve processes, increase efficiency, and enable creative teams to do their best work.

You will...

Own Creative Operations

Lead end-to-end operational management across integrated marketing initiatives, overseeing project planning, execution, and delivery from intake through final asset release across digital, print, packaging, video, photography, CRM, and lifecycle marketing.

Lead Strategic Marketing Initiatives

Manage operational delivery for major business priorities including Peak campaigns, product launches, refreshed meal photography, strategic partnerships, packaging initiatives, brand campaigns, and cross-channel marketing programs, ensuring milestones are met and deliverables are executed on time.

Cross-Functional Partnership

Serve as the primary Creative Operations partner for Brand Marketing, Creative, Production, Lifecycle Marketing, Product Marketing, Packaging, and external agency partners, ensuring alignment on priorities, timelines, deliverables, and business objectives.

Resource & Capacity Management

Partner with the Creative Resource Manager and Creative Operations Lead to forecast upcoming work, balance team capacity, identify resourcing risks, and recommend freelance or agency support as business needs evolve.

Drive Operational Excellence

Oversee the end-to-end creative lifecycle across multiple concurrent initiatives while continuously improving workflows, intake processes, project governance, and ways of working to increase speed-to-market and operational efficiency.

Project & Production Leadership

Develop and manage complex integrated project plans, coordinating cross-functional teams through creative development, production, reviews, approvals, and final asset delivery while proactively identifying risks and removing blockers.

Workflow & Systems Optimization

Champion best practices across project management systems and operational tools, driving adoption of standardized processes while identifying opportunities for automation and scalable operational improvements.

Data-Driven Reporting

Build and maintain reporting that provides visibility into project health, team capacity, delivery performance, and operational metrics, enabling informed decision-making across Creative Operations and Marketing leadership.

Continuous Improvement

Lead retrospectives following major campaigns, productions, and launches, documenting learnings and implementing scalable process improvements that strengthen creative operations across the organization.

- 6-8 years of experience in Creative Operations, Creative Project Management, or integrated marketing operations, including direct experience managing creative workflows within an in-house creative team, agency, or studio environment

- Experience using reporting and resource planning tools to support operational decision-making

- Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and relationship-building skills

- Passion for process improvement, operational excellence, and building scalable ways of working

jobs.title: Senior UX Product Designer
jobs.description:
Senior Product Designer

This is a hybrid role to our Toronto HelloFresh Headquarters

HelloFresh is seeking a Senior Product Designer to join our Growth UX team, shaping how prospective and returning customers discover, evaluate, and choose HelloFresh across our portfolio of brands.

As a Senior-level individual contributor, you’ll lead complex, high-impact growth challenges across acquisition, conversion, checkout, reactivation, and new purchase experiences. You’ll combine strong product design craft with experimentation, systems thinking, and commercial awareness to create experiences that are intuitive, relevant, and effective.

This is a strategic and hands-on role. You’ll contribute to the future direction of our growth experiences while continuously identifying opportunities to improve what exists today. You’ll work in an AI-native design environment, using AI throughout the design lifecycle to accelerate discovery, synthesis, prototyping, and execution — while applying strong judgment around where AI improves the quality of the customer experience.

At Senior level, we expect you to independently lead ambiguous product challenges, influence product direction, and contribute patterns and practices that make the broader team stronger. You’ll remain deeply involved in the craft, using the quality of your thinking, design, and collaboration to bring others along.

What you’ll do

Lead high-impact Growth experiences

- Own the end-to-end design of critical growth journeys across acquisition, conversion, checkout, payment, reactivation, and emerging purchase models.

- Translate complex customer and business problems into experiences that clearly communicate value, reduce friction, and help customers confidently make decisions.

- Balance immediate conversion opportunities with the longer-term customer experience, considering not only whether customers convert, but whether we are setting them up for meaningful engagement and retention.

Shape product direction

- Partner with Product, Engineering, Data, Research, Marketing, and Content Design to identify opportunities across the customer journey.

- Connect customer needs, behavioural insights, commercial goals, and emerging technology to develop strong product directions.

- Move comfortably between contributing to longer-term vision and delivering tactical improvements that generate measurable impact today.

- Bring a strong design perspective to your product area while remaining open to evidence, experimentation, and the expertise of your partners.

Drive experimentation and validated learning

- Use quantitative and qualitative insights to identify opportunities, develop hypotheses, and design high-impact experiments.

- Partner closely with Product and Data to understand performance across the funnel and translate learnings into actionable design improvements.

- Look beyond the outcome of individual A/B tests to identify patterns and insights that can inform future product and design decisions.

- Help teams balance experimentation velocity with customer comprehension, trust, and experience quality.

Work AI-natively

- Integrate AI into your day-to-day design practice, from exploration, research synthesis, and ideation through rapid prototyping and design-to-code workflows.

- Use tools such as Claude & Claude Code, Gemini, Figma AI, and emerging technologies to shorten the distance between an idea and something customers can experience and validate.

- Explore opportunities for AI-native customer experiences, including personalization, recommendations, adaptive journeys, and conversational interactions.

- Apply strong design judgment to AI-generated outputs, understanding when AI accelerates quality and when human craft, intuition, and critical thinking matter most.

Raise the bar for design craft

- Create polished, intuitive experiences with strong attention to visual hierarchy, interaction design, motion, micro-interactions, content, and overall usability.

- Identify opportunities to improve the quality and coherence of the Growth experiences you work on.

- Contribute patterns, practices, and examples that help other designers deliver stronger work.

- Give and seek thoughtful critique, using feedback to continuously strengthen the work.

Design systems, not just screens

- Think across journeys rather than individual touchpoints, identifying opportunities to create reusable patterns and modular experiences that can scale across markets, brands, customer types, and purchase models.

- Partner with our design system teams while contributing to Growth-specific patterns where needed.

- Help reduce design debt and fragmentation by creating solutions that make future experimentation faster without sacrificing relevance or quality.

Lead through collaboration

- Bring strong perspectives and clear rationale to complex product decisions.

- Guide cross-functional partners through ambiguity and trade-offs, advocating for customer-centred solutions while understanding commercial and technical constraints.

- Build alignment through clear communication, evidence, and strong design rationale rather than formal authority.

- Support other designers through critique, collaboration, and sharing new practices and approaches.
jobs.requirements_raw:
What you’ll bring

Senior-level product design experience

- Typically 4-6+ years of product design experience, although we care more about the scope, complexity, and impact of your work than years alone.

- A strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end ownership of complex consumer experiences, from understanding the problem through shipped outcomes and learning.

- Experience independently navigating ambiguous problems, making sound design decisions, and influencing product direction within your area.

Growth and experimentation expertise

- Strong experience designing B2C growth, e-commerce, subscription, marketplace, or other transaction-driven experiences.

- You understand experimentation deeply and can translate behavioural data, customer insights, and business metrics into meaningful design opportunities.

- You know how to optimize for conversion without losing sight of trust, comprehension, customer value, and longer-term engagement.

Exceptional product design craft

- Strong expertise across interaction and visual design, including hierarchy, information architecture, responsive behaviour, motion, and micro-interactions.

- You can take complex experiences and make them feel simple, and can articulate what separates a functional experience from a great one.

- You care about the details while understanding when speed, learning, and iteration matter more than perfection.

AI-native design fluency

- AI is already part of how you work, not something you are waiting to adopt.

- You regularly use AI across multiple stages of your design process, whether that’s discovery, synthesis, ideation, prototyping, or execution.

- You’re comfortable experimenting with tools such as Figma AI, Claude, Claude Code, Gemini, or similar emerging technologies.

- You’re interested not only in using AI to work faster, but in understanding how it changes what we can design for customers.

Systems thinking

- You naturally look beyond the individual screen or experiment to understand how experiences connect.

- You have experience creating reusable patterns or modular solutions that can work across journeys, customer contexts, brands, or markets.

- You can balance the benefits of consistency and reuse with the need to design for the specific customer problem at hand.

Strategic thinking and high agency

- You’re comfortable navigating ambiguity, challenging assumptions, and proactively identifying opportunities rather than waiting for perfectly defined briefs.

- You bring conviction to your design decisions while remaining open to evidence, experimentation, and alternative perspectives.

- You can establish a strong direction for your work and then get hands-on to make it real.

Cross-functional leadership

- You’re comfortable working beyond traditional design boundaries: shaping product decisions with Product Managers, exploring technical possibilities with Engineers, working with Data to understand performance, and partnering with Research and Content Design to understand customer behaviour.

- You know how to build alignment across disciplines and move work forward without relying on formal authority.

Exceptional communication

- You can turn complex problems into clear, compelling narratives and confidently present your thinking to stakeholders at different levels.

- You communicate not only what you designed, but the customer insight, hypothesis, trade-offs, and business rationale behind it.

- You can adapt the depth and format of your communication to the decision that needs to be made.

Let’s cut to the cheese, this is why you'll love it here

- Box Discount - Amazing discounts on 1 box per week! 75% discount on weekly HelloFresh and Chefs Plate meal kits AND 50% off weekly Factor meal box.

- Health & Wellness - Health & Dental benefits from day 1, a Health Spending Account, unlimited access to the Headspace app to meet your self-care needs, and 25% discount on GoodLife fitness memberships!

- RRSP Matching - Competitive RRSP matching program offered

- Vacation & PTO - Time off is also an important part of self-care! We offer generous vacation and PTO to help you create a good work-life balance.

- Family Benefits - A parental leave top-up program for expectant parents.

- Growth & Development - We support your career progression and invest in your continued learning through experiences and initiatives owned by our dedicated L&D team

- Work Hard & Have Fun - From team socials to engaging company days, you’ll have plenty of opportunity to experience the fun!

- Diversity & Inclusion Initiatives - With impactful ERG’s like FreshPride, Women Empowered and LIMES, we are committed to our diversity, equity & inclusion efforts.

- Food Puns - this one is kind of a big dill if you haven’t already noticed. We even have some punny meeting room names!

Flexible Hybrid Approach

At HelloFresh, we know that flexible work arrangements are essential in enabling you to do your best work, while balancing your personal and life needs. Offering remote work flexibility, along with the opportunity to interact and collaborate in the office are all a part of creating a great employee experience.

To meet these needs, we are pleased to provide Flexible Hybrid work. Flexible Hybrid is a people-first approach that is based on choice, trust, personalization, and empowers teams to choose when and how often they work from the office and work from home, in addition to team days and company days. This means a minimum of 2 days in office per week, with most teams in office between 2-3 days a week.
