jobs.title: Junior Growth Manager
jobs.description:
Junior Growth Manager

As a Junior Growth Manager you’ll play a key role in driving the next phase of growth for the Partnerships channel within the HelloFresh Group. If you are a keen negotiator, analytical, have a strong foundation in data and measurement, and drive big ideas, you will thrive in this role. You will support the expansion of our acquisition ecosystem by sourcing, developing, and managing high‑impact and commercially strategic partnerships across the UK for both HelloFresh and Green Chef. In this role, you will focus on identifying new opportunities, building a strong pipeline of potential partners, and managing end-to-end campaigns. You will nurture and grow existing relationships while proactively securing new partners, defining the global standard. You’ll collaborate closely with local and global Growth Partnerships teams, bringing an innovative, commercial mindset to the channel.

To succeed, you’ll bring hands‑on experience in partnerships, strong relationship‑building skills, and a passion for business development that fuels long‑term, sustainable growth.

What You Will Be Doing

- Build and maintain a strong roadmap of new, high‑quality partnership opportunities across varied industries and verticals (Content/Editorial, Card Linked Offers, B2B, Gift Cards, and more), targeting high brand-affinity, high-intent and reach.

- Prospecting, pitching, and securing new acquisition‑focused partnerships.

- Manage the housing and optimisation of partner offers to deliver partner value and grow platform reach.

- Manage and scale the B2B sub‑channel (Daily Deals, Gift Cards).

- Measurement & analysis against partnerships with a reactive and commercially strategic mindset, negotiating on cost mechanics and pivoting when needed.

- Share insights, learnings, and best practices with wider local and international markets to enhance global performance, along with adopting global learnings for local success.

- Ideally you have a background in growth marketing, consulting, or data handling.

- Growth mindset: commercially strategic with a strong foundation in measurement (COS/ROI, CAC, LTV are essential, CVA/CCV is desired), efficiency, incrementality and negotiation.

- Ideas-led with the ability to think big and think “brand” - expanding partnership proposals holistically to leverage relevant marketing channels where it adds value.

- A natural relationship builder – strong people skills, confident communicator, and able to influence internal and external stakeholders.

- Ability to evaluate performance, spot data trends, and ideate and execute regular A/B tests.

- Organised, independent, and adaptable with solid project management skills – able to manage multiple conversations, priorities, and deadlines.

- A problem solver who quickly identifies barriers and drives solutions.

- A collaborative team player who contributes to a positive culture and works seamlessly across teams to achieve shared goals.

- Excited by growth, and passionate about building scalable partnerships that deliver long‑term impact and value.

● Nursery support scheme

jobs.title: Production Manager
jobs.description:
Full Time, On-Site

St. Margaret’s, Co.Dublin, K67 P7E5

Working hours 8:00am - 5:00pm

About The Role:
Lead shift operations and inventory activities to ensure uninterrupted production and the accurate, efficient delivery of customer orders. Drive operational performance through strong leadership, accountability, and continuous improvement, while maintaining stock accuracy and supporting seamless supply chain operations.

What You Will Be Doing:

Operational & Inventory Leadership

- Lead shift operations to achieve productivity, quality, safety, and service targets.

- Manage a team of colleagues on shift, ensuring KPIs and daily tasks are met.

- Oversee all aspects of inventory control, including daily audits of ingredients, packaging, and label materials.

- Conduct regular physical inventory counts to reconcile discrepancies and maintain stock accuracy.

- Monitor shift performance, resolve operational issues, and implement corrective actions.

- Maintain a strong shop floor presence, leading by example and ensuring tasks are completed to deadline.

People Leadership

jobs.title: Senior Mobile Product Engineer, Intelligent Platforms (all genders)
jobs.description:
Work with HelloFresh in Warsaw and its HelloTech organisation, HelloFresh’s global technology backbone with more than 1000 people, building the digital products that power our end-to-end food experience. From meal kits and ready-to-eat meals to specialty offerings like pet food and premium meat & seafood, HelloTech creates the platforms that bring tailored food solutions to millions of customers every month.

Our subscription-based, direct-to-consumer model relies on technology at every step, from customer-facing apps and personalization logic to pricing, forecasting, supply chain optimization, and initiatives that help reduce food waste. While our brands operate independently to serve distinct customer needs, they are united by shared platforms, data, and operational excellence built by HelloTech.

HelloTech works in autonomous, cross-functional alliances, each owning a specific product or domain end to end. By working with our Warsaw office, you will help shape scalable, data-driven products used across our markets, working with a modern tech stack and international teams to continuously improve how people discover, order, and enjoy HelloFresh’s products, today and in the future.

About the Team:

Behavioral Data & Experimentation is a cross-functional platform team with end-to-end ownership of digital tracking across all markets globally at HelloFresh: from tracking infrastructure all the way to curated data products and the hypothesis validation mechanisms (e.g., A/B testing). Our customers are the engineering and product teams across HelloFresh, so reliability, automation, and developer experience are central to what we build. The squad brings together software engineers, data engineers, and data scientists to build the tracking, event, and statistical infrastructure that drives product decisions. Our work enables customer experience improvements and business growth.

About the Role: What's in the Box

As a Senior Mobile Engineer, you'll own and evolve the mobile app tracking architecture that powers behavioral tracking and experimentation across HelloFresh's brand portfolio. Your core platforms are Android (Kotlin) and React Native. You will also contribute to iOS and Web codebases as the work requires, alongside teammates with deep expertise on those platforms. AI is part of our daily work: you'll use Claude, Zed, and Opencode across design, development, and testing, and help the team adopt new practices as they emerge. Above all, we want people who make the team stronger. Even if you do not meet every requirement, we would still like to hear from you.

What you’ll do: The Recipe

At HelloFresh we are moving away from a model where software developers just execute tickets toward one where product engineers are trusted to own customer problems. A Product Engineer takes a problem, forms a point of view, validates it with customers and data, and ships it using AI as a force multiplier.

- Own the integration and evolution of tracking and experimentation SDKs (Snowplow, Statsig, or equivalent) across Android native and React Native layers, ensuring consistent, reliable event capture for every brand and customer touchpoint.

- Solve native mobile telemetry challenges, such as lifecycle events, background sync, offline event buffering, and custom native bridges.

- Embed AI-driven workflows into our platform tooling to increase automation and data quality.

- Drive engineering excellence by implementing robust automated testing, rigorous error handling, and high-quality release practices.

- Work closely with product managers, software and data engineers to continuously evolve our platform offering.

- Mentor engineers and contribute to team-wide engineering standards.

- Contribute to] the app experience, owning the metrics that reflect quality for mobile customers (retention, crash-free sessions, conversion).

- Work beyond your specialization when the problem demands it. Your specialization is your anchor, not your boundary.

- Operate what you build. You instrument, monitor, and improve your systems in production. Shipping is the beginning of the learning cycle, not the end.

What you’ll bring: The Ingredients

- Hands-on experience working with AI tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) beyond casual experimentation. You use AI agents every day. You have a practical sense of how the context you provide to AI tools shapes output quality, and how to set boundaries on AI-generated work.

- Extensive mobile engineering experience (5+ years) with strong native depth, ideally on Android (Kotlin). If your depth is on another platform but you have a track record of ramping up quickly in unfamiliar stacks, that works for us.

- A flexible, cross-platform mindset, with a proven ability to work across mobile and web codebases.

- GenAI proficiency, including a proven ability to leverage AI tools and workflows to increase development speed, quality, and overall team output.

- A strong focus on engineering excellence, demonstrated through a commitment to high-quality codebases, proactive system stability, and resilient infrastructure design.

- Experience building and maintaining automated tests at different levels, including unit, integration, and end-to-end testing.

- A track record of taking ownership in ambiguous, cross-functional environments and working across engineering, product, and data teams to ship solutions that measurably move the needle.

- Deep mobile engineering expertise, with experience across the app release cycle, test automation, on-device performance and platform UX conventions.

- Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain technical decisions and trade-offs to different audiences.

- You take full ownership. You have a bias to ship. You finish the last twenty percent.

- You have product sense and are opinionated about what should be built and why, and you can back that opinion with data and user evidence.

Nice to have

- Familiarity with how client-side signals flow into downstream systems such as GTM and Snowplow, and with A/B testing and feature-flagging frameworks such as Statsig.

- Hands-on experience with iOS development (Swift).

- Experience with Web frontend development (React, TypeScript, browser telemetry).

- Basic backend or data engineering context (Node.js, Python, REST/gRPC APIs, or data pipelines).

What we offer: The Toppings

- Global collaboration at scale: Collaborate with experienced engineers and product partners across HelloTech’s international teams, in a culture of active knowledge sharing.

- Technology with real-world impact: Build and operate modern systems at global scale, supporting 6+ millions of customers and complex supply chain operations.

- Technical/Product/Design leadership: Drive best practices and influence architecture/design, quality, and ways of working in an autonomous, product-led setup.

- End-to-end development/delivery: Drive decisions from problem definition to production, improving systems and enabling long-term scalability.

- Access to workspace at Warsaw Centre Point. The hub offers modern facilities including showers, breakout zones, outdoor space, cycle parking, and refreshments (coffee, soft drinks, and fruit).

Are you the missing ingredient? If this sounds like a tasty opportunity, we’d be excited to hear from you. We aim to review your profile and respond within 5 business days.

The Shipping Associate oversees day-to-day operations across receiving, shipping, warehousing, inventory distribution, and logistics. - Accurately record pallet data using the Box Counter Tool for every processed load.

- Perform thorough trailer cleanliness and safety inspections, completing required documentation prior to loading.

- Re-verify top-layer package labels for each pallet prior to trailer loading.

- Collaborate effectively across cross-functional facility departments to resolve operational bottlenecks.

- Work autonomously under minimal supervision while carrying out management directives professionally.

- Maintain organized and clean work environments in accordance with facility 5S and safety regulations.

- Input operational data accurately into inventory management systems and software platforms (e.g., Microsoft Office, Google Sheets).

Work Environment

Duties are performed within a cold-storage manufacturing and assembly facility with exposure to controlled temperatures ranging from 10ºF to 40ºF. The environment involves continuous exposure to airborne particles, active mechanical equipment, and operational noise/vibration.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer - New Ventures & Consumer UX
jobs.description:
At HelloFresh, the goal is to change the way people eat forever by delivering high-quality food across 18 countries and 3 continents. As a global food solutions group and the world's leading meal kit provider, the portfolio includes HelloFresh, Green Chef, EveryPlate, Chefs Plate, Factor_, Youfoodz, Good Chop, and The Pets Table.

Engaging with HelloFresh in Warsaw means collaborating with HelloTech—a global technology division of over 1,000 people powering an end-to-end food ecosystem. From digital personalization and forecasting to supply chain optimization and food waste reduction, technology drives every step of this direct-to-consumer model. HelloTech operates in autonomous, cross-functional alliances, with each team holding full accountability for a specific domain. By collaborating with the Warsaw office, the service provider will leverage a modern tech stack and work with international teams to shape scalable, data-driven platforms that impact millions of global customers.

About the Role: What's in the Box

HelloFresh Group is building the next generation of consumer experiences across its portfolio—from discovery and personalization to shopping and subscription management. The Consumer UX team is at the heart of this work, designing end-to-end experiences that are simple, delightful, and grounded in real customer needs.

Services are required for Senior UX Designers across two squad contexts: one embedded in Good Chop, the premium American meat and seafood subscription brand, and one in the central Consumer UX team working across the broader HelloFresh Group portfolio. Both roles share the same craft bar, strategic expectations, and ways of working.

These are full-accountability roles inside a fast-paced environment. The provider will partner with Product and Engineering leads on a cross-functional squad, where UX serves as a strategic input to shape direction from the start. This role does not include people management responsibilities.

What You’ll Do: The Recipe

- Consumer Experience Design: Lead design from concept to shipped product, maintaining full accountability for the consumer experience across touchpoints while holding a high quality bar at every stage.

- Strategy and Roadmap Influence: Frame problem spaces before briefs are created. Bring evidence-backed consumer insights into squad planning to surface opportunities and inform what gets built.

- Craft and Execution: Maintain a high personal standard across UI, interaction design, motion, micro-interaction, and UX writing, using animation and motion as intentional strategic tools.

- AI-Native Workflow: Utilize AI across the entire design lifecycle—including insight synthesis, discovery, rapid prototyping, and design-to-code workflows—to increase execution speed and precision.

What You’ll Bring: The Ingredients

- Experience: 6+ years in product design, with a proven track record delivering high-quality consumer products end-to-end.

- Consumer Instinct: Deep understanding of consumer-facing products and decision-making drivers across the full customer lifecycle. Subscription domain experience is a plus.

- Strategic Range: Ability to define problem spaces before designing solutions, utilizing evidence to refine project scopes and contribute to roadmap strategies.

- Craft Mastery: Exceptional visual and interaction design skills with deep focus on hierarchy, motion, micro-interaction, and animation. High proficiency in Figma and strong familiarity with front-end technical constraints.

- High Agency: Proactivity to advocate for optimal design solutions, bringing conviction to decisions and collaborating effectively with cross-functional partners.

- Research Fluency: Ability to frame research questions, run lightweight studies, and translate findings into design direction.

- AI-Native in Practice: Active use of AI tools (such as Figma AI and Claude) in live project workflows for synthesis, discovery, prototyping, and code generation.

- Communication: Clear presentation capabilities, skill in facilitating cross-functional alignment, and the ability to defend design decisions using data and evidence.

What We Offer: The Toppings

- Global collaboration at scale: Collaborate with experienced engineers and product partners across HelloTech’s international teams, in a culture of active knowledge sharing.

- Technology with real-world impact: Build and operate modern systems at global scale, supporting millions of customers and complex supply chain operations.

- Technical/Product/Design leadership: Drive best practices and influence design quality, architecture, and ways of working in an autonomous, product-led setup.

- End-to-end development/delivery: Drive decisions from problem definition to production, improving systems and enabling long-term scalability.

- Access to workspace at Warsaw Centre Point: The hub offers modern facilities including showers, breakout zones, outdoor space, cycle parking, and refreshments (coffee, soft drinks, and fruit).

jobs.title: Director, WMS Product Design and Engineering
jobs.description:
About the role

HelloFresh is searching for an action-oriented servant leader for our warehouse management system (WMS) Product Design and Software Engineering functions. This leader owns the full software delivery lifecycle for HelloFresh's global warehouse fulfillment and inventory control domain — from architecture and product design through engineering execution, quality assurance, and operational reliability. You will collaborate closely with stakeholders across operations, automation/production technology, procurement, and finance to deliver innovative solutions on our strategic WMS platform — Infios's Warehouse Advantage (Körber/Highjump) — while balancing competing priorities and technical resource demand.

This location-flexible position can be physically based in any of our North America corporate offices or fulfillment centers with a hybrid working model, but must be flexible with work hour scheduling as teams and solutions are dispersed globally.

The Director of WMS Product Design and Software Engineering will work with key technology and product leaders across HelloFresh to enable the inventory management and control domain strategy, evaluate technology-related priorities, and translate stakeholder needs into actionable roadmaps. The ideal candidate combines impeccable management and communication skills with a practitioner's instinct for modern software delivery — knowing how to build high-performing teams, establish engineering health metrics, and integrate AI-assisted tooling that meaningfully accelerates quality and velocity.

What you'll own

- WMS Solution Ownership: Provide technical direction, development oversight, and performance accountability for HelloFresh's deployment of Infios's Warehouse Advantage (Körber/Highjump) WMS platform across all global locations

- Integration Architecture & Reliability: Own WMS layer Integrations to host systems and CDC pipelines (Debezium/kafka) to Snowflake/Databricks

- Platform Architecture: Partner/ support as needed the Hosting Architecture team in the optimal sizing and performance of WMS Architecture in AWS

- Agentic Engineering & Developer Productivity: Champion and drive adoption of agentic engineering practices across the team: automated code review tooling (e.g., AI-assisted PR analysis, static analysis agents, LLM-powered code quality gates), AI-augmented test generation and execution, and intelligent deployment pipelines. Measure and report the impact of these practices on delivery velocity and defect escape rate

- CI/CD & Deployment Automation: Own the maturity roadmap for CI/CD pipelines. Establish automated deployment workflows with robust rollback strategies, feature flagging, environment-specific gate checks, and infrastructure-as-code practices — enabling high-confidence, low-friction releases across all WMS environments

- Quality Engineering & Test Automation: Partner with WMS Services and Support leadership to build a world-class QA function. Drive adoption of automated regression suites, AI-assisted edge case generation, and contract testing for integrations. Push teams beyond happy-path coverage toward comprehensive scenario validation, including automated performance and load testing for peak fulfillment periods

- Engineering Metrics & Continuous Improvement: Establish DORA metrics (deployment frequency, lead time for change, change failure rate, and mean time to restore) as the foundation of engineering health reporting for the WMS organization. Set baselines, publish improvement targets, and use metric trends to identify bottlenecks, prioritize tooling and process investments, and communicate engineering performance to senior leadership

- Technical Roadmap & Architecture Governance: Partner with peers and senior leadership on architectural decision-making for WMS platform evolution, integration patterns, and technology transitions. Champion the use of structured design reviews to maintain coherent, scalable technical direction. Lead evaluations to refactor or replace legacy systems, including risk mitigation and transition planning

- Vendor & Capacity Management: Work with department leadership to source and partner with 3rd-party vendors to augment internal engineering capacity and expertise. Maintain vendor performance accountability and ensure structured knowledge transfer to build durable internal capability

- People Leadership & Talent Development: Coach, develop, and retain high-performing engineers, product managers, and team leads. Partner with HR and Talent Acquisition to build organizational depth — playing an active role in recruiting, onboarding, and career development

- International Standardization/ Release Consolidation. Partner with departmental leadership, peer domains, and executive leadership to own the long term roadmap for product consolidation to a single application release version administered globally

- Cross-functional Leadership. Serve on both the Fulfillment Technology and overall Automation & Technology leadership teams, reinforcing HelloFresh DNA values, establishing KPIs, and prioritizing strategic initiatives at a departmental level

What you bring

Technical/Engineering Experience

- 10+ years of warehouse management system (WMS) software engineering and implementation experience with a tier-one WMS in an RF-based distribution, manufacturing, or e-commerce fulfillment environment

- 3+ years of direct hands-on experience with Infios's Warehouse Advantage (Körber/Highjump) WMS platform with SQL Server

- 3+ years managing application integrations via microservices and associated toolsets, including REST APIs, event-driven architectures, and ETL pipelines

- Demonstrated experience implementing or scaling CI/CD pipelines, including automated testing gates, deployment automation, and infrastructure-as-code (IaC) practices across multi-environment WMS or fulfillment technology stacks

- Hands-on familiarity with agentic and AI-assisted engineering tools — including automated code review platforms, AI-assisted test generation, and LLM-powered developer productivity tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, CodeRabbit, SonarQube AI, or equivalent) — with a track record of driving meaningful team-wide adoption and measurable impact

- Experience defining and tracking engineering delivery and quality metrics (DORA metrics or equivalent) and using data to drive process improvement and leadership reporting

- Experience leading evaluations to refactor or replace legacy systems, including developing and executing technology transition plans with appropriate risk mitigation strategies

Product Experience

- Experience leading a design and product process that scales a digital technology operations ecosystem across volume growth, multiple brands, and new digital properties

- Strategic thinker with the ability to build and execute innovative digital product strategy while executing tactically against multiple competing priorities simultaneously

- Proven ability to translate business requirements into technical specifications, roadmaps, and delivery plans — and to communicate progress and tradeoffs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

- Demonstrated ability to build leadership support for proactive technology investments, making the business case for engineering quality, automation, and platform modernization

What we offer

- Shape the future of food: Play a key role in transforming how millions of people eat as we grow into a global food solutions company.

- Drive transformational change: Your decisions will have a direct and immediate impact, helping to shape strategy, scale teams, and redefine leadership in a rapidly evolving business.

- Build a global brand: Create deeper, more sustainable connections with our customers, putting them at the heart of every decision.

- Compensation & Financial Wellbeing: Enjoy amazing discounts: 75% off weekly HelloFresh/Chefs Plate meal kits plus 50% off weekly Factor meal boxes.

- Health & Wellbeing: Benefit from health and dental coverage from day one, a Health Spending Account, unlimited Headspace access, and 25% off GoodLife fitness memberships.

- Flexibility & Work-Life: Receive generous vacation and PTO offerings. Benefit from a parental leave top-up program designed to support expectant parents.

- Career & Development: Grow with dedicated L&D initiatives and career support, aligning with our "Learning Never Stops" value.

Flexible Hybrid Approach

At HelloFresh, we know that flexible work arrangements are essential in enabling you to do your best work, while balancing your personal and life needs. Offering remote work flexibility, along with the opportunity to interact and collaborate in the office are all a part of creating a great employee experience.

To meet these needs, we are pleased to provide Flexible Hybrid work. Flexible Hybrid is a people-first approach that is based on choice, trust, personalization, and empowers teams to choose when and how often they work from the office and work from home, in addition to team days and company days. This means a minimum of 2 days in office per week, with most teams in office between 2-3 days a week.

jobs.title: Director, Global WMS Software Engineering and Product Design
jobs.description:
Join our R&D Tech Hub in Warsaw

We’re building a new R&D Tech Hub in Poland and are looking for people who want to make a real impact from day one. You’ll be part of a globally connected team, helping to shape the culture and ways of working at our new location. This is a hands-on role in a supportive environment, where collaboration, learning, and adaptability are key.

We value practical problem-solving, diverse perspectives, and people who take ownership. If you're ready to contribute to meaningful projects and help lay the foundation for a growing team, we’d like to hear from you.

About the role: What's in the Box

HelloFresh is searching for an action-oriented servant leader for our warehouse management system (WMS) Software Engineering and Product functions. This leader owns the full software delivery lifecycle for HelloFresh's global warehouse fulfillment and inventory control domain — from architecture and product design through engineering execution, quality assurance, and operational reliability. You will drive a culture of product & engineering excellence, leveraging modern agentic tooling and AI-assisted workflows to increase team velocity, reduce defect escape rates, and accelerate deployment confidence.

You will collaborate closely with stakeholders across technology, operations, automation/production technology, procurement, and finance to deliver innovative solutions on our strategic WMS platform — Infios's Warehouse Advantage (Körber/Highjump) — while balancing competing priorities and technical resource demand.

The Director of WMS Engineering and Product will work with key technology and product leaders across HelloFresh to enable the inventory management and control domain strategy, evaluate technology-related priorities, and translate stakeholder needs into actionable roadmaps. The ideal candidate combines impeccable management and communication skills with a practitioner's instinct for modern software delivery — knowing how to build high-performing teams, establish engineering health metrics, and integrate AI-assisted tooling that meaningfully accelerates quality and velocity.

What you’ll do: The Recipe

- WMS Solution Ownership: Provide technical direction, development oversight, and performance accountability for HelloFresh's deployment of Infios's Warehouse Advantage (Körber/Highjump) WMS platform across all global locations

- Integration Architecture & Reliability: Drive WMS application layer Integration architecture to upstream tooling and host systems via CI/CD pipelines [Debezium/Kafka to Snowflake/Databricks]

- Platform Architecture: Partner/ support as needed the Hosting Architecture team in the optimal sizing and performance of WMS Architecture in AWS

- Agentic Engineering & Developer Productivity: Champion and drive adoption of agentic engineering practices across the team: automated code review tooling (e.g., AI-assisted PR analysis, static analysis agents, LLM-powered code quality gates), AI-augmented test generation and execution, and intelligent deployment pipelines. Measure and report the impact of these practices on delivery velocity and defect escape rate

- CI/CD & Deployment Automation: Own the maturity roadmap for CI/CD pipelines. Establish automated deployment workflows with robust rollback strategies, feature flagging, environment-specific gate checks, and infrastructure-as-code practices — enabling high-confidence, low-friction releases across all WMS environments

- Quality Engineering & Test Automation: Partner with WMS Services and Support leadership to build a world-class QA function. Drive adoption of automated regression suites, AI-assisted edge case generation, and contract testing for integrations. Push teams beyond happy-path coverage toward comprehensive scenario validation, including automated performance and load testing for peak fulfillment periods

- Engineering Metrics & Continuous Improvement: Establish DORA metrics (deployment frequency, lead time for change, change failure rate, and mean time to restore) as the foundation of engineering health reporting for the WMS organization. Set baselines, publish improvement targets, and use metric trends to identify bottlenecks, prioritize tooling and process investments, and communicate engineering performance to senior leadership

- Technical Roadmap & Architecture Governance: Partner with peers and senior leadership on architectural decision-making for WMS platform evolution, integration patterns, and technology transitions. Champion the use of structured design reviews to maintain coherent, scalable technical direction. Lead evaluations to refactor or replace legacy systems, including risk mitigation and transition planning

- Vendor & Capacity Management: Work with department leadership to source and partner with 3rd-party vendors to augment internal engineering capacity and expertise. Maintain vendor performance accountability and ensure structured knowledge transfer to build durable internal capability

- People Leadership & Talent Development: Coach, develop, and retain high-performing engineers, product managers, and team leads. Partner with HR and Talent Acquisition to build organizational depth — playing an active role in recruiting, onboarding, and career development

- International Standardization/ Release Consolidation. Partner with departmental leadership, peer domains, and executive leadership to own the long term roadmap for product consolidation to a single application release version administered globally

- Cross-functional Leadership. Serve on both the Fulfillment Technology and overall Automation & Technology leadership teams, reinforcing HelloFresh DNA values, establishing KPIs, and prioritizing strategic initiatives at a departmental level

What you’ll bring: The Ingredients

Technical/Engineering Experience

- 10+ years of warehouse management system (WMS) software engineering and implementation experience with a tier-one WMS in an RF-based distribution, manufacturing, or e-commerce fulfillment environment

- 3+ years of direct hands-on experience with Infios's Warehouse Advantage (Körber/Highjump) WMS platform with SQL Server

- 3+ years managing application integrations via microservices and associated toolsets, including REST APIs, event-driven architectures, and ETL pipelines

- Demonstrated experience implementing or scaling CI/CD pipelines, including automated testing gates, deployment automation, and infrastructure-as-code (IaC) practices across multi-environment WMS or fulfillment technology stacks

- Hands-on familiarity with agentic and AI-assisted engineering tools — including automated code review platforms, AI-assisted test generation, and LLM-powered developer productivity tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, CodeRabbit, SonarQube AI, or equivalent) — with a track record of driving meaningful team-wide adoption and measurable impact

- Experience defining and tracking engineering delivery and quality metrics (DORA metrics or equivalent) and using data to drive process improvement and leadership reporting

- Experience leading evaluations to refactor or replace legacy systems, including developing and executing technology transition plans with appropriate risk mitigation strategies

Product Experience

- Experience leading a design and product process that scales a digital technology operations ecosystem across volume growth, multiple brands, and new digital properties

- Strategic thinker with the ability to build and execute innovative digital product strategy while executing tactically against multiple competing priorities simultaneously

- Proven ability to translate business requirements into technical specifications, roadmaps, and delivery plans — and to communicate progress and tradeoffs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

- Demonstrated ability to build leadership support for proactive technology investments, making the business case for engineering quality, automation, and platform modernization

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh Group better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What we offer: The Toppings

- Health - You’re covered from your first day with private health insurance.

- Flexible Working - We work in-office 3 days a week to align on goals, with flexible hours to support work-life balance and personal needs

- Time Off - You receive 26 days of paid vacation each year, providing you time to rest and recharge.

- Learning and Development - An annual Learning & Development budget and a Mentoring Program to support your ongoing professional growth.

- Employee Referral Program - Our team members can take part in our internal employee referral program and receive a bonus for recommending successful candidates to open roles.

- Daily Comforts - Free coffee, drinks, and fresh fruit are available to keep you refreshed throughout the day.

jobs.title: EHS Specialist (all genders)
jobs.description:

Gesundheitsschutz und unterstützt unsere Führungskräfte bei der fachgerechten Umsetzung der gesetzlichen sowie internen Anforderungen an unseren Last Mile Logistikstandorten. Du berätst die operativen Bereiche bei der Identifikation sowie Beurteilung von Gefährdungen und wirkst somit an der Weiterentwicklung einer nachhaltigen Sicherheitskultur mit. Du unterstützt zudem bei der Ableitung und Umsetzung geeigneter Schutzmaßnahmen und trägst mit Deiner fachlichen Expertise dazu bei, ein hohes Sicherheitsniveau in unseren deutschlandweit rund 20 Zustell-Hubs sicherzustellen.

Bitte beachte, dass für diese Tätigkeit eine Reisebereitschaft von ca. 90% sowie ein Führerschein der Klasse B vorausgesetzt werden.

Bitte beachte auch, diese Stelle auf 24 Monate befristet ist (eine anschließende Entfristung wird angestrebt).

Deine Aufgaben

- Beratung der Führungskräfte und operativen Bereiche bei allen Fragen des Arbeits- und Gesundheitsschutzes sowie bei der Umsetzung gesetzlicher und interner Anforderungen zugeschnitten auf unsere Logistik-Hubs

- Unterstützung bei der Ermittlung und Beurteilung von Gefährdungen, bei der Entwicklung geeigneter Schutzmaßnahmen sowie bei Dokumentation und Wirksamkeitskontrolle

- Durchführung und Begleitung von Begehungen, Unfall- und Ereignisanalysen sowie Ableitung geeigneter Präventions- und Verbesserungsmaßnahmen

- Optimierung und Weiterentwicklung von Sicherheitsprozessen durch strukturiertes Prozess- und Risikomanagement sowie Mitwirkung bei Audits und organisatorischen Veränderungen

- Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Fachstellen, insbesondere Brandschutz, Gefahrstoffmanagement, Fuhrpark sowie Behörden und Sachverständigen
jobs.requirements_raw:

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Benefits Platform (all genders)
jobs.description:
Work with HelloFresh in Warsaw and its HelloTech organisation, HelloFresh’s global technology backbone with more than 1000 people, building the digital products that power our end-to-end food experience. From meal kits and ready-to-eat meals to specialty offerings like pet food and premium meat & seafood, HelloTech creates the platforms that bring tailored food solutions to millions of customers every month. Our subscription-based, direct-to-consumer model relies on technology at every step, from customer-facing apps and personalization logic to pricing, forecasting, supply chain optimization, and initiatives that help reduce food waste. While our brands operate independently to serve distinct customer needs, they are united by shared platforms, data, and operational excellence built by HelloTech.

About the role: What's in the Box

As a Staff Product Manager, you will own and evolve HelloFresh's benefit creation platform, which defines, configures, and governs every discount, voucher, and reward across all our global brands and channels. Leading a dedicated squad of engineers, you will transform this high-impact system into a flexible, scalable, and highly automated platform. This is a foundational infrastructure role where you will design self-serve tooling and robust governance rules, ensuring our marketing and commercial teams can safely launch campaigns without engineering bottlenecks. Your work will directly protect our P&L margins while unlocking innovative, automated capabilities for future customer experiences.

What you’ll do: The Recipe

- Define the long-term vision, strategy, and roadmap for our global benefit and incentive platform, setting the path toward intelligent, automated creation tools.

- Design scalable platform primitives and reusable building blocks to eliminate custom, one-off engineering for individual marketing campaigns.

- Establish automated governance layers, including margin floors and stacking checks, to systematically protect business profitability.

- Build intuitive back-office tooling that enables commercial and growth teams to configure standard campaigns independently.

- Drive cross-functional alignment across international teams, encouraging adoption of a unified platform contract.

- Evaluate and implement automation and smart interfaces where they bring the highest return on investment, balancing flexibility with system reliability.

What you’ll bring: The Ingredients

- Extensive experience in platform product management is essential, with a proven track record of building scalable internal tools, APIs, or foundational infrastructure rather than just user-facing features.

- You bring 6+ years of product management experience, specifically operating already at a Senior or Staff level within complex systems across multiple markets or diverse business lines.

- Exceptional leadership and communication skills are required to align senior, cross-functional stakeholders and champion platform adoption without direct authority.

- It is a strong advantage if you bring a background in commercial strategy or promotional economics, enabling you to design smart business guardrails that balance marketing flexibility with P&L protection.

- Familiarity with data analysis and technical architecture is highly valued, helping you effectively design reliable automation and interpret experiment data alongside engineering teams.

Above all, we are looking for individuals who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What we offer: The Toppings

- Global collaboration at scale: Collaborate with experienced engineers and product partners across HelloTech’s international teams, in a culture of active knowledge sharing.

- Technology with real-world impact: Build and operate modern systems at global scale, supporting 6+ millions of customers and complex supply chain operations.

- Technical/Product/Design leadership: Drive best practices and influence architecture/design, quality, and ways of working in an autonomous, product-led setup.

- End-to-end development/delivery: Drive decisions from problem definition to production, improving systems and enabling long-term scalability.

- Access to workspace at Warsaw Centre Point (Prosta 20). The hub offers modern facilities including showers, breakout zones, outdoor space, cycle parking, and refreshments (coffee, soft drinks, and fruit).

Are you the missing ingredient? If this sounds like a tasty opportunity, we’d be excited to hear from you. We aim to review your profile and respond within 5 business days.

jobs.title: Senior Director of Machine Learning Engineering
jobs.description:
The CVO Tribe

CVO owns two of HelloFresh's largest economic levers: benefit optimization and pricing. The tribe uses machine learning, personalization, and lifetime-value prediction to replace manual, rules-based decisioning with data-driven systems.

The engineering org is globally distributed across Berlin, Warsaw, NYC, Boulder, and Toronto, and includes Frontend, Backend, Data, and ML Engineering, working closely with embedded Data Scientists. The work spans a genuinely mixed engineering profile: ML-heavy systems for benefit recommendation, personalization, and customer lifetime-value forecasting, alongside backend and distributed-systems work powering pricing infrastructure and subscription products at scale.

As Senior Director, based in Berlin, you'll lead this full spectrum, setting technical strategy across ML, backend, and data disciplines and across time zones, without relying on daily co-location.

What you'll do

- Lead an organization of 25-30 engineers, data scientists, and ML practitioners across Berlin, Warsaw, NYC, Boulder, and Toronto, through a layer of Engineering Managers and Staff Engineers reporting into you.

- Own ML strategy for benefit recommendation, personalization, and customer lifetime-value forecasting, as well as backend and distributed-systems strategy for pricing and subscription infrastructure.

- Drive the transformation of ways of working toward fully GenAI-native, cross-functional product teams, building on teams that already ship the majority of their code with AI assistance.

- Own reliability and operational excellence across both ML and backend systems: observability from model output through to customer-facing delivery, SLOs/SLIs, incident management, and MLOps practices such as retraining, rollback, and experiment tracking.

- Partner with Product, Data Science, Marketing, Finance, and adjacent engineering teams to align engineering priorities with business outcomes.

- Manage and develop Engineering Managers and Data Science Leads across disciplines and geographies, holding them accountable for team health, delivery, and engineering standards.
jobs.requirements_raw:
What you'll bring

- Range across ML and backend engineering. You don't need to be hands-on expert in both, but you need credibility in each: enough ML depth to set direction on production ML systems and partner effectively with Data Science, enough distributed-systems depth to be a trusted partner on pricing infrastructure and subscription products.

- Proven leadership of globally distributed teams across multiple countries and time zones, without daily co-location. Comfortable with regular travel and bridging US and European hours.

- Deep ML engineering expertise, including feature engineering, training/serving infrastructure, experimentation, and MLOps. Causal inference or uplift modeling experience is a plus.

- Distributed systems and backend depth, including scaling backend services and data pipelines in revenue-sensitive, high-throughput environments. Subscription or billing experience is a plus.

- AI-native leadership, with a track record of building or scaling AI-native engineering practices, not just adopting AI tools.

- Commercial and pricing domain fluency, or strong aptitude to build it quickly, including benefit optimization, lifetime-value forecasting, and pricing elasticity.

- Proven leadership at scale: 12+ years in software/ML engineering, with 5+ years managing Engineering Managers across more than one technical discipline and geography.

- Operational excellence mindset, with strong grounding in SRE and MLOps practices for systems with direct financial impact.

- Strong cross-functional communication, translating ML, data, and backend concepts into business terms and vice versa.

- Low ego, high ownership, and a bias toward clarity over complexity.

What we offer

- Global collaboration across HelloTech's hubs in Berlin, Warsaw, NYC, Boulder, and Toronto.

- High-leverage, technically diverse work spanning ML, backend, data, and product engineering, with a direct line to business outcomes.

- A genuinely AI-native environment with a mandate to scale that approach further.

- Technical and engineering leadership in an autonomous, product-led setup, with end-to-end ownership from problem definition to production.

- Enjoy a discount on HelloFresh meal kits, delivered straight to your door.

- Build for the long-term with our company pension scheme (not available for interns/working students).

- Benefit from discounted memberships with Urban Sports Club and John Reed, yoga classes, and access to Headspace and Spill.

- Balance your work and life with flexible hours, Work From Home/Abroad options, and a home office setup budget.

- Receive childcare support (not available for interns/working students).

- Embrace "Learning Never Stops" with access to internal trainings and a central L&D budget (remove for interns).

- Work from a modern, comfortable office in Berlin-Kreuzberg and enjoy social events like team outings, Friday beers, and company runs.

Above all, we are looking for individuals who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences, so even if you don't tick every box but think you'd thrive in this role, we'd really like to hear from you.

jobs.title: Staff Full stack Engineer [CONSUMER]
jobs.description:
About the role: What's in the Box

Our New Ventures team is focused on growing our global footprint by launching our core products in new markets and expanding across multiple brands and verticals. We’re a globally distributed team operating across 7+ brands in 15+ countries, building desirable products and seamless, engaging experiences that customers haven’t seen before. With many exciting projects underway, we’re driven to generate the next billion-dollar business—so if you’re passionate about tackling bold challenges, join us!

We are a close-knit group of engineers of different stripes - developers, designers, and product owners - who are working together to solve interesting e-commerce and supply chain problems around how people eat. Sometimes, this involves implementing features to improve the user
journey and making it easier for our customers to buy amazing food. Other times, this means creating stable software solutions that keep our distribution centers running.

We are looking for an engineer to help implement solutions & write beautiful code, working with various team members as we build out our consumer facing applications & the infrastructure that supports them. As a member of our Toronto team, you’ll work with highly-skilled engineers, who in collaboration with our other global teams, have turned HelloFresh into the #1 meal delivery service in the world!

What You’ll Do: The Recipe

- Lead the design and delivery of scalable backend platforms and distributed systems, leveraging AI-assisted and agentic engineering workflows to accelerate delivery and improve system quality.

- Drive technical discovery, requirements refinement, and solution architecture in ambiguous problem spaces, translating product and business goals into scalable execution strategies.

- Design and optimize AI-enabled development workflows, including spec-driven development, agent orchestration, context management, automated verification, and quality validation.

- Partner closely with product, platform, and engineering teams to foster a strong product engineering mindset focused on customer value, experimentation, and measurable outcomes.

- Lead architectural discussions, mentor engineers in modern backend and AI-assisted engineering practices, and establish standards for observability, quality engineering, and system reliability.

- Evaluate emerging technologies and AI tooling to continuously enhance engineering effectiveness, software quality, and organizational scalability while ensuring strong human oversight and operational accountability.

What You’ll Bring: The Ingredients

- Strong experience with microservice architectures, event-driven systems (e.g. Kafka, RabbitMQ), and distributed systems design patterns.

- Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and modern CI/CD practices in production environments.

- Proficiency with relational and document databases, including PostgreSQL, MySQL, and/or MongoDB.

- AI proficiency and advocacy. Hands-on experience leveraging AI technologies through AI-assisted engineering workflows, LLM integrations, agentic development patterns, or ML-driven product capabilities to improve engineering velocity and product outcomes.

- Proficiency and production experience with one or more backend languages such as Golang, Python, or Java.

- Strong communication and collaboration skills. You are comfortable working closely with frontend engineers, designers, product managers, and distributed teams, and can influence technical direction while bringing clarity to complex topics.

What we Offer: The Toppings

- Box Discount - Amazing discounts on 1 box per week! 75% discount on weekly HelloFresh and Chefs Plate meal kits AND 50% off weekly Factor meal box.

- Health & Wellness - Health & Dental benefits from day 1, a Health Spending Account, unlimited access to the Headspace app to meet your self-care needs, and 25% discount on GoodLife fitness memberships!

- Vacation & PTO - Time off is also an important part of self-care! We offer generous vacation and PTO to help you create a good work-life balance.

- Family Benefits - A parental leave top-up program for expectant parents.

- Growth & Development - We support your career progression and invest in your continued learning through experiences and initiatives owned by our dedicated L&D team

- Work Hard & Have Fun - From team socials to engaging company days, you’ll have plenty of opportunity to experience the fun!

- Diversity & Inclusion Initiatives - With impactful ERG’s like FreshPride, Women Empowered and LIMES, we are committed to our diversity, equity & inclusion efforts.

- Food Puns - this one is kind of a big dill if you haven’t already noticed. We even have some punny meeting room names!

Flexible Hybrid Approach

At HelloFresh, we know that flexible work arrangements are essential in enabling you to do your best work, while balancing your personal and life needs. Offering remote work flexibility, along with the opportunity to interact and collaborate in the office are all a part of creating a great employee experience.

To meet these needs, we are pleased to provide Flexible Hybrid work. Flexible Hybrid is a people-first approach that is based on choice, trust, personalization, and empowers teams to choose when and how often they work from the office and work from home, in addition to team days and company days. This means a minimum of 2 days in office per week, with most teams in office between 2-3 days a week.

#LI-HYBRID

Toronto, ON Pay Range

$170,000—$215,000 CAD

jobs.title: Operations Shift Lead – Production (all genders)
jobs.description:
Deine Rolle

Als Operations Shift Lead – Production (all genders) bist Du das Herzstück unserer Produktions- und Lagerabläufe. Du führst ein Team von Bereichsleitern, koordinierst die Produktionspläne und sorgst dafür, dass Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsstandards jederzeit eingehalten werden. Dabei hast Du stets die Effizienz und Produktivität im Blick und treibst Verbesserungen aktiv voran.

Du arbeitest eng mit anderen Schichtleitern und funktionsübergreifenden Teams zusammen, um Prozesse zu optimieren, die Produktionsziele zu erreichen und unseren Betrieb reibungslos am Laufen zu halten. Mit Deinen ausgeprägten Führungsqualitäten, Deinem Blick fürs Detail und Deinem Engagement für kontinuierliche Verbesserungen trägst Du maßgeblich zum Erfolg unseres Unternehmens bei.

Dein Verantwortungsbereich

- Gemeinsam mit Deinem Schicht-Team aus Bereichsleitern und Supervisoren sorgst Du dafür, dass unsere Produktionsziele in Sicherheit, Qualität und Effizienz erreicht werden.

- Du motivierst Dein Team, schaffst eine positive Arbeitsatmosphäre und ermutigst alle, Feedback zu geben und aktiv Verbesserungen mitzugestalten.

- Als zentrale Ansprechperson koordinierst Du Kommunikation, Eskalationen und Reporting – intern wie mit der Produktionsleitung.

- Du planst Ressourcen wie Personal, Zutaten und Energie clever und nachhaltig, damit alles reibungslos läuft.

- Produktionsprobleme gehst Du aktiv auf den Grund, leitest Maßnahmen ein und setzt Verbesserungen erfolgreich um.

- Zusammen mit Deinem Team stellst Du sicher, dass Hygiene-, Gesundheits- und Umweltvorgaben jederzeit eingehalten werden.

- Ein moderner Arbeitsplatz in angenehmer Atmosphäre mit einem engagierten Team in Barleben bei Magdeburg.

jobs.title: Fachkraft für Arbeitssicherheit (all genders)
jobs.description:
Deine Rolle

Als Fachkraft für Arbeitssicherheit (all genders) bist Du die zentrale Ansprechperson bei Fragen zum Thema Arbeits- bzw. Gesundheitsschutz und unterstützt unsere Führungskräfte bei der fachgerechten Umsetzung der gesetzlichen sowie internen Anforderungen an unseren Last Mile Logistikstandorten. Du berätst die operativen Bereiche bei der Identifikation sowie Beurteilung von Gefährdungen und wirkst somit an der Weiterentwicklung einer nachhaltigen Sicherheitskultur mit. Du unterstützt zudem bei der Ableitung und Umsetzung geeigneter Schutzmaßnahmen und trägst mit Deiner fachlichen Expertise dazu bei, ein hohes Sicherheitsniveau in unseren deutschlandweit rund 20 Zustell-Hubs sicherzustellen.

Bitte beachte, dass für diese Tätigkeit eine Reisebereitschaft von ca. 90% sowie ein Führerschein der Klasse B vorausgesetzt werden.

Bitte beachte auch, diese Stelle auf 24 Monate befristet ist (eine anschließende Entfristung wird angestrebt).

Deine Aufgaben

- Beratung der Führungskräfte und operativen Bereiche bei allen Fragen des Arbeits- und Gesundheitsschutzes sowie bei der Umsetzung gesetzlicher und interner Anforderungen zugeschnitten auf unsere Logistik-Hubs

- Unterstützung bei der Ermittlung und Beurteilung von Gefährdungen, bei der Entwicklung geeigneter Schutzmaßnahmen sowie bei Dokumentation und Wirksamkeitskontrolle

- Durchführung und Begleitung von Begehungen, Unfall- und Ereignisanalysen sowie Ableitung geeigneter Präventions- und Verbesserungsmaßnahmen

- Fachliche Beratung zur Einhaltung relevanter Anforderungen des deutschen Arbeitsschutzrechts, insbesondere ArbSchG, BetrSichV, GefStoffV, ArbStättV und des DGUV-Regelwerks

- Beratung und Coaching von Führungskräften sowie operativen Teams zur Gefahrenidentifikation, sicheren Arbeitsgestaltung, Wahrnehmung der Arbeitsschutzverantwortung und Förderung einer nachhaltigen Sicherheitskultur

- Optimierung und Weiterentwicklung von Sicherheitsprozessen durch strukturiertes Prozess- und Risikomanagement sowie Mitwirkung bei Audits und organisatorischen Veränderungen

- Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Fachstellen, insbesondere Brandschutz, Gefahrstoffmanagement, Fuhrpark sowie Behörden und Sachverständigen
jobs.requirements_raw:
Dein Profil

- Abgeschlossene Ausbildung zur Fachkraft für Arbeitssicherheit (Sifa) bzw. Qualifikation nach ASiG und DGUV Vorschrift 2 oder Bereitschaft, diese Qualifikation zu erwerben

- 3+ Jahre Berufserfahrung im Bereich Arbeitssicherheit/EHS/HSE, vorzugsweise in der Logistik, Produktion, Distribution oder vergleichbaren operativen Umgebungen

- Fundierte Kenntnisse des deutschen Arbeitsschutzrechts und DGUV-Regelwerks, insbesondere ArbSchG, BetrSichV, GefStoffV und ArbStättV

- Erfahrung in der fachkundigen Mitwirkung bei Gefährdungsbeurteilungen, Begehungen, Unfallanalysen und Maßnahmenverfolgung

- Idealerweise fachliches Verständnis in den Bereichen Verkehrssicherheit, Flottenmanagement, innerbetrieblicher Transport, Brandschutz und Gefahrstoffmanagement sowie bestenfalls zusätzlich im Umweltrecht bzw. zu BImSchG

- Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (jeweils mind. auf C1 Niveau) sowie ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Beratungskompetenz im Umgang mit operativen Teams

- Analytische, strukturierte und problemlösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe Zusammenhänge in umsetzbare Sicherheitsstrategien zu überführen

Das bieten wir Dir

- Einen Wohlfühlarbeitsplatz mit einem tollen Team

- Rabatte auf unsere HelloFresh Kochboxen und Convini-Produkte

- Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten durch interne Trainings sowie ein jährliches Team-Budget für Weiterbildung

- Ein flexibles Arbeitsumfeld mit Vertrauensarbeitszeit, Work From Home/Work From Abroad und Sabbatical Policy

- Ein umfassendes Onboarding inkl. Buddy-Programm

- Spaß bei Teamevents

- Vergünstigte Fitnessangebote bei Urban Sports Club bzw. John Reed, regelmäßige Yoga-Sessions

- Initiativen für das Wohlbefinden durch Kooperationen mit der Headspace-App und Spill

- Unterstützungsangebote bei der Kinderbetreuung

- Betriebliche Altersvorsorge

- Einen monatlichen Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket

Bist du die fehlende Zutat?

Wenn diese Gelegenheit für Dich lecker klingt, freuen wir uns darauf, von Dir zu hören. Wir bemühen uns, Dein Profil zu prüfen und Dir innerhalb von 5 Werktagen zu antworten.

#JD1005

jobs.title: Purchasing Coordinator
jobs.description:
The Role

At HelloConnect, you will be part of a dynamic team that embraces innovation and leverages advanced technology to create exceptional experiences. Our culture is built on collaboration, continuous learning, and a commitment to excellence. You’ll have the opportunity to work on impactful projects, develop your skills, and grow within a supportive environment that values diverse perspectives and experiences.

In this role, you will take on a key responsibility in supporting our Supply Chain Operations in the generation of purchase orders for various HelloFresh markets across Europe, the UK, Australia, and New Zealand. You will ensure the accuracy and timeliness of our ordering processes using a combination of in-house tools and Google Suite packages. Working closely with the Supply Chain, Procurement, and Forecasting teams, you will raise, edit, and send purchase orders to suppliers, contributing to our ongoing efforts to drive business success and enhance customer satisfaction.

We’re looking for passionate individuals who can bring their unique skills and ideas to the table. Even if you don't meet every requirement but believe you’d excel in this role, we’d love to hear from you!

What you’ll do

-

Drive Inbound Delivery & Order Accuracy: Calculate, raise, edit, and issue accurate purchase orders across assigned category areas to ensure ingredients arrive on time and in full.

-

Perform Comprehensive Audit & Data Quality Checks: Execute thorough quality checks on purchase orders to verify data accuracy prior to supplier distribution, maintaining total confidential and operational integrity.

-

Manage Supplier Communications & Issue Resolution: Serve as the main point of contact for supplier inquiries, resolve transportation or order queries, and manage root-cause analysis to prevent recurring operational issues.

-

Support Daily Administrative & Emergency Operations: Execute essential daily tasks including high-volume data entry, issuing emergency purchase orders, updating delivery schedules, and adjusting inventory data.

-

Maintain Operational Reporting & Forecast Distribution: Build, manage, and update daily operational reports while regularly distributing demand forecast data to suppliers.

-

Collaborate Cross-Functionally Across Supply Chain Teams: Partner closely with Forecasting, Procurement, Warehouse, and Inventory teams to align order processing with customer demand and inventory requirements.

-

Optimize Tooling & Process Efficiency: Monitor in-house tools and Google Suite packages to perform routine data updates, report system glitches, and recommend continuous workflow improvements.
jobs.requirements_raw:
What you’ll bring

GBS Version:

-

At least 2 years of previous purchasing experience as a Buyer.

-

Strong background and expertise in operating Microsoft Office programs (especially Excel) and ERP/MRP systems.

-

Fluent in English; knowledge of other European languages (German, Dutch, French, Spanish, Italian) is a strong plus.

-

Excellent verbal and written communication, collaboration, and self-management skills with a hands-on, proactive mentality.

-

Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills with high attention to detail in a fast-paced environment.

What we offer

- Competitive Compensation: Beyond the standard package, we offer perks like Long Service Benefits (anniversary bonus) to recognize and celebrate your dedication

- Wellness & Perks: We prioritize your well-being by offering mental health support, HMO medical coverage, generous leave benefits plus life insurance for both you and your family's peace of mind

- Growth Opportunities: Invest in your personal development with an annual learning & development budget, plus access to the 360 Learning platform

- Dynamic Environment: Join a rapidly growing global Business Process Outsourcing company, where you'll collaborate with a diverse community spanning across multiple continents and cultures

- Work-Life Balance: Enjoy a healthy balance between your professional and personal life, with a supportive environment that prioritizes your well-being and personal time

Are you up for the challenge?

The first step to your new role starts here. Send in your application, along with your salary expectations and preferred start date. Our dedicated team will thoroughly review your details. We are excited to connect with you soon!

jobs.title: Growth Strategy Data Analyst - Intern (M/F/N)
jobs.description:
Join one of France’s fastest-growing foodtech scale-ups

At HelloFresh, we’re transforming the way people cook and eat. Through our meal-kit boxes, we help thousands of customers cook delicious, balanced meals at home while reducing food waste and simplifying everyday life. Operating in 15+ countries, HelloFresh is one of the world’s leading foodtech companies. The French market, launched in 2020, has experienced hyper growth and became market leader in 2021.

Behind this growth is a simple formula: technology, data, and a team of ambitious people working together to reinvent food at home.

If you want to work at the intersection of data, strategy, and growth, and have a tangible impact on a fast-scaling business, this internship is for you.

Your Role

As a Growth Strategy Data Analyst Intern, you will join the Analytics & Performance team and work closely with the Growth Marketing team to help drive HelloFresh’s growth in France.

You will act as a data partner to business stakeholders, turning complex data into actionable insights that influence key strategic decisions, marketing investment decisions, and customer lifecycle optimization.

Your work will directly impact critical growth levers such as customer acquisition, retention, pricing strategy, and website optimization.

This role combines business analysis, experimentation, and data modeling, giving you end-to-end exposure to how data drives decisions in a growing company.

This role is ideal for candidates who want to apply rigorous analytics to real business problems and see their insights translated into concrete growth decisions.

Your Impact

You will work with modern analytics tools including SQL, Tableau, and Google Sheets, as well as internal data pipelines to analyze large-scale datasets and support data-driven decision-making across the Growth team.

Drive business-impacting analyses

- Conduct deep-dive analyses on key growth topics such as customer acquisition, retention, pricing strategy, discount optimization, and marketing channel performance

- Identify opportunities to improve conversion, marketing efficiency, and customer lifetime value

- Translate complex data into clear, actionable recommendations for business stakeholders

Partner with stakeholders

- Work closely with Growth Marketing managers and team leads to support strategic decisions

- Present insights and recommendations that influence budget allocation and growth strategy

Support experimentation and A/B testing

- Contribute to the design, monitoring, and analysis of A/B tests and growth experiments

- Measure the impact of new initiatives and help scale successful strategies

Build data products and dashboards

- Define and track key business KPIs

- Build and maintain dashboards that enable the marketing team to make data-driven decisions.

- Develop data models, reporting pipelines, and analysis frameworks that help teams scale their decision-making
jobs.requirements_raw:
About You

We’re looking for someone curious, analytical, and eager to tackle complex business problems using data. You are comfortable navigating large datasets, structuring ambiguous questions, and translating analyses into insights that drive business decisions.

- Strong analytical thinking and ability to structure complex business problems

- Advanced proficiency in SQL, Excel / Google Sheets, and data analysis

- Experience with data visualization tools (Tableau is a plus)

- Ability to translate data into clear and actionable business insights

- Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously

- Gap-year or final-year student from a top engineering or business school

- Previous experience in data, consulting, strategy, or analytics

- Fluent in French and English

What You'll Get

- A steep learning curve in one of Europe’s fastest-growing scale-ups

- Exposure to real business decisions driven by data

- A collaborative and international environment

- Discounts on HelloFresh boxes, Swile meal vouchers, and Wellpass

- Offices in the heart of Paris (1st arrondissement)

Hiring Process

- CV review

- Invitation to Case Study

- Interviews with your future managers

Your onboarding

Your first days will include dedicated onboarding sessions with key managers across teams to help you understand HelloFresh’s organization and business model. You’ll then quickly dive into your projects and start contributing to the team’s impact from day one.

jobs.description:

We are looking for a Senior Financial Analyst, reporting to Manager, FP&A to join our team in Toronto. In this role, you will be providing the financial basis as well as analysis to management and senior management to make decisions contributing to overall company goals.

Lettuce share what this role will be responsible for

- Be the lead for the full month-end close (MEC) and Budgeting process for Revenue:

- Act as the primary user of the revenue forecasting model

- Schedule and lead budget meetings with senior management

- Communicate with business stakeholders on timeliness of inputs, manage delays and other requests

We are seeking a driven and analytical Supply Chain Enablement Associate Manager to support the transformation of our ingredients and packaging inbound supply chain. Reporting to the Associate Director, Supply Chain Enablement, you will lead standalone supply chain process and technology improvement workstreams end-to-end — turning operational signals into data-driven cases and delivering measurable impact. As a part of the Procurement team, you will develop deep expertise in our processes, data, and technology, building the analytical foundation that drives continuous improvement across our E2E supply chain.

You will succeed in this role by combining structured analytical thinking, effective cross-functional collaboration, and strong project management skills to independently own and deliver workstreams from problem definition through implementation.

jobs.title: Senior Data Product Engineer, Marketing Customer Profile (all genders)
jobs.description:
Work with HelloFresh in Warsaw and its HelloTech organisation, HelloFresh’s global technology backbone with more than 1000 people, building the digital products that power our end-to-end food experience. From meal kits and ready-to-eat meals to specialty offerings like pet food and premium meat & seafood, HelloTech creates the platforms that bring tailored food solutions to millions of customers every month.

Our subscription-based, direct-to-consumer model relies on technology at every step, from customer-facing apps and personalization logic to pricing, forecasting, supply chain optimization, and initiatives that help reduce food waste. While our brands operate independently to serve distinct customer needs, they are united by shared platforms, data, and operational excellence built by HelloTech.

HelloTech works in autonomous, cross-functional alliances, each owning a specific product or domain end to end. By working with our Warsaw office, you will help shape scalable, data-driven products used across our markets, working with a modern tech stack and international teams to continuously improve how people discover, order, and enjoy HelloFresh’s products, today and in the future.

About the role: What's in the Box

As a Senior Data Product Engineer on the Marketing Customer Profile team under Growth Alliance, you will design and scale the foundational data layer that powers high-impact personalization and real-world segmentation. You will be responsible for integrating diverse data sources into a unified customer view, enabling advanced AI/ML modeling and real-time marketing activations. By optimizing our Databricks-based infrastructure, you will ensure our data is the engine behind every personalized customer journey.

At HelloTech, flexibility and cross-functional collaboration are core to how we work. While this role is aligned to a specific Alliance, strong candidates may also be considered for opportunities across different teams or projects.

What you’ll do: The Recipe

At HelloFresh we are moving away from a model where software developers just execute tickets toward one where product engineers are trusted to own customer problems. A Product Engineer takes a problem, forms a point of view, validates it with customers and data, and ships it using AI as a force multiplier.

- Work on the end-to-end process, including architecture, design, development, deployment, and operations of data pipelines, applying DevOps practices, pair programming, and other cutting-edge methodologies.

- Be an active, solution-oriented contributor within autonomous, cross-functional agile teams collaborating with Product Owners, Back-end Engineers, Front-end Engineers, Product Analysts, and Business Intelligence teams.

- Demonstrate an in-depth understanding of HelloFresh’s core product and architecture, acting as a technical expert for software solutions and offering support to colleagues.

- Work with state-of-the-art technologies like AWS (EMR, Glue, s3, etc), Kafka, PySpark, Kubernetes, Airflow, Prefect, Tecton, Databricks, as well as in-house Data Pipeline tools.

- Work beyond your specialization when the problem demands it. Your specialization is your anchor, not your boundary.

- Operate what you build. You instrument, monitor, and improve your systems in production. Shipping is the beginning of the learning cycle, not the end.

What you’ll bring: The Ingredients

- Hands-on experience working with AI tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) beyond casual experimentation. You use AI agents every day. You have a practical sense of how the context you provide to AI tools shapes output quality, and how to set boundaries on AI-generated work.

- Strong background in data engineering with a focus on writing clean, maintainable Python code

- Proficient in working with cloud platforms and data technologies such as PySpark and Kubernetes. Streaming technologies is a plus.

- Skilled in designing scalable data models and working with relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL) and object stores (e.g., AWS S3)

- Basic understanding of Backend Development

- Track record of building and optimizing efficient, reliable data pipelines

- Committed to ensuring data quality, implementing monitoring practices, and maintaining high testing standards across the development lifecycle

- Comfortable in agile environments, embracing fast iterations, lean principles, and continuous delivery

- Solid hands-on experience working with AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) beyond casual experimentation. You use AI agents as thought partners to onboard on unfamiliar codebases and navigate new areas of the code with confidence. You have a practical sense of how the context you provide to AI tools - specifications, constraints, examples - shapes output quality, and a developing awareness of how agentic outputs can fail, with growing habits around verifying, testing, and setting boundaries on AI-generated work.

- You take full ownership. You have a bias to ship. You finish the last twenty percent.

- You have product sense and are opinionated about what should be built and why, and you can back that opinion with data and user evidence.

Above all, we are looking for individuals who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What we offer: The Toppings

- Global collaboration at scale: Collaborate with experienced engineers and product partners across HelloTech’s international teams, in a culture of active knowledge sharing.

- Technology with real-world impact: Build and operate modern systems at global scale, supporting 6+ millions of customers and complex supply chain operations.

- Technical/Product/Design leadership: Drive best practices and influence architecture/design, quality, and ways of working in an autonomous, product-led setup.

- End-to-end development/delivery: Drive decisions from problem definition to production, improving systems and enabling long-term scalability.

- Access to workspace at Warsaw Centre Point. The hub offers modern facilities including showers, breakout zones, outdoor space, cycle parking, and refreshments (coffee, soft drinks, and fruit).

Are you the missing ingredient? If this sounds like a tasty opportunity, we’d be excited to hear from you. We aim to review your profile and respond within 5 business days.
