jobs.title: Senior Manager, Sales Strategy & Planning, Retail
jobs.description:
Senior Manager, Sales Strategy & Planning, Retail and Food Service

This is a hybrid role to the NYC HelloFresh Headquarters

Factor is building the next growth platform in fresh prepared meals. We’ve already built one of the leading DTC meal brands in North America, and now we’re extending that strength into retail and foodservice, where customers are increasingly looking for better, fresher, more convenient meals. We believe this is a category ready for real disruption, and early signals show that Factor’s product, brand, and customer promise are resonating.

We are hiring a Sr. Manager, Sales Strategy & Planning, Retail & Foodservice to build the commercial operating system that turns this ambition into a scalable business. Reporting to the Director, Commercial Sales, Retail & Foodservice, you will own commercial forecasting and sales planning, trade and revenue growth management, pricing architecture, commercial reporting, and new item launch processes - much of which doesn't exist yet and is yours to build.

This is a high-impact role for someone analytical, structured, commercially curious, and energized by building systems where none exist. You'll be the connective tissue across sales, supply chain, finance, marketing, and operations. If you've built a forecast from scratch, run a post-promotion analysis, and kept a new-account launch on track across sales, supply chain, and finance, this role was designed for you.

You will...

- Own the master commercial forecast by customer, SKU, and week, consolidating inputs from retail sales, foodservice, and account teams; partner with Supply Chain on S&OP, forecast assumptions, promotional lifts, new item launch curves, and key customer and channel scenarios.

- Build and maintain the master trade calendar across retail and foodservice accounts, integrating promotional activity with retail / shopper marketing, account milestones, and commercial planning cycles.

- Track trade spend against budget, build promotional ROI models, and run post-event analysis — building the trade guardrails, margin visibility, and revenue management discipline the commercial team plans against.

- Own customer pricing files, price lists, and cost-change workflows; govern account data and prepare the materials behind pricing committee decisions.

- Build the weekly and monthly commercial dashboards covering shipments, forecast, sell-through, trade, pricing, distribution, new item performance, and key account risks.

- Own the data behind category reviews and customer meetings — scorecards, velocity and distribution readouts, the appendix — and turn category analytics into clear commercial recommendations.

- Serve as the commercial gatekeeper for new item commercialization, owning launch timelines, commercialization one-pagers, retailer submission readiness, and first 26-week launch scorecards.

- Partner closely with Sales & BD, Foodservice, Retail / Shopper Marketing, Supply Chain, Finance, and Operations to keep customer meetings, trade plans, marketing activity, launches, and account calendars synchronized.

- Document core commercial processes and build the repeatable SOPs for forecasting, pricing, item setup, reporting, and account planning.

You are...

- Analytically self-sufficient: you can build models, dashboards, trackers, and data views independently, and translate analysis into clear business recommendations.

- A process builder: you are energized by creating systems, calendars, scorecards, and SOPs where none exist yet.

- Commercially minded: you understand that forecasting, pricing, trade, and analytics are only useful if they help the team make better customer, operational, and P&L decisions.

- Organized and detail-oriented without losing the big picture: you can manage multiple accounts, SKUs, launches, deadlines, and stakeholders while knowing what needs escalation.

- A strong collaborator: you build trust with sales, supply chain, finance, marketing, business operations, and external data partners through accuracy, reliability, and follow-through.

- Structured communicator: you can turn complex data, risks, and trade-offs into concise, decision-ready summaries for commercial leaders and cross-functional partners.

- Proactive and ownership-oriented: you send the update before being asked, flag the risk before it becomes a problem, and help keep the team moving.

- Comfortable in a fast-moving build environment: you can create structure as the business scales, even when the process is not fully defined yet.

You have...

- 6+ years in sales strategy, sales planning, commercial strategy, trade marketing, revenue growth management, category management, consulting, or CPG analytics.

- Experience building and owning a commercial forecast, trade calendar, pricing file, or planning process end-to-end — not just contributing inputs to someone else's.

- Strong Excel / Google Sheets modeling skills; experience with dashboards, BI tools, or SQL is a plus.

- Experience with retail sales data, syndicated data (e.g. Circana, NielsenIQ), retailer portals, or category management is strongly preferred.

- Exposure to CPG, retail, grocery, food, beverage, or fresh / refrigerated categories is a plus.

- Experience partnering with sales, finance, supply chain, and marketing on commercial planning or launch execution.

- Strong written and verbal communication, with comfort preparing leadership-ready materials.

- BA/BS or equivalent experience; MBA a plus.

You’ll get…

- 401k with company match that vest immediately upon participation, and company equity plan based on role

- Generous PTO, including sabbatical, and parental leave of up to 16 weeks

- Comprehensive health and wellness benefits with options at $0 monthly, effective first day of employment

- Tuition reimbursement for continuing education (upon 2 years of service)

- Up to 85% discount on subscriptions to HelloFresh meal plans (HelloFresh, Green Chef, Everyplate, and Factor_)

- Access to 7 different Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) including those for BIPOC, women, veterans, parents, and LGBTQ+

- Inclusive, collaborative, and dynamic work environment within a fast-paced, mission-driven company that is disrupting the traditional food supply chain

You will lead the sourcing of third-party manufactured products, owning the full lifecycle from co-manufacturer qualification to supplier portfolio governance. jobs.title: Delivery Capacity & Demand Manager (f/m/x)
jobs.description:
About the role: What's in the Box

Every day, a defined set of rules decides what every new HelloFresh customer sees: a unique mix of delivery days, prices and recommended selections. Your job, should you choose to accept it, is to keep that rule-set correct in a constantly moving environment: configuring it, checking it daily, documenting it, and fixing exceptions before a misconfiguration reaches a customer or a warehouse.

You'll join Demand Steering, the team within Network Operations Europe that shapes those offerings so they add up to a plan our warehouses and logistics partners can actually execute. That means balancing what customers want against the real constraints of the journey from click to delivery: every box still has to be produced in a shift at a production facility and delivered by a van on a route.

Using our in-house demand steering tool, you'll configure the delivery offering customers see at checkout across your own set of European markets: which delivery days and time windows are offered, at what price, with which recommendation, and to which customer segment. As technical owner of that configuration, you'll balance demand against capacity: working with supply chain planners, local market teams and our tech partners to validate holiday shifts and peak periods, check daily that the offering behaved as intended, and catch misconfigurations before a customer or a warehouse feels them..

What you’ll do: The Recipe

- Own the delivery proposition for your set of European markets: the delivery days, time windows, cut-offs, pricing nudges and recommendations customers see when they place or change an order.

- Configure and calibrate our in-house demand steering tool, so demand is guided towards the capacity we have rather than blocked outright when a production site or delivery route fills up.

- Monitor daily whether the offering ran as expected across your markets, and get to the bottom of it when it didn't: a data pipeline that stalled, a setting that's off, or a shift in how customers are behaving.

- Dig into the data with SQL and our monitoring dashboards to establish what actually happened,.

- Make it make sense to turn technical outcomes into a clear story for colleagues who don't live inside the tool.

- Partner with supply chain planners, logistics teams, local market colleagues and our tech partners to translate their constraints into configurations, and to flag early where a forecast and a delivery plan are heading for a collision.

- Lead the validation for holiday shifts and peak periods, giving a clear go/no-go recommendation backed by evidence rather than instinct.

- Shape where the tool goes next, improving the configurations, checks and documentation that keep demand steering reliable as we roll the model out across more markets.

What you’ll bring: The Ingredients

- Experience in logistics, supply chain, operations or a related field, where you've seen how a change to what you offer customers affects their journey

- Confidence with data: you write your own SQL queries, work comfortably in spreadsheets, and read a dashboard closely enough to tell a real signal from noise.

- A methodical way of working: you like things documented and done properly, and you stay effective while the system around you is still being built out.

- The ability to explain a technical problem to a non-technical colleague, and to make a recommendation land with evidence behind it.

- An appetite for ownership over the long haul: you'd rather take one system and develop true mastery in it than move from project to project.

- Fluent English, and you're based in Berlin or ready to move there.

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. There are many different ways of developing skills, and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What we offer: The Toppings

Elevate your lifestyle! Join one of Europe's fastest-growing tech powerhouses in a dynamic phase of expansion.

- Immerse yourself in a diverse global community of 90+ nationalities.

- Enjoy a competitive compensation package that goes beyond the norm, with perks like a HelloFresh- subsidized Pension Scheme, Berlin relocation support, and a Hybrid working model.

- Elevate your lifestyle with exclusive discounts on your weekly HelloFresh box and office meals.

- Invest in your growth with a German language learning budget, and access to the HelloFresh Academy.

- Plus, we've got your well-being covered with mental health support, transportation perks, and working-parent-friendly benefits. From our 24/7 gym access,wellbeing platforms like Headspace and Spill, to sabbatical leave options, HelloFresh is not just a workplace; it's a lifestyle of perks and possibilities!

Are you the missing ingredient? If this sounds like a tasty opportunity, we’d be excited to hear from you. We aim to review your profile and respond within 5 business days.

jobs.description:
At HelloFresh, the goal is to change the way people eat forever by delivering high-quality food across 18 countries and 3 continents. As a global food solutions group and the world's leading meal kit provider, the portfolio includes HelloFresh, Green Chef, EveryPlate, Chefs Plate, Factor_, and Youfoodz.

Engaging with HelloFresh in Warsaw means collaborating with HelloTech—a global technology division of over 1,000 people powering an end-to-end food ecosystem. From digital personalization and forecasting to supply chain optimization and food waste reduction, technology drives every step of this direct-to-consumer model.

About the Role: What's in the Box

HelloTech operates in autonomous, cross-functional alliances, each holding accountability for a specific product domain end to end. In this role you will join an assigned squad, with the flexibility to transition between teams and projects as technical objectives and business priorities evolve.

Several technical domains are actively engaging providers. Projects will be aligned based on individual strengths and expertise during the process. Key technical domains include:

- Deliveries & Orders / Plans: Core backend systems turning a subscription into correct physical deliveries for millions of customers.

- Active Journey: Maintaining customer lifecycle stability: features covering habits, subscription management, ordering, and graceful error recovery at scale.

- Menu Personalization & Forecasting: Utilizing data and applied science workflows to tailor user interfaces and predict regional consumer demand.

- Operations & Supply Chain (SCM): Procurement, inventory, labeling, and production systems solving physical-world challenges with software.

Across all domains, the technical profile consists of highly available, event-driven distributed systems serving global architectures. This role does not include people management responsibilities.

What You’ll Do: The Recipe

At HelloFresh we are moving away from a model where software developers just execute tickets toward one where product engineers are trusted to own customer problems. A Product Engineer takes a problem, forms a point of view, validates it with customers and data, and ships it using AI as a force multiplier.

- Maintain accountability for the architecture, design, development, deployment, and operation of microservices under a full DevOps model.

- Take the technical lead on backend-heavy product problems, designing, building and operating the services and systems needed to deliver them reliably at scale.

- Build event-driven systems utilizing messaging technologies such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, or AWS SQS/SNS, and expose data via clean REST and gRPC interfaces.

- Work extensively with Docker, container orchestration via Kubernetes, and CI/CD automated deployment pipelines.

- Maintain a strong commitment to testing, executing robust test suites stretching from unit tests through to full end-to-end coverage.

- Collaborate closely within cross-functional agile teams including product leads, frontend engineers, designers, and data teams.

- Provide technical guidance and support to surrounding team members, actively participating in code and architecture reviews.

- Leverage modern AI tools and workflows (e.g., Claude, Cursor) as a standardized component of engineering delivery to increase productivity.

- Work beyond your specialization when the problem demands it. Your specialization is your anchor, not your boundary.

- Operate what you build. You instrument, monitor, and improve your systems in production. Shipping is the beginning of the learning cycle, not the end.

What You’ll Bring: The Ingredients

- Hands-on experience working with AI tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) beyond casual experimentation. You use AI agents every day. You have a practical sense of how the context you provide to AI tools shapes output quality, and how to set boundaries on AI-generated work.

- Strong fluency in Go or a JVM language (Java/Kotlin) and hands on experience building distributed systems in production: event-driven and asynchronous flows, clear service contracts, and designing for partial failure. High proficiency in one stack is required, with a willingness to expand technical knowledge into Go. You operate what you build, including its observability and data layer.

- Solid experience building, deploying, and operating critical backend services in a production environment.

- Technical comfort navigating distributed systems, messaging queues, containerization, and modern deployment infrastructure.

- Strong software engineering instincts, including practical application of design methodologies like TDD, BDD, or DDD, and the ability to make sensible technical trade-offs.

- Excellent communication capabilities to operate effectively inside an international, multi-disciplinary technical environment.

- You take full ownership. You have a bias to ship. You finish the last twenty percent.

- You have product sense and are opinionated about what should be built and why, and you can back that opinion with data and user evidence.

What We Offer: The Toppings

- Global collaboration at scale: Collaborate with experienced engineers and product partners across HelloTech’s international teams, in a culture of active knowledge sharing.

- Technology with real-world impact: Build and operate modern systems at global scale, supporting millions of customers and complex supply chain operations.

- Technical/Product/Design leadership: Drive best practices and influence architecture/design, quality, and ways of working in an autonomous, product-led setup.

- End-to-end development/delivery: Drive decisions from problem definition to production, improving systems and enabling long-term scalability.

- Access to workspace at Warsaw Centre Point: The hub offers modern facilities including showers, breakout zones, outdoor space, cycle parking, and refreshments (coffee, soft drinks, and fruit).

jobs.title: DC Senior Supply Chain Manager (H/F/X)
jobs.description:
Rejoins une superstar de la foodtech française

Chez HelloFresh, nous bousculons les habitudes alimentaires des français grâce à nos Box à cuisiner !

Notre ambition ? Révolutionner le quotidien de nos abonnés, en promouvant une façon plus durable de cuisiner et en leur faisant découvrir de délicieuses recettes, créatives et équilibrées. L’alliance parfaite entre technologie et gastronomie, pour un maximum de gourmandise.

HelloFresh est présent dans plus de 15 pays. La France, un jeune marché lancé en 2019, connaît une ascension fulgurante : nous y sommes déjà leaders depuis 2021. Le moment parfait pour rejoindre notre équipe et avoir un impact fort dans l'une des scales up françaises les plus prometteuses !

Comment rendre tout cela possible ? Grâce à une équipe talentueuse et dynamique, des valeurs fortes de bienveillance et de diversité, et un environnement de travail stimulant.

Les missions du poste

Pour notre jeune équipe de passionnés, nous sommes à la recherche d’un.e Responsable Supply Chain Site.

A- En tant que Responsable de l’équipe Supply Chain site:

- Assurer un environnement de travail sûr et sain, visant le “zéro accident”

- Manager les équipes: Réception, Entrepôt, Expédition, construire les plans de développement personnel, fixer les objectifs de performance, et accompagner les équipes pour y parvenir.

- Superviser l’équipe Réception dont le rôle est de recevoir, compter, contrôler, et mettre à disposition de la Production les marchandises fraîches entrantes, en quantités exactes, aux emplacements prévus et en temps voulu

- Superviser l’équipe Entrepôt dont le rôle est d’assurer la réception, le stockage et la mise à disposition des marchandises à longue conservation pour l’équipe de Production, en quantités exactes, aux emplacements prévus et en temps voulu

- Superviser l’équipe Expédition dont le rôle est la gestion de l’entreposage et du dispatching des palettes de produits finis dans les délais impartis / gestion des déchets

- Cadrer et optimiser les communications entre les équipes susmentionnées et les équipes FSQA (qualité), Procurement (achat et approvisionnement), et Production, pour assurer un démarrage de la production dans les meilleures conditions, chaque jour ; Être proactif et moteur dans la résolution des problèmes rencontrés

- Gérer les niveaux de stock des marchandises à longue conservation et non-alimentaire ; travailler main dans la main avec l’équipe Procurement pour minimiser les pertes alimentaires

- Mettre en place et optimiser les outils de suivi et de gestion de stock et mener des revues d’inventaires hebdomadairement et mensuellement en s’inspirant des pratiques existantes sur les autres sites HelloFresh

- En collaboration avec le Responsable OPEX et le DA Production, fixer les objectifs de performances de votre équipe et concevoir la stratégie pour y parvenir

- Mener une démarche d’amélioration continue basée sur les concepts de Lean Manufacturing

B- En tant que cadre sur un site de production:

- Être exemplaire en terme de sécurité au quotidien

- Toujours placer la sécurité mentale et physique du personnel, ainsi que la qualité du produit, avant les impératifs de coût

- Contribuer à créer un environnement de travail où l’excellence industrielle est atteinte sur le long terme en plaçant la sécurité et le bonheur au travail au centre des préoccupations au quotidien

- Faire vivre les valeurs de HelloFresh sur le site

- Participer à, et si nécessaire mener, les réunions de suivi production quotidiennes et hebdomadaires

Ton Profil:

- Tu es passionné.e par le management d’équipes en entrepôt logistique et tu aimes former ces personnels sur de nouveaux outils et processus

- Diplômé.e en Management de la Supply Chain ou Génie Industriel ou détenteur d’une expérience terrain équivalente, tu justifies de 3 ans d’expérience dans l’encadrement d’équipes en milieu logistique ou industriel (idéalement dans l’industrie alimentaire)

- Tu es très à l’aise dans l’utilisation de système type WMS et ERP, idéalement tu as participé à la mise en place de tels outils par le passé

- Tu as une bonne capacité analytique (data, analyses…)

- Tu as une bonne connaissance des outils du Lean Manufacturing (5S, management visuel, PDCA, VSM, TPM, ...)

- Tu es capable de travailler en anglais (impératif) car nous évoluons dans un environnement international

Infos complémentaires

- Véhicule indispensable

- Astreintes possibles

jobs.title: Accounts Payable Specialist
jobs.description:
The Role

At HelloConnect, you will be part of a dynamic team that embraces innovation and leverages advanced technology to create exceptional experiences. Our culture is built on collaboration, continuous learning, and a commitment to excellence. You’ll have the opportunity to work on impactful projects, develop your skills, and grow within a supportive environment that values diverse perspectives and experiences.

In this role as an Accounts Payables Specialist, you will take on a key responsibility in managing accounts payable workflows and maintaining accurate financial records for our German and international companies. You will ensure supplier invoices are coded and processed correctly, resolve discrepancies, and help keep open items organized and up to date. This role is ideal for an experienced finance professional who values accuracy, strong communication, and efficient digital financial processes.

We’re looking for passionate individuals who can bring their unique skills and ideas to the table. Even if you don't meet every requirement but believe you’d excel in this role, we’d love to hear from you!

What you’ll do

- Global Accounts Payable: Run the end-to-end invoice process for our German and international entities. You’ll ensure incoming invoices are accurately checked, meticulously coded for tax in D365, and smoothly routed through our digital workflows.

- Proactive Vendor Management: Manage open items and handle incoming electronic mail and supplier reminders. You'll act as the professional bridge between us and our vendors, ensuring inquiries are addressed promptly and vendor relationships remain strong.

- Dispute & Inquiry Resolution: Act as our internal "problem solver" for payment roadblocks. You’ll collaborate closely with internal departments and the Invoice Coordinator to investigate discrepancies, resolve issues, and keep our financial operations flowing.

- System Integrity & Compliance: Take charge of the formal review during preliminary digital entry. You’ll be our first line of defense, meticulously verifying all invoices for accuracy, completeness, and total compliance with company policies before approval.

- Month-End Support: Help us achieve a seamless, stress-free close process by maintaining spotless accounts payable reconciliations. You’ll engage in regular, vital exchange with the general ledger team to support both month-end and year-end closing activities.
jobs.requirements_raw:
What you’ll bring

- Solid AP Background: 3–5+ years of experience in Accounts Payable or Finance Operations, ideally within a high-volume, BPO, or shared services environment. We are looking for someone who can hit the ground running; a degree in a relevant field and experience supporting international entities are huge pluses.

- The Problem Solver: You don’t just process invoices; you have a sharp eye for detail, accuracy, and compliance. You enjoy investigating payment discrepancies, managing open items, and successfully resolving supplier inquiries.

- Tech-Savvy: You’re highly comfortable navigating ERP platforms like Microsoft Dynamics 365 (or SAP/Oracle) and have strong proficiency in Excel for data analysis and reporting. You appreciate the efficiency of digital invoice workflows and automated approval processes.

- The Communicator: You excel at stakeholder management, seamlessly coordinating with internal departments and maintaining a highly professional, collaborative rapport with our external vendors.

- Driven & Organized: You thrive when managing multiple priorities and strict deadlines without sacrificing accuracy. You bring a strong understanding of accounts payable processes, tax coding, and financial controls to confidently support our month-end close.

What we offer

- Competitive Compensation: Beyond the standard package, we offer perks like Long Service Benefits (anniversary bonus) to recognize and celebrate your dedication

- Wellness & Perks: We prioritize your well-being by offering mental health support, HMO medical coverage, generous leave benefits plus life insurance for both you and your family's peace of mind

- Growth Opportunities: Invest in your personal development with an annual learning & development budget, plus access to the 360 Learning platform

- Dynamic Environment: Join a rapidly growing global Business Process Outsourcing company, where you'll collaborate with a diverse community spanning across multiple continents and cultures

- Work-Life Balance: Enjoy a healthy balance between your professional and personal life, with a supportive environment that prioritizes your well-being and personal time

Location: Work from home – Please note that you will need to visit our BGC office to pick up your equipment.

Are you up for the challenge?

The first step to your new role starts here. Send in your application, along with your salary expectations and preferred start date. Our dedicated team will thoroughly review your details. We are excited to connect with you soon!

The HelloFresh Group includes eight brands serving customers across multiple meal occasions, including HelloFresh, Green Chef, EveryPlate, and Chefs Plate, as well as ready-to-eat meals from Factor and YouFoodz, meat and seafood subscriptions through Good Chop, and pet nutrition with The Pets Table. Through technology, data, and culinary innovation, we deliver personalised food experiences to millions of households worldwide.

Work with HelloFresh in Berlin and its HelloTech organisation — HelloFresh's global technology backbone with more than 1,000 people, building the digital products that power our end-to-end food experience. From meal kits and ready-to-eat meals to specialty offerings like pet food and premium meat and seafood, HelloTech creates the platforms that bring tailored food solutions to millions of customers every month.

Our subscription-based, direct-to-consumer model relies on technology at every step, from customer-facing apps and personalisation logic to pricing, forecasting, supply chain

About the role: What's in the box

HelloFresh Group is building the next generation of consumer experiences across its portfolio — from discovery and personalisation to shopping and subscription management. The Consumer UX team is at the heart of this work, designing end-to-end experiences that are simple, delightful, and grounded in real customer needs.

We're hiring Senior UX Designers across two squads: one embedded in Good Chop, our premium American meat and seafood subscription brand, and one in our central Consumer UX team working across the broader HelloFresh Group portfolio. Both roles share the same craft bar, strategic expectations, and ways of working — the difference is context and squad focus.

These are full-ownership roles in a startup-paced environment. You'll partner with Product and Engineering on a cross-functional squad — the PM owns the roadmap, you own the UX direction. UX here is a strategic input, not a downstream service.

What you’ll do: The Recipe

- Consumer Experience Design: Lead design from concept to shipped product, maintaining accountability for the full consumer experience across touchpoints. You hold a high bar for quality at every stage — from early framing through final execution.

- Strategy and Roadmap Influence: Frame problems before they become briefs. Bring evidence-backed consumer insight into squad planning — challenge priorities, surface opportunities, and influence what gets built. You're a strategic partner in roadmap conversations, contributing to direction from the start.

- Craft and Execution: Hold a high personal bar across UI, interaction design, motion, micro-interaction, and UX writing — and raise the standard within your squad. Use animation and motion as intentional tools, not decoration.

- AI-Native Workflow: Use AI across the full workflow — synthesis, discovery, rapid prototyping, design-to-code. A working method that lets you move faster and think sharper.

What you’ll bring: The Ingredients

- Experience: 6+ years in product design, with a proven track record delivering high-quality consumer products end-to-end.

- Consumer Instinct: You've worked on consumer-facing products and understand how real people make decisions — to try something, to stay, to leave. You think about the full customer lifecycle, not just the next feature. Subscription context is a plus.

- Strategic Range: You define the problem before designing the solution. You've pushed back on a brief, reframed a PM's question, or changed a roadmap priority through evidence. You bring design into the strategy conversation because you built the case, not because you were invited.

- Craft Mastery: Exceptional visual and interaction design skills with a high personal bar. Deep focus on hierarchy, motion, micro-interaction, and animation. Figma mastery is non-negotiable. You understand front-end constraints well enough to have credible conversations with engineers.

- High Agency: Proactivity to push for the right solution rather than the convenient one, with conviction in your design decisions and the ability to bring cross-functional partners along.

- Research Fluency: You can frame a research question, run a lightweight study, and translate findings into design direction without needing a researcher to drive the process. You know when to go deeper and how to collaborate with experts.

- AI-Native in Practice: Active use of AI tools in live project work — synthesis, discovery, prototyping, design-to-code. Fluency with tools like Figma AI and Claude is expected. This is how you work, not something you're working towards.

- Communication: You present clearly, facilitate alignment across functions, and can run a workshop as confidently as you can ship a screen. You make the case for your decisions with evidence, not opinion.

What We Offer: The Toppings

- Elevate your lifestyle! Join one of Europe's fastest-growing tech powerhouses in a dynamic phase of expansion.

- Immerse yourself in a diverse global community of 90+ nationalities.

- Enjoy a competitive compensation package that goes beyond the norm, with perks like a HelloFresh- subsidized Pension Scheme, Berlin relocation support, and a Hybrid working model.

- Elevate your lifestyle with exclusive discounts on your weekly HelloFresh box and office meals.

- Invest in your growth with a German language learning budget, and access to the HelloFresh Academy.

- Plus, we've got your well-being covered with mental health support, transportation perks, and working-parent-friendly benefits. From our 24/7 gym access,wellbeing platforms like Headspace and Spill, to sabbatical leave options, HelloFresh is not just a workplace; it's a lifestyle of perks and possibilities!

Ons Facility and Maintenance Team is de motor achter ons nieuwe distributiecentrum in Bleiswijk en zorgt er dagelijks voor dat productie soepel blijft draaien. Jouw werk ondersteunt direct onze collega's binnen productie, door hen een schone, veilige en goed-georganiseerde werkomgeving te bieden. Ben jij hands-on, proactief en hou je van afwisseling in je dag? Dan is dit jouw kans om een zichtbare en praktische impact te maken op onze locatie.

- Je houdt de administratie en documentatie nauwkeurig bij

Wat wij zoeken

- Een relevante achtergrond; het is een pré als je al wat ervaring hebt in facilitaire zaken, logistiek of productiewerk

jobs.title: Social Content Creator
jobs.description:
About The Role:
We're looking for a culturally-switched-on Social Content Creator to shape how HelloFresh and Green Chef show up organically across TikTok and Instagram, while also building paid hooks that amplify what's working. You're a storyteller first, someone who can capture a real moment, build a brand world, and move at the speed of culture. You work closely with Creative Strategy, PR and product teams to make sure content is joined up, whether that's amplifying a launch, staying ahead of a sensitive moment, or keeping your creative output aligned with what's happening across the broader business.

What You Will Be Doing:

- Organic content creation (60%): Own the creative production for HelloFresh and Green Chef's organic social channels, TikTok, Instagram Reels, and Stories. Ideate, film, and edit content that feels genuinely native to each platform and each brand.

- Cultural moments and reactive content: You're plugged in. You spot a trend, a moment, or a cultural conversation and move fast, translating it into content that's relevant to HelloFresh or Green Chef without feeling forced or late.

- EGC and community-first content: Champion employee-generated and community content that makes both brands feel human and real. Whether it's a team member's kitchen, a customer's box arrival, or a behind-the-scenes prep moment, you know how to shape raw material into something worth watching.

- Copy and community voice: Write captions that earn the scroll-stop and comments that make the brand feel like a person. You're in the comments sparking conversations, replying in a way that builds a following, and turning passive viewers into people who actually care about the brand.

- Brand judgement: You have a strong point of view and aren't afraid to use it, but you also know which hills aren't worth dying on. You can read a moment, take a calculated risk on a spiky caption, and pull back when the brand's reputation matters more than the engagement.

- Brand world content: Build and hold the visual and tonal brand worlds for both HelloFresh and Green Chef, they are distinct, and you'll maintain that distinction while keeping content fresh, platform-native, and never stale.

- Documentary-style storytelling: You’re comfortable being front of camera. Bring depth and craft to both brands, following a Green Chef recipe from field to fork, documenting what a real week of HelloFresh cooking looks like, or capturing the texture of life inside the business. You shoot and edit with intention.

- Paid video hooks (40%): Convert organic learnings into paid-ready hooks and short-form ad formats. Work with the paid social team to identify what's resonating organically and rapidly translate it into tested paid creative.

- Trend research and idea generation: Constantly scouting, TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts, food culture, competitor brands, and bringing a consistent pipeline of fresh ideas to the team each week.

jobs.title: Marketing Analyst - Growth & Analytics (M/F/X)
jobs.description:
Rejoins une superstar de la foodtech française

Chez HelloFresh, nous bousculons les habitudes alimentaires des français grâce à nos Box à cuisiner !

Notre ambition ? Révolutionner le quotidien de nos abonné.e.s, en promouvant une façon plus durable de cuisiner et en leur faisant découvrir de délicieuses recettes, créatives et équilibrées. L'alliance parfaite entre technologie et gastronomie, pour un maximum de gourmandise.

La France est l'un des plus jeunes marchés du groupe, lancé en 2019, et nous y avons connu une croissance fulgurante nous propulsant comme leader du marché. Rejoindre notre équipe, c'est la garantie d'avoir un impact fort dans l'une des scale-up françaises les plus prometteuses !

Comment rendre tout cela possible ? Grâce à une équipe talentueuse et dynamique, des valeurs fortes de bienveillance et de diversité, et un environnement de travail stimulant.

Si tu souhaites prendre part à cette incroyable aventure humaine, internationale et entrepreneuriale, rejoins-nous !

Le poste :

L'équipe Marketing Analytics France est une petite équipe au cœur du pilotage de la performance marketing FR. En tant qu'Analyste Marketing, tu reporteras à notre Analytics and Retention Lead, et tu seras un maillon essentiel de notre équipe Growth/Marketing : tu es au cœur de nos décisions et garant.e de la fiabilité des données qui les alimentent.

Ce rôle est central pour faire tourner nos opérations analytiques au quotidien (en gardant le ROI et la CLV au centre de toutes nos décisions marketing), tout en contribuant à la réflexion de plus long terme sur notre stratégie de croissance et nos insights clients. C'est un poste varié : tu pourras passer une journée à planifier un AB test avec un channel manager, la suivante à contribuer à un exercice de budget, et la troisième à driver l'adoption d'un nouvel outil IA au sein de l'équipe. Tu bénéficieras d'une forte exposition auprès de nombreuses équipes (marketing, produit, opérations, stratégie).

Ce que tu feras :

- Performance marketing : tu suis notre performance marketing et pilotes nos principaux KPIs. Tu détectes les signaux de performance (court et long terme) et les fais remonter auprès des équipes concernées.

- Analyses ad-hoc / Business partner des channel managers : tu es au cœur de nos initiatives growth/marketing. Tu aides les channel managers à construire et analyser leurs tests, pour en tirer les meilleures conclusions possibles. Tu es un vrai partenaire de réflexion pour ces équipes.

- Développement et maintenance d'outils analytiques et de process : tu conçois et maintiens des outils analytiques internes (scripts, dashboards, automatisations) pour soutenir les workflows de l'équipe Growth. Par exemple : les reports quotidiens, les meetings hebdo ou le budget bi-annuel.

- Analyses stratégiques : tu travailleras sur la définition de notre stratégie de croissance — pénétration géographique et par canal, allocation des investissements marketing, arbitrages entre acquisition et rétention pour éclairer des décisions qui engagent l'entreprise sur plusieurs années, avec une forte exposition au C-level France.

- Implémentation IA : tu seras un 'AI champion' pour augmenter l'efficacité de nos process. Tu mettras en place de l'agentic analytics, et accompagneras le reste de l'équipe marketing dans l'automatisation de certains process existants.

- Collaboration cross-équipes : tu seras en collaboration étroite avec l'équipe marketing évidemment, mais aussi les équipes finance, produit & opérations (pour comprendre les comportements des clients), et Global Analytics (située à Berlin).

Ce qu'on recherche chez un.e candidat.e :

- Tu es hautement analytique : tu sais lire la donnée et les tendances, puis traduire des analyses complexes en recommandations claires et actionnables pour des interlocuteurs non techniques.

- Tu as une grande attention au détail et fais preuve d'une grande rigueur.

- Tu as 2 à 4 ans d'expérience en analytics, business intelligence ou performance marketing, idéalement dans un environnement e-commerce, D2C ou fast-paced.

- Tu es issu.e d'une formation supérieure (école de commerce, d'ingénieur, ou cursus universitaire) avec une spécialisation data/analytics.

- Tu maîtrises Excel/Google Sheets à un niveau avancé, et tu es à l'aise avec des outils de BI (Tableau, Clarisights ou équivalent). Tu maîtrises les principaux outils IA (Claude Cowork/Code). SQL est un vrai plus.

- Tu es organisé.e et tu sais prioriser entre des sujets multiples, à la fois opérationnels et stratégiques.

- Tu es autonome et proactif.ve : tu identifies les bonnes questions autant que tu y réponds. Tu es force de proposition et agis comme sparring partner pour les équipes avec lesquelles tu travailles, afin de nourrir la réflexion.

- Tu parles couramment français et anglais à l'oral comme à l'écrit.

- Bonus : tu as une appétence pour le secteur food, retail ou grande consommation.

Ce que nous t'offrons :

- Un impact réel : tes analyses alimentent directement les décisions de croissance d'une des plus belles scale-ups européennes.

- Une équipe bienveillante et une petite team qui t'aidera à monter rapidement en compétence.

- Un environnement international, au contact des équipes Global Marketing Analytics.

- Des bureaux au cœur de Paris, une culture dynamique et entrepreneuriale.

- Avantages : réductions HelloFresh, tickets restaurant Swile, mutuelle, participation transport, accès Gymlib.

Le déroulé du processus de recrutement :

Nous examinons ton CV et ta lettre de motivation. Si c'est un match, nous t'invitons à une série d'entretiens et à réaliser un case study :

Tes débuts chez HelloFresh :

A ton arrivée, nous te concoctons des sessions d'onboarding qui te permettront de rencontrer chaque manager et de t'imprégner ainsi du fonctionnement de HelloFresh. Tu auras aussi du temps pour faire plus ample connaissance avec ton équipe avant de plonger dans le vif de tes missions !

- Collaborate with and mentor analysts within the team, championing scalable, automated, and reproducible ways of working.

- As scope grows, measure, benchmark, and monitor brand and market performance and help inform Marketing budgets — contributing to the Market Insights agenda alongside senior stakeholders.

jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Menu Performance (f/m/x)
jobs.description:
The role

Factor Europe is scaling rapidly, and as the complexity of our product offering grows, we are looking for a Sr. Manager, Menu Performance to optimize the performance of our weekly menu plan and surrounding processes.

This is a data-driven, hands-on building role. You will decide what tools, systems, and processes we need to optimize our weekly processes, and use all of the AI tools at your disposal to develop / optimize them. You’ll be the ultimate owner of our weekly product cycle: which means optimizing our menu for maximal engagement and retention of our customers, as well as simplifying / automating as much of our internal process as possible.

Whether you’re analytical supply chain master who wants more exposure to product/customer, a systems thinker who loves building and improving processes, or a technical generalist who wants to push the boundaries of what’s newly possible with AI - this is a chance to supercharge one of Europe’s fastest-growing food-tech brands.

What you’ll do

- Optimize menu performance

- Improve our menu planning model: Refine the models that architect our weekly menu—optimizing for customer engagement and retention within real constraints: seasonality, cost targets, and production capacity.

- Find out what actually drives outcomes: Run correlation and driver analysis on which menu attributes genuinely move engagement and retention.

- Model the commercial impact: Understand and forecast how menu decisions land on cost per meal and profitability to course-correct early.

- Own the weekly menu cycle

- Translate customer data into action: Own the weekly menu review, turning customer ratings and qualitative feedback into insights the Culinary and Kitchen Operations teams can act on.

- Run the process reliably: Ensure menus are built and uploaded on time, coordinating across R&D, Supply Chain, and Production as needed.

- Own recipe/menu data quality: Challenge our data hygiene practices and implement the processes and controls that ensure our data is complete and accurate.

- Build the tools and automate the work

- Automate meal onboarding: Take our concept-to-launch process apart, find the unnecessary manual steps, and eliminate or automate them to improve speed to market. Expect to build software and write scripts to get there.

- Own and extend the Product tool stack: Take our existing tools and improve them, consolidate them, and build what’s missing. Build systems that survive without you in the room.

- A systems thinker: You don’t just fix a problem; you fix the process that allowed the problem to happen.

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist, Demand Forecasting, Food Systems
jobs.description:
Work with HelloFresh in Warsaw and its HelloTech organisation, HelloFresh’s global technology backbone with more than 1000 people, building the digital products that power our end-to-end food experience. From meal kits and ready-to-eat meals to specialty offerings like pet food and premium meat & seafood, HelloTech creates the platforms that bring tailored food solutions to millions of customers every month.

Our subscription-based, direct-to-consumer model relies on technology at every step, from customer-facing apps and personalization logic to pricing, forecasting, supply chain optimization, and initiatives that help reduce food waste. While our brands operate independently to serve distinct customer needs, they are united by shared platforms, data, and operational excellence built by HelloTech.

HelloTech works in autonomous, cross-functional alliances, each owning a specific product or domain end to end. By working with our Warsaw office, you will help shape scalable, data-driven products used across our markets, working with a modern tech stack and international teams to continuously improve how people discover, order, and enjoy HelloFresh’s products, today and in the future.

About the role: What's in the Box

Do you consider yourself to be a Demand Forecasting Model expert and enthusiast? Then this position might be the perfect fit for you!

As a Senior Data Scientist, Demand Forecasting, you will play a pivotal role in designing, implementing, and improving our demand forecasting time series and causal models that are used across HelloFresh’s global markets. In this role, you can expect to have a large and tangible impact on our global supply chain. You will work closely with forecasting data scientists and machine learning (ML) engineers, together delivering statistical and ML models to production.

To succeed in this role you should be curious, a fast learner, and someone who relentlessly prioritizes problem statements and tailors the solution accordingly. You should also be comfortable suggesting multiple solutions based on your experience, prioritizing tasks based on effort and potential impact, as well as use GenAI tooling to boost your productivity. As a senior member of the Data Science team, you will jump into problem solving with others as challenges arise, and coach junior members of the team to develop their skills and increase their impact. Your team will be a place where your thoughts and opinions matter, and your contributions will have a tremendous impact on the team's success.

At HelloTech, flexibility and cross-functional collaboration are core to how we work. While this role is aligned to a specific Alliance, strong candidates may also be considered for opportunities across different teams or projects.

What you’ll do: The Recipe

- Join and become an integral part of a high-impact data science team covering the global demand forecasting domain.

- Take technical ownership of our demand forecasting time series and causal models from data collection to operationalization and closely align them with non-technical stakeholders.

- Shape and transform the future of demand forecasting at HelloFresh by proposing new approaches and evolving the statistical and ML models in pace with future company strategies.

- Experiment and explore opportunities to constantly improve and refine the approaches.

- Work with state-of-the-art technologies - such as AWS (EMR, Glue, S3, etc), Kafka, PySpark, Airflow, and Databricks - for the full ML lifecycle, from experimentation to production deployment

- Collaborate closely within cross-functional teams (product, demand planning, engineering) to translate business objectives into concrete, data-driven strategies.

- Think out of the box to come up with new ways of how we can improve the forecast we deliver to our stakeholders.

- Mentor and support data scientists and colleagues, fostering a collaborative and knowledge-sharing environment.

What you’ll bring: The Ingredients

- Proven track record of scientific work in your Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in econometrics, statistics, computer science, physics, economics, mathematics, data science or similar.

- Long-term (3+ yrs) work experience as a (senior) data scientist in demand forecasting, developing time series and causal models.

- Fluency and long-term experience in Python, including high familiarity with its scientific stack such as Numpy, Pandas, Scikit-learn, Matplotlib, etc. (experience in Databricks and PySpark is a plus).

- In-depth knowledge of how to handle statistical uncertainties and how to apply statistical models such as regressors and classifiers.

- Ability to retrieve (using SQL), manipulate, and analyse large, heterogeneous datasets.

- Comfortable working in cloud-based environments for data science (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — beyond local notebooks, with experience deploying and running ML workloads on shared infrastructure.

- Experience collaborating through Git and code review workflows.

- Ability to describe a GenAI-supervised development flow — where AI tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor) handle code generation, execution, output analysis, and iteration, with the data scientist acting as supervisor and decision-maker. Hands-on experience is a plus, but a concrete vision is a must.

- You love to learn, are a critical thinker and creative problem solver who strives for excellence.

- You are a team player who loves to collaborate and work with stakeholders from different backgrounds in an international environment.

- Exceptional communication and collaboration capabilities.

- Proficiency in using GenAI tooling to boost productivity and the development workflow.

- Strong supply chain domain knowledge is a big plus.

Interacting with demand planners, ML and data engineers, product managers, as well as business stakeholders, is very much part of our day-to-day, so communication skills are vital. We are looking for strong problem-solvers who can apply their statistical modeling skills to a wide range of business problems in the forecasting space while also acting as an ambassador to coach team members and stakeholders.

Above all, we are looking for individuals who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What we offer: The Toppings

- Global collaboration at scale: Collaborate with experienced engineers and product partners across HelloTech’s international teams, in a culture of active knowledge sharing.

- Technology with real-world impact: Build and operate modern systems at global scale, supporting 6+ millions of customers and complex supply chain operations.

- Technical/Product/Design leadership: Drive best practices and influence architecture/design, quality, and ways of working in an autonomous, product-led setup.

- End-to-end development/delivery: Drive decisions from problem definition to production, improving systems and enabling long-term scalability.

- Access to workspace at Warsaw Centre Point. The hub offers modern facilities including showers, breakout zones, outdoor space, cycle parking, and refreshments (coffee, soft drinks, and fruit).

Are you the missing ingredient? If this sounds like a tasty opportunity, we’d be excited to hear from you. We aim to review your profile and respond within 5 business days.

jobs.title: Director, Customer Compensation & Policy
jobs.description:
About the Role

Within Global Customer Experience (GCX), our mission is to advance the HelloFresh customer relationship from reactive resolution to proactive, trust-building service. The compensation function sits at the heart of that mission: it is the mechanism through which the business acknowledges failures, restores customer confidence, and, when done well, turns a bad experience into a reason to stay.

The Associate Director, Customer Compensation & Policy is responsible for the global strategy, architecture, and governance of how HelloFresh compensates customers across all markets and brands. This is not a policy maintenance role. It is a strategic function that sits at the intersection of customer economics, operational data, behavioral experimentation, and cross-functional influence.

You will own one of the most financially material and customer-sensitive levers in the business. You will shape a multi-year roadmap and hold peers in Operations, Technology, Finance, and Market Leadership accountable for the quality of inputs that determine how well and how efficiently we recover customer trust.

The ideal candidate brings a rare combination: analytical rigor sharp enough to architect a global compensation engine from first principles, and the executive presence to drive adoption across a complex, multi-market organization without formal authority over most of the people they need to move.

What You'll Own

Global Compensation Strategy & Engine Architecture

- Own the end-to-end strategic vision for how HelloFresh categorizes customer errors and determines compensation across all markets, brands, and contact channels.

- Lead the design and continuous evolution of the compensation engine: along with Tech, you’ll define the the rules, thresholds, segmentation logic, and automation frameworks that govern recovery decisions at scale.

- Define the principles that govern trade-offs between customer generosity and cost discipline and translate those principles into operational rules that hold across market complexity and brand variation.

- Partner with Technology to ensure the compensation engine is scalable, auditable, and capable of supporting dynamic, AI-assisted decisioning as the product evolves.

Experimentation & Behavioral Economics

- Set the global roadmap for compensation experimentation: A/B testing across offer types, value levels, channel timing, and segmentation variables.

- Apply behavioral economics frameworks to compensation design understanding how recovery offers shape long-term retention, repurchase behavior, and brand perception, not just immediate satisfaction.

- Define the measurement framework for experimentation: what constitutes a successful test, what confidence warrants global rollout, and how results are synthesized into durable policy change.

- Partner with Analytics & Insights to ensure test design, sample integrity, and rollout analysis meet a rigorous standard of evidence.

Financial Stewardship & Cost Governance

- Own the global compensation P&L line: tracking spend by market, error category, customer segment, and channel — and holding yourself accountable to defined cost-per-incident and avoidable-contact targets.

- Identify and close financial leakage: cases where compensation is being issued without policy justification, at incorrect values, or at the wrong frequency.

- Build the reporting infrastructure that makes compensation economics visible to GCX leadership, market GMs, and Finance — with the granularity and context needed to drive decisions.

- Define the right balance between cost optimization and customer lifetime value investment: not just 'spend less' but 'spend where it earns back.

Fraud Policy & Global Governance

- Own the global fraud and abuse prevention framework: the policies, detection logic, thresholds, and escalation paths that protect the business without creating friction for genuine customers.

- Lead the governance rhythm for policy: quarterly reviews, market exception management, escalation adjudication, and framework versioning across a multi-brand, multi-market environment.

- Act as the final authority on complex, cross-market policy gaps — resolving ambiguity with speed, consistency, and strategic clarity rather than routing decisions upward by default.

- Maintain global standards while creating principled space for market-level adaptation where local context genuinely requires it.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Stakeholder Accountability

- Represent the compensation function in senior forums translating customer economics into requirements that peers in Operations, Technology, Finance, and Market GMs must respond to.

- Hold cross-functional partners accountable for the upstream data quality, operational accuracy, and system reliability that the compensation engine depends on.

- Drive adoption of policy changes across markets and brands, building communication and change management plans that make new frameworks land — not just launch.

- Influence at VP and Director level across multiple functions; escalate only strategic blockers, not routine alignment.
jobs.requirements_raw:
What You'll Bring

Education

- MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification required.

- Undergraduate degree in Economics, Business, Engineering, or a quantitative discipline.

Experience

- 8–12 years of progressive experience in customer strategy, pricing, operations, or a directly adjacent domain with meaningful exposure to global, multi-market environments.

- Demonstrated track record of owning a financially significant operational lever and managing it with both analytical precision and strategic judgment.

- Prior experience leading and developing teams; comfort operating as a senior individual contributor and a people leader simultaneously.

- Background in subscription commerce, logistics, or consumer-facing operations strongly preferred. Familiarity with the economics of customer recovery in high-volume, low-margin environments is a distinct advantage.

Technical & Analytical

- Advanced proficiency in SQL and data analysis; able to build and pressure-test the analytical models that underpin policy decisions without delegating the logic to others.

- Fluency with experimentation methodology: test design, statistical significance, holdout analysis, and the translation of results into policy not just reporting.

- Experience working with or alongside engineering teams to define product and system requirements for rules-based or AI-assisted decisioning tools.

- Comfort with financial modeling: building the business case for compensation investment, forecasting spend impact, and tracking actuals against plan.

Leadership & Influence

- Senior executive presence: able to walk into a GM, COO, or CFO conversation with a clear point of view, defend it under pressure, and leave with alignment.

- A credible voice with peers and upward stakeholders not because of title, but because of the quality of analysis and clarity of communication.

- Structured and decisive under ambiguity: able to make a defensible call with incomplete information and adjust as evidence develops.

- Genuinely collaborative across markets and functions able to hold people to standards without damaging the relationships needed to sustain them.

What we offer

- Health - You’re covered from your first day with private health insurance.

- Flexible Working - We work in-office 3 days a week to align on goals, with flexible hours to support work-life balance and personal needs

- Time Off - You receive 26 days of paid vacation each year, providing you time to rest and recharge.

- Learning and Development - An annual Learning & Development budget and a Mentoring Program to support your ongoing professional growth.

- Employee Referral Program - Our team members can take part in our internal employee referral program and receive a bonus for recommending successful candidates to open roles.

- Daily Comforts - Free coffee, drinks, and fresh fruit are available to keep you refreshed throughout the day

jobs.title: [US DC] Labor Planning Associate
jobs.description:
Factor, a brand of HelloFresh is seeking a Labor Planning Analyst. The Labor Planning team plays a central role in maintaining capacity for Operations and delivering for our customers in a high-growth environment. Our team is responsible for generating the hiring plans for all U.S. distribution centers. We are looking for leaders with strong analytical and technical skills who can partner effectively with leaders across functions to drive planning accuracy.

Hybrid Day Shift: Tuesday - Saturday

Job Responsibilities

- Work alongside other members of the Planning team to validate labor plans and improve overall accuracy

- Support all labor management functions by driving enhancements in headcount planning, attrition curves, scheduling, and cohort balancing based on data.

- Track progress to and deviations from the plan, assist with problem-solving and root cause analysis

- Serve as a technical liaison between Planning and Data/Engineering teams to translate business requirements, resolve escalations and contribute to the continuous improvement of tools and processes

- Own short-term labor planning to ensure operational sites are set up for success with staffing needs, optimizing for cost and experience.

Key Characteristics/Skills

- Advanced Spreadsheet Skills (Excel/Google Sheets): ability to conduct deep dive analysis and complex troubleshooting.

- Data Querying & Manipulation (SQL): essential for pulling labor planning data and comparing performance against assumptions.

- Data Visualization & Reporting (Tableau): required to develop performance scorecards and build reports.

- Statistical Analysis & Forecasting: ability to understand forecasting and statistical concepts and models (exponential smoothing, variance, MAPE/RMSE, confidence intervals, etc.)

- Unstructured Data Analysis & Workflow Automation: ability to use Gemini or similar AI tools to summarize information via structured prompts, build mechanisms for data comparison, and integrate data sources.

At a Minimum You Have....

- Bachelor’s Degree - Engineering, Mathematics, or Business/ Supply Chain

- Experience in roles that require driving operational efficiency and influencing stakeholders using data interpretation

- Advanced data analysis and tool development experience using Google Sheets and/or MS Excel

- Proficiency in Google App Scripts, SQL and Tableau

- Proficiency in Snowflake or similar platforms

- Experience within a distribution center, logistics, or manufacturing environment required

- Experience with project management tools

- Excellent interpersonal and written/verbal communication skills

You’ll get…

- Competitive hourly rate, 401K company match that vests immediately upon participation, & team bonus opportunities

- Generous PTO and flexible attendance policy

- Comprehensive health and wellness benefits with options at $0 monthly, effective first day of employment

- Up to 85% discount on subscriptions to HelloFresh meal plans (HelloFresh, Green Chef, Everyplate, and Factor_)

- Access to Employee Resource Groups that are open to all employees, including those pertaining to BIPOC, women, veterans, parents, and LGBTQ+

- Inclusive, collaborative, and dynamic work environment within a fast-paced, mission-driven company that is disrupting the traditional food supply chain

This job description is intended to provide a general overview of the responsibilities. However, the Company reserves the right to adjust, modify, or reassign work tasks and responsibilities as needed to meet changing business needs, operational requirements, or other factors.

Illinois Pay Range

$63,000—$67,500 USD

jobs.title: Lead Product Strategy
jobs.description:
The role

We are looking for a high-calibre Lead - Menu Strategy to drive strategic, global improvements in our value-added products portfolio, focusing on premium offerings and recipe customization that leads to higher retention and improved monetization performance. In this role, reporting to the Director of Product Strategy - Menu within the Global Product Strategy and Operations team, you will work closely with Product Development Managers across our global business units to expand our customization capabilities and coverage, introduce new premium concepts that excite our customers, and increase basket sizes through more food items ordered. This is an exciting opportunity for Product Managers with strong analytical abilities to drive the Global team’s future product strategy.

What you’ll do

Lead the value-added products roadmap, ensuring alignment with stakeholders across HelloFresh Group's meal kits business and driving monetization (AOV) performance

Drive our customization strategy to support expanding our customization assortment in 10+ markets, delivering on ambitious growth and profitability objectives:

- Identify and implement mid-term multi-market customization opportunities based on commercial potential and consumer relevance, such as tailoring recipes to different dietary needs or enabling multi-ingredient customization at scale.

- Build systems for efficient sharing and scaling of best-performing customization types across our different business units

- Analyze the performance of existing customization types and create business cases and improvement plans to drive commercial growth within our current offering.

Redefine our surcharge recipes strategy to define a clear value proposition and grow average order value:

- Review existing portfolio and current positioning and create a new strategy to reposition our surcharge recipe portfolio that feels premium and customers engage with

- Develop hypotheses and testing frameworks to validate new premium concepts, pricing sensitivity, and menu composition changes.

- Analyze the performance of different surcharge recipe initiatives such as pricing changes, assortment expansion and new premium ingredients.

Collaborate with Tech on upselling initiatives through improved UI, better discovery of value-added product portfolio, and cross-selling products that lead to incremental improvements in average order value.

Our Facility and Maintenance team keeps the new Bleiswijk fulfilment center running smoothly, day in and day out. As part of this team, you'll take ownership of everything facility-related: coordinating suppliers, monitoring stock levels, managing waste streams, and ensuring the site stays clean, organized, and fully operational at all times.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Maintenance and Reliability Engineering
jobs.description:
Associate Director, Reliability (MRE)

As the Associate Director, Reliability (MRE), you will oversee the team of reliability engineers, the reliability planner/scheduler, CMMS systems, Quality Engineering, and industrial SMEs in refrigeration, kitchen equipment, and other critical utilities. You'll also take direct ownership of all life-cycle maintenance projects across US sites — including utility expansion/modification, new equipment installation (in coordination with engineering), and refrigeration system projects. You'll lead hands-on, engaging, motivating, and coaching your team members directly. Partnering with M&RE senior leadership, you'll define, develop, and deliver the facilities maintenance roadmap and set the standard for operational efficiency at your fulfillment center.

You will…
• Oversee MRE-related projects, including facilities maintenance across electrical, refrigeration, building, and grounds
• Asset Performance: Implement Reliability-Centered Maintenance (RCM), root cause analysis (RCA), and failure mode and effects analysis (FMEA) to reduce downtime.
• Motivate, engage, coach, and inspire a team of specialists — building a positive team dynamic that encourages feedback and drives change from within
• Manage outside vendors and facilitate planned and unplanned Life cycle repairs/replacements
• Ensure maintenance regulations are followed
• Maintain a current list of contractors to ensure emergency repairs are handled promptly

jobs.title: Coordinateur Supply Chain - (H/F/N)
jobs.description:
Join a French foodtech superstar

At HelloFresh, we’re changing the way people in France eat and cook with our meal kits!

Our ambition? To revolutionize our subscribers’ everyday lives by promoting a more sustainable way of cooking while helping them discover delicious, creative and balanced recipes. The perfect combination of technology and gastronomy, for maximum enjoyment.

HelloFresh operates in more than 15 countries. France is a young market, launched in 2019, and has experienced tremendous growth: we have already been the market leader since 2021. It’s the perfect time to join our team and make a real impact in one of France’s most promising scale-ups!

How do we make all this possible? Through a talented and dynamic team, strong values centered around kindness and diversity, and an inspiring and stimulating work environment.

In 2023, we opened a production site in France. If you’d like to be part of this incredible human, international and entrepreneurial adventure, join us!

The role

As a Junior Supply Chain Coordinator, you'll help ensure our production always receives the right ingredients and materials on time, in full, and with the required quality. You'll be the main point of contact for suppliers whenever deliveries don't go as planned and work closely with internal teams to find quick and effective solutions.

This role combines communication, coordination, and data analysis. You'll investigate issues, identify root causes, and support continuous process improvements. Your work has a direct impact on ensuring our customers receive their HelloFresh boxes exactly as expected.

What you'll do

- Monitor inbound deliveries and ensure production is supplied on time.

- Act as the main point of contact for suppliers regarding delivery delays, shortages, or quality deviations.

- Lead confident and solution-oriented conversations with suppliers, following up until issues are resolved.

- Collaborate closely with Procurement, Production, Warehouse, FSQA, and Operations teams.

- Analyse delivery issues and perform root cause analyses to identify improvement opportunities.

- Prepare reports and communicate insights clearly to internal stakeholders.

- Support continuous improvement initiatives across our supply chain processes.

- Help reduce food waste while maintaining excellent supplier performance and service levels.

Job Title: Junior Maintenance Engineer

Location: Smart parc, Spondon, Derby DE21 7HW

About The Job:

We are looking for a Junior Engineer to be responsible for fixing, maintaining and improving our equipment on site to make sure everything is working as it should at all times.

The Junior Engineer will be responsible for completing reactive and preventative works across the site, reporting defects to contractors, assisting contractors, keeping up to date on defect tickets raised on our CMMS system and following the sites Health and Safety rules.

- Identify defects that arise while completing PPMs and undertake rectifications, recording actions taken in the maintenance manual and CMMS system.

- Conduct minor structural and electrical improvement works.

- Provide reactive support when required, including breakdown response, and ensure high standards and timely completion of work.

- Comply with all Health and Safety requirements of the site at all times.

- Work proactively with maintenance shift manager to manage task volumes, provide regular updates on task status, and identify problems with plant efficiency and determine rectification measures.

- Support operational projects on an ad-hoc basis.

- Flag low stock levels to ensure inventory stays within min-max levels using our CMMS system.

jobs.title: HR Business Partner (H/F/X)
jobs.description:
Rejoins une superstar de la foodtech française

Chez HelloFresh, nous bousculons les habitudes alimentaires des français grâce à nos Box à cuisiner !

Notre ambition ? Révolutionner le quotidien de nos abonnés, en promouvant une façon plus durable de cuisiner et en leur faisant découvrir de délicieuses recettes, créatives et équilibrées. L’alliance parfaite entre technologie et gastronomie, pour un maximum de gourmandise.

HelloFresh est présent dans plus de 15 pays. La France, un jeune marché lancé en 2019, connaît une ascension fulgurante : nous y sommes déjà leaders depuis 2021. Le moment parfait pour rejoindre notre équipe et avoir un impact fort dans l'une des scales up françaises les plus prometteuses !

Comment rendre tout cela possible ? Grâce à une équipe talentueuse et dynamique, des valeurs fortes de bienveillance et de diversité, et un environnement de travail stimulant.

Rejoignez l'une des scale ups à la croissance la plus rapide en France

Dans un environnement où 90% des employés sont des agents logistique, le HRBP chez HelloFresh conseille et accompagne les managers et leurs collaborateurs dans l’engagement des salariés et la gestion des talents.

Il accompagne les salariés tout au long de leur aventure chez HelloFresh. Il gère la conformité au cadre légal et collabore avec toutes les autres équipes pour répondre aux besoins de ses clients internes. Ce rôle contribue également aux projets stratégiques au sein de la fonction RH.

Ce que tu feras

- Fournir un soutien RH aux managers et aux salariés, en se concentrant sur la politique salariale, la conformité à nos processus, le développement des talents et l'expérience employé.

- Aligner le support avec la stratégie de l'équipe/du site et collaborer avec les managers pour trouver des solutions aux défis liés aux personnes.

- Agir à titre de conseiller et de coach de confiance auprès des gestionnaires et des salariés

- Gérer la mise en œuvre de programmes clés tels que la gestion de la rémunération, des performances et des présences

- Utiliser la data de manière proactive pour créer des rapports et identifier les opportunités d'amélioration des politiques et des processus RH.

Ce qu’on recherche chez un.e candidat.e :

- Bac +3 spécialisé en ressources humaines ainsi que 3 ans d'expérience HRBP, de préférence au sein d'une entreprise en pleine expansion, idéalement en milieu industriel ou logistique

- Bonne connaissance du droit du travail français

- Expérience en matière de planification et de gestion de projets RH (gestion des performances, engagement des employés, planification des effectifs)

- Solides compétences analytiques, souci du détail et capacité à utiliser les données pour identifier et résoudre des problèmes

- Expérience avec les systèmes SIRH, en particulier les suites Workday, Horoquartz, Microsoft Office et Google

- La maîtrise de l'anglais est un plus

Ce que nous t’offrons :

- 30% de réductions sur nos Box HelloFresh

- 75% de prise en charge sur la Mutuelle Alan Green (options supplémentaires possibles)

- 50% de participation au transport en commun

- Des tickets restaurant sur une carte Swile

- Un environnement de travail sûr, bienveillant, et respectueux de chacun

Voici le déroulé du processus de recrutement :

Nous examinons ton CV et ta lettre de motivation. Si c’est un match, nous t’invitons à une série d’entretiens et à réaliser un cas pratique. Nous nous engageons à organiser rapidement les entretiens, afin de t’accueillir chez HelloFresh au plus vite !

This role is the resident expert in refrigeration systems.

Shift: Monday to Friday - 7:00am to 3:30pm

You will...

- Maintain and operate industrial refrigeration systems including large rack systems, split systems, blast chillers, cooling towers and ancillary equipment.

- Lead and educate compliance with all safety, food safety, and security standards.

- Perform preventive maintenance and routine inspections on assigned refrigeration and HVAC systems and ancillary equipment as needed.
