- Document all work in the computerized maintenance management system (CMMS) and ticketing systems as appropriate.

- Mentor all maintenance personnel in developing appropriate skill sets and knowledge of equipment specializing in refrigeration.

- Lead root cause analysis of major downtime events.

- Act as a network resource for technical issues and lead network-wide root cause analysis.

- Develop maintenance personnel knowledge on intermediate to advanced refrigeration processes, tools and techniques.

- Audit maintenance personnel work and provide feedback to improve performance and quality.

- Audit vendor work to provide feedback to leadership on quality of work and SLA performance.

- Write and/or modify PMs to standardize across the network and increase effectiveness.

- Repair and perform predictive and preventative maintenance procedures on CO2 and Freon refrigeration systems including, but not limited to compressors, pumps, fans, heat exchangers, glycol systems, various industrial utility systems, motors, and power distribution systems.

- Give direction and/or training to entry level refrigeration technicians including, but not limited to day-to-day operations, inspections and inspection techniques, basic repairs and repair techniques, and conformance to all state, local, and HelloFresh regulations and policies.

- Perform building project work as assigned.

You have...

- 4-6 years of experience with refrigeration repair and maintenance in an industrial setting,

- Advanced understanding of rack system refrigeration and associated equipment.

- Experience with repair and maintenance of glycol systems, heat exchangers, HVAC, and water chiller systems.

- Experience with electrical systems including single and three phase motor systems, power distribution, and low voltage controls with the ability to troubleshoot to the component level.

- Current Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Section 608 certification.

- All necessary regulatory licenses required by local municipalities to work in the field of industrial refrigeration.

- Ability to demonstrate excellent work habits in line with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP’s).

- Ability to conform to all OSHA, PSM, HAZMAT, and HelloFresh safety programs and regulations.

- Ability to demonstrate understanding of proper handling and recycling procedures for chlorofluorocarbon (CFC), hydrochlorofluorocarbon (HCFC), Hydrofluro-Olefins (HFO), CO2, and other industry standard refrigerant types.

- Ability to safely replace mechanical and electrical components including motors, motor starters, switches, solenoids, pumps, refrigeration valves, compressors, and auxiliary refrigeration equipment.

- Experience working with a wide range of networked refrigeration controls platforms.

- Ability to withstand walking, lifting, bending, stooping, climbing ladders, walking on roofs, and working in confined spaces.

jobs.title: Director UX, Growth
jobs.description:
Director of UX, Growth

Location: Toronto or New York

Team: UX, Growth Mega-Alliance

Level: Director (people leadership). For the right person there's a clear path to Senior Director as the alliance scales.

Reports to: Global VP of UX

About HelloFresh

Our mission is simple: to change the way people eat, forever. We're the world's leading meal-kit provider and a global digital-native FMCG company, reaching more than 6 million customers across 16 markets through a portfolio of brands, from HelloFresh and Factor to Green Chef, EveryPlate, Chefs Plate, YouFoodz, Good Chop, and The Pets Table. HelloTech, our global technology division, builds the digital consumer experience across Berlin, Warsaw, and North America. Experience quality and innovation are leadership priorities all the way to the group president.

About the role

We're looking for a Director of UX to lead the Growth experience end to end, across the brands in our portfolio, with HelloFresh and Factor the biggest. This is the team that owns how people discover our brands, sign up, get to their first great box, and keep coming back. Most funnels are something people endure. We want ours to be something they remember. Your job is to turn each step into a moment worth having, so the journey feels effortless, true to each brand, and sticky enough that people want to stay, and to grow the business while you do it.

You'll report directly to the Global VP of UX and lead a team of 6 UX designers and collaborate closely with content design and research strategy. You set the quality bar for the alliance and work shoulder to shoulder with Growth product, marketing, lifecycle/CRM, and engineering across web and app, and across 16 markets. You care about the numbers and the experience, and you know the best growth work improves both at once.

This is a hands-on leadership role, and a build-and-scale one rather than a maintenance one. You are exceptional at craft and stay close enough to the work to lead with credibility. You're also a visionary: you bring our brands to life and express them clearly across every touchpoint, and you have a strong feel for content and how words shape an experience. You're happy in ambiguity, and you'd rather write the playbook than follow one.

What you'll own

A funnel worth remembering. You lead the experience across the full customer journey: acquisition and activation, conversion, retention, and reactivation of lapsed customers. You do more than reduce drop-off and smooth out onboarding. You make each step sticky and memorable, so people feel something at sign-up, come back because they want to, and tell a friend. You give lapsed customers a real reason to return.

Experimentation and evidence. You run a team that tests its way to the answer. You treat behavioral data as a primary design input, not just something to validate a decision after the fact. You set clear hypotheses, design experiments and A/B tests with statistical rigor alongside data science, read the results honestly, and balance quick wins with the changes that compound over time.

Strategy before screens. You decide which problems are worth solving and why, and you tie design choices to the business outcomes this role is measured on, like conversion, activation rate, and retention [confirm the exact KPIs for this role]. You set direction before design work begins.

Craft and quality. You define what excellent looks like for Growth and hold the bar. You set a high standard for craft yourself and raise it in others, and you build and evolve the systems and patterns that let the team ship consistent, high-quality work at speed across web and app.

Brand expression. You bring our portfolio of brands to life, from HelloFresh and Factor to the rest, and give each a clear, distinct voice and look in the experience. You know how to hold what makes a brand itself while keeping the funnel coherent across all of them. You have a strong understanding of content and how design and words work together to express who each brand is.

Make us AI-native. You lead a team that treats AI as an active part of how the work gets done, from insight synthesis to rapid prototyping to the path from design to code. You define the quality bar AI-assisted work has to meet, and you help rewrite how growth experiences get built in the AI era. You are a driving force in this transformation, not a passenger, and you help your team see the shift as opportunity rather than threat.

A team of generalists. You lead a team of UX Designers with a generalist profile that move across design, content, research and code. You attract, develop, and retain strong talent, coach through feedback and influence rather than authority, and build a place where people do the best work of their careers.

What you bring

- 10+ years in product design, including experience leading and growing teams in a consumer (B2C) or product-led environment with a track record of moving metrics like activation, conversion, retention, and reactivation.

- Exceptional craft. You are a top-tier designer who sets and holds a high bar, and you stay hands-on enough to lead with credibility and a visionary eye for the brand. You can bring distinct brands to life and express them clearly and consistently across an experience.

- High agency. You push for the right solution over the convenient one and make things happen without waiting for permission.

- AI-native practice. You already use AI across the design workflow, for insight synthesis, rapid prototyping, and design to code, and you have a clear point of view on scaling it responsibly at a high quality bar. Fluency with tools like Figma and Claude is expected, and you can show your team what excellent AI-assisted work looks like.

- Strong data fluency. You read behavioral data and experiment results well, know what they are and aren't telling you, and use them to sharpen design, not just defend it. You're comfortable partnering with data science on experimentation quality.

- Command of experimentation: hypothesis design, A/B testing, and funnel analysis as a connected system rather than isolated moments.

- A partnership mindset with Growth product, marketing, lifecycle/CRM, and engineering. You navigate constraints with engineers and shape research and synthesis with researchers.

- People leadership experience: building teams, coaching designers, and setting a quality bar others rally around.

Nice to have

- Experience shaping cross-channel communication strategy across app, email, push, and web, so the message a customer gets is consistent and well-timed wherever they meet us.

- Experience with pricing, packaging, or monetization design.

- A track record building 0-to-1 growth systems, or fixing broken acquisition and retention loops.

What success looks like

- Your team consistently ships high-quality growth work at speed, and the metrics move.

- You've hired exceptional talent and helped your existing team grow in craft and judgment.

- Experience quality across the funnel is visibly higher, and customers feel it.

- Product and engineering leaders love partnering with you because you unlock progress and raise the ambition.

- AI-native ways of working in your domain make the whole team faster without giving up craft.

- Each brand feels distinctly itself in the experience, while the funnel stays coherent across all of them.

What we offer

- Scale and impact. Shape experiences for millions of customers across our brands and 16 markets.

- A craft-and-AI-first culture, championed from the top of the organization.

- Real ownership of your domain, with the autonomy to set and raise the bar.

- A defined leadership track and the chance to grow your scope as the alliance scales.

- Global collaboration with experienced product, engineering, and design partners across HelloTech.

- Compensation & Financial Wellbeing

- Enjoy amazing discounts: 75% off weekly HelloFresh/Chefs Plate meal kits plus 50% off weekly Factor meal boxes.

- Benefit from health and dental coverage from day one, a Health Spending Account, unlimited Headspace access, and 25% off GoodLife fitness memberships.

- Access wellness resources including fitness discounts and mental health support.

- Receive generous vacation and PTO offerings.

- Benefit from a parental leave top-up program designed to support expectant parents.

- Grow with dedicated L&D initiatives and career support, aligning with our "Learning Never Stops" value.

How we work

We're moving UX to work AI-native, and we expect our leaders to help drive that shift. You'll report directly to the Global VP of UX and partner closely with Product and Engineering leaders in the region.

Equal opportunity

We believe that sharing a meal brings people of all identities, backgrounds, and cultures together, and we're committed to celebrating every dimension of diversity in the workplace. We're an equal-opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, color, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic. jobs.title: Senior UX Product Designer, Engagement
jobs.description:
Senior UX Product Designer, Engagement

This is a hybrid role to the Toronto HelloFresh Headquarters

About the role

HelloFresh is seeking a Senior Product Designer to join our Engagement team, shaping experiences that deepen customers’ relationships with HelloFresh and create more reasons to engage with our products over time.

As a Senior-level individual contributor, you’ll lead complex, high-impact challenges across loyalty, referrals, discovery, cooking experiences, and other engagement initiatives. You’ll combine strong product design craft with experimentation, systems thinking, and commercial awareness to create experiences that are useful, rewarding, and capable of building lasting customer habits.

This is a strategic and hands-on role. You’ll contribute to the future direction of our engagement experiences while continuously identifying opportunities to improve what exists today. You’ll work in an AI-native design environment, using AI throughout the design lifecycle to accelerate discovery, synthesis, prototyping, and execution — while exploring how emerging technology can create more relevant and personalized customer experiences.

At Senior level, we expect you to independently lead ambiguous product challenges, influence product direction, and contribute patterns and practices that make the broader team stronger. You’ll remain deeply involved in the craft, using the quality of your thinking, design, and collaboration to bring others along.

What you’ll do

Lead high-impact UX experiences

- Own the end-to-end design of experiences across loyalty, rewards, referrals, discovery, cooking, and other engagement mechanics that strengthen customers’ relationships with our brands.

- Design experiences that give customers compelling reasons to return, participate, explore, share, and get more value from HelloFresh over time.

- Translate complex customer and business problems into experiences that feel simple, motivating, and relevant while driving measurable outcomes such as engagement, retention, lifetime value, and referral-driven acquisition.

- Think beyond individual features or transactions to understand how repeated interactions can build habits, trust, and long-term customer value.

Help shape product direction

- Partner with Product, Engineering, Data, Research, Marketing, CRM, and Content Design to identify opportunities across the customer lifecycle.

- Connect customer needs, behavioural insights, commercial goals, and emerging technology to develop strong product directions.

- Help define how loyalty, referrals, discovery, and other engagement experiences connect into a coherent customer relationship rather than a collection of disconnected features.

- Move comfortably between contributing to longer-term vision and delivering tactical improvements that generate measurable impact today.

- Bring a strong design perspective to your product area while remaining open to evidence, experimentation, and the expertise of your partners.

Drive experimentation and validated learning

- Use quantitative and qualitative insights to identify opportunities, develop hypotheses, and design high-impact experiments.

- Partner closely with Product and Data to understand customer behaviour and translate signals such as participation, frequency, retention, redemption, sharing, and conversion into actionable design opportunities.

- Explore how different mechanics — from rewards and incentives to personalization and social sharing — influence customer motivation and behaviour.

- Look beyond the outcome of individual A/B tests to identify patterns and insights that can inform future product and design decisions.

- Balance short-term commercial impact with the quality and sustainability of the longer-term customer relationship.

Work AI-natively

- Integrate AI into your day-to-day design practice, from exploration, research synthesis, and ideation through rapid prototyping and design-to-code workflows.

- Use tools such as Claude & Claude Code, Gemini, Figma AI, and emerging technologies to shorten the distance between an idea and something customers can experience and validate.

- Explore opportunities for AI-native engagement experiences, including personalization, recommendations, adaptive experiences, conversational interactions, and new ways to help customers discover and get value from HelloFresh.

- Apply strong design judgment to AI-generated outputs, understanding when AI accelerates quality and when human craft, intuition, and critical thinking matter most.

Raise the bar for design craft

- Create polished, intuitive experiences with strong attention to visual hierarchy, interaction design, motion, micro-interactions, content, and overall usability.

- Bring a high level of craft to experiences that may need to be motivating, rewarding, or expressive without becoming distracting, confusing, or gimmicky.

- Identify opportunities to improve the quality and coherence of the Engagement experiences you work on.

- Contribute patterns, practices, and examples that help other designers deliver stronger work.

- Give and seek thoughtful critique, using feedback to continuously strengthen the work.

Design systems, not just screens

- Think across journeys rather than individual touchpoints, identifying opportunities to create reusable patterns and modular experiences that can scale across loyalty, referrals, rewards, discovery, brands, markets, and customer segments.

- Consider how engagement mechanics connect across surfaces and moments rather than treating individual features in isolation.

- Partner with our design system teams while contributing Engagement-specific patterns where needed.

- Help reduce design debt and fragmentation by creating solutions that make future experimentation faster without sacrificing relevance or quality.

Lead through collaboration

- Bring strong perspectives and clear rationale to complex product decisions.

- Guide cross-functional partners through ambiguity and trade-offs, advocating for customer-centred solutions while understanding commercial and technical constraints.

- Work closely with Marketing and CRM to ensure product experiences and customer communications reinforce one another across the lifecycle.

- Build alignment through clear communication, evidence, and strong design rationale rather than formal authority.

- Support other designers through critique, collaboration, and sharing new practices and approaches.
jobs.requirements_raw:
What you’ll bring

Senior-level product design experience

- Typically 4–6+ years of product design experience, although we care more about the scope, complexity, and impact of your work than years alone.

- A strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end ownership of complex consumer experiences, from understanding the problem through shipped outcomes and learning.

- Experience independently navigating ambiguous problems, making sound design decisions, and influencing product direction within your area.

Engagement and experimentation expertise

- Strong experience designing B2C consumer products, ideally within e-commerce, subscription, marketplace, loyalty, social, content, or other high-frequency digital experiences.

- You understand how product experiences can influence customer motivation, frequency, habit formation, retention, and advocacy — not just immediate conversion.

- You understand experimentation deeply and can translate behavioural data, customer insights, and business metrics into meaningful design opportunities.

- You can balance commercial outcomes with customer value, trust, and the quality of the longer-term relationship.

Exceptional product design craft

- Strong expertise across interaction and visual design, including hierarchy, information architecture, responsive behaviour, motion, and micro-interactions.

- You can take complex experiences and make them feel simple, and can articulate what separates a functional experience from a great one.

- You understand how thoughtful interaction and visual design can create moments of delight and motivation without compromising clarity or usability.

- You care about the details while understanding when speed, learning, and iteration matter more than perfection.

AI-native design fluency

- AI is already part of how you work, not something you are waiting to adopt.

- You regularly use AI across multiple stages of your design process, whether that’s discovery, synthesis, ideation, prototyping, or execution.

- You’re comfortable experimenting with tools such as Figma AI, Claude, Claude Code, Gemini, or similar emerging technologies.

- You’re interested not only in using AI to work faster, but in understanding how it changes what we can design for customers.

Systems thinking

- You naturally look beyond the individual screen or experiment to understand how experiences connect across the customer lifecycle.

- You have experience creating reusable patterns or modular solutions that can work across journeys, customer contexts, brands, or markets.

- You can balance the benefits of consistency and reuse with the need to design for the specific customer motivation and context at hand.

Strategic thinking and high agency

- You’re comfortable navigating ambiguity, challenging assumptions, and proactively identifying opportunities rather than waiting for perfectly defined briefs.

- You bring conviction to your design decisions while remaining open to evidence, experimentation, and alternative perspectives.

- You can establish a strong direction for your work and then get hands-on to make it real.

Cross-functional leadership

- You’re comfortable working beyond traditional design boundaries: shaping product decisions with Product Managers, exploring technical possibilities with Engineers, working with Data to understand behaviour, and partnering with Research, Content Design, Marketing, and CRM to understand and influence the broader customer experience.

- You know how to build alignment across disciplines and move work forward without relying on formal authority.

Exceptional communication

- You can turn complex problems into clear, compelling narratives and confidently present your thinking to stakeholders at different levels.

- You communicate not only what you designed, but the customer insight, hypothesis, trade-offs, and business rationale behind it.

- You can adapt the depth and format of your communication to the decision that needs to be made.

Let’s cut to the cheese, this is why you'll love it here

- Box Discount - Amazing discounts on 1 box per week! 75% discount on weekly HelloFresh and Chefs Plate meal kits AND 50% off weekly Factor meal box.

- Health & Wellness - Health & Dental benefits from day 1, a Health Spending Account, unlimited access to the Headspace app to meet your self-care needs, and 25% discount on GoodLife fitness memberships!

- RRSP Matching - Competitive RRSP matching program offered

- Vacation & PTO - Time off is also an important part of self-care! We offer generous vacation and PTO to help you create a good work-life balance.

- Family Benefits - A parental leave top-up program for expectant parents.

- Growth & Development - We support your career progression and invest in your continued learning through experiences and initiatives owned by our dedicated L&D team

- Work Hard & Have Fun - From team socials to engaging company days, you’ll have plenty of opportunity to experience the fun!

- Diversity & Inclusion Initiatives - With impactful ERG’s like FreshPride, Women Empowered and LIMES, we are committed to our diversity, equity & inclusion efforts.

- Food Puns - this one is kind of a big dill if you haven’t already noticed. We even have some punny meeting room names!

Flexible Hybrid Approach

At HelloFresh, we know that flexible work arrangements are essential in enabling you to do your best work, while balancing your personal and life needs. Offering remote work flexibility, along with the opportunity to interact and collaborate in the office are all a part of creating a great employee experience.

To meet these needs, we are pleased to provide Flexible Hybrid work. Flexible Hybrid is a people-first approach that is based on choice, trust, personalization, and empowers teams to choose when and how often they work from the office and work from home, in addition to team days and company days. This means a minimum of 2 days in office per week, with most teams in office between 2-3 days a week.

- Own the end-to-end design of experiences across loyalty, rewards, referrals, discovery, cooking, and other engagement mechanics that strengthen customers’ relationships with our brands.

- Design experiences that give customers compelling reasons to return, participate, explore, share, and get more value from HelloFresh over time.

- Translate complex customer and business problems into experiences that feel simple, motivating, and relevant while driving measurable outcomes such as engagement, retention, lifetime value, and referral-driven acquisition.

- Think beyond individual features or transactions to understand how repeated interactions can build habits, trust, and long-term customer value.

Help shape product direction

- Partner with Product, Engineering, Data, Research, Marketing, CRM, and Content Design to identify opportunities across the customer lifecycle.

- Connect customer needs, behavioural insights, commercial goals, and emerging technology to develop strong product directions.

- Help define how loyalty, referrals, discovery, and other engagement experiences connect into a coherent customer relationship rather than a collection of disconnected features.

- Move comfortably between contributing to longer-term vision and delivering tactical improvements that generate measurable impact today.

- Bring a strong design perspective to your product area while remaining open to evidence, experimentation, and the expertise of your partners.

Drive experimentation and validated learning

- Use quantitative and qualitative insights to identify opportunities, develop hypotheses, and design high-impact experiments.

- Partner closely with Product and Data to understand customer behaviour and translate signals such as participation, frequency, retention, redemption, sharing, and conversion into actionable design opportunities.

- Explore how different mechanics — from rewards and incentives to personalization and social sharing — influence customer motivation and behaviour.

- Look beyond the outcome of individual A/B tests to identify patterns and insights that can inform future product and design decisions.

- Balance short-term commercial impact with the quality and sustainability of the longer-term customer relationship.

Work AI-natively

- Integrate AI into your day-to-day design practice, from exploration, research synthesis, and ideation through rapid prototyping and design-to-code workflows.

- Use tools such as Claude & Claude Code, Gemini, Figma AI, and emerging technologies to shorten the distance between an idea and something customers can experience and validate.

- Explore opportunities for AI-native engagement experiences, including personalization, recommendations, adaptive experiences, conversational interactions, and new ways to help customers discover and get value from HelloFresh.

- Apply strong design judgment to AI-generated outputs, understanding when AI accelerates quality and when human craft, intuition, and critical thinking matter most.

Raise the bar for design craft

- Create polished, intuitive experiences with strong attention to visual hierarchy, interaction design, motion, micro-interactions, content, and overall usability.

- Bring a high level of craft to experiences that may need to be motivating, rewarding, or expressive without becoming distracting, confusing, or gimmicky.

- Identify opportunities to improve the quality and coherence of the Engagement experiences you work on.

- Contribute patterns, practices, and examples that help other designers deliver stronger work.

- Give and seek thoughtful critique, using feedback to continuously strengthen the work.

Design systems, not just screens

- Think across journeys rather than individual touchpoints, identifying opportunities to create reusable patterns and modular experiences that can scale across loyalty, referrals, rewards, discovery, brands, markets, and customer segments.

- Consider how engagement mechanics connect across surfaces and moments rather than treating individual features in isolation.

- Partner with our design system teams while contributing Engagement-specific patterns where needed.

- Help reduce design debt and fragmentation by creating solutions that make future experimentation faster without sacrificing relevance or quality.

Lead through collaboration

- Bring strong perspectives and clear rationale to complex product decisions.

- Guide cross-functional partners through ambiguity and trade-offs, advocating for customer-centred solutions while understanding commercial and technical constraints.

- Work closely with Marketing and CRM to ensure product experiences and customer communications reinforce one another across the lifecycle.

- Build alignment through clear communication, evidence, and strong design rationale rather than formal authority.

- Support other designers through critique, collaboration, and sharing new practices and approaches.
jobs.requirements_raw:
What you’ll bring

Senior-level product design experience

- Typically 4–6+ years of product design experience, although we care more about the scope, complexity, and impact of your work than years alone.

- A strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end ownership of complex consumer experiences, from understanding the problem through shipped outcomes and learning.

- Experience independently navigating ambiguous problems, making sound design decisions, and influencing product direction within your area.

Engagement and experimentation expertise

- Strong experience designing B2C consumer products, ideally within e-commerce, subscription, marketplace, loyalty, social, content, or other high-frequency digital experiences.

- You understand how product experiences can influence customer motivation, frequency, habit formation, retention, and advocacy — not just immediate conversion.

- You understand experimentation deeply and can translate behavioural data, customer insights, and business metrics into meaningful design opportunities.

- You can balance commercial outcomes with customer value, trust, and the quality of the longer-term relationship.

Exceptional product design craft

- Strong expertise across interaction and visual design, including hierarchy, information architecture, responsive behaviour, motion, and micro-interactions.

- You can take complex experiences and make them feel simple, and can articulate what separates a functional experience from a great one.

- You understand how thoughtful interaction and visual design can create moments of delight and motivation without compromising clarity or usability.

- You care about the details while understanding when speed, learning, and iteration matter more than perfection.

AI-native design fluency

- AI is already part of how you work, not something you are waiting to adopt.

- You regularly use AI across multiple stages of your design process, whether that’s discovery, synthesis, ideation, prototyping, or execution.

- You’re comfortable experimenting with tools such as Figma AI, Claude, Claude Code, Gemini, or similar emerging technologies.

- You’re interested not only in using AI to work faster, but in understanding how it changes what we can design for customers.

Systems thinking

- You naturally look beyond the individual screen or experiment to understand how experiences connect across the customer lifecycle.

- You have experience creating reusable patterns or modular solutions that can work across journeys, customer contexts, brands, or markets.

- You can balance the benefits of consistency and reuse with the need to design for the specific customer motivation and context at hand.

Strategic thinking and high agency

- You’re comfortable navigating ambiguity, challenging assumptions, and proactively identifying opportunities rather than waiting for perfectly defined briefs.

- You bring conviction to your design decisions while remaining open to evidence, experimentation, and alternative perspectives.

- You can establish a strong direction for your work and then get hands-on to make it real.

Cross-functional leadership

- You’re comfortable working beyond traditional design boundaries: shaping product decisions with Product Managers, exploring technical possibilities with Engineers, working with Data to understand behaviour, and partnering with Research, Content Design, Marketing, and CRM to understand and influence the broader customer experience.

- You know how to build alignment across disciplines and move work forward without relying on formal authority.

Exceptional communication

- You can turn complex problems into clear, compelling narratives and confidently present your thinking to stakeholders at different levels.

- You communicate not only what you designed, but the customer insight, hypothesis, trade-offs, and business rationale behind it.

- You can adapt the depth and format of your communication to the decision that needs to be made.

Above all, we are looking for individuals who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What we offer: The Toppings

- Global collaboration at scale: Collaborate with experienced engineers and product partners across HelloTech’s international teams, in a culture of active knowledge sharing.

- Technology with real-world impact: Build and operate modern systems at global scale, supporting 6+ millions of customers and complex supply chain operations.

- Technical/Product/Design leadership: Drive best practices and influence architecture/design, quality, and ways of working in an autonomous, product-led setup.

- End-to-end development/delivery: Drive decisions from problem definition to production, improving systems and enabling long-term scalability.

jobs.title: Senior Data Product Engineer, Intelligent Platforms (all genders)
jobs.description:
Work with HelloFresh in Warsaw and its HelloTech organisation, HelloFresh’s global technology backbone with more than 1000 people, building the digital products that power our end-to-end food experience. From meal kits and ready-to-eat meals to specialty offerings like pet food and premium meat & seafood, HelloTech creates the platforms that bring tailored food solutions to millions of customers every month.

Our subscription-based, direct-to-consumer model relies on technology at every step, from customer-facing apps and personalization logic to pricing, forecasting, supply chain optimization, and initiatives that help reduce food waste. While our brands operate independently to serve distinct customer needs, they are united by shared platforms, data, and operational excellence built by HelloTech.

HelloTech works in autonomous, cross-functional alliances, each owning a specific product or domain end to end. By working with our Warsaw office, you will help shape scalable, data-driven products used across our markets, working with a modern tech stack and international teams to continuously improve how people discover, order, and enjoy HelloFresh’s products, today and in the future.

About the Team

Behavioral Data & Experimentation Platform is a cross-functional team with end-to-end ownership of digital tracking across all markets globally at HelloFresh - from infrastructure all the way to curated data products and the hypotheses validation mechanisms (eg. AB testing, quasi-experiments). The squad brings together software engineers, data engineers, and data scientists to build the tracking, event, and statistical infrastructure that every tech team relies on to drive product decisions. Our work enables customer experience improvements and business growth.

About the Role: What's in the Box

As our Senior Data Engineer, you'll play a crucial part in extending and operating the platform behind our behavioral data - from event & experiment pipelines to Databricks Unity Catalog and semantic layer integrations, to the systems and standards that let other teams validate hypotheses on top of our platform. This isn't a pure data pipeline-building role: you'll reason about system design, schema governance and develop a technology platform as much as data engineering. Your deep understanding of behavioral tracking and data platform systems enables you to identify pain points across Behavioral Data Collection and Experimentation, and to design solutions that improve how we work at scale.

What You'll Do: The Recipe

At HelloFresh we are moving away from a model where software developers just execute tickets toward one where product engineers are trusted to own customer problems. A Product Engineer takes a problem, forms a point of view, validates it with customers and data, and ships it using AI as a force multiplier.

- Become an integral part of a high-impact data platform team, covering behavioral and experimentation data products.

- Design, build, and operate the platform components behind our behavioral data and experimentation infrastructure (Snowplow, Statsig, Databricks, Unity Catalog).

- Leverage Generative AI to improve and add new capabilities to the data platform.

- Build high-quality, well-modeled data pipelines for analytical purposes, enabling reliable reporting, experimentation analysis, and self-serve insight at scale across HelloFresh.

- Own reliability and scalability of data platform components - schema governance, event standards, lineage, and data quality checks.

- Extend and evolve our semantic layer, partnering with domain teams who federate metric definitions on top of it.

- Work with state-of-the-art technologies like Snowplow, Statsig, AWS, Airflow, Databricks Unity Catalog and Metric Views.

- Collaborate with product managers, product analysts and data scientists to create reusable, well-governed data products and to ensure the platform supports fast, trustworthy experiment readouts.

- Contribute to a collaborative and knowledge-sharing environment, providing technical guidance and coaching to team members and stakeholders.

- Work beyond your specialization when the problem demands it. Your specialization is your anchor, not your boundary.

- Operate what you build. You instrument, monitor, and improve your systems in production. Shipping is the beginning of the learning cycle, not the end.

What You'll Bring: The Ingredients

- Hands-on experience working with AI tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) beyond casual experimentation. You use AI agents every day. You have a practical sense of how the context you provide to AI tools shapes output quality, and how to set boundaries on AI-generated work.

- Proven track record of scientific or engineering work (Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD) in computer science, software engineering or related field.

- 5+ years of work experience as a Data Engineer, including delivery of production data. 2+ years on data platform systems - eg. semantic layers, catalogs, schema/governance systems.

- Fluency in Python and dbt, and building large scale high quality data pipelines on a modern cloud stack.

- Technical proficiency in SQL for retrieving, manipulating, and analyzing large datasets.

- Experience with software development practices and tools such as Git, CI/CD, and AWS.

- Expertise in leveraging Generative AI tools (eg. Claude, Copilot) to support development, experimentation, and documentation.

- Exceptional communication capabilities to interact effectively with product managers, product analysts and business stakeholders.

- You take full ownership. You have a bias to ship. You finish the last twenty percent.

- You have product sense and are opinionated about what should be built and why, and you can back that opinion with data and user evidence.

What we offer: The Toppings

- Global collaboration at scale: Collaborate with experienced engineers and product partners across HelloTech’s international teams, in a culture of active knowledge sharing.

- Technology with real-world impact: Build and operate modern systems at global scale, supporting 6+ millions of customers and complex supply chain operations.

- Technical/Product/Design leadership: Drive best practices and influence architecture/design, quality, and ways of working in an autonomous, product-led setup.

- End-to-end development/delivery: Drive decisions from problem definition to production, improving systems and enabling long-term scalability.

- Access to workspace at Warsaw Centre Point. The hub offers modern facilities including showers, breakout zones, outdoor space, cycle parking, and refreshments (coffee, soft drinks, and fruit).

jobs.description:
Senior Data Analyst

This is a hybrid role to our Newark, NJ or New York City HelloFresh Office

The role

As a Senior Data Analyst at HelloFresh, you will anchor the data strategy driving our aggressive, automation-first transformation. Our Global Customer Experience (GCX) team’s mission is to understand our customers’ journeys and empower market leads with insights and intelligent solutions that improve satisfaction, retention, and efficiency. We are moving fast to scale our self-serve rate, achieve 100% chatbot coverage, improve CSAT, and launch real-time, proactive incident communications via in-app CRM channels.

We need a strategic thought partner for our Product, Engineering, and CX Automation teams who brings a high bar of technical rigor. In this role, you will own our core automation analytics architecture (chatbots, voicebots, agent-assist AI, and customer self-reporting tools), dive deep into GenAI conversational landscapes, and translate complex log data into actionable roadmap strategies. If you love solving open-ended problems and want to directly shape the experience of millions of global customers, you might just be our missing ingredient.

What you’ll do

- Anchor the data strategy for our entire automation and chatbot analytics infrastructure, serving as the sole embedded analytics lead within the Global CX department.

- Proactively monitor user intents and trends to diagnose system bugs early and establish standardized, organization-wide KPIs for bot containment and NLP accuracy.

- Conduct deep-dive analyses of chat transcripts and user journeys, leveraging semantic clustering and LLM evaluation to uncover friction points and tune conversational flows.

- Continuously optimize and secure our reporting environment, ensuring data integrity, normalization, and advanced visualization techniques for critical executive decision-making.

- Partner closely with cross-functional teams (Product, Engineering, and CX Automation) to translate complex customer log data and system requirements into sustainable roadmap strategies.

- Own and deliver core business reporting mechanisms and dashboards, including the Monthly Business Review (MBR) and EBIT reviews.
jobs.requirements_raw:
What you’ll bring

- A passion for driving automation-first transformations and solving complex operational problems within a fast-paced customer experience environment.

- Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL to handle increased domain complexity and secure our underlying reporting architecture.

- Experience with next-gen agentic workflow stacks (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor) to optimize development and analytical speed.

- Proven track record of designing, implementing, and maintaining high-visibility BI solutions and dashboards that communicate trends clearly to Directors, VPs, and SVPs.

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to lead complex data analytics projects and influence cross-functional partner

You’ll get

-

- Competitive Salary & 401k company match that vests immediately upon participation

- Generous parental leave of 16 weeks & PTO policy, as well as paid holidays off

- $0 monthly premium and other flexible health plans

- Amazing discounts, including up to 85% off HelloFresh subscription

- Emergency child and adult care services

- Snacks & monthly catered lunches

- Collaborative, dynamic work environment within a fast-paced, mission-driven company

This job description is intended to provide a general overview of the responsibilities. However, the Company reserves the right to adjust, modify, or reassign work tasks and responsibilities as needed to meet changing business needs, operational requirements, or other factors.

jobs.description:
The Role

At HelloConnect, you will be part of a dynamic team in Inoza tower, BGC that embraces innovation and leverages advanced technology to create exceptional experiences. Our culture is built on collaboration, continuous learning, and a commitment to excellence. You’ll have the opportunity to work on impactful projects, develop your skills, and grow within a supportive environment that values diverse perspectives and experiences.

In this role, you will take on a key responsibility in converting artwork, logos, illustrations, and customer designs into optimized embroidery stitch files using Tajima DG16. This individual combines technical digitizing expertise, embroidery production knowledge, and quality control skills to create efficient stitch plans that run smoothly on commercial embroidery machines while maintaining the highest possible visual quality.

The ideal candidate understands not only how to digitize designs, but why specific stitch types, densities, underlays, pull compensation, and sequencing decisions affect production outcomes.

We’re looking for passionate individuals who can bring their unique skills and ideas to the table. Even if you don't meet every requirement but believe you’d excel in this role, we’d love to hear from you!

What you’ll do

Advanced Embroidery Digitizing

- Convert customer artwork into production-ready embroidery files.

- Create efficient stitch paths that minimize trims, jumps, thread breaks, and machine downtime.

- Digitize for multiple fabric types including: Performance apparel, Caps and structured hats, Knit garments, Woven garments, Heavy jackets, Bags and accessories

- Apply proper stitch sequencing and object ordering.

- Optimize designs for different embroidery machine brands and formats.

Tajima DG16 Expertise

- Expert use of: Auto Punch, Manual Punch, Stitch Editor, Underlay Settings, Pull Compensation, Density Management, Pathing & Travel Runs, Appliqué Functions, Sequin Functions (if applicable), Cap Frame Digitizing, Lettering & Monogramming Tools, Vector Import & Cleanup

- Troubleshoot production issues directly within DG16.

Production Optimization

- Reduce stitch count without sacrificing quality.

- Improve machine efficiency and production speed.

- Analyze sew-outs and make corrections.

- Create machine-ready files that require minimal operator intervention.

Quality Assurance

- Review sew-out samples.

- Identify causes of: Registration issues, Puckering, Thread breaks, Bird nesting, Poor coverage, Distortion

- Implement corrective digitizing adjustments.

Technical Competencies

Advanced Digitizing Knowledge

Stitch Types

Expert understanding of: Satin stitches, Fill stitches, Tatami fills, Motif fills, Running stitches, Bean stitches, Zig-zag stitches, Edge-run stitches, Decorative stitches

Underlay Strategy

Deep understanding of: Edge Run, Center Walk, Zig-Zag, Double Zig-Zag, Combination underlays

Knows when each underlay type should be used based on: Fabric, Design size, Stitch type, Garment stability

Density Control

Ability to: Adjust density based on fabric type. Balance coverage versus stitch count. Prevent thread buildup and puckering.

Pull Compensation

Expert-level understanding of: Fabric distortion, Push and pull effects, Compensation adjustments by stitch angle and material

Sequencing & Pathing

Efficient object ordering. Minimized trims and color changes. Reduced machine movement. Logical sew sequence construction.

Production Knowledge

Machine Understanding

Experience with commercial embroidery equipment such as: Tajima, Barudan, SWF, Ricoma

Understands: Tension management, Needle selection, Stabilizer selection, Thread behavior, Machine limitations

Fabric Knowledge

Can digitize appropriately for: Cotton, Polyester, Fleece, Performance fabrics, Stretch fabrics, Leather, Twill, Structured caps.

Factor is our newest brand - a healthy, ready-to-eat meal delivery service, and one of the fastest-growing parts of the HelloFresh Group’s European business.

jobs.title: Senior Safety Specialist
jobs.description:
Senior Safety Specialist

Day and Night Shift available

Factor a brand of HelloFresh is seeking an experienced Sr. Safety Specialist to join our team! As Sr. Safety Specialist, you will join forces with the Manager of Safety and Loss Prevention to head up workplace safety initiatives for one of our distribution center operations! You will be on the front lines of production and immerse yourself in the trenches to promote HelloFresh’s vision, inspire change, raise the bar on safety performance, and champion a culture of safety!

You will…

- Work with integrity and the utmost regard for the safety and health at HelloFresh

- Provides subject matter expertise either through education, training, and/or experience in multiple areas including environmental management, compliance, occupational safety, risk management and/or occupational health

- Ensure OSHA compliance within a HelloFresh/Green Chef Facility including but not limited to: Powered Industrial Trucks (PIT’s); New Hire safety training and ongoing safety training; Lockout/Tagout, Machine Guarding and Chemical Safety; all necessary recordkeeping and reporting including OSHA 300 Logs

- Assist management team during accident or injury investigations and root cause analysis

- Act as the management team’s subject matter expert for safety and security questions

- Ensure visibility of HSE initiatives at the site level (Behavior Safety, Safe Work Permit process, Safety Observations, Near Miss, etc) to all levels of operations management and recommend improvements in effectiveness. Demonstrate sound judgment based on observations and evaluation, by site, to determine safety meeting effectiveness and appropriate level of mentoring for safety meeting facilitators. Collect and analyze data to identify safety or injury trends and develop corrective actions

- Ensure contractors and visitors follow HelloFresh safety policies during their time on-site

- Assist with the site emergency action plan and liaison with local first responders when needed

- Conduct a Job Safety Analysis (JSA) of all routine and non-routine tasks performed on-site

- Promote safer forklift operations through training, observation and coaching operators

- Develop training materials including toolbox talks, standard operating procedures (SOP’s) and others

- Manage the relationship with site security and ensures security services are being provided for each DC

- Assist with inventory shrinkage and other deliberate damage/product theft investigations as needed

- Support other departments including quality, food safety, production and logistics as needed

- Use continuous improvement principles to identify ways to improve our processes and results

You are…

- Partner: you effectively listen, build rapport and communicate at all levels; you’re confident sharing ideas and are a trusted advisor for workplace safety

- Results-driven: you recognize and resolve situations that are ambiguous or challenging, focus effort on meeting or exceeding goals, and pave the way for efficiency.

- Programmatic: able to identify the system component that is causing the error, as well as the options available for resolving it and completing the task.

- Inspirational: you know how to make an impact and deliver presentations that inspire and influence change

- Versatile: you roll with the punches and don’t get overwhelmed easily; you enjoy grinding away at issues and have a knack for driving results in hyper-growth, constantly changing environments

You have…

- Minimum of 3 years of experience in occupational safety experience with knowledge of manufacturing/industrial EHS

- Bachelor’s degree in Safety, Occupational Health, or Environmental Health & Safety preferred; will consider high school diploma with 4+ years EHS experience

- Preferred Safety Certification: CSP, ASP, OHST, etc.

- Expertise in OSHA compliance, especially with powered industrial trucks, lockout/tagout, strain and sprain prevention.

- Superior communication and presentation skills with ability to influence across all levels of an organization

- Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Power Point) and Google app (Gmail, drive, sheets, etc.)

You'll get…

- Competitive Salary & 401k company match that vests immediately upon participation

- Generous parental leave of 16 weeks & PTO policy, as well as paid holidays off

- $0 monthly premium and other flexible health plans

- Amazing discounts, including up to 75% off HelloFresh subscription

- Flexible shift scheduling & advancement opportunities

- Emergency child and adult care services

- Snacks & monthly catered lunches

- Collaborative, dynamic work environment within a fast-paced, mission-driven company

You’ll get…

- Competitive hourly rate, 401K company match that vests immediately upon participation, & team bonus opportunities

- Generous PTO and flexible attendance policy

- Comprehensive health and wellness benefits with options at $0 monthly, effective first day of employment

- Up to 85% discount on subscriptions to HelloFresh meal plans (HelloFresh, Green Chef, Everyplate, and Factor_)

- Access to Employee Resource Groups that are open to all employees, including those pertaining to BIPOC, women, veterans, parents, and LGBTQ+

- Inclusive, collaborative, and dynamic work environment within a fast-paced, mission-driven company that is disrupting the traditional food supply chain

jobs.title: Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description

Based in Auckland, New Zealand, the Marketing Manager will report to the Associate Director Brand for Meal Kits ANZ, working as part of a team that is responsible for bringing the HelloFresh brand strategy and go-to-market plan to life in fresh, creative ways in New Zealand. Excitingly, frequent travel to Australia is required as part of this role, to work closely with our Sydney team. This is a full-time, permanent role, starting from Oct 1 2026.

We are looking for an ambitious and passionate marketer that wants to help shape and change the way people eat forever. Most of all, someone that will enrich our team at HelloFresh.

We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences. So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d love and thrive in this role, we would really like to hear from you and learn more about you.

You will…

- Contribute to the development and hands-on execution of HelloFresh New Zealand marketing plans, becoming an expert on the local consumer, media, and food category landscape while balancing global stakeholder requirements.

- Contribute to an integrated brand calendar, working with local/global creative, brand, and product teams while integrating campaigns across marketing channels (SEO, influencer, paid social, direct sales, etc.) to drive wider goals.

- Partner with the HelloFresh ANZ Product Marketing Lead to support, deliver, and seamlessly integrate product marketing as part of broader brand activity.

- Champion the HelloFresh customer at the heart of everything, supporting performance, CRM, direct sales, and CX teams with customer-focussed creative and comms briefing to reinforce the brand value proposition.

- Manage day-to-day agency relationships (creative, PR, media) and central ATL teams to write insight-led briefs, develop media strategies, and execute localized brand activity.

- Manage the end-to-end creative production of campaigns and autonomously deliver locally- and globally-led brand partnerships, collaborating with central teams and local culinary, product, growth, and ops functions.

- Coordinate and track the HelloFresh New Zealand brand budget, maintaining accurate records and processing spend to deliver world-class activity on time and to budget.

- Deliver post-campaign analysis and reports, sharing the impact of marketing activity on business and brand KPIs alongside recommendations and hypotheses to test for future brand activity.

You have/are…

- Passionate about food and the HelloFresh brand, immensely curious about future possibilities, and driven to bring an innovative, ambitious approach to brand marketing.

- Extensive marketing knowledge (ideally brand/digital), with a solid understanding of tailoring cross-channel communication to increase brand salience, love, and consideration while balancing data to inform planning and decision making.

- Excellent understanding and track record in delivering end-to-end ATL activity, including media strategies, media plans, and executing creative and comms to deliver on plans.

- Strong communicator with exceptional influencing skills (written/verbal) to navigate a global organisation across multiple functions, products, and local and central teams.

- A natural talent for inspiring exceptional creativity, writing clear, simple, insight-driven briefs (often at pace for topical/trending opportunities), and making space for creatives to do their best work.

- Exceptional project management skills and a highly organised approach to keep clear WIP and budget documentation, working cross-functionally to deliver on time and to budget.

- Ability to work autonomously to drive an ambitious brand plan agenda, ensuring stakeholders are brought in at relevant stages, while remaining an accountable, proactive, solution-oriented team player.

- Data literate, analytical, and structured in problem solving—including problem definition, hypothesis development, testing, analysis, evaluation of results, and recommendations.

What you’ll get in return…

- The chance to have a significant impact in a leading global food technology company

- Flexible working arrangements

- Egoless environment, constant learning with room for personal growth

- Free access to Headspace

- Internal learning & development

- A diverse and vibrant international environment, with offices in 18 countries

- Competitive salary & benefits - 70% off HelloFresh

- Access to ClassPass corporate membership - 33 credits per month

Start Date: 1st October 2026

Duration: Permanent full time role. You must have the right to work full-time in Australia/New Zealand

Location: Penrose, Auckland - hybrid working environment

Salary: Competitive salary & employee benefits

jobs.title: Director, WMS Product Design/Development [OPERATIONS TECHNOLOGY]
jobs.description:
About the role

HelloFresh is searching for an action-oriented servant leader for our warehouse management system (WMS) Product Design and Software Engineering functions. This leader owns the full software delivery lifecycle for HelloFresh's global warehouse fulfillment and inventory control domain — from architecture and product design through engineering execution, quality assurance, and operational reliability. You will drive a culture of product & engineering excellence, leveraging modern agentic tooling and AI-assisted workflows to increase team velocity, reduce defect escape rates, and accelerate deployment confidence.

You will collaborate closely with stakeholders across operations, automation/production technology, procurement, and finance to deliver innovative solutions on our strategic WMS platform — Infios's Warehouse Advantage (Körber/Highjump) — while balancing competing priorities and technical resource demand.

This location-flexible position can be physically based in any of our North America corporate offices or fulfillment centers with a hybrid working model, but must be flexible with work hour scheduling as teams and solutions are dispersed globally.

The Director of WMS Product Design and Software Engineering will work with key technology and product leaders across HelloFresh to enable the inventory management and control domain strategy, evaluate technology-related priorities, and translate stakeholder needs into actionable roadmaps. The ideal candidate combines impeccable management and communication skills with a practitioner's instinct for modern software delivery — knowing how to build high-performing teams, establish engineering health metrics, and integrate AI-assisted tooling that meaningfully accelerates quality and velocity.

What you'll own

- WMS Solution Ownership: Provide technical direction, development oversight, and performance accountability for HelloFresh's deployment of Infios's Warehouse Advantage (Körber/Highjump) WMS platform across all global locations

- Integration Architecture & Reliability: Own WMS layer Integrations to host systems and CDC pipelines (Debezium/kafka) to Snowflake/Databricks

jobs.title: Associate Director of CI, Ingredient Excellence
jobs.description:
Associate Director of Continuous Improvement, Ingredient Quality (North America)

We are looking for a high-impact leader to bridge the gap between Quality data and Operational execution. This role is designed for a proven, data-driven continuous improvement leader who uses analytics, trends, and structured problem-solving to identify systemic opportunities and deliver measurable results. You have the ability to turn data into scalable operational improvement. This is not a "desk job." As the Associate Director of Ingredient Excellence & CI, you will be the chief architect and project owner for North American quality standards. You will be responsible for identifying systemic failures and then leading the development and implementation of solutions through our entire supply chain, from suppliers through our operations and right to our customers' doorstep. You are successful only when the metrics move, which requires staying with a project from the initial data deep-dive through to final staff training and process adoption.

You Will...

- Own the Implementation Lifecycle: Lead the end-to-end development and execution of our ingredient quality error governance. You don’t do band-aid fixes, and you are able to sort signals from noise. You don't just identify the root cause; you partner with all stakeholders to re-engineer the process and stay on-site until the defect rate drops.

- Architect the NA Meal Kit Quality Program: Develop a unified quality focus strategy for our North American network. This involves creating the standards, building the systems & process, and setting up the automated tracking of the execution to ensure consistency across all sites.

- Turn Data into Action: Use KPIs, trend analysis, and performance data to identify systemic gaps and prioritize the highest-impact improvement opportunities across the network. Translate insights into scalable solutions and measure results to ensure improvements are sustained.

- Drive Operational Accountability: Act as the "boots on the ground" leader who translates quality KPIs into actionable SOPs for our Distribution Centers. You will manage the process implementation to ensure new quality initiatives are adopted, sustained, and reflected in the data.

- Advanced Quality Reporting: Own the North American quality reporting suite. You will evolve our real-time data capabilities to provide the business with predictive insights rather than just post-mortem reports. Use reporting not simply to describe performance, but to identify trends, uncover root causes, prioritize action, and measure business impact.

- Cross-Functional Leadership: Serve as the primary quality liaison for Product, Procurement, Operations and Logistics. If they are hearing about problems, you are their first call to help fix it.

- Continuous Improvement Mentality: Apply Lean or Six Sigma methodologies to eliminate waste and reduce ingredient damage, directly impacting the bottom line. Lead structured improvement initiatives across multiple sites and translate successful solutions into scalable network standards.

- Build and Mentor a High-Performance Team: Recruit, train, coach, and manage a team of quality professionals and continuous improvement specialists across North America, fostering a culture of accountability, data-driven decision-making, and excellence.

- Drive Organizational Change: Champion quality-first thinking throughout the organization, influencing leaders and inspiring team members at all levels to adopt new processes and standards.

You Are...

- Data-Driven: You naturally start with the data. You can identify patterns and trends, distinguish symptoms from systemic problems, and turn insights into measurable operational improvements.

- A Continuous Improvement Leader: You have a demonstrated track record of solving complex problems, improving processes, and scaling successful solutions across sites, functions, or business units.

- An Operator at Heart: You understand that a quality program is only as good as the operator’s ability to execute it. You enjoy being on the ground, walking the lines, and solving problems in real-time.

- A "Finisher": You have a proven track record of seeing complex projects through to completion. You don't "throw ideas over the fence"; you jump the fence and help build the solution.

- Strategic & Tactical: You can present a 3-year quality roadmap to a boardroom in the morning and troubleshoot a conveyor belt/packaging interface with a floor lead in the afternoon.

- Influential: You can convince Ops leaders to change their processes by proving that higher quality standards lead to higher efficiency and lower costs.

- A Talent Developer: You are a dedicated mentor who takes pride in developing the next generation of quality and operational leaders, providing clear career paths and constructive feedback.

- An Influential Communicator: You effectively communicate complex quality initiatives, process changes, and performance results to diverse audiences, from associates in our sites to execs in a meeting room.

At a Minimum, You Have...

- Experience: 8+ years in Continuous Improvement, Operational Excellence, Quality, Supply Chain, or related operational disciplines, with demonstrated experience using data to drive measurable improvements across complex operations. You have a history of managing teams and large-scale projects in a high-volume manufacturing or logistics environment.

- Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Food Science, Supply Chain, Engineering, Business, Analytics, or a related discipline. (Lean Six Sigma Green/Black Belt highly preferred).

- Continuous Improvement: Demonstrated experience using Lean, Six Sigma, DMAIC, Kaizen, RCA, or similar structured problem-solving methodologies to deliver measurable results.

- Data & Analytics: Demonstrated ability to analyze KPIs and performance trends, identify systemic gaps, develop actionable insights, and measure the impact of implemented solutions. Experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau or Power BI strongly preferred.

- Quality/Food: Experience within food manufacturing, distribution, supply chain, quality, or another complex operational environment preferred.

- Travel: Ability to travel up to 25% to North American Distribution Centers. This role requires a physical presence to ensure process implementation is successful.

jobs.title: Associate Director of IT Operations
jobs.description:
Job Description

Based in our Chippendale head office in Sydney and reporting to our Director of IT, you will lead the evolution of our APAC IT team from a traditional service desk into a high-performing, globally integrated IT operations hub. Covering HelloConnect Philippines (1,600+ staff across three sites), YouFoodz, BeCool Logistics, and HelloFresh ANZ, this is one of the most dynamic and operationally complex IT leadership roles in the HelloFresh Group.

In this position, you will connect regional teams with global leadership, turning big-picture strategy into clear local results, preventing operational silos, and building an IT function ready to scale. As Associate Director, you will act as a trusted advisor to senior executives, shape global IT strategy, and champion IT Operations best practices across the APAC region.

You will…

- Define & Own Regional Strategy: Shape and execute the APAC IT strategy across all entities, balancing speed, scope, and quality to seamlessly integrate the region into the global HelloFresh ecosystem.

- Lead & Master Asynchronous Work: Guide a distributed team across Australia, New Zealand, and the Philippines while syncing with Berlin and Toronto. You write clear direction and document key decisions, empowering time-zone-agnostic execution where real-time overlap is optimized and asynchronous is the default.

- Evolve Regional Operations: Transform a service-desk model into a specialized IT Operations framework, building deep domain expertise so local teams can operate autonomously without constant escalation.

- Partner with Executive Stakeholders: Serve as the trusted IT advisor to APAC business leadership, translating complex technical trade-offs into clear, high-level business recommendations.

- Drive SLAs, Compliance & Audits: Govern regional performance using Jira Service Management insights, maintaining a robust audit posture and keeping global IT leadership informed on key metrics.

- Champion AI Innovation: Lead by example with AI tools, actively embedding AI-driven workflows across the team as a core operational standard.

- Optimize Finance & Influence Global Strategy: Maximize regional ROI through smart vendor negotiations, tooling consolidation, and infrastructure streamlining, while representing APAC as a key contributor to global IT strategy.

You have/are…

- Async-First Leadership: Proven ability to manage across major time-zone gaps (e.g., aligning Manila with different hemispheres) using clear written communication and structure over constant calls.

- APAC Senior Leadership: Experience at the Associate Director level (or equivalent), with direct accountability for multi-country IT strategy, portfolio ownership, and service delivery across APAC.

- Philippines & BPO Expertise: Hands-on experience leading or partnering with IT operations in a Philippines-based BPO or shared-services environment—navigating regulatory requirements, multi-site logistics, and remote team management.

- Executive Stakeholder Management: Track record of advising C-suite stakeholders, balancing competing interests, and simplifying complex IT trade-offs into clear decisions.

- Distributed Team Building: Expertise in leading cross-cultural teams across borders, focusing on performance calibration, coaching, and retention.

- AI Adoption: Practical experience integrating AI tools into your personal workflows and embedding AI-driven practices within your team to boost efficiency.

- Financial & Governance Savvy: Skilled in cost optimization via vendor negotiations and tool consolidation. Familiarity with cybersecurity frameworks and BPO regulatory environments is a plus.

What you’ll get in return…

- The chance to have a significant impact in a leading global food technology company

- Flexible working arrangements

- Egoless environment, constant learning with room for personal growth

- Free access to Headspace

- Internal learning & development

- A diverse and vibrant international environment, with offices in 18 countries

- Company discount - 70% off HelloFresh & 40% off Youfoodz

Start Date: Immediately available - Can wait a notice period

Duration: Permanent full time role. You must have the right to work full-time in Australia/New Zealand

Location: Chippendale Head Office- hybrid working environment

Salary: Competitive salary & employee benefits
