jobs.title: Lead Copywriter, Global Creative Studio (m/f/x)
jobs.description:
Lead Copywriter, Global Creative Studio (m/f/x)

Brand Marketing · Berlin or Warsaw

At HelloFresh Group, our mission is to change the way people eat forever. Since our 2011 founding in Berlin, we've become the global market leader in the meal kit sector, inspiring millions of home cooks and food lovers every week. Our portfolio spans eight brands across 16 markets, from HelloFresh and Factor to Good Chop and Pets Table.

ABOUT THE JOB

If you love making words work hard, this might be your job.

HelloFresh Group is looking for a Lead Copywriter to join our Creative Studio and help drive copy quality across our demand generation engine. You'll work across the full funnel and across every channel that matters (TV, OOH, paid social, display, CRM, YouTube) with a particular focus on mid-funnel, paid social creative that stops thumbs and starts conversations.

This is a hands-on writing role, creating everything from campaign headlines to push notifications, from social hooks to CRM journeys. You'll also bring the strategic thinking to help shape how eight global brands communicate across sixteen markets, and the collaborative instinct to consult with local teams, advise channel owners, and help more junior staffers write better.

Crucially, you will help build, train, and socialize AI tools (particularly on Claude and Gemini) to create and maintain a broad creative toolkit. You will use these tools to generate, iterate, and localize content, but you will be the creative brain behind all LLM work.

This position is based in Berlin or Warsaw. Berlin-based employees have required attendance three days per week (Monday to Wednesday) at our Creative Studio in Moabit.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Write sharp, on-brand copy across the full funnel and all major channels (paid social, display, CRM, YouTube, TV, and OOH), with a particular emphasis on mid-funnel paid social creative.

- Bring big-picture strategic thinking to campaign briefs and creative concepts, while staying just as comfortable writing a single subject line or a two-second video hook.

- Consult with local market copywriting teams across sixteen markets, offering guidance, feedback, and creative direction that keeps their work on-brand and high-quality.

- Use AI tools (especially Claude and Gemini) as part of your creative workflow: for ideation, iteration, and developing prompt frameworks and localization pipelines that improve quality and efficiency at scale.

- Advise channel owners and marketing stakeholders on copy strategy, messaging hierarchy, and how to make creative work harder at every touchpoint.

- Help shape, evolve, and maintain tone of voice and messaging guidelines across eight brands, ensuring they’re clear and practical enough to use at local and global levels.

- Partner with designers, videographers, motion designers, and performance marketers to bring creative ideas to life and optimize them for conversion.

- Interpret performance data to understand what's working, and use those insights to improve briefs, iterate on copy, and sharpen your craft.

- Rigorously proofread copy. Zero typos, zero grammatical errors, no exceptions.

- Manage content flows via Google Suite, Airtable, and Jira so copy moves efficiently from brief to stakeholders to market.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- A full-time copywriter based in, or willing to relocate to, Berlin or Warsaw.

- BS/MS from a top-tier university in Communications, Marketing, Creative Writing, or a related field.

- 8+ years of copywriting or communications experience, ideally spanning both agency and in-house environments.

- A proven track record of high-impact, English-language copy across major digital channels, especially paid social, display, CRM, email, and YouTube.

- A strategic thinker who can see the big picture across brands and markets, but who is equally happy polishing a push notification or reworking a subject line.

- An experienced AI worker, using LLMs as part of a creative process to generate, refine, and localize copy more effectively.

- A natural collaborator who can consult with and advise local teams and channel owners—someone who leads through the quality of their thinking.

- Comfortable working within brand and tone guidelines, and experienced enough to know when to push the boundaries.

- Ability to write across multiple projects, brands, markets, and tones simultaneously.

- A curiosity about audiences and the ability to interpret performance data to refine copy strategy.

- Experience with localization and machine translation workflows is a plus.

- Agency experience, particularly at a social media-focused or digital agency, is a plus.

- Experience working for food or tech brands is a plus.

- Knowledge of German, French, Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, or Dutch is a plus.

ARE YOU UP FOR THE CHALLENGE?

To apply, please complete the application and send us a portfolio that shows your range: performance-driven digital copy, campaign thinking across brands or markets, and any examples of how you've worked smarter—whether that's AI-assisted workflows, localization processes, or something else entirely.

We're excited to see what you bring to the team.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Long-Term Planning
jobs.description:
The Senior Manager, Long-Term Planning will serve as the architect of our future-state planning for the North America (NA) market, comprising our US and CA businesses. Reporting into the Director, Strategic Planning, you will be responsible for implementing a structured, long-term strategic planning horizon in the NA business.

This role will optimize North American supply chain and fulfillment operations and implement long-term strategies aligned with business objectives. Working closely with our Planning team, Procurement, Fulfillment, Product, and other key stakeholders, you will play a crucial role in delivering exceptional value to our customers. This role demands a strategic mindset, strong analytical skills, and effective collaboration to ensure a seamless flow of goods and services.

This is a critical Individual Contributor (IC) role responsible for two major transformations:

- Implementing a formal Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) process in the US, leveraging our Canadian model as a reference point

- Leading and continue improving our existing S&OP process in Canada

- Acting as the key NA Planning representative for our global transition from manual tools into an Advanced Planning System

Responsibilities:

- Build and Launch US S&OP: Lead the design and implementation of a structured monthly Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) process for the US market. You will facilitate the monthly review meetings, identifying misalignments between demand and supply, and owning the escalation process to senior leadership when decisions on footprint, inventory, or labor are required.

- Drive Long-Term Alignment: Own the long-term view (16–52 weeks) of end-to-end plans. You will collaborate with Network, Demand, Fulfillment, and Supply Planning counterparts to assess risks and ensure our infrastructure can support initiatives like "Project 500" (expanding to 500+ recipes) and "Infinite Choice".

- Set-up framework to ensure alignment on long term network strategy across both markets, from a volume allocation to distribution center perspective, and identify risks and opportunities associated with evolving box count and site performance landscape

- Resolve Strategic Risks: Act as the primary cross-functional liaison to identify and resolve long-range constraints. You will translate the "how" of planning into the "so what" for the P&L, quantifying impacts on inventory, cost, and service levels.

- Champion Process Standardization: Partner with global Planning counterparts to understand successful operating models and adapt best practices for NA, fostering a unified North American planning culture.

- Establish Key Performance Indicators: Define and track success metrics for long-term planning accuracy, including inventory health, capacity utilization, and forecast stability, establishing a performance-driven culture.

- Support planning Tooling Strategy (Build vs. Buy): Help define detailed business requirements, participate in evaluation of external vendors versus internal builds, and draft the business case to move the NA planning function away from manual Google Sheets toward an integrated, automated Planning System.

You are:

- A Strategic Thinker: You can look past today's operational fires to solve tomorrow's structural problems.

- Data-Driven & Analytical: You use logic to think critically through complex problems, exploring data to inform operational decision-making.

- An Effective Communicator: You can distill complex supply chain risks into clear decision points for the Executive Team.

- A Change Agent: You are comfortable driving process adoption in an environment transitioning from siloed operations to integrated planning.

- Self-driven: You can take an ask and drive it to completion end-to-end without requiring continuous support along the way

- Technically Savvy: You understand the architecture of planning systems (APS/ERP) and can articulate the difference between "infinite capacity" ERP views and "finite capacity" APS constraints.

It would be an asset if you have:

- 6+ years of experience in Supply Chain Planning, S&OP, Network / Operations Strategy, or related positions that require cross-functional collaboration in the intersection between strategy and operations

- Strong experience facilitating S&OP / IBP cycles, including executive presentations and conflict resolution.

- Excellent quantitative and analytical skills - able to gather, organize, analyze, visualize, and present data to enable decision-making

- Experience implementing, managing or working with Advanced Planning Systems (APS) (e.g., OMP, Blue Yonder, SAP IBP, Kinaxis) and managing the "build vs. buy" decision process

- Proficiency in spreadsheet applications, such as Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets, with preference for ability to automate within spreadsheets

- Bachelor’s / Master’s degree in Engineering, Business, Supply Chain, or a related field; strong mathematical/statistical skills.

- Ability to work as an Individual Contributor who leads through influence across cross-functional stakeholders (Operations, Logistics, Procurement, Finance, Product).

- Strong verbal and written communication abilities - able to convey the most important information to stakeholders, and to be effective in both technical and non-technical (business) situations.

You’ll get…

- Competitive hourly rate, 401K company match that vests immediately upon participation, & team bonus opportunities

- Generous PTO and flexible attendance policy

- Comprehensive health and wellness benefits with options at $0 monthly, effective first day of employment

- Up to 85% discount on subscriptions to HelloFresh meal plans (HelloFresh, Green Chef, Everyplate, and Factor_)

- Access to Employee Resource Groups that are open to all employees, including those pertaining to BIPOC, women, veterans, parents, and LGBTQ+

- Inclusive, collaborative, and dynamic work environment within a fast-paced, mission-driven company that is disrupting the traditional food supply chain

This job description is intended to provide a general overview of the responsibilities. However, the Company reserves the right to adjust, modify, or reassign work tasks and responsibilities as needed to meet changing business needs, operational requirements, or other factors.

New York Pay Range

$136,710—$158,110 USD

jobs.title: Creative Systems & Optimization Manager
jobs.description:
HelloFresh is seeking a sharp, systems-minded Creative Systems & Optimization Manager to own the operating model behind our XPOD studio. As the single intake owner across Paid Social, Organic Social, Brand Partnerships and localization, this role turns a complex, multi-brand production slate into one prioritized, efficient engine — ensuring the highest-impact work moves first.

XPOD Creative Studio is focused on delivering a high output of creative assets to drive growth across paid channels. Day-to-day, that still means hands-on project management - scoping, scheduling, resourcing, and driving projects through to completion across TikTok, Reels, Snap, Pinterest, YouTube and beyond. We move fast, flex with business needs and operate at the intersection of creative and performance. The right candidate is fluent in Growth, obsessed with efficiency and skilled at building systems that help creative teams move faster and smarter.

This is not a traditional Creative Operations/PM role. You’ll proactively build AI-powered workflows, automate manual processes and keep stakeholders across Growth, Brand, Influencer and markets aligned and moving. In close partnership with Growth Ops, you’ll continuously test and embed smarter ways of working into the studio’s day-to-day operations.

You will …

- Own the design and evolution of the studio's operational workflows - building frameworks flexible enough to move with shifting business needs, yet structured enough to scale and stay easy for others to follow.

- Apply strong project management fundamentals - setting milestones and deadlines from a brief, driving the decisions needed to execute within time constraints, and pushing every project through to completion, even when things are ambiguous or change at the last minute.

- Own all studio intake as the single point of contact for every video brief across brands and channels: scoping, prioritizing, and routing every request against total studio capacity

- Identify, evaluate, and implement automations, AI tools, and templates that lift the studio's operating efficiency.

- Maintain the studio's performance data and reporting - trends, production velocity, and project-level status - keeping the Head of Creative Production, project teams, and other stakeholders ahead of timelines and risk.

- Coordinate schedules and workflows with the wider creative operations team and Growth Operations, keeping cross-studio campaigns and the paid social content pipeline in sync.

- Stay close enough to every project in the pipeline that creatives always have what they need to keep moving, and that no question sits unanswered long enough to cause a delay.

- Work closely with stakeholders and creative teams to shape expectations and define project scope, and manage those relationships day to day - including negotiating, and where necessary pushing back on, channel requests against budget and priority so the studio's limited creative capacity goes toward what the business actually needs.

- Own resourcing and allocation across the creative team - assessing priority, balancing workload and timelines, and adjusting on the fly so creatives can sustain their pace without projects slipping.

- Onboard, train, and manage freelance creatives and creative partners or vendors, flexing the team's capacity up or down against demand.

- Partner with global stakeholders on localization, translation and versioning of assets, ensuring creative holds up at both a product and creative level in every local market.

- Ensure projects launch on time and to expectation, and drive the post-campaign assessments that follow.

- Bring critical thinking to competing business interests, cross-functional friction, and risk resolution.

You are…

- Impeccably organized, with an eye for detail that doesn't slow you down.

- Fluent in paid social media channels, growth funnels, and performance marketing

- An empowered self-starter with strong time, people, and stakeholder management instincts.

- A confident negotiator on time, scope, budget, and resources - comfortable pushing back when a request doesn't match the studio's capacity.

- A systems thinker who'd rather design the framework than just manage what runs through it.

- An AI power-user: you build and maximize automation proactively, a self-starter obsessed with efficiency rather than waiting to be told what to do

- A natural coach, comfortable onboarding, training, and developing freelance creative talent.

- Able to run high volumes of concurrent projects through prioritization and organization under tight deadlines.

- Able to follow through, own, and guide a project from infancy to execution - even when very little is known at the start.

- A fan of working in an ultra-fast-paced environment.

- A creative thinker who uses non-linear approaches and critical thinking to proactively problem-solve and steer projects.

- Willing to challenge assumptions and the status quo in favor of iterative, adaptive change.

- Solution-oriented - you flag and fix problems as they arise, not after the fact.

At a minimum, you have…

- Bachelor's degree in Advertising, Business, Management, Communications, or equivalent experience.

- 5–7 years of creative/marketing project management or creative operations experience at an in-house agency or studio, in a high-volume, high-efficiency, fast-moving environment.

- Experience designing or evolving operational workflows and resourcing frameworks, not just executing within existing ones.

- Experience working in a project management system (e.g. Jira, Airtable).

- Experience managing, training, or onboarding freelance or contract creative talent.

- Familiarity evaluating or implementing automation, AI tools, or templated workflows within a creative production context.

- Appreciation for creative and production workflows and experience working closely with creative teams.

- Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills, including experience negotiating scope and budget with non-creative stakeholders.

- Experience managing 360 campaigns spanning multiple deliverables (e.g. digital, photo, and video production).

- Exposure to international/localization workflows is a plus.

You’ll get:

- Competitive salary and 401(k) with company match (vesting immediately upon participation)

- Generous PTO policy and 4 weeks of parental leave

- $0 monthly premium and flexible health plans starting on day one

- 85% discount on your HelloFresh subscription and other product offerings

- A collaborative, dynamic work environment within a fast-paced, mission-driven company

This job description is intended to provide a general overview of the responsibilities. However, the Company reserves the right to adjust, modify, or reassign work tasks and responsibilities as needed to meet changing business needs, operational requirements, or other factors.

New York Pay Range

$88,935—$121,000 USD

jobs.title: Quality Control Associate (12 Months Contract)
jobs.description:
Location: (EDM) 36 Ave & 8th St, Nisku

Note: Please note that this is 12 Months contract role.

About the Role

As a Quality Control Associate you will take a hands-on approach to maintaining and continuously improving our product quality control processes. Reporting to the Supervisor, Quality Control , you will play a key role in ensuring our Production Associates have all essential high-quality ingredients required to make delicious and safe meal kits for our customers.

What you will be doing:

- Receive inbounding and inventory SKUs from the Warehouse department and conduct quality control inspections to ensure products adhere to required specifications.

- Work closely with the Warehouse team to achieve quality targets, in addition to performing regular inspections on packaged products for lot codes.

- Respond to Quality and/or BBD issues on the production lines

- Maintain clear and concise communication with the Operations, Procurement, and Logistics teams; in cases of product non-conformance, alongside maintaining a photo database of product non-conformances.

- Lead production associates for ingredient sorting.

- Perform quality control inspections on work-in-progress and finished products to ensure products meet Company Standards.

- Ensure accuracy and efficiency at designated ship-out stations, and complete logs and records as required.

- Work in compliance with OH&S acts and regulations.

- Use personal protective and safety equipment and clothing as directed by the employer and report workplace hazards and dangers to the supervisor or employer.

- Conduct environmental monitoring and equipment calibration verification, (Environmental sampling & ATP swabbing)

- Provide support to FSQA Supervisor.

- Perform Quality Assurance inspections as they pertain to Finished Product, Raw Materials, Water and Cleaning & Sanitation.

- Perform sensory on shelf stable raw materials.

- Monitor PRPs and PC's.

- Ensure all Out of Spec findings, as they pertain to the aforementioned, are addressed through the procedures as they pertain to "Deviation, Corrective Action & Preventative Measures", "Food Safety Assessment" and "Product Holds".

- Conduct internal inspection on a periodic basis, i.e. GMP audits and pre operational inspections.

- Ensure water samples are sent out to Accredited Laboratories on a periodic basis for analytical testing.

- Provide support to the management teams in troubleshooting and resolving problems in the Production Process.

- Ensure GMPs and Management of allergens is followed as per procedures.

- Ensure spillages are cleaned up immediately to eliminate the potential for cross contamination of allergens.

- Other duties as assigned

At a minimum, you have:

- Post-secondary education in Biological, Chemical or Food Sciences diploma

- 6 Months to 1 year experience working in QC/QA in a food processing, manufacturing or service industry

- Willing and able to push, pull, and lift up to 50lbs

- Has experience with standing for prolonged periods of time including regular bending, twisting and walking

- Understanding the Safe Food for Canadians Regulations and GFSI schemes

- Willing and able to work in a refrigerated environment (0°C to 4°C)

- Ability to communicate in English, both verbal and written

- Familiar with MS Office, Google Apps and comfortable learning new technologies.

- Ability to prioritize, remain calm and alert while multitasking in a fast-paced and deadline oriented environment.

- Ability to work independently and within a team environment, in addition to having strong interpersonal skills.

- Level 1 First Aid is considered an asset.

What you’ll get in return:

- Competitive salary and health benefits

- Shift premiums are available for afternoon and overnight shifts

- 75% discount on HelloFresh or Chefs Plate weekly box subscription

- High impact work to help feed thousands of families in Canada

- Opportunity to learn and grow

- Work with a hard-working and supportive team

Working Conditions:

It’s no surprise that as a food company, we use many ingredients that may be considered common allergens (i.e. peanuts, tree nuts, milk, etc.). - Ability to remain calm and effective under pressure

jobs.title: Operational Excellence Junior Manager
jobs.description:
About The Team:

The Operational Excellence Junior Manager sits within the UK OPEX & Transformation team and plays a vital role in driving the commercial sizing, delivery, implementation, and continuous improvement of production technologies, processes, and business propositions across HelloFresh distribution centres in the UK, IE & EU markets. If you're someone who gets restless watching a problem go unsolved, who thrives in ambiguity, and who wants to look back in two years and say "I helped build that", you've found your place!

This is a hands-on, project-led role for someone who turns data into decisions and decisions into results on the floor. You'll build the commercial case for change and then deliver it, from initial scoping and business casing through to on-floor adoption, with a relentless focus on the metrics that matter most: Error Rate, Minutes per Box, and productivity.

What You Will Be Doing:

- End-to-End Project Delivery: Define project scope, milestones, and success measures to lead technical and non-technical projects from initiation through to successful implementation on time and within budget.

- Data Analysis & Actionable Insights: Analyse complex operational data using tools like Excel, Google Sheets, Grafana, Tableau, or SQL, translating these metrics into actionable business decisions and measurable KPI improvements.

- Opportunity Sizing: Identify and validate improvement opportunities through financial modelling and commercial analysis, building the business case for investment and prioritisation.

- Stakeholder Management & Collaboration: Lead and influence diverse, cross-functional teams and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders from shop-floor operatives up to senior management through disciplined meetings and clear, structured communication.

- Digital & Low-Code Innovation: Leverage AI tools, modern digital solutions, and low-code/no-code platforms (e.g., PowerApps, AppSheet) to build practical on-floor tools that bridge the gap between data insights and daily operations. We use AI daily and are constantly looking for better ways to do our jobs.

- Change Management & Floor Presence: Maintain a strong, visible presence on the production floor to drive change initiatives, ensure the sustainable adoption of new processes/technologies, and support trials or tests.

- Continuous Improvement: Identify, support and lead projects utilizing Lean Six Sigma methodologies to identify bottlenecks, eliminate waste, and drive a culture of continuous improvement on the shop floor.

- Risk & Issue Mitigation: Proactively recognize project risks and operational bottlenecks; create robust avoidance plans, take corrective measures early, and provide transparent status reporting to leadership.
jobs.requirements_raw:
Who You Are:

Education & Experience

- Degree: Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Operations, or a related technical field (preferred).

- Experience: 2-3 years of experience in manufacturing, high-volume fulfillment, or logistics sectors (preferred).

- Project Management: Proven experience leading or contributing to operational excellence, continuous improvement, or technology implementation projects (essential).

Technical Skills

- Project Management Qualification: (desirable but not essential).

- Lean Six Sigma: Strong practical knowledge of Lean Methodology, its tools, and standard work principles (formal certification is not mandatory; practical knowledge equivalent to Green/Yellow Belt level is essential)

- Data & Analytics: Proficiency in data analysis tools (Excel, Google Sheets, Grafana, Tableau, or SQL).

- Digital Aptitude: Familiarity with modern digital solutions, AI tools, and low-code/no-code application development (desirable but not essential).

- Systems Knowledge: Previous experience working with Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) or Warehouse Control Systems (WCS) (desirable but not essential).

Core Competencies

- Roll-up-Your-Sleeves Attitude: You have a passion for combining analytical thinking with hands-on, real-time problem solving on a fast-paced production floor.

- Communication & Influence: You have an engaging, collaborative personality with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and effectively communicate complex updates to various audiences.

- Presentation: You have the ability to translate complex operational data into clear, commercial narratives for non-technical stakeholders

- Organisation: You are highly organised and detail-orientated, with a proven ability to manage multiple competing priorities simultaneously.

- Comfortable with ambiguity: You can define the problem before someone hands you the answer.

- Low ego, high ownership: You'll get your hands dirty on the floor as readily as you'll present to senior leadership.

jobs.description:
About The Team:

The Planning team is the most data-driven team at HelloFresh: we plan, schedule and analyse the production of every box, and start the process of feeding the UK. With hundreds of thousands of customers relying on us to get the plan right, this is a role with real ownership and real impact.

What You Will Be Doing:

Reporting into the site leadership, you'll own the production plan for the UK in its entirety, and lead the planning team. This is a role for someone who wants to build and elevate: to take a team through a step change in maturity, drive it to operate at its full potential, and make the plan as efficient and optimised as it can be. In your first year you will:

- Own the UK production plan end to end, working daily with the site director to balance efficiency, plan attainment, minimised downtime and flexibility.

- Own the planning structure for the site, and take full responsibility for scale hiring of our operational workforce, assessing labour requirements continuously.

- Own the ramp and the seasonal calendar, planning ahead rather than reacting to it.

- Lead, coach and elevate the planning team, the CS4 Planning Manager and the planning executives, holding them to the level their roles are set at and developing them towards it.

- Continuously improve the planning strategy, using data and feedback to adapt to changing business needs.

- Work closely with BI, Operations and wider stakeholders to automate processes, refine planning tools, and move work that shouldn't sit with the team away from it.

- Generate and analyse weekly and monthly KPIs across operational planning, identify trends and issues, and drive cost-saving initiatives.

- Own compliance for the team across Food Safety, Health & Safety and applicable standards (e.g. BRCGS, ISO).

The role

We are looking for an experienced People Technology Senior Integrations Specialist to join our HelloFresh People Technology team. This role represents the senior individual contributor level within the Integrations and Engineering discipline and is designed for specialists who can independently deliver complex technical solutions across our People Technology landscape.

Today, the role has a strong focus on Workday integrations and connected enterprise systems. Over time, the scope will increasingly extend across system-agnostic integrations, workflow automation, software and low-code development, and AI-enabled solutions. You will take end-to-end responsibility for designing, building, operating, and supporting reliable, secure, and scalable solutions across global environments, using the most appropriate technology for the problem rather than being limited to a single platform.

The role combines deep hands-on engineering with mature operational ownership. You will work across Workday, APIs, middleware and emerging engineering capabilities, and will contribute to automation, intelligent workflows and AI-enabled solutions where these create practical value. You will act as a senior point of expertise for incidents and changes, applying judgement to diagnose root causes, manage risk and drive permanent fixes. While you will not define the overall engineering architecture or platform strategy, you will contribute actively to technical standards, patterns, quality improvements and the evolution of the discipline.

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What you’ll do

- Build and improve workflow automation, intelligent integrations and AI-enabled solutions that reduce manual effort, improve employee technology experiences or increase the effectiveness of People Technology operations.

- Maintain high-quality technical documentation and apply sound software engineering practices across solution design, testing, version control, deployment and support.

jobs.description:
At HelloFresh, the goal is to change the way people eat forever by delivering high-quality food across 18 countries and 3 continents. As a global food solutions group and the world's leading meal kit provider, the portfolio includes HelloFresh, Green Chef, EveryPlate, Chefs Plate, Factor_, and Youfoodz.

Engaging with HelloFresh in Warsaw means collaborating with HelloTech—a global technology division of over 1,000 people powering an end-to-end food ecosystem. From digital personalization and forecasting to supply chain optimization and food waste reduction, technology drives every step of this direct-to-consumer model.

About the Role: What's in the Box

HelloTech operates in autonomous, cross-functional alliances, each holding accountability for a specific product domain end to end. The service provider will join an assigned squad, with the flexibility to transition between teams and projects as technical objectives and business priorities evolve.

Several technical domains are actively engaging providers. Projects will be aligned based on individual strengths and expertise during the process. Key technical domains include:

- Marketing Customer Profile squad: Builds AI-powered backend systems that automate campaign execution end-to-end, from content generation and validation to multi-channel delivery across email, SMS, and push.

- Conversions Tribe: supporting the "Reachable Audience" and Personalization initiatives. The mission is to build the systems that power customized user journeys at scale.

Across all domains, the technical profile consists of highly available, event-driven distributed systems serving global architectures. This role does not include people management responsibilities.

What You’ll Do: The Recipe

At HelloFresh we are moving away from a model where software developers just execute tickets toward one where product engineers are trusted to own customer problems. A Product Engineer takes a problem, forms a point of view, validates it with customers and data, and ships it using AI as a force multiplier.

- Take the technical lead on backend-heavy product problems, designing, building and operating the services and systems needed to deliver them reliably at scale under a full DevOps model..

- Build event-driven systems utilizing messaging technologies such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, or AWS SQS/SNS, and expose data via clean REST and gRPC interfaces.

- Work extensively with Docker, container orchestration via Kubernetes, and CI/CD automated deployment pipelines.

- Maintain a strong commitment to testing, executing robust test suites stretching from unit tests through to full end-to-end coverage.

- Collaborate closely within cross-functional agile teams including product leads, frontend engineers, designers, and data teams.

- Provide technical guidance and support to surrounding team members, actively participating in code and architecture reviews.

- Leverage modern AI tools and workflows (e.g., Claude, Cursor) as a standardized component of engineering delivery to increase productivity.

- Work beyond your specialization when the problem demands it. Your specialization is your anchor, not your boundary.

- Operate what you build. You instrument, monitor, and improve your systems in production. Shipping is the beginning of the learning cycle, not the end.

What You’ll Bring: The Ingredients

- Strong fluency in Go or Python and hands on experience building distributed systems in production: event-driven and asynchronous flows, clear service contracts, and designing for partial failure. jobs.title: Lead Equity & Incentive Compensation Partner
jobs.description:
The role

HelloFresh is seeking a Lead Equity & Incentives Compensation Partner to drive the strategy and execution of our global equity programs, short- and long-term incentive plans, executive compensation, and rewards governance framework. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who has been deep in the mechanics of compensation in a high-growth technology company and is now ready to own a portfolio that spans program design, governance, and cross-functional influence. You will play a foundational role in defining our global rewards strategy and structuring defensible compensation frameworks.

Reporting to the Global Director, Compensation Strategy, you will serve as the subject matter expert across equity, incentives, and executive pay - working at the intersection of people, finance, legal, and the business. This role is central to building scalable, market-competitive compensation programs that support HelloFresh's continued growth across global markets.

What you’ll do

Equity Program Design & Execution

- Program Ownership: Lead the design, administration, and continuous improvement of HelloFresh's global equity programs - including RSUs, performance shares, and any new equity vehicles - ensuring they are competitive, compliant, and well-understood by employees.

- Platform & Data Integrity: Serve as the operational lead for the equity compensation platform, ensuring accurate data bridges between Workday, Payroll, and external equity administration tools.

- Equity Education: Develop scalable education materials - guides, FAQs, webinars - that help employees across all markets understand their equity awards and the broader compensation philosophy

Incentive Plans & Variable Pay

- STI & LTI Design: Lead the design and annual refresh of short-term and long-term incentive structures, including corporate bonus plans, sales incentive frameworks, and performance-based equity programs.

- Plan Modelling: Build and maintain incentive compensation models to evaluate cost, dilution, payout scenarios, and competitive positioning; translate model outputs into clear recommendations for senior leadership.

- Goal-Setting & Calibration: Partner with Finance and HR Business Partners during the annual goal-setting cycle to ensure incentive metrics are appropriately rigorous, measurable, and aligned to business priorities.

- Pay Mix Analysis: Conduct ongoing analysis of total compensation pay mix across roles, levels, and geographies to identify gaps and recommend design adjustments.

Executive Compensation

- C-Suite Support: Support executive compensation reviews, including benchmarking for C-suite and director-level roles, peer group analysis, and preparation of materials for Compensation Committee review.

- Benchmarking & Market Data: Manage relationships with compensation survey vendors; lead annual and ad-hoc benchmarking exercises to keep HelloFresh's executive pay competitive.

- Offer Construction: Partner with Talent Acquisition and senior HR leadership to structure competitive offers for executive hires, including equity, sign-on, and ongoing compensation considerations.

- Disclosure & Reporting: Support preparation of executive compensation disclosures and Compensation Committee materials, ensuring accuracy and regulatory compliance.

Rewards Governance & Compliance

- Governance Framework: Develop and maintain HelloFresh's global compensation governance framework — including salary band structures, job architecture, and pay approval workflows — ensuring consistency, fairness, and auditability.

- Regulatory Compliance: Ensure all compensation programs comply with applicable securities law, tax regulations, and reporting requirements across jurisdictions (DE, US, UK, and others); lead preparation for the EU Pay Transparency Directive.

- Pay Equity: Design and execute regular pay equity analyses across gender, ethnicity, and tenure; surface findings and drive remediation plans in partnership with HR leadership and Legal.

- SOX & Audit Support: Maintain rigorous controls and documentation for equity and incentive programs to support internal and external audit requirements.

- Process Improvement: Identify and implement opportunities to automate and streamline compensation operations, including tooling, workflows, and AI-assisted analytics.

Strategic Partnership & Program Building

- Cross-Functional Influence: Act as the compensation expert for HR Business Partners, Finance, and Legal — providing timely, data-driven guidance on compensation decisions across the employee lifecycle.

- M&A and Expansion: Support compensation due diligence and integration work for acquisitions and new market entries, ensuring programs can scale with the business.

- Stakeholder Communication: Translate complex compensation concepts into clear narratives for senior leaders, the Compensation Committee, and employees at all levels.

- Team Mentorship: Provide guidance and mentorship to more members of the compensation team, including the Senior Equity Compensation Analyst.
jobs.requirements_raw:
What you’ll bring

- Experience: 8+ years of progressive compensation experience, with at least 4 years focused on equity, incentives, or executive compensation in a high-growth global technology or e-commerce company.

- Program Builder: Demonstrated track record of designing and scaling compensation programs from the ground up — not just administering inherited ones.

- Technical Depth: Strong command of equity mechanics (RSUs, options, performance shares), incentive plan design, and executive pay practices. Familiarity with SOX, EU Pay Transparency, and multi-jurisdictional compliance requirements.

- Analytical Rigour: Expert-level proficiency in financial modelling and data analysis (Excel/Google Sheets required; SQL, Python, or BI tools a plus). Comfortable building models that inform multi-million dollar decisions.

- Governance Mindset: Experience developing or maintaining global compensation governance frameworks, job architectures, and pay equity programs.

- Stakeholder Influence: Proven ability to work effectively with Finance, Legal, Talent, and senior executives; capable of presenting complex analyses in simple, compelling terms.

- Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Finance, HR, Economics, or a related field. Certifications such as Certified Compensation Professional (CCP) or Certified Equity Professional (CEP) are highly preferred.

- Adaptability: Comfortable operating in ambiguity and navigating rapid change; thrives in a fast-paced, high-ownership environment.

From our 24/7 gym access,wellbeing platforms like Headspace and Spill, to sabbatical leave options, HelloFresh is not just a workplace; it's a lifestyle of perks and possibilities!

Chez HelloFresh, nous bousculons les habitudes alimentaires des français grâce à nos Box à cuisiner !

Notre ambition ? Révolutionner le quotidien de nos abonnés, en promouvant une façon plus durable de cuisiner et en leur faisant découvrir de délicieuses recettes, créatives et équilibrées. L’alliance parfaite entre technologie et gastronomie, pour un maximum de gourmandise.s

HelloFresh est présent dans plus de 15 pays. La France, un jeune marché lancé en 2019, connaît une ascension fulgurante : nous y sommes déjà leaders depuis 2021. Le moment parfait pour rejoindre notre équipe et avoir un impact fort dans l'une des scale-ups françaises les plus prometteuses !

Comment rendre tout cela possible ? Grâce à une équipe talentueuse et dynamique, des valeurs fortes de bienveillance et de diversité, et un environnement de travail stimulant.

Si tu souhaites prendre part à cette incroyable aventure humaine, internationale et entrepreneuriale, rejoins-nous !

L'opportunité:

HelloFresh France place le produit au cœur de sa croissance, et ce rôle en est le moteur. En tant que Directeur(rice) Produit, vous piloterez une équipe pluridisciplinaire couvrant le culinaire, le développement recettes, l'innovation produit et l'analytique, avec la responsabilité pleine et entière de ce qui se retrouve au menu chaque semaine : les ingrédients que nous sélectionnons, les concepts que nous créons, et les arbitrages commerciaux qui les sous-tendent. Cela implique la gestion directe du budget coût des marchandises et la responsabilité de son impact sur le compte de résultat. C'est un rôle concret et exigeant, à la croisée de l'alimentaire, de la stratégie et des opérations, là où la qualité du produit est ce qui fidélise nos clients.

Vos missions:

- Construire et développer une équipe produit performante

- Fédérer, inspirer et manager une équipe pluridisciplinaire — en posant une vision claire, en instaurant des rythmes de travail qui permettent d'avancer vite, et en investissant dans les personnes qui porteront le prochain chapitre de HelloFresh France.

- Définir et challenger la vision produit

- Construire une vision claire et ambitieuse de ce que doit devenir notre produit physique — ancrée dans la connaissance client, rigoureuse sur le plan commercial, et suffisamment différenciante pour gagner. Développer un point de vue propre et indépendant, nourri des insights de l'équipe Produit globale, mais enraciné dans la réalité du marché français.

- Garantir l'accès aux informations, analyses et données nécessaires pour prendre des décisions éclairées en matière de développement produit, et traduire la vision en actions concrètes.

- Pousser l'équipe et l'entreprise à aller au-delà de la feuille de route actuelle — en remettant en question les hypothèses, en interrogeant les arbitrages, et en s'assurant que nous travaillons toujours sur ce qui a le plus d'impact.

- Piloter la rétention client et la performance commerciale

- Faire de la rétention client votre boussole. Construire une vision rigoureuse et fondée sur les données de ce qui la détermine, et mobiliser l'équipe autour des actions qui font vraiment la différence.

- Prendre des décisions produit en ayant pleinement conscience de leurs implications financières. Prendre des risques calculés, mesurer les résultats honnêtement, et ajuster rapidement quand un pari ne fonctionne pas.

- Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Opérations (Achats, Qualité, Production, etc.) pour assurer une approche coordonnée des initiatives produit, à l'échelle locale comme globale.

- Aligner produit et stratégie marketing

- Travailler main dans la main avec l'équipe brand & marketing pour que la feuille de route produit et la stratégie marketing soient pleinement synchronisées — ce que nous construisons, comment nous en parlons et comment nous le vendons doivent former une proposition cohérente.

- Être la voix du produit au sein du comité de direction, en portant une vision convaincante de là où le produit doit aller et pourquoi.

- Passionné(e) de food, avec la capacité à transformer les tendances et les signaux marché en offres produit attractives.

- Tu parles couramment français et maîtrises l’anglais à l’oral comme à l’écrit

jobs.title: Director, Product (physical) (f/m/x)
jobs.description:
Reporting Relationships

- Primary Manager: COO and Co-MD

- Dotted Line: CMO and Co-MD

- Direct Reports: ~10 people spanning Culinary, Product Innovation, Product Strategy, Product Operations, and Product Analytics

The Opportunity

Factor is a healthy, ready-to-heat meal delivery service that has built a category-defining business in the US and Canada. Now we're building Factor in Europe — and although we have strong blueprints from North America, we have the opportunity to leverage the very rich multi-cultural environment in Europe to tailor both our physical and digital products to five different markets.

As our Director, Product, you will own the full product vision and execution for Factor Europe. You will lead a multi-layered team of ~10 people, sit on the Factor Europe leadership team, and maintain a close dotted-line relationship with our CMO to ensure product and marketing move as one.

This is a rare kind of role: senior strategic ownership and real infrastructure, with the pace and ambition of an early-stage scale up. If you are a visionary builder who leads with curiosity, earns conviction through data, and holds your team to the same high standard you hold yourself — we'd love to hear from you.

What You'll Do

- Lead and Develop a High-Performance Product Team

- Build, inspire, and manage a multi-disciplinary team — setting a clear vision, establishing the operating rhythms that allow the team to move fast, and investing in the people who will drive Factor Europe's next chapter.

- Own and Challenge the Product Vision

- Define a clear and compelling vision for what Factor's physical product must become in Europe — grounded in customer insight, commercially rigorous, and differentiated enough to win. Develop a deep, independent point of view on where the North American model translates and where European markets demand something different.

- Push the team and the business to think beyond the current roadmap — challenging assumptions, interrogating trade-offs, and ensuring we are always working on the highest-leverage version of the product.

- Act as the liaison to our global Digital Product team — representing Factor Europe's priorities in the feature roadmap and collaborating on shared global initiatives that benefit the wider business.

- Drive Customer Retention and Commercial Performance

- Own customer retention levers as your north star. Build a rigorous, evidence-based view of what drives it and rally the team around interventions that move the needle.

- Make product decisions with full awareness of their P&L implications. Take calculated risks, track outcomes honestly, and move quickly to learn and adjust when bets don't pay off.

- Build for Multiple European Markets

- Lead our effort to find product-market fit across five distinct markets — understanding how consumer preferences vary by culture, and building a proposition that resonates locally while scaling efficiently.

- Share learnings across geographies and partner with peers across the HelloFresh Group to continuously raise the bar.

- Support new channel strategies, understanding and adapting products for different customer bases.

- Align Product and Marketing Strategy

- Work closely with the brand & marketing team to ensure product roadmap and marketing strategies are fully synchronised — so what we build, how we talk about it, and how we sell it form one coherent proposition.

- Act as the product voice on the leadership team, articulating a compelling vision for where the product needs to go and why.
jobs.requirements_raw:
Who You Are

- A visionary leader who executes. You set a compelling direction, bring your team with you, and roll up your sleeves to make it happen.

- Customer-obsessed and analytically rigorous. Sharp instincts backed by disciplined discovery. Comfortable querying your own data and stress-testing assumptions.

- Commercially minded. You understand how product decisions flow through to the P&L — and hold yourself accountable to outcomes, not just outputs.

- A cross-functional influencer. You build trust quickly, drive execution through others, and get the right priorities onto other teams' roadmaps.

- Internationally curious. You find the complexity of building for multiple European cultures energising, and you seek out the nuances that matter.

- An exceptional communicator. You write and present with clarity and conviction — from strategy narratives to leadership updates to product briefs.

- Food and/or nutrition obsessed!

Requirements

- Experience: 8–10+ years in Product, Strategy, or a closely related commercial leadership role; 3+ years managing multi-disciplinary teams.

- Technical toolkit: Advanced Excel/Google Sheets; AI proficiency and curiosity required.

- Strong preference for:

○ Experience in D2C subscription businesses — retention, lifecycle, and recurring revenue models.

○ Multi-market European experience and an understanding of how consumer preferences vary across the continent.

○ Experience in physical products or FMCG, especially food & beverage.

○ A track record of scaling a product in a new market and finding product-market fit.

Compensation & Financial Wellbeing

- Enjoy 20% off HelloFresh and 40% off Factor_ subscriptions.

- Access the "Benefits at Work" platform for discounts on brands like Nike, Bol.com, and IKEA.

- You'll receive a HelloFresh laptop, a €250 home office setup budget, and contribute to the Bedrijfspensioenfonds Levensmiddelen pension scheme (2025 rate 27.6%; employer pays 19.64%, employee pays 7.96%).

Health & Wellbeing

- Get a 10% discount on additional health insurance at Zilveren Kruis in 2025.

Flexibility & Work-Life

- Work flexibly with our hybrid setup (50% office, 50% remote), plus a €2.40 daily remote work allowance.

- Receive 24 days of annual leave (pro-rated), plus one additional day per year of service (up to 30 days total).

- Full reimbursement for 2nd-class public transport to the office, plus €0.23 per km for car and bicycle travel.

Career & Development

- Grow with our "Learning Never Stops" mindset: participate in Pantry Staple trainings, access internal/external opportunities, and join our cross-market mentoring program.

Culture & Environment

jobs.title: Health & Safety Specialist - all genders
jobs.description:
The Role (What’s in the Box)

The Health & Safety Specialist is an expert-level contributor who owns the H&S function operationally. This role goes beyond administration and compliance to drive meaningful cultural and systemic change across the Cloudberry site. The ideal candidate brings deep technical expertise, strong regulatory knowledge, and the experience to independently lead complex initiatives — acting as a trusted authority for site management, operational leaders, and the HQ H&S team alike.

What You’ll Do (The Recipe)

-

Lead and independently conduct thorough incident investigations with robust root cause analysis; own corrective action follow-through with site stakeholders

-

Design, implement and continuously improve the site H&S management system in alignment with ISO 45001 and HelloFresh global standards

-

Develop and own site-level H&S policies, risk assessment frameworks and safe work procedures

-

Proactively identify systemic risks and drive preventive initiatives before incidents occur — not solely in response to them

-

Lead and facilitate workplace risk assessments in partnership with the Joint Health & Safety Committee (JHSC)

-

Build and develop safety capability across operational leaders — coaching supervisors to own safety conversations and daily huddles rather than simply delivering prescribed content

-

Track, analyse and report on H&S KPIs (LTI, Near Miss, audit results); translate data into actionable insights for senior management

-

Lead internal and external audit preparation (including BSI/ISO); conduct spot checks and compliance reviews

-

Administer, train and continuously improve the site H&S reporting system

-

Support and challenge HQ H&S strategy based on operational insights from the site

-

Ensure compliance with Swedish AML, SAM regulations, and all applicable OH&S legislation

What You’ll Bring (Your Ingredients)

Competency Profile

-

Technical Expertise: Deep, current knowledge of Swedish OH&S legislation and ideally ISO 45001. Able to interpret and apply regulatory requirements independently and advise management with authority.

-

Investigation & Analysis: Proven ability to lead complex incident investigations and identify systemic root causes — not surface-level fixes.

-

Risk Management: Experienced in designing and leading risk assessment processes, not just completing templates.

-

Coaching & Influence: Capable of building safety capability in others without relying on formal authority — a trusted expert who makes leaders better.

-

Data Literacy: Comfortable with KPI analysis, trend identification and presenting data-driven recommendations to senior stakeholders.

-

Communication: Fluent in Swedish and English. Able to communicate clearly and credibly at all levels — from production floor to senior management.

-

Proactivity & Drive: Operates with a prevention mindset and takes initiative without needing direction. Brings ideas and owns them through to implementation.

-

Digital Proficiency: Confident working with H&S reporting systems, data tools, and standard office applications.

Experience & Qualifications

-

At least 5 years of relevant experience in an H&S specialist or senior H&S role

-

Experience from production, food manufacturing, logistics or similarly regulated operational environment strongly preferred

-

Demonstrated experience building or significantly improving H&S management systems — not just maintaining them

-

NEBOSH Certificate or Diploma, ISO 45001 Lead Auditor, or equivalent certification preferred

-

Experience with regulatory authority contact (Arbetsmiljöverket or equivalent) and external audit processes (BSI, ISO)

-

Degree in Occupational Health & Safety, Engineering or related discipline, or equivalent practical experience

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. There are many different ways of developing skills, and we love diverse experiences!

What We Offer (The Toppings)

- HelloFresh Discounts – Enjoy 65% off your HelloFresh Meal Box and 40% off Factor subscriptions.

- Learning & Development – Access learning and development opportunities, including the HelloMint mentorship program.

- Time Off – Enjoy 30 days of paid vacation per year.

- Parental Leave & Pension – Benefits are provided in accordance with the applicable Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA).

- Fitness & Well-being – Benefit from discounts at Nordic Wellness gyms.

- Health & Well-being – Access Spill online therapy, with support available within 24 hours of your request.

Are you the missing ingredient?

If this sounds like a tasty opportunity, we’d be excited to hear from you. We aim to review your profile and respond within 5 business days.

jobs.title: Associate Director Marketing Lifecycle, CC outbound
jobs.description:
The role

The Associate Director for Lifecycle, CC Outbound, owns the outbound call center channel strategy and performance for millions of former customers across all 17 of our international markets and all our brands. We are looking for a CRM expert, who is interested in running strategy for Call Center, with a high level of autonomy and agility. You will own the strategic development, performance and strategic innovations for this channel, working closely with the Call Center Operations team. Your scope includes steering performance and managing budgets, implementing strategies that will unlock a better customer experience, under consideration of country-specific idiosyncrasies. It also means developing this channel into one of our prime sources of insight to customer sentiment and inspiration for product improvements at scale (e.g., through the use of AI tools). Moreover, you will own the performance of this channel, which includes setting targets together with our local market CMOs and day-to-day steering of conversions, cost and ROI together with our VP of customer care and his operations managers.

If you want to own a critical channel for one of our most valuable customer groups and develop a strong muscle in driving CRM strategy and execution, we want to hear from you!

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What you’ll do

- CRM Strategy Development:

- Develop and implement annual strategic plans for Call Centre Outbound initiatives

- Manage the CC Outbound for the full customer lifecycle, from leads to reactivation

- Collaborate with CC Operations, cross-functional teams, local markets and international marketing leadership to align strategies with overall business goals.

- Personalization of Customer Interaction

- Work with L&D, Brand and local teams to enrich the training for agents, adding the local context, address the customer needs and have the best pitch for the customer

- Test personalized offers for customers

- Utilize AI tools to improve customer interactions and call content

- Call Centre Outbound Campaign Management:

- Design and execute outbound communication campaigns. Provide guidance on campaign targeting, messaging, incentives and timing to maximize conversion rates.

- Own and steer campaign performance, maximizing ROI and effectiveness.

- Ensure all outbound communication activities comply with relevant regulations and internal expectations (e.g., via quality assurance measures)

- Data Analysis and Tech Tooling:

- Leverage data analysis to identify, test and evaluate impactful reactivation strategies and improvement opportunities

- Evaluate and implement CRM tools to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of outbound initiatives, coordinating with Call Center Operations and CommsTech.

- Experience in and a passion for delivering excellent and effective customer experiences (e.g., working in CRM/Lifecycle Marketing, campaign management, Product, etc.)

- Strong ownership mentality and drive to deliver results, including experience with prioritizing for highest impact and managing trade-off decisions in a fast-paced environment.

jobs.title: Director of Accounting, Inventory & COGS
jobs.description:
The Director of Inventory & Logistics Accounting is a member of the Finance leadership team and reports to the VP Accounting/US Controller. In this position you will partner closely with the stakeholders in Operations, Logistics, Procurement and Business Technology as well as your peers across the US & International Finance teams. As a leader you will develop and grow talent and engagement in a team of Accounting professionals with a clear focus on closing the books, accuracy, timeliness and effective controls for the US HelloFresh Brands for one of the most complex and dynamic areas of the business. In order to succeed in this role, you will need to demonstrate the ability to transform the existing business as usual processes, drive initiatives and deliver results in a fast-paced and highly collaborative environment. In addition, this role requires excellent communication and organization skills, including the ability to anticipate, identify and communicate risks to senior leadership.

You will …

- Be responsible for overseeing financial processes, daily accounting activities, project management, accounting process design and documentation, and review and sign off of control activities.

- Ensure strong and reliable accounting procedures and controls are in place for your area and will result in accurate, complete and timely results.

- Manage and develop a team of Accounting professionals.

- Support external and internal audits for your area.

- Partner closely with Senior Leadership in Finance, Logistics, Procurement and Operations to increase visibility, transparency and understanding of actual results and variances between actuals and management reporting.

- Partner with business leadership to understand new developments in the supply chain and distribution center network and plan effectively for their impact on accounting results.

- Transform existing processes to deliver both results and insights more efficiently and effectively for a growing business with multiple brands.

- Collaborate with operations leadership to ensure tight inventory controls and accurate recognition of direct cost of goods sold.

- Drive process improvements and automation efforts to increase controllership and reduce manual workload

You are…

- A humble and engaging leader who earns the trust of others through delivering results, you consistently raise the bar on those around you

- An excellent communicator and that intuitively collaborates with teams of different backgrounds

- Able to work comfortably under pressure and meet tight deadlines; ability to do more with less and faster

- Goal oriented, execution focused and motivated by your achievements

- Relentless on the integrity of financial information and underlying data

- Excited about continuous learning and improving processes in a high-growth environment susceptible to change

You have…

- 10+ years of experience in Accounting positions of increasing scope and complexity; experience with inventory accounting and supply chain processes; experience with high growth e-commerce businesses

- 4+ years experience as a manager and manager of managers

- Experience in leading teams, influencing and galvanizing others to follow you towards a solution

- A Bachelor's degree in Accounting and a CPA or equivalent

- Experience in a Big 4 Accounting firm in Audit

- Proven ability to transform accounting process

- Proven ability to manage and drive engagement in a team

- Strong affinity for controllership, data and technology

- Excellent communication, analytical and presentation skills; you have the ability to condense complex issues into key take-aways and action items

You’ll get…

- Competitive salary, 401k with company match that vests immediately upon participation

- Generous PTO, including sabbatical, and parental leave of up to 16 weeks

- Comprehensive health and wellness benefits with options at $0 monthly, effective first day of employment

- Tuition reimbursement for continuing education (upon 2 years of service)

- Access to Employee Resource Groups that are open to all employees, including those pertaining to BIPOC, women, veterans, parents, and LGBTQ+

- Inclusive, collaborative, and dynamic work environment within a fast-paced, mission-driven company that is disrupting the traditional food supply chain

jobs.title: (Senior) Director UX, Operations
jobs.description:
About the role

HelloFresh is reorganising UX to work AI-native — practitioners either go deep as platform and skills experts, or broad as generalists who move fluidly across product, design and engineering to drive experience quality and innovation. This role leads UX for our Operations organisation: the part of the business that bridges technology with physical fulfilment, procurement, quality assurance and supply chain, across every market and brand we operate in.

You'll take over from a Director who spent two years shifting this function from reactive delivery to a high-leverage, AI-native strategic partner — including building an internal design platform, integrated with AI tooling, that other parts of the business have since adopted. You inherit that trajectory, not a finished product: some of our highest-stakes bets for 2026, including how we plan menus algorithmically at scale and how we run the internal tools that power supply-chain decision-making, are still being actively designed, not maintained.

This is a Berlin-based, in-person leadership role. Operations is one of several major, Berlin-anchored parts of our technology organization, and regular physical presence — with peers, with your team, and in the room for cross-functional decisions — is a deliberate requirement of how we want this function led going forward.

What you'll own

- UX strategy and quality across four core areas of Operations: menu planning and food systems (algorithmic menu planning, ranking, demand forecasting, assortment), fulfillment (production, order management, inventory, logistics, manufacturing, supplier reliability), an internal operations-research platform that runs dozens of optimization models across the supply chain, and the technology backbone that keeps our warehouses and production sites running.

- Continued build-out of an AI-native design practice: extending our design system directly into AI-assisted workflows, and using that as proof that UX can lead — not just support — the company's AI-first agenda.

- Service design for the internal-facing tools that operators, planners and analysts depend on every day — often the least glamorous and highest-impact surface area in the company.

- Talent leadership for a distributed team spanning multiple geographies: hiring, career development, and consistent design-quality standards.

- A seat at the Operations leadership table, partnering directly with the senior Product and Engineering leaders for the organization, and representing UX's interests in company-wide strategy.
jobs.requirements_raw:
What we're looking for

- 10+ years in UX/product design, including several years leading design for complex, operational, or B2B/enterprise-grade systems — supply chain, logistics, marketplace operations, or similar domains are a strong plus.

- A track record of shifting a design function from reactive delivery to strategic, AI-native practice — not just familiarity with AI tools, but experience redesigning how a team works because of them.

- Experience building or scaling design systems/platforms that other teams adopt, and comfort operating at the intersection of design, product and engineering.

- Strong stakeholder management — this role sits at the table with senior product, engineering and exec leadership and needs to hold its own there.

- Comfort with ambiguity and unglamorous domains: this is service design for internal operators and planners, not consumer-facing polish, and the highest-value problems here are rarely the most visible ones.

Location & ways of working

Based in our Berlin office, with an expectation of regular in-person presence — this is one of the small number of senior UX roles at HelloFresh where onsite leadership is a deliberate requirement rather than a preference.

Reporting line

Reports to HelloFresh's VP of UX, who also leads UX for two other major parts of the business and reports into senior Product leadership. UX holds a more central, cross-functional reporting line than is typical for Product or Engineering here, reflecting the company's investment in design and experience quality as a differentiator — with visible sponsorship at the executive level.

The role

As an Associate Director, Procurement, you will report to the Procurement Director and own the strategy, performance, and people development for your category cluster. This is a 12-month fixed-term position. You will lead a team of Category Managers, set the direction for supplier relationships and commercial outcomes, and operate as the senior point of escalation across operational and strategic procurement challenges.

This is a role for a procurement professional who is equally comfortable in a negotiation room with a strategic supplier, a governance forum with senior cross-functional leaders, and a development conversation with a direct report. You will act as a connector between your team's day-to-day work and the broader supply chain strategy and as a builder of capability, process, and relationships that outlast the current planning cycle.

What you’ll do

Strategy & Category Leadership

- Define and own the multi-year category strategy for your cluster sourcing model, supplier segmentation, risk posture, and cost ambition and present that strategy coherently to Director-level stakeholders.

- Translate market intelligence (commodity dynamics, seasonality, geopolitical risk, supply constraints) into actionable procurement decisions and communicate them with clarity and confidence.

- Lead cross-category standardization and process improvement initiatives, identifying leverage across the broader portfolio where applicable.

Supplier Relationships & Partnerships

- Build and steward the most strategically important supplier relationships in your cluster, including joint investment plans, multi-year contracts, and structured partnership governance.

- Lead or oversee tender processes end-to-end — from strategy and data-pack through to award, contract, and supplier briefing at pace and to a high standard of documentation.

- Act as the senior escalation point for supply disruptions, quality issues, and commercial disputes, resolving with a mix of supplier accountability and operational pragmatism.

- Develop new or alternative suppliers to strengthen resilience and competitiveness across your category network.

Performance, Data & Commercial Delivery

- Take full commercial accountability for your cluster's cost performance, savings targets, and COGS variance — ensuring outcomes are tracked, explained, and acted upon.

- Drive a data-first culture within your team: category reviews, investment cases, and supplier performance assessments should be grounded in robust analysis and structured decision-making.

- Contribute to seasonality planning, static pricing rounds, and volume S&OP processes with the rigour and cross-functional coordination those forums require.

- Oversee cost reporting, invoice validation and supplier database quality for your cluster.

- Lead, coach and develop a team of Category Managers, creating a high-performance environment that is psychologically safe, commercially ambitious, and genuinely invested in its people.

- Shift progressively from doing to enabling: your job is to build the capability of your team, not to be their best individual contributor.

- Own team capacity planning, workload prioritization, and performance development including calibration, promotion cases, and succession thinking.

- Foster a culture of continuous improvement, clear communication, and accountability without micromanagement.

- Represent GRO Strategic Procurement at Director-level planning and governance meetings as appropriate, contributing with the strategic perspective expected at that level.
