jobs.title: Mobile Staff Product Engineer, Platform/Infrastructure (all genders)
jobs.description:
Work with HelloFresh in Warsaw and its HelloTech organisation, HelloFresh’s global technology backbone with more than 1000 people, building the digital products that power our end-to-end food experience. From meal kits and ready-to-eat meals to specialty offerings like pet food and premium meat & seafood, HelloTech creates the platforms that bring tailored food solutions to millions of customers every month. Our subscription-based, direct-to-consumer model relies on technology at every step, from customer-facing apps and personalization logic to pricing, forecasting, supply chain optimization, and initiatives that help reduce food waste. While our brands operate independently to serve distinct customer needs, they are united by shared platforms, data, and operational excellence built by HelloTech.

About the role: What's in the Box

As a Staff Mobile Product Engineer in the Consumer Foundations tribe, you will provide technical leadership for the evolution of our mobile platform. Working alongside engineering and product teams, you will help shape the core architecture, tooling, and developer experience of our mobile applications. This is a high-visibility, high-impact opportunity to contribute to the transition of our white-labeled, multi-brand application from a native brownfield React Native setup to a highly scalable Greenfield architecture.

You will combine hands-on engineering with technical leadership, helping teams adopt scalable architectural patterns, shared tooling, and engineering best practices across the mobile ecosystem. By designing automated guardrails, shared infrastructure, and scalable developer workflows, you will enable a growing team of 50+ mobile engineers to deliver high-quality software safely, independently, and efficiently.

Our stack: Core: React Native, iOS (Swift), Android (Kotlin) Architecture: Monorepos, White-labeling, shared npm packages CI/CD & Automation: Bitrise, Expo (Future) Observability & Testing: Honeycomb, Maestro E2E

What you’ll do: The Recipe

At HelloFresh we are moving away from a model where software developers just execute tickets toward one where product engineers are trusted to own customer problems. A Product Engineer takes a problem, forms a point of view, validates it with customers and data, and ships it using AI as a force multiplier.

- Shape Architectural Direction: Shape the architectural direction and contribute to the execution of our brownfield-to-greenfield React Native migration within a white-labeled, multi-brand application ecosystem.

- Scale Infrastructure for Growth: Design and evolve the long-term scalability and developer experience of the React Native monorepo, enabling seamless concurrent development for 50+ mobile engineers across multiple squads.

- Future-Proof Shared Code: Maintain and scale the monorepo to host shared npm packages designed for future cross-platform code sharing with web repositories.

- Champion CI/CD & Developer Experience: Maintain and optimize our current CI/CD pipelines in Bitrise while helping shape our future migration to Expo.

- Elevate Quality & Observability: Enable product teams to make data-informed decisions by building robust tracing and dashboards in Honeycomb. Help establish and scale end-to-end testing frameworks across the organization using Maestro.

- Drive Technical Alignment: Partner with Engineering Managers and Product stakeholders to review technical solutions, provide architectural guidance, and promote engineering best practices across squads.

- Strengthen Application Health & Reliability: Lead technical efforts to improve application health and reliability by designing observability tooling, performance reporting, incident response practices, and operational guardrails that improve system stability.

- Pragmatic Technical Governance: Facilitate architectural decision-making, choosing the appropriate level of documentation—from lightweight design proposals to formal RFCs and ADRs—based on the scope and impact of each initiative.

- Contribute to the app experience, owning the metrics that reflect quality for mobile customers (retention, crash-free sessions, conversion).

- Work beyond your specialization when the problem demands it. Your specialization is your anchor, not your boundary.

- Operate what you build. You instrument, monitor, and improve your systems in production. Shipping is the beginning of the learning cycle, not the end.

What you’ll bring: The Ingredients

- Hands-on experience working with AI tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) beyond casual experimentation. You use AI agents every day. You have a practical sense of how the context you provide to AI tools shapes output quality, and how to set boundaries on AI-generated work.

- React Native & Native Mobile Expertise: Deep, production-tested expertise in React Native, combined with strong knowledge of both iOS and Android. You understand React Native's internal mechanics, performance profiling, native code bridging, platform-specific features and constraints, as well as the respective app store release processes. You are comfortable working across the full mobile stack to build and scale enterprise-grade applications.

- Agentic Engineering: Hands-on experience using AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) in production or near-production work. You think beyond prompts to context engineering—structuring specifications, tool configurations, and information flow so agents produce reliable output. You can decompose complex workflows across agentic components, identify unreliable outputs, and introduce the appropriate guardrails where needed.

- Scale-Minded Developer Experience: Proven track record of managing and optimizing workflows, linting, caching, and build times for large engineering organizations (50+ developers).

- Systems & Monorepo Thinker: Experience managing complex build configurations, white-label scaling, and monorepo architectures.

- High Autonomy & Accountability: You are comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy, making sound technical decisions in ambiguous situations, and supporting teams during complex production incidents.

- Deep mobile engineering expertise, with experience across the app release cycle, test automation, on-device performance and platform UX conventions.

- Exceptional Cross-Squad Influence: You have a proven ability to influence technical direction across multiple engineering teams through expertise, communication, and collaboration.

- You take full ownership. You have a bias to ship. You finish the last twenty percent.

- You have product sense and are opinionated about what should be built and why, and you can back that opinion with data and user evidence.

Above all, we are looking for individuals who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What we offer: The Toppings

- Global collaboration at scale: Collaborate with experienced engineers and product partners across HelloTech’s international teams, in a culture of active knowledge sharing.

- Technology with real-world impact: Build and operate modern systems at global scale, supporting 6+ millions of customers and complex supply chain operations.

- Technical/Product/Design leadership: Drive best practices and influence architecture/design, quality, and ways of working in an autonomous, product-led setup.

- End-to-end development/delivery: Drive decisions from problem definition to production, improving systems and enabling long-term scalability.

- Access to workspace at Warsaw Centre Point. The hub offers modern facilities including showers, breakout zones, outdoor space, cycle parking, and refreshments (coffee, soft drinks, and fruit).

Are you the missing ingredient? If this sounds like a tasty opportunity, we’d be excited to hear from you. We aim to review your profile and respond within 5 business days.

jobs.title: Delivery Station Supervisor
jobs.description:
The Delivery Station Supervisor will provide on-shift leadership and will oversee the logistics package sort operation. You will manage all Hub activities and volume, including the unloading, sorting, and allocation of freight for drivers. Safe operations of the Hub are of the utmost importance and you will be responsible for leading up to 20 Associates at any one time and providing coverage for the Logistics Hub Manager when they are not onsite. The Delivery Station Supervisor will lead and cultivate a functional working relationship with all levels of personnel throughout the organization.

Must be able to work overnight shift Sunday-Thursday (on-call Friday's)

You will...

- Manage a team of Warehouse Associates, along with directing contingent workforce to meet quality and safety standards, achieve performance metrics, and accomplish incoming volume bound for the correct destination

- Use HelloFresh tech and systems to make operational decisions and ensure a culture of safety for operations inside facilities and over the road

- Report to the Logistics Hub Manager to support operational scaling and communicate delays or any issues while quickly analyzing and prioritizing work to prevent failures

- Conduct team huddles, to maintain engagement and an open line of communication with employees

- Perform some dispatching functions for drivers and provide coverage for the Logistics Hub Manager on nightshift, weekends, and holidays

- Monitor and evaluate the safety, cost, quality, and other agreed indicators

- Ensure the security of all HelloFresh assets (hub facilities, vehicles, inventory)

- Build an inclusive workplace culture and relationships with all staff, delivering on retention goals

- Operate a lean facility by making recommendations to improve and implement new processes

- On rare occasions, transport delayed package deliveries to customers, move vans in and out of the building, and transport vehicles to and from the repair shop.

- Employees are expected to perform related responsibilities assigned by management, which may be added or revised based on business and operational needs, with or without advance notice

- Hard-working, driven, and the ability to work and make decisions independently

- Ability to collaborate cross-functionally with other supervisors to coordinate activities

You are...

- Inclusive in your approach to engage staff and bring out the best performance in a team

- A conveyer of clear vision, setting direction and goals, and driving team understanding during daily/weekly stand-ups and leadership reviews

- Sound in data-driven decisions that express originality and an enterprising mindset

- Collaborative - enjoys working with different teams to gather inputs

- A connector of complex problems at all levels through excellent written and verbal skills

You have...

- High school diploma or equivalent

- Preferably 2+ years' experience managing operations for fulfillment, supply chain, logistics, or transportation companies

- Must be at least 22 years old and legally authorized to work in the US and possess and maintain a valid driver's license

- Must be able to pass all pre-employment screens (including drug, MVR, background, and criminal checks)

- Availability to support night shift hours starting between 11:30 pm-2 am - until the job is complete (4-day work week shift) or day shift hours (4-day shift week or 5-day shift week based on local need) and may include a weekend-day designated between Sunday-Saturday and general availability with shifts.

- Proficiency in manipulating data and reporting.

- Meet schedules/timelines and organize your own work. Can reliably work alternative and flexible work schedules including nights, Sundays, and Holidays

- Leadership experience motivating and encouraging others

- This position's essential functions demand the performance of the following physical requirements with or without reasonable accommodation:

- Can lift/move up to 50 lbs and participate in physical job activities such as standing, walking, and crouching daily. Can work in an environment that may be hot, cold, and noisy.

You’ll get…

- Competitive hourly rate, 401K company match that vests immediately upon participation, & team bonus opportunities

- Generous PTO and flexible attendance policy

- Comprehensive health and wellness benefits with options at $0 monthly, effective first day of employment

- Up to 85% discount on subscriptions to HelloFresh meal plans (HelloFresh, Green Chef, Everyplate, and Factor_)

- Access to Employee Resource Groups that are open to all employees, including those pertaining to BIPOC, women, veterans, parents, and LGBTQ+

- Inclusive, collaborative, and dynamic work environment within a fast-paced, mission-driven company that is disrupting the traditional food supply chain

This job description is intended to provide a general overview of the responsibilities. However, the Company reserves the right to adjust, modify, or reassign work tasks and responsibilities as needed to meet changing business needs, operational requirements, or other factors.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Machine Learning Engineer, Menu Personalisation
jobs.description:
About HelloFresh

At HelloFresh, we want to change the way people eat forever by offering our customers high-quality food and recipes for different meal occasions. Even after celebrating our 10-year anniversary, we continue to see this mission spread around the world and beyond our wildest dreams. Now, we are a global food solutions group and the world's leading meal kit company, active in 18 countries across 3 continents. So, how did we do it? Our weekly boxes full of exciting recipes and fresh ingredients have blossomed into a community of customers looking for delicious, healthy and sustainable options. The HelloFresh Group now includes our core brand, HelloFresh, as well as: Green Chef, EveryPlate, Chefs Plate, Factor_, YouFoodz, The Pets Table and GoodChop.

About the Team

Menu Personalization decides what millions of customers see when they open HelloFresh each week. The team owns the recommender systems that match customers to recipes across our global markets, and brings together Data Scientists, Backend Engineers, Data Engineers, ML Engineers, and Product to take ideas from experiment to production. The work directly shapes customer experience and business growth: when personalization gets better, customers find recipes they love faster, and HelloFresh becomes a stronger weekly habit.

At HelloFresh we are moving away from a model where software developers just execute tickets toward one where engineers are trusted to own customer problems. You take a problem, form a point of view, validate it with customers and data, and ship it using AI as a force multiplier.

About the Role

We are looking for a technical leader for the Menu Personalization ML systems, someone who owns the recommender stack that runs in production. You will set the direction for how we design, build, and operate the ML systems behind menu personalization, while staying hands-on across feature pipelines, training workflows, model serving, experimentation tooling, and the infrastructure underneath. The decisions you make here shape the platform for years, not quarters, and you will be expected to hold a point of view on where personalization at HelloFresh should go and to back it with data and user evidence. You will partner with Data Scientists to take models from notebook to production, with Data Engineers on features and pipelines, with Backend Engineers on online inference paths, and with Product on what to build next. Your influence will reach well beyond Menu Personalization: through the standards you set, the architectural decisions you make, the engineers you grow around you, and the company-wide initiatives you drive to advance ML and data engineering craft across HelloFresh.

What you'll do

- Set the technical direction for the ML systems behind menu personalization, owning the end-to-end stack: feature pipelines, training workflows, model serving, experimentation tooling, and infrastructure.

- Take research and experiments to reliable production systems, partnering with Data Scientists on services that meet real latency, scalability, and observability requirements.

- Shape the personalization roadmap with Product and Engineering leadership, backing your point of view with data and user evidence.

- Operate what you build, instrumenting and improving your systems in production because shipping is the beginning of the learning cycle, not the end of it.

- Raise the technical bar across the team through architecture reviews, mentorship, and the example you set on production ML craft.

- Shape long-term architecture and make platform decisions whose payoff plays out over years rather than quarters.

- Drive engineering excellence beyond Menu Personalization by setting standards other ML and data teams adopt.

- Sync with peers across HelloFresh on best practices and contribute to company-wide engineering initiatives that move the broader ML and data craft forward.

- 8+ years building and operating production ML systems, with a track record of technical leadership at scale.

- Architectural decisions in your past that held up over multiple years and influenced teams beyond your own.

- Production experience with recommender systems or large-scale personalization is a strong plus.

- Fluency across our data and ML stack (Python, Spark) and our backend and platform stack (Go, Kafka, Kubernetes), with hands-on experience across pipelines, model serving, and observability at scale.

- Statistical literacy to design honest experiments and the judgment to know when a model is actually better versus when the metrics are lying to you.

- Operational judgment to diagnose system misbehavior, find root causes, and ship systems you can debug under real load.

- Hands-on experience with AI tooling (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) beyond casual experimentation; you use AI agents every day and have a practical sense of how the context you provide shapes output quality.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Machine Learning Engineer, Menu Personalisation
jobs.description:
About HelloFresh

At HelloFresh, we want to change the way people eat forever by offering our customers high-quality food and recipes for different meal occasions. Even after celebrating our 10-year anniversary, we continue to see this mission spread around the world and beyond our wildest dreams. Now, we are a global food solutions group and the world's leading meal kit company, active in 18 countries across 3 continents. So, how did we do it? Our weekly boxes full of exciting recipes and fresh ingredients have blossomed into a community of customers looking for delicious, healthy and sustainable options. The HelloFresh Group now includes our core brand, HelloFresh, as well as: Green Chef, EveryPlate, Chefs Plate, Factor_, YouFoodz, The Pets Table and GoodChop.

About the Team

Menu Personalization decides what millions of customers see when they open HelloFresh each week. The team owns the recommender systems that match customers to recipes across our global markets, and brings together Data Scientists, Backend Engineers, Data Engineers, ML Engineers, and Product to take ideas from experiment to production. The work directly shapes customer experience and business growth: when personalization gets better, customers find recipes they love faster, and HelloFresh becomes a stronger weekly habit.

At HelloFresh we are moving away from a model where software developers just execute tickets toward one where engineers are trusted to own customer problems. You take a problem, form a point of view, validate it with customers and data, and ship it using AI as a force multiplier.

About the Role

We are looking for a technical leader for the Menu Personalization ML systems, someone who owns the recommender stack that runs in production. You will set the direction for how we design, build, and operate the ML systems behind menu personalization, while staying hands-on across feature pipelines, training workflows, model serving, experimentation tooling, and the infrastructure underneath. The decisions you make here shape the platform for years, not quarters, and you will be expected to hold a point of view on where personalization at HelloFresh should go and to back it with data and user evidence. You will partner with Data Scientists to take models from notebook to production, with Data Engineers on features and pipelines, with Backend Engineers on online inference paths, and with Product on what to build next. Your influence will reach well beyond Menu Personalization: through the standards you set, the architectural decisions you make, the engineers you grow around you, and the company-wide initiatives you drive to advance ML and data engineering craft across HelloFresh.

What you'll do

- Set the technical direction for the ML systems behind menu personalization, owning the end-to-end stack: feature pipelines, training workflows, model serving, experimentation tooling, and infrastructure.

- Take research and experiments to reliable production systems, partnering with Data Scientists on services that meet real latency, scalability, and observability requirements.

- Shape the personalization roadmap with Product and Engineering leadership, backing your point of view with data and user evidence.

- Operate what you build, instrumenting and improving your systems in production because shipping is the beginning of the learning cycle, not the end of it.

- Raise the technical bar across the team through architecture reviews, mentorship, and the example you set on production ML craft.

- Shape long-term architecture and make platform decisions whose payoff plays out over years rather than quarters.

- Drive engineering excellence beyond Menu Personalization by setting standards other ML and data teams adopt.

- Sync with peers across HelloFresh on best practices and contribute to company-wide engineering initiatives that move the broader ML and data craft forward.
jobs.requirements_raw:

- 8+ years building and operating production ML systems, with a track record of technical leadership at scale.

- Architectural decisions in your past that held up over multiple years and influenced teams beyond your own.

- Production experience with recommender systems or large-scale personalization is a strong plus.

- Fluency across our data and ML stack (Python, Spark) and our backend and platform stack (Go, Kafka, Kubernetes), with hands-on experience across pipelines, model serving, and observability at scale.

- Statistical literacy to design honest experiments and the judgment to know when a model is actually better versus when the metrics are lying to you.

jobs.title: Director UX Design
jobs.description:
About HelloFresh

HelloFresh Group reaches more than 6 million customers across 16 markets through a portfolio of 8 consumer brands — from meal kits and ready-to-eat meals to pet food and specialty products. HelloTech, our global technology division, builds the digital consumer experience across Berlin, Warsaw, and North America: the apps, the personalization, the discovery moments, and everything in between that turns food into something people genuinely look forward to.

Design is core to how we compete. Our Consumer UX team designs end-to-end experiences across all 8 brands, and we hold a high quality bar — internally, our “zest-appeal” framework defines design excellence from baseline usability through to best-in-class, surprise-and-delight craft. We are also moving fast to an AI-native way of working, where AI rethinks discovery, prototyping, and the path from design to code. Experience quality and innovation are leadership priorities all the way to the group president.

About the role

This year we are doubling down on craft, execution, and design leadership. In a world where it is easier than ever to get software to 75% built, it is the last 25% — the polish, the motion, the detail customers actually feel — that decides whether a consumer experience is merely useful or genuinely loved. Millions of people open our apps every week to feed themselves and their families; the final 10% is the difference between a transaction and a habit.

This is a build-and-scale role, not a maintenance one. We are hiring a design leader to own a consumer experience domain within the Consumer mega alliance, raise the quality bar across it, grow a high-performing team, and build the design-technology and AI-native capability that turns ambitious ideas into beautifully executed, shipped products. We need a maker and a leader who leads through the work — not a strategy-only or people-management-only role.

The level — Director or Senior Director — will be set by the candidate’s experience and the final scope of the domain. We are open to both.

What You’ll Do: The Recipe

- Lead from the front. Lead, coach, and inspire a multidisciplinary team — UX, UI, content, and localization — across multiple consumer surfaces. Stay hands-on in the work: review designs, jump into critiques, and drive clarity.

- Turn ambiguity into clarity. Solve problems from first principles, not templates. Help your team make hard decisions, focus on outcomes over process, and install just the right amount of structure and rigour to ship great work at speed.

- Set and uphold an extremely high craft bar. From UX flow to polished UI — layout, typography, motion, micro-interaction, and visual storytelling. Be the design-quality amplifier who notices the details others miss and pushes work to where it needs to be, coaching the team to our quality tenets.

- Own a consumer experience domain end-to-end. Take accountability for the quality and delivery of experiences across the customer journey, from problem framing to shipped product across our brands and 16 markets. Drive design excellence through every detail.

- Build design-technology capability. Champion and scale our design system (Zest) and modern UI foundations. Close the gap between design and engineering through prototyping, design-to-code workflows, and component quality — making design and engineering faster together.

- Make us AI-native. Treat AI as an active part of how design gets done — accelerating discovery, generating and validating prototypes, and shortening design-to-delivery. Define the quality bar AI-assisted workflows must meet, and help the company rewrite how consumer products get built in the AI era.

- Partner deeply with Product and Engineering. Align on priorities, make tradeoffs, unblock delivery, and move fast. Advocate clearly and persistently for the right experience, and raise the ambition of the partners around you.

What You’ll Bring: The Ingredients

- Team leadership. A track record of leading and growing high-performing design teams in product-first, consumer (B2C) companies — hiring, coaching, and developing designers at all levels, from IC to managers.

- High agency. You thrive in ambiguous, fast-changing environments, push for the right solution rather than the convenient one, and lean in to make things happen without waiting for permission.

- A bias to ship. Demonstrated success driving teams to ship great software at scale, not just making decks about it — owning execution across a product line and a portfolio of features.

- Exceptional craft and product taste. Strong visual and interaction sensibility and a high personal bar for detail. You know what great looks like for a consumer audience, and you can help teams get there — across hierarchy, motion, and micro-interaction.

- Design-technologist mindset. Fluency at the design–engineering boundary: design systems, component architecture, prototyping in code or advanced tools, and a practical grasp of front-end constraints.

- AI-native practice. You already use AI across the design workflow — for insight synthesis, rapid prototyping, and design-to-code — and have a point of view on scaling it responsibly with a high quality bar. Fluency with tools like Figma, Claude, and similar is expected.

- Scale and systems thinking. Experience designing and maintaining quality across a multi-brand or multi-market consumer ecosystem, balancing consistency with brand-specific character.

What Success Looks Like

- Your team consistently delivers high-quality consumer product work at speed.

- You have hired exceptional talent and helped your existing team grow in craft and execution maturity.

- Experience quality in your domain is visibly higher — the last 10% is sweated, and it shows in what customers feel.

- Product and engineering leaders love partnering with you because you unlock progress and raise the ambition.

- Design systems and AI-native workflows in your domain make the whole team faster without sacrificing craft.

- You are a key player in shaping how HelloFresh builds consumer product in the AI era — writing new playbooks, not following old ones.

What We Offer: The Toppings

- Scale and impact. Shape experiences for 6+ million customers across 8 brands and 16 markets.

- A craft-and-AI-first culture. Leadership that champions experience quality, innovation, and AI-native ways of working from the top of the organization.

- Real ownership. End-to-end accountability for your domain, with the autonomy to set and raise the bar.

- Growth. A defined leadership track and the chance to expand scope as the alliance scales.

- Global collaboration. Work with experienced product, engineering, and design partners across HelloTech’s international teams.

jobs.title: Senior React Native Product Engineer, Consumer Alliance (all genders)
jobs.description:
Work with HelloFresh in Warsaw and its HelloTech organisation, HelloFresh’s global technology backbone with more than 1000 people, building the digital products that power our end-to-end food experience. From meal kits and ready-to-eat meals to specialty offerings like pet food and premium meat & seafood, HelloTech creates the platforms that bring tailored food solutions to millions of customers every month.

Our subscription-based, direct-to-consumer model relies on technology at every step, from customer-facing apps and personalization logic to pricing, forecasting, supply chain optimization, and initiatives that help reduce food waste. While our brands operate independently to serve distinct customer needs, they are united by shared platforms, data, and operational excellence built by HelloTech.

HelloTech works in autonomous, cross-functional alliances, each owning a specific product or domain end-to-end. By working with our Warsaw office, you will help shape scalable, data-driven products used across our markets, working with a modern tech stack and international teams to continuously improve how people discover, order, and enjoy HelloFresh’s products, today and in the future.

About the role: What's in the Box

The Consumer Alliance drives customer acquisition, conversion optimization, and retention strategies across all HelloFresh and Ready-to-Eat (RTE) brands globally. The alliance is responsible for cross-cutting initiatives that maximize business value through modernized payment processing, dynamic customer activations and reactivations, and organic growth channels like SEO. By leveraging rigorous experimentation, data-driven insights, and continuous backend modernization, we ensure a frictionless, highly optimized funnel that improves conversion rates and sustains long-term growth across all regions.

The Cart & Wallet squad is looking for a Senior React Native Engineer to build and evolve the cart, checkout, and wallet experiences across our mobile and web apps. This is where intent turns into revenue: every change you ship is measured directly in conversion, order value, and customer trust, across all HelloFresh Group's brands and markets, for millions of customers every day, globally.

At HelloTech, flexibility and cross-functional collaboration are core to how we work. While this role is aligned to a specific Alliance, strong candidates may also be considered for opportunities across different teams or projects.

What you’ll do: The Recipe

At HelloFresh we are moving away from a model where software developers just execute tickets toward one where product engineers are trusted to own customer problems. A Product Engineer takes a problem, forms a point of view, validates it with customers and data, and ships it using AI as a force multiplier.

- Build and improve the cart, checkout, and wallet flows in our React Native apps, from problem definition through to production and measurement

- Run experiments on high-traffic, revenue-critical surfaces, and use the results to decide what ships next

- Collaborate with engineers across the department and the company to continuously improve the code base, systems, and processes

- Design and develop solutions that can continue to scale

- Support other team members through workshops, pair programming, and code reviews

- Work beyond your specialization when the problem demands it. Your specialization is your anchor, not your boundary.

- Operate what you build. You instrument, monitor, and improve your systems in production. Shipping is the beginning of the learning cycle, not the end.

- Contribute to the app experience, owning the metrics that reflect quality for mobile customers (retention, crash-free sessions, conversion).

What you’ll bring: The Ingredients

- Hands-on experience working with AI tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) beyond casual experimentation. You use AI agents every day. You have a practical sense of how the context you provide to AI tools shapes output quality, and how to set boundaries on AI-generated work.

- At least 2-3 years of hands-on work with React Native

- A minimum of 5 years of experience working with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript

- Proficiency in building component-based architectures using React.js and Node.js

- Deep understanding of integrating frontend and backend services seamlessly

- Familiarity with CI/CD workflows, along with solid testing practices, including unit, integration, and end-to-end testing

- Strong collaboration skills when partnering with engineers and other functional roles, like product management and UX designer.

- You take full ownership. You have a bias to ship. You finish the last twenty percent.

- You have product sense and are opinionated about what should be built and why, and you can back that opinion with data and user evidence.

- Deep mobile engineering expertise, with experience across the app release cycle, test automation, on-device performance and platform UX conventions.

Above all, we are looking for individuals who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills, and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What we offer: The Toppings

- Global collaboration at scale: Collaborate with experienced engineers and product partners across HelloTech’s international teams, in a culture of active knowledge sharing.

- Technology with real-world impact: Build and operate modern systems at a global scale, supporting 6+ million customers and complex supply chain operations.

Our subscription-based, direct-to-consumer model relies on technology at every step, from customer-facing apps and personalization logic to pricing, forecasting, supply chain optimization, and initiatives that help reduce food waste. While our brands operate independently to serve distinct customer needs, they are united by shared platforms, data, and operational excellence built by HelloTech.

HelloTech works in autonomous, cross-functional alliances, each owning a specific product or domain end to end. By working with our Warsaw office, you will help shape scalable, data-driven products used across our markets, working with a modern tech stack and international teams to continuously improve how people discover, order, and enjoy HelloFresh’s products, today and in the future.

About the role: What's in the Box

The Communications tribe, a key part of the Growth Alliance, enables our brands to deliver highly personalized, meaningful interactions with our users across global markets. As a Senior Machine Learning Product Engineer within this team, you will drive a direct business impact by shaping the intelligence behind how, when, and what we communicate with our customers.

Your work will primarily focus on three core initiatives:

- Send Decisioning: Improving the data layer and integration for the decisioning engine, specifically utilizing the company's existing feature store and feature sets, to optimize our communication channels (email, SMS, and push notifications). Your models will automate the logic that determines the most relevant message and timing for each individual user.

- Intelligent Funnel: Supporting a collaborative, cross-tribe initiative aimed at personalizing the post-click experience. You will streamline the content generation process to reduce manual work when creating email marketing copy.

- AI-Assisted Content & Search: Developing automated asset retrieval to select images based on context during email creation, moving away from manual selection. Additionally, you will develop tools that assist marketing teams in the automated composition of new, high-performing communication assets.

To succeed in this project, you should be a pragmatic and curious problem solver who excels in a cross-functional environment. Success involves translating complex user behavior into scalable models, identifying opportunities to improve our data foundations, and balancing technical depth with a strong focus on driving user engagement.

At HelloTech, flexibility and cross-functional collaboration are core to how we work. While this role is aligned to a specific Alliance, strong candidates may also be considered for opportunities across different teams or projects.

What you’ll do: The Recipe

At HelloFresh we are moving away from a model where software developers just execute tickets toward one where product engineers are trusted to own customer problems. A Product Engineer takes a problem, forms a point of view, validates it with customers and data, and ships it using AI as a force multiplier.

- Own & elevate ML infrastructure: Build, maintain, and refine the core repositories, developer tooling, and engineering workflows that enable the team to organize, scale, and deploy production ML systems smoothly.

- Build and operate data products and machine-learning systems, taking them from experimentation through production and owning their real-world performance.

- Architect the Send Decisioning data layer: Evaluate, optimize, and potentially redesign our communication platform integrations - building robust pipelines and integrating our feature store to enhance data quality and feature availability for decisioning models.

- Engineer AI-assisted content & asset systems: Develop scalable integrations and workflows to streamline email copy generation (subject lines, copy context) and build context-driven asset retrieval systems for marketing teams.

- Build production-grade pipelines & serving layers: Translate research and experimentation into low-latency, highly reliable production systems, ensuring continuous observability, data reliability, and error handling.

- Bridge research & production: Partner closely with Data Scientists to transition experimental models into resilient, low-latency production services with high observability and robust fallback mechanisms.

- Set the ML engineering standard: Build, standardize, and maintain core repositories, CI/CD templates, and ML platform practices (Databricks, MLflow) to streamline how the team develops and deploys code. Take full accountability for production reliability—monitoring input data quality, drift, and latency across critical communication and personalization funnels.

- Work beyond your specialization when the problem demands it. Your specialization is your anchor, not your boundary.

- Operate what you build. You instrument, monitor, and improve your systems in production. Shipping is the beginning of the learning cycle, not the end.

What you’ll bring: The Ingredients

- Hands-on experience working with AI tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) beyond casual experimentation. You use AI agents every day. You have a practical sense of how the context you provide to AI tools shapes output quality, and how to set boundaries on AI-generated work.

- Deep data/ML engineering expertise, experience operating models or data products in production, and the statistical literacy to design sound experiments and interpret their results.

- (Ideally) 5+ years of experience building and operating production ML systems.

- Fluency across the data and ML stack (Python, Spark, Databricks) and working knowledge of the backend and platform stack (Go, Kafka, Kubernetes), with hands-on experience across pipelines, model serving, and observability at scale.

- Statistical literacy to design honest experiments and the judgment to evaluate model metrics accurately.

- Operational judgment to diagnose system misbehavior under real load, identify root causes, and deploy robust fixes.

- You take full ownership. You have a bias to ship. You finish the last twenty percent.

- You have product sense and are opinionated about what should be built and why, and you can back that opinion with data and user evidence.

Above all, we are looking for individuals who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What we offer: The Toppings

- Global collaboration at scale: Collaborate with experienced engineers and product partners across HelloTech’s international teams, in a culture of active knowledge sharing.

- Technology with real-world impact: Build and operate modern systems at global scale, supporting 6+ millions of customers and complex supply chain operations.

- Technical/Product/Design leadership: Drive best practices and influence architecture/design, quality, and ways of working in an autonomous, product-led setup.

The Associate will support improving our transportation strategic initiatives to enhance processes within our Logistics Operations Center team. Responsibilities include transportation scheduling, tracking line hauls, negotiating spot market freight, managing exceptions and communicating cross-functionally to create seamless shipping execution across our network.

You will ...

- Report to the Associate Manager / Manager to manage, monitor and develop recovery plans for outbound loads

- Execute outbound strategy - working across all distribution centers, third-party storage locations, cross docks, and vendors

- Monitor, measure, and improve service level metrics, including on-time arrival and on-time departure

- Determine root causes and ensure details of escalations are provided and accurate

- Execute relabeling of boxes from label generation to pushing customer communication updates

- Quickly and effectively analyze real-time data to provide recovery and contingency action plans

- Run the daily Exception Management process, communicating potential delays and assigning boxes to be re-made, with the goal of protecting the customer experience

- Track, organize, log and root cause major exceptions events; analyzing the impact of these events to weekly error data

- Solve unique and challenging problems faced in a perishable supply chain

- Become part of a passionate team that strives to develop innovative solutions to improve and grow HelloFresh’s delivery network

- Build relationships with third-party carriers and execute plans to secure loads against forecasted volume

- Work directly with our outbound transportation team to lead and reinforce operational process improvement projects

- Drive a customer-focused environment committed to delivering the highest quality product to our customers

You are...

- Data-driven – you can organize, explore, and synthesize unstructured data into actionable insights to better inform operational decision-making

- Intellectually curious – you have an insatiable desire to understand how things work, why they work the way they do, and to consistently challenge the status quo

- Detail-oriented – you possess strong organizational skills and consistently demonstrate a methodical approach to all your work

- Agile – you thrive in fast-paced and dynamic environments and are comfortable working autonomously

- A critical thinker – you use logic to identify opportunities, evaluate alternatives, and synthesize and present critical information to solve complex problems

- An excellent communicator – able to communicate at all levels with clarity, poise, maturity and precision both written and verbal

- Collaborative - you enjoy working cross-functionally with various teams to gather key inputs, and are able to work well with diverse opinions

- Dedicated to providing the best possible experience for the HelloFresh customer

You have...

- Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, Data Science, Computer Science, Information Systems, Accounting, Supply Chain, or other relevant areas of study required

- 2 years of experience delivering analytical solutions to complex problems required

- Ability to travel up to 10% within the United States required

- Experience working with transportation management software (E2Open, BluJay) preferred

- Flexible in working a non M-F work schedule (e.g. rotational schedule, weekends, and/or overnights). Must be able to work the shift: Sunday- Wednesday, 7am-5pm CST

- This position's essential functions demand the performance of the following physical requirements with or without reasonable accommodation:

-

- Prolonged periods working at a desk and on a computer

- Reading information on a computer screen and inputting data into a computer system

You’ll get…

- Competitive hourly rate, 401K company match that vests immediately upon participation, & team bonus opportunities

- Generous PTO and flexible attendance policy

- Comprehensive health and wellness benefits with options at $0 monthly, effective first day of employment

- Up to 85% discount on subscriptions to HelloFresh meal plans (HelloFresh, Green Chef, Everyplate, and Factor_)

- Access to Employee Resource Groups that are open to all employees, including those pertaining to BIPOC, women, veterans, parents, and LGBTQ+

- Inclusive, collaborative, and dynamic work environment within a fast-paced, mission-driven company that is disrupting the traditional food supply chain

This job description is intended to provide a general overview of the responsibilities. However, the Company reserves the right to adjust, modify, or reassign work tasks and responsibilities as needed to meet changing business needs, operational requirements, or other factors.

jobs.title: Elektroniker für Betriebstechnik (all genders)

Gestalte den neuen Factor_-Standort in Verden mit.

Unser neuer Produktionsstandort in Verden ist erst seit diesem Frühjahr in Betrieb – und genau jetzt ist der richtige Zeitpunkt, Teil unserer Erfolgsgeschichte zu werden.

Gemeinsam sorgen wir dafür, dass unsere frischen Factor_-Mahlzeiten jeden Tag zuverlässig produziert werden. Dafür suchen wir Menschen, die gerne anpacken, technische Herausforderungen mögen und Verantwortung übernehmen.

Bei uns erwartet dich kein eintöniger Arbeitsalltag. Du arbeitest an modernen Produktionsanlagen, Fördertechnik und Gebäudetechnik und bist Teil eines kleinen, eingespielten Team, das den Standort aktiv weiterentwickelt.

Dein Verantwortungsbereich

- Wartung, Reparatur und Instandhaltung unserer Produktionsanlagen und technischen Einrichtungen

- Mit externen Dienstleistern und Handwerksfirmen zusammenarbeiten

- Wartungsarbeiten dokumentieren und Verbesserungen im technischen Bereich einbringen

- Gemeinsam mit dem Team für eine sichere und zuverlässige Produktion sorgen

- Gesundheit & Wohlbefinden: Zugang zu Wellbeing-Initiativen – bald ergänzt durch attraktive Fitnessangebote.

Du bist auch hungrig nach mehr?

Bewirb Dich jetzt mit Deinen vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen, gerne auch ohne Lichtbild und ohne Angabe von spezifischen Merkmalen wie Nationalität oder Geschlecht. Sprachzertifikate und Unterlagen zur Aufenthalts- und Arbeitserlaubnis können gerne mit eingereicht werden.

Wir freuen uns auf Dich!

jobs.title: Senior Accounting Coordinator
jobs.description:
The Role

At HelloConnect, you will be part of a dynamic team in Inoza tower, BGC that embraces innovation and leverages advanced technology to create exceptional experiences. Our culture is built on collaboration, continuous learning, and a commitment to excellence. You’ll have the opportunity to work on impactful projects, develop your skills, and grow within a supportive environment that values diverse perspectives and experiences.

In this role, you will take take ownership of advanced and complex accounting tasks, ensuring the seamless execution of financial operations. This role acts as a key resource in solving escalated issues, streamlining processes, and providing insights to optimize the accounting workflow. The Senior Accounting Coordinator will also mentor junior team members and serve as a subject matter expert on critical finance operations, contributing to our ongoing efforts to drive business success and enhance customer satisfaction.

We’re looking for passionate individuals who can bring their unique skills and ideas to the table. Even if you don't meet every requirement but believe you’d excel in this role, we’d love to hear from you!

What you’ll do

- Handle complex invoice processing tasks, including three-way matching for high-value or disputed invoices.

- Investigate and resolve escalations from suppliers or procurement teams, identifying root causes and implementing long-term solutions.

- Identify inefficiencies within accounting processes and propose solutions to streamline workflows.

- Enforce and refine financial controls related to inventory, accounts payable, and month-end reporting.

- Perform detailed reconciliations of high-volume accounts, ensuring accuracy and resolving discrepancies.

- Generate and analyze advanced reports on accounts payable status, supplier performance, and financial compliance.

- Collaborate with senior accountants to ensure the timely completion of close activities.

- Develop guides and resources to improve team understanding of best practices.

- Ensure compliance with internal policies and external regulations across all financial transactions.

- Participate in or lead ad-hoc projects aimed at improving operational efficiency or implementing new accounting tools.

- Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field.

- Experience with process improvement initiatives or audit readiness is a plus.

- Growth Opportunities: Invest in your personal development with an annual learning & development budget, plus access to the 360 Learning platform

- Dynamic Environment: Join a rapidly growing global Business Process Outsourcing company, where you'll collaborate with a diverse community spanning across multiple continents and cultures

Are you up for the challenge?

The first step to your new role starts here. Send in your application, along with your salary expectations and preferred start date. Our dedicated team will thoroughly review your details. We are excited to connect with you soon!

jobs.title: Senior Frontend Product Engineer, Conversions (all genders)
jobs.description:
Work with HelloFresh in Warsaw and its HelloTech organisation, HelloFresh’s global technology backbone with more than 1000 people, building the digital products that power our end-to-end food experience. From meal kits and ready-to-eat meals to specialty offerings like pet food and premium meat & seafood, HelloTech creates the platforms that bring tailored food solutions to millions of customers every month. Our subscription-based, direct-to-consumer model relies on technology at every step, from customer-facing apps and personalization logic to pricing, forecasting, supply chain optimization, and initiatives that help reduce food waste. While our brands operate independently to serve distinct customer needs, they are united by shared platforms, data, and operational excellence built by HelloTech.

About the role: What's in the Box

Conversions Tech empowers HelloFresh Group meal brands to achieve ambitious growth targets through a seamless and high-performing conversion funnel. As part of the Growth Alliance, you will drive marketing innovation by delivering advanced MarTech capabilities, conversion optimization, and data-driven growth strategies. You will build personalized web experiences using React, Next.js, and edge environments, tailoring user journeys based on intent, channel, and campaign data. In this role, you will integrate with our CMS, leverage experimentation frameworks, and utilize GenAI tools, such as Claude, Cursor, Figma, and Contentful MCPs, to accelerate architecture, design, and testing workflows. Working alongside machine learning, product, and design experts, you will ensure high-performance execution, maintaining strong Core Web Vitals and low-latency delivery across global desktop and mobile applications.

What you’ll do: The Recipe

At HelloFresh we are moving away from a model where software developers just execute tickets toward one where product engineers are trusted to own customer problems. A Product Engineer takes a problem, forms a point of view, validates it with customers and data, and ships it using AI as a force multiplier.

- Drive the architecture and delivery of personalized conversion pages and funnels using React, TypeScript, and Next.js, spanning SSR middleware design through to edge-layer caching strategies.

- Champion GenAI proficiency, embedding AI-driven workflows into development, debugging, and code-quality processes to accelerate execution velocity and output.

- Ensure top-tier funnel performance and application stability, optimizing Core Web Vitals, low-latency personalization, and multi-brand reliability at global scale.

- Architect and maintain the MarTech integration layer, behavioral lead-capture tools, and GTM event pipelines feeding downstream analytics and CRM systems.

- Implement robust automated testing strategies with Jest and Cypress, alongside frontend observability tools (OpenTelemetry, Honeycomb, Grafana, or Sentry) to embed deep traceability from initial design to release.

- Partner with cross-functional product, machine learning, and design experts to shape personalized user experiences and resolve complex technical trade-offs.

- Work beyond your specialization when the problem demands it. Your specialization is your anchor, not your boundary.

- Operate what you build. You instrument, monitor, and improve your systems in production. Shipping is the beginning of the learning cycle, not the end.

- Contribute to customer-facing web surfaces, driving measurable improvements in conversion, activation, or retention.

What you’ll bring: The Ingredients

- Hands-on experience working with AI tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) beyond casual experimentation. You use AI agents every day. You have a practical sense of how the context you provide to AI tools shapes output quality, and how to set boundaries on AI-generated work.

- Deep technical proficiency in React, TypeScript, and modern rendering patterns (SSR), supported by extensive professional software engineering experience.

- Proven track record architecting solutions using edge runtimes (such as Vercel Edge Functions or Cloudflare Workers) and understanding how edge caching directly impacts personalization and latency.

- Demonstrated GenAI expertise, with hands-on skill leveraging modern AI tools and workflows to enhance code quality, development speed, and overall technical standards.

- Practical application of A/B testing and feature-flagging frameworks (e.g., Statsig, Optimizely) alongside frontend monitoring and observability platforms.

- Strong collaborative mindset with an ability to communicate complex technical decisions clearly, share knowledge with peers, and drive results autonomously across cross-functional domains.

- You take full ownership. You have a bias to ship. You finish the last twenty percent.

- You have product sense and are opinionated about what should be built and why, and you can back that opinion with data and user evidence.

- Strong frontend engineering expertise and the product and design judgment to independently prototype and iterate on coherent customer experiences.

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What we offer: The Toppings

- Global collaboration at scale: Collaborate with experienced engineers and product partners across HelloTech’s international teams, in a culture of active knowledge sharing.

- Technology with real-world impact: Build and operate modern systems at global scale, supporting 6+ millions of customers and complex supply chain operations.

- Technical/Product/Design leadership: Drive best practices and influence architecture/design, quality, and ways of working in an autonomous, product-led setup.

- End-to-end development/delivery: Drive decisions from problem definition to production, improving systems and enabling long-term scalability.

- Access to workspace at Warsaw Centre Point. The hub offers modern facilities including showers, breakout zones, outdoor space, cycle parking, and refreshments (coffee, soft drinks, and fruit).

Are you the missing ingredient? If this sounds like a tasty opportunity, we’d be excited to hear from you. We aim to review your profile and respond within 5 business days.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Intelligent Platforms
jobs.description:
Work with HelloFresh in Warsaw and its HelloTech organisation, HelloFresh’s global technology backbone with more than 1000 people, building the digital products that power our end-to-end food experience. From meal kits and ready-to-eat meals to specialty offerings like pet food and premium meat & seafood, HelloTech creates the platforms that bring tailored food solutions to millions of customers every month.

Our subscription-based, direct-to-consumer model relies on technology at every step, from customer-facing apps and personalization logic to pricing, forecasting, supply chain optimization, and initiatives that help reduce food waste. While our brands operate independently to serve distinct customer needs, they are united by shared platforms, data, and operational excellence built by HelloTech.

HelloTech works in autonomous, cross-functional alliances, each owning a specific product or domain end to end. By working with our Warsaw office, you will help shape scalable, data-driven products used across our markets, working with a modern tech stack and international teams to continuously improve how people discover, order, and enjoy HelloFresh’s products, today and in the future.

About the role: What's in the Box

The Foundations Alliance's mission is to accelerate the delivery of high-quality, scalable, and highly available digital products at HelloFresh by providing services and platforms that improve internal builder productivity and system reliability. This position is for a Senior Product Manager to drive the vision, strategy, and execution for the Operational Data Platform—the systems that create, transport, and store data at the point of origin, making it available for downstream analytics or AI. The role holds accountability for a high-leverage layer of the data ecosystem: the streaming and database infrastructure that product engineering teams rely on to get data flowing reliably.
The core objective is to ensure operational data is created, delivered, and shared downstream reliably, cost-efficiently, and with explicit quality guarantees. The service provider will define the roadmap for the squad's platform (event streaming, relational, and NoSQL databases), partner closely with the Engineering Lead for the Operational Data Platform, and collaborate cross-functionally with data producer and analytical teams. This engagement comes at a key moment for critical-path cost-efficiency and reliability initiatives. This role does not include people management responsibilities.

At HelloTech, flexibility and cross-functional collaboration are core to how we work. While this role is aligned to a specific Alliance, strong candidates may also be considered for opportunities across different teams or projects.

What you’ll do: The Recipe

- Drive the product vision and roadmap for the Operational Data Platform—focusing on low-latency data creation, transport, storage, and availability for downstream analytics—partnering closely with the Engineering Lead for the platform.

- Lead the squad's cost-efficiency roadmap, taking accountability for targeted cost savings as a core KPI.

- Maintain the reliability of critical-path systems (streaming and core databases), setting uptime targets and feeding incident learnings back into platform planning.

- Champion data-contract and schema standards at the point of data creation, collaborating with data-producing engineering teams to close adoption gaps and ensure quality data flows downstream.

- Guide platform tooling decisions, consolidating technologies around optimal solutions rather than accumulating redundant options.

- Define and maintain the handover contract with the Analytical Data Platform, ensuring downstream data is consistently trustworthy and ready for governance.

- Act as the primary interface between the Operational Data Platform and data producers, translating business and technical needs into actionable roadmap priorities.

- Define, track, and report squad KPIs (cost efficiency, critical-path reliability, data-quality adoption) against quarterly alliance goals.

What you’ll bring: The Ingredients

- Proven experience as a Product Manager with a solid grounding in data infrastructure, data engineering, or backend platforms—comfortable with streaming, messaging, and database architecture.

- Working familiarity with event streaming and relational/NoSQL database technologies to partner credibly with engineering leads on technical trade-offs.

- Track record of driving roadmaps and KPIs for technical teams in platform problem spaces, managing metrics like cost, reliability, or data quality to target.

- Data-driven approach to prioritization and roadmap decisions, supported by analytical tools and frameworks.

- Strong collaboration and communication capabilities to establish trust and technical alignment with engineering leads and key stakeholders.

- Pragmatic, execution-oriented mindset to drive day-to-day delivery autonomously and navigate cost, reliability, and technical debt trade-offs in live production environments.

Above all, we are looking for individuals who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What we offer: The Toppings

- Global collaboration at scale: Collaborate with experienced engineers and product partners across HelloTech’s international teams, in a culture of active knowledge sharing.

- Technology with real-world impact: Build and operate modern systems at global scale, supporting 6+ millions of customers and complex supply chain operations.

- Technical/Product/Design leadership: Drive best practices and influence architecture/design, quality, and ways of working in an autonomous, product-led setup.

- End-to-end development/delivery: Drive decisions from problem definition to production, improving systems and enabling long-term scalability.

- Access to workspace at Warsaw Centre Point. The hub offers modern facilities including showers, breakout zones, outdoor space, cycle parking, and refreshments (coffee, soft drinks, and fruit).

Are you the missing ingredient? If this sounds like a tasty opportunity, we’d be excited to hear from you. We aim to review your profile and respond within 5 business days.

jobs.title: Team Lead, Display and Video Marketing
jobs.description:
As Team Lead of Display & Video Marketing, you will take ownership of a critical execution function within the Display & Video Marketing team within the HelloFresh Group’s US portfolio of brands (HelloFresh, Factor, Green Chef, EveryPlate). You will also lead a small team of Specialists across paid programmatic Display & Video user acquisition.

Your primary mission will be to drive channel performance across YouTube, Google Demand Gen, and non-Google programmatic display & video channels— whilst developing your team and building the processes that make our Display & Video marketing operation more efficient and scalable.

This is a role for someone ready to step up from expert individual contributor to first-line people leader. You will be accountable for results, energized by coaching others, and rigorous enough to hold the bar on data quality, testing discipline, and creative execution.

Above all, we are looking for someone driven to make HelloFresh better. We firmly believe that skills are developed through diverse experiences and unique pathways. Therefore, even if your background doesn't "tick every box" but you are confident you would excel in this role, we strongly encourage you to apply and share your story with us.

What you'll do:

- Lead and develop a team of Display & Video specialists, providing regular 1:1s, clear performance feedback, and visible growth opportunities.

- Own the setup, management, and day-to-day optimization of Display & Video campaigns across YouTube, Google Demand Gen, and additional non-Google programmatic channels (Amazon DSP, AppLovin, The Trade Desk, etc.), ensuring KPIs are met and budgets are paced efficiently across markets.

- Drive a structured testing agenda — running A/B tests and audience segmentation experiments across CPAs, ROAS, and retention metrics, and translating results into repeatable playbooks.

- Partner cross-functionally with CRO, Creative, Brand, and Product teams to ensure a seamless user journey from click to first subscription.

- Work closely with the Tracking and Creative Teams to launch new partners.

- Coordinate aligned messaging across ad creative alongside the Brand and Creative production teams, leading a continuous feedback loop of testing and learning, collaborating closely with the Brand team and relevant Performance Marketing channels.

- Collaborate with the Marketing Analytics and AdTech teams to support the integration of display & video marketing data into Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM) and other core measurement frameworks.

- Identify and close technical or setup gaps that impede channel efficiency, partnering with Product and Tech stakeholders where needed.

- Maintain team documentation, reporting dashboards, and marketing calendars to ensure the Display & Video Marketing team operates efficiently and at scale.

jobs.title: Senior Motion Designer (x/f/m)
jobs.description:
Senior Motion Designer 2D/3D (m/f/x)

Brand Marketing · Berlin

At HelloFresh Group, our mission is to change the way people eat forever. Since our 2011 founding in Berlin, we've become the global market leader in the meal kit sector, inspiring millions of home cooks and food lovers every week. Our portfolio spans eight brands across 16 markets, from HelloFresh and Factor to Good Chop and Pets Table.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Senior Motion Designer who balances high-level craft with systems-level thinking. This isn't a role for templated content churn; it’s about setting a high creative bar and building the frameworks that keep that quality intact at high volume, particularly across Paid Social. You will use AI tools to accelerate production, keeping human creativity at the center of every decision.

Based in our Berlin studio as part of the Global Brand Team, you will report to the Video Creative Lead. You’ll act as their key partner in translating brand storytelling into motion — owning the creative process from inception to final cut while evolving our motion design system across global markets.

We value diverse backgrounds and non-linear skill development. If you feel aligned with this mission, we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every single bullet point.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Own the craft. Concept, storyboard, design, and animate 2D and 3D motion assets across TV, Digital OOH, Paid Social, and YouTube.

Scale Brand Systems: Evolve and maintain our global motion design guidelines. Build reusable project templates, workflows, and asset libraries that internal designers and external agencies can seamlessly execute against.

Integrate AI Thoughtfully: Leverage modern AI tools (e.g., Runway, Midjourney) to optimize production speed without compromising brand aesthetic or creative standards.

Collaborate & Mentor: Partner with creative and brand leads to present work to stakeholders, while guiding junior designers and freelancers to raise overall craft quality.

Obsess over details: Execute precise timing, easing, pacing, and basic sound design. Master the invisible stuff that separates ok motion from unforgettable motion.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- Experience: 5+ years of dedicated motion design experience with a strong portfolio demonstrating excellence in both 2D and 3D execution.

- Systems Mindset: Proven ability to build production pipelines, style frameworks, and scalable workflows for high-volume content environments.

- Technical Toolkit: Advanced proficiency in After Effects, Cinema 4D, Blender, Figma, and the broader Adobe Creative Cloud suite.

- Emerging Tech Proficiency: Hands-on experience integrating AI-assisted animation, editing, or image-generation tools into creative workflows.

- Conceptual & Nuanced Craft: Exceptional eye for rhythm and pacing, strong sensitivity to brand context, and the communication skills to navigate stakeholder feedback effectively.

- Solid brand experience. You've applied and evolved brand systems before, not just made pretty one-off videos.

- Meticulous Craft & Sensitivity: Uncompromising taste and attention to detail (from timing and easing to brand nuance and context) backed by the emotional intelligence to navigate feedback and read both a brief and a room well.

Nice to Have:

- Experience in sound design or an intuitive musical sense for pacing and rhythm. ● Prior experience working within the food, D2C, or tech sectors.

Please submit your application along with a portfolio or showreel highlighting your 2D/3D capabilities, above-the-line campaigns (TV/DOOH), and digital channel assets (Paid Social/YouTube).
