jobs.description:
The Role – Wat zit er in de box?

Als Onderhoudsmonteur binnen de Technische Dienst in Bleiswijk zorg jij ervoor dat ons distributiecentrum elke dag veilig, betrouwbaar en soepel draait. Jij werkt met (elektro)technische installaties die essentieel zijn voor onze operatie en speelt een actieve rol in het voorkomen en oplossen van storingen. Samen met je team verbeter je processen, borg je kwaliteit en draag je bij aan een veilige werkomgeving.

Werkdagen

- Maandag tot vrijdag van 08.00 tot 17.00 uur.

- Standby-diensten: 1 keer per maand neem je deel aan de standby-diensten buiten de reguliere werktijden. Tijdens deze diensten ben je oproepbaar voor urgente storingen.

What You’ll Do – Het recept

- Installeren, onderhouden en repareren van machines en technische installaties binnen het distributiecentrum.

- Signaleren en oplossen van storingen in het productie- en logistieke proces, samen met collega’s van Operations en Facility.

- Uitvoeren van periodieke controles en inspecties om storingen en veiligheidsrisico’s te voorkomen.

- Meedenken over verbeteringen aan technische installaties, processen en onderhoudsplannen.

- Documenteren van werkzaamheden en vastleggen van onderhoud en storingen in het Facility Management Systeem (Ultimo).

- Ondersteunen van afdeling-overstijgende projecten, waaronder de transitie en verhuizing naar het nieuwe DC.

- Draaien van standby-diensten (één week per maand) voor urgente technische storingen buiten reguliere werktijden.

What You’ll Bring – Jouw ingrediënten

- Een technische opleiding (MBO of hoger), bijvoorbeeld in mechatronica, elektrotechniek, werktuigbouwkunde of een vergelijkbare richting.

- Praktische ervaring in een technische functie, zoals monteur, servicetechnicus of medewerker technische dienst.

- Basiskennis van mechanische en elektrotechnische systemen en het kunnen lezen van technische tekeningen en schema’s.

- Een proactieve en oplossingsgerichte houding: je ziet werk liggen en pakt het op.

- Je werkt zelfstandig én prettig samen in een team en blijft rustig onder druk.

- Je spreekt bij voorkeur Nederlands en Engels.

Pre’s (geen must):

- Ervaring met onderhoudssoftware (zoals Ultimo).

- VCA-certificaat (of bereid dit te behalen).

- NEN 3140 (kan ook op locatie worden behaald).

- Rijbewijs B

Boven alles zijn we bij HelloFresh op zoek naar mensen die ons elke dag een beetje beter maken. Er zijn veel manieren om vaardigheden te ontwikkelen en we waarderen diverse achtergronden en ervaringen. Voldoe je niet aan alle punten, maar denk je dat deze rol goed bij je past en dat je hierin kunt groeien? Dan horen we heel graag van je.

Dit is ons recept

- De vrijheid en ruimte voor eigen ideeën en initiatieven én de kans om deze zelf te ontwikkelen en implementeren;

- De mogelijkheid om samen te werken met collega’s over de hele wereld;

- Genoeg ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden en een persoonlijk budget om verder te groeien binnen HelloFresh;

- 24 vakantiedagen per jaar, plus 1 extra vakantiedag per jaar dat je bij ons werkt;

- Reiskostenvergoeding naar ons kantoor

- Wekelijkse korting op jouw HelloFresh of factor_box

- Korting op je ClassPass abonnement, en korting op je fitness abonnement via Bedrijfsfitness Nederland

- Ons FreshEnergy programma inclusief Headspace lidmaatschap, een samenwerking met OpenUp voor je mentale welbevinden, webinars en andere evenementen;

- Gezonde lunches en fruit op kantoor;

- Meerdere opties om naar een werk gerelateerde afspraak te reizen, bijvoorbeeld door gebruik te maken van onze HelloFresh auto’s of een MyWheels auto

- Korting op je aanvullende zorgverzekering bij Zilveren Kruis

- Pensioenopbouw

Hungry for more?

- Verstuur je sollicitatie met cv en motivatiebrief;

- Zien wij een match? Dan volgt er een videocall met een van onze recruiters om te kijken wat jij voor het team kan betekenen;

- Zijn we allebei positief? Dan volgt een persoonlijk gesprek met twee collega's binnen het team in ons distributiecentrum om je beter te leren kennen en je nog meer inzichten te geven in de rol en de impact die je gaat maken;

- Tot slot heb je een gesprek met iemand uit ons Leadership Team.

jobs.title: Food Safety & Quality Assurance Supervisor
jobs.description:
S'more about the team

We are looking for a FSQA Supervisor who will take a hands-on approach to owning and continuously improving our inbounding quality control process. Reporting to the FSQA Manager, you will serve as the single point of accountability for all receiving activities during peak inbounding windows, supervising a dedicated team of QC Associates and FSQA Technicians at the dock. You will ensure that 100% of incoming proteins and produce are inspected to standard, cold-chain integrity is strictly protected, and non-conforming product is escalated and rejected before it enters production.

Lettuce share what this role will be responsible for:

- Own end-to-end accountability for the inbounding process during assigned shifts (Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Friday, and Saturday), from dock receipt through clearance to designated holding areas.

- Lead and coordinate two inspection teams — one focused on proteins, one on produce — ensuring rapid dock clearance to protect cold-chain thresholds.

- Oversee 100% inspection of all inbound proteins, including destructive testing of vacuum-packed items (e.g., bravette steak), and 100% inspection of all inbound produce across all incoming packaging types.

- Make immediate disposition decisions on non-conforming products; escalate rejections directly to vendors and coordinate returns without delay.

- Monitor and record receiving temperatures; flag and address any cold-chain deviations in real time.

- Serve as the direct liaison with warehouse and procurement teams to coordinate inbounding flow, communicate defects, and drive vendor accountability.

- Assign and monitor inbounding-related food safety programs, including pre-op inspections, GMP monitoring, and temperature logging at receiving.

- Perform trend analysis on inbounding data (defect rates, vendor scorecards, temperature excursions); use results to drive improvements and close gaps.

- Conduct root cause analysis and implement corrective action plans for inbounding non-conformances.

- Manage FSQA-related on-boarding and training for inbounding associates.

- Assist with internal, CFIA and third-party audits and inspections related to receiving and supplier quality.

- Act as primary escalation point and back-up to FSQA Manager in their absence.

- Work in compliance with OH&S acts and regulations.

- Use personal protective and safety equipment and clothing as directed by the employer and report workplace hazards and dangers to the supervisor or employer.

- Other duties as assigned.

Sound a-peeling? Here's what we're looking for:

- 3+ years in a food safety or quality assurance role in the food or other regulated industry, with experience in receiving or inbounding operations preferred.

- 1+ years of supervisory experience is considered an asset.

- Post-secondary education in Biological, Chemical or Food Sciences or equivalent experience.

- Understanding of HACCP principles, the Safe Food for Canadians Regulations and GFSI schemes.

- Strong leadership and communication skills.

- Excellent organizational and time management skills.

- Familiar with MS Office, Google Apps and comfortable learning and using new technology.

- Comfortable working in a deadline-driven and fast-paced environment.

- Flexible with working hours for business requirements, including early morning and weekend shifts (Monday, Tuesday, Friday, Saturday schedule).

Let’s cut to the cheese, this is why you'll love it here:

- Box Discount - Amazing discounts on 1 box per week! 75% discount on weekly HelloFresh and Chefs Plate meal kits AND 50% off weekly Factor meal box.

- Health & Wellness - Health & Dental benefits from day 1, a Health Spending Account, unlimited access to the Headspace app to meet your self-care needs, and 25% discount on GoodLife fitness memberships!

- RRSP Matching - Competitive RRSP matching program offered

- Vacation & PTO - Time off is also an important part of self-care! We offer generous vacation and PTO to help you create a good work-life balance.

- Family Benefits - A parental leave top-up program for expectant parents.

- Growth & Development - We support your career progression, provide development opportunities, and invest in your continued learning through our organization wide L&D fund.

- Work Hard & Have Fun - From team socials to engaging company days, you’ll have plenty of opportunity to experience the fun!

- Diversity & Inclusion Initiatives - With impactful ERG’s like FreshPride, Women Empowered and LIMES, we are committed to our diversity, equity & inclusion efforts.

- Food Puns - this one is kind of a big dill if you haven’t already noticed. We even have some punny meeting room names!

Working Conditions:

It’s no surprise that as a food company, we use many ingredients that may be considered common allergens (i.e. peanuts, tree nuts, milk, etc.). Whether this role is based out of our headquarters or one of our distribution centers, it is possible that you may be exposed to such allergens in this role. If you have any concerns with being exposed to any particular food ingredients, including meat, please disclose this during the hiring process.

If this sounds like you, please click the "Apply Now" button. If this role doesn't quite match what you're looking for, but you'd like to know more about joining the HelloFresh team, please visit our Jobs page to view our other vacancies. We'd love to hear from you!

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

jobs.title: Control Systems Technician

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist, Growth Alliance
jobs.description:
Work with HelloFresh in Warsaw and its HelloTech organisation, HelloFresh’s global technology backbone with more than 1000 people, building the digital products that power our end-to-end food experience. From meal kits and ready-to-eat meals to specialty offerings like pet food and premium meat & seafood, HelloTech creates the platforms that bring tailored food solutions to millions of customers every month.

Our subscription-based, direct-to-consumer model relies on technology at every step, from customer-facing apps and personalization logic to pricing, forecasting, supply chain optimization, and initiatives that help reduce food waste. While our brands operate independently to serve distinct customer needs, they are united by shared platforms, data, and operational excellence built by HelloTech.

HelloTech works in autonomous, cross-functional alliances, each owning a specific product or domain end to end. By working with our Warsaw office, you will help shape scalable, data-driven products used across our markets, working with a modern tech stack and international teams to continuously improve how people discover, order, and enjoy HelloFresh’s products, today and in the future.

About the role: What's in the Box

The Communications tribe, a key part of the Growth Alliance, enables our brands to deliver highly personalized, meaningful interactions with our users across global markets. As a Senior Data Scientist within this team, you will drive a direct business impact by shaping the intelligence behind how, when, and what we communicate with our customers.

Your work will primarily focus on three core initiatives:

- Send Decisioning: Designing and scaling AI agents, specifically using contextual bandits, to optimize our communication channels (email, SMS, and push notifications). Your models will automate the logic that determines the most relevant message and timing for each individual user.

- Intelligent Funnel: Supporting a collaborative, cross-tribe initiative aimed at personalizing the post-click experience. You will leverage contextual bandits to match user ad-context and pre-questionnaire preferences with the optimal landing page journey.

- AI-Assisted Content & Search: Building intelligent systems to index and search internal marketing assets (images and copy). Additionally, you will develop tools that assist marketing teams in the automated composition of new, high-performing communication assets.

To succeed in this project, you should be a pragmatic and curious problem solver who excels in a cross-functional environment. Success involves translating complex user behavior into scalable models, identifying opportunities to improve our data foundations, and balancing technical depth with a strong focus on driving user engagement.

At HelloTech, flexibility and cross-functional collaboration are core to how we work. While this role is aligned to a specific Alliance, strong candidates may also be considered for opportunities across different teams or projects.

What you’ll do: The Recipe

- Build, own, and iterate on RL and ML models that run in production behind high-traffic, performance-critical conversion and communication flows.

- Develop the decisioning logic that determines the best next action for each user across the funnel and the messaging lifecycle.

- Drive the architectural evolution of our contextual-bandit systems — from online exploration (Bootstrapped Thompson Sampling) toward offline policy evaluation and deterministic, low-latency inference (Counterfactual Risk Minimization, Offset Trees, model distillation).

- Partner with Engineering on system design so models integrate cleanly into the funnel and messaging architecture — including where models decide, how decisions are served at latency, and how failures are handled and rolled back.

- Own experimentation design for decisioning models: define success metrics and guardrails, and interpret results in high-noise, high-traffic environments using rigorous methods (sequential testing / SPRT, propensity handling, allocation-bias-free setups).

- Keep models safe and effective in production — monitoring performance, input-data reliability, drift, and latency, and iterating quickly when issues surface.

- Collaborate with CRM Ops agent leads, Marketing Analytics, and platform partners to turn model behaviuor into decisions marketers trust.

What you’ll bring: The Ingredients

- 5+ years of professional experience in data science, ML, or a related quantitative field, with a track record of shipping models to production.

- Proficient in Python and experienced operating in a modern ML stack (e.g. Databricks/Spark, MLflow) in close collaboration with engineers.

- Strong foundation in machine learning for personalization, plus direct experience with reinforcement learning and/or contextual bandits (e.g. Thompson Sampling, epsilon-greedy, reward design).

- Solid grounding in experimentation and causal inference — designing and analyzing controlled experiments in high-traffic settings, and reasoning about guardrails, exposure, and bias.

- Hands-on with classical ML techniques (regression, classification, clustering, recommendation systems) and comfort choosing the right tool for the problem.

- Experience with customer-behaviour data, segmentation, and production feature pipelines.

- Clear, structured communication and a genuinely collaborative, cross-functional mindset.

Nice to have:

- Off-policy evaluation/counterfactual learning, propensity methods, or sequential testing (SPRT).

- Experience with experimentation platforms (e.g. Statsig) and streaming/low-latency inference.

- Working with unstructured data as model features (embeddings, text signals).

- Exposure to marketing/CRM decisioning, deliverability, or funnel/conversion optimisation.

Above all, we are looking for individuals who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What we offer: The Toppings

- Global collaboration at scale: Collaborate with experienced engineers and product partners across HelloTech’s international teams, in a culture of active knowledge sharing.

- Technology with real-world impact: Build and operate modern systems at global scale, supporting 6+ millions of customers and complex supply chain operations.

- Technical/Product/Design leadership: Drive best practices and influence architecture/design, quality, and ways of working in an autonomous, product-led setup.

- End-to-end development/delivery: Drive decisions from problem definition to production, improving systems and enabling long-term scalability.

- Access to workspace at Warsaw Centre Point. The hub offers modern facilities including showers, breakout zones, outdoor space, cycle parking, and refreshments (coffee, soft drinks, and fruit).

Are you the missing ingredient? If this sounds like a tasty opportunity, we’d be excited to hear from you. We aim to review your profile and respond within 5 business days.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Consumer Alliance (m/f/x)
jobs.description:
About the role: What's in the Box

As the Engineering Manager for the Deliveries squad at HelloFresh, you will lead the engineering vision and execution for how customers control their box week to week. Your squad owns the systems that keep a subscription flexing with the customer's life: skip, pause and resume, reschedule, delivery cadence, delivery day, and address changes — the controls a customer uses before an order locks in at cutoff — along with the home and delivery feed that surfaces them.

Delivery planning is where correctness, resilience, and scale matter most: every change a customer makes must be applied accurately and in time before cutoff, and the platform must hold up at HelloFresh scale — around 7 million active customers across 18 countries, with close to 1 billion meals delivered a year. You and your team will work in a cross-functional squad with product, frontend, and data.

We are looking for a leader who brings deep backend engineering judgement and is energised by collaborating across disciplines to make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don't “tick all the boxes” but think you'd thrive in this role, we'd really like to learn more about you.

What you’ll do: The Recipe

- Lead, inspire and grow a cross-functional team of engineers (backend and frontend), ensuring smooth delivery and continuous improvement of the Deliveries systems and tech real estate.

- Own the architecture and reliability of the delivery-control experience — skip, pause and resume, reschedule, cadence, delivery day, and address — with a strong focus on correctness, applying changes in time before cutoff, data integrity, and operational excellence.

- Drive design decisions for scalable, event-driven services (e.g., Kafka) that apply high volumes of delivery changes reliably, with the highest quality and resilience standards.

- Operate as an engineering leader within a cross-functional squad: partner closely with product, frontend, and data to deliver end-to-end customer outcomes and make joint decisions across disciplines.

- Champion observability, on-call health, and incident readiness so delivery changes stay accurate and available around the clock.

- Actively contribute to hiring and capacity planning, conduct regular code reviews, and mentor engineers.

- Drive a continuous improvement culture and promote the HelloFresh DNA.

What you’ll bring: The Ingredients

- You have led a team in an agile environment (5+ engineers), ideally within a cross-functional squad setup.

- You bring 6+ years of hands-on backend development experience.

- Deep experience building scalable microservices and event-driven systems (e.g., Kafka), especially where correctness, idempotency, and data consistency are critical — such as scheduling, subscription management, or other transactional domains.

- Experience designing and operating high-throughput backend systems that other teams and customer-facing surfaces depend on.

- Experience with DevOps practices and cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud), including observability and production ownership.

- A collaborative mindset and comfort working cross-functionally with product, frontend, and data partners.

- You are an empathetic, strong communicator and active listener.

- You are a self-organized individual who can operate autonomously, solve complex problems, and remove roadblocks.

- You are a humble leader who can motivate a team and drive them to their highest potential.

- Nice to have: experience with React Native.

What we offer: The Toppings

Compensation & Financial Wellbeing

- You’ll receive a competitive salary package, including a HelloFresh-subsidized pension scheme.

- Enjoy savings on your weekly HelloFresh box.

- Save with discount schemes with corporate benefits and Vorteile.

Health & Wellbeing

- Support your mental wellbeing with access to platforms like Headspace and Spill.

Flexibility & Work-Life

- Get to work with ease through sustainable travel perks and transportation benefits.

jobs.title: Director, Planning Value Stream
jobs.description:
Overview

As a Director on the Global Value Stream team, you will lead the design, harmonization, and continuous improvement of planning processes and capabilities across HelloFresh's global supply chain. Your initial focus will be Demand Planning, Supply Planning, and Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP). Scope may evolve over time as the team matures and business priorities shift. This role demands strong working expertise across the planning value stream, strategic command of how planning processes and systems interact across markets, and the credibility to drive alignment among senior operational, commercial, and technology leaders.

You will...

- Own the 'to-be' global process architecture and multi-year capability roadmap for Demand Planning, Supply Planning, and S&OP, ensuring the full forecast-to-supply pipeline is harmonized, scalable, and aligned to long-term business growth across all international markets.

- Lead alignment among senior operational leaders across regions and functions, building the consensus and governance structures required for adoption of global planning standards at scale.

- Partner with senior Product and Engineering leadership to shape the planning technology strategy, prioritizing roadmap investments that deliver durable global capability and reflect a Global-First design philosophy.

- Establish and govern the operating model for planning exceptions and deviation control, defining where global standards must hold and where market-specific adaptation is permitted.

- Serve as the process and requirements architect for Lighthouse Projects within the planning value stream, shaping the design and acceptance criteria for new harmonized blueprints and supporting their pilot and validation before multi-market deployment.

- Set the methodology and standards for cross-market maturity assessments, directing diagnostic work and translating systemic capability gaps into structured improvement programs with measurable business impact.

- Define the plan quality and S&OP performance framework (e.g., forecast accuracy, plan adherence, S&OP effectiveness), partnering with Finance and Analytics to set benchmarks and quantify the business value of planning standardization and harmonization at scale.

- Convene and orchestrate cross-functional stakeholders across regional Planning, Operations, Commercial, Product, and Technology, building the operating relationships and forums that keep planning priorities aligned to the global value stream mission.

- Set the global S&OP operating model, including cadence, decision rights, escalation paths, and the integration logic that connects demand, supply, network, production, and labour planning into a coherent monthly cycle.

- Shape the team's contribution to company strategy and department OKRs, contributing to multi-year planning and capability investment decisions across the function.

- Mentor Associate Directors on the team and contribute to the development of senior planning talent across the function.

You have...

- 12 to 15 years of progressive experience in supply chain planning, including significant time in demand planning, supply planning, and/or S&OP leadership within multi-site or multi-country operations.

- Strong working expertise across demand planning, supply planning, and S&OP, with the depth to engage credibly on methodology and the breadth to integrate across the full planning pipeline.

- Track record of designing and implementing S&OP processes at scale, ideally in fast-moving consumer goods, food, or other high-velocity supply chain environments.

- Experience leading or significantly shaping the implementation of Advanced Planning Systems - including requirements definition, vendor evaluation, and business-side program leadership.

- Demonstrated success driving cross-functional alignment and senior stakeholder influence across regional, functional, and executive boundaries - without relying on direct authority.

- Strong analytical foundation with the ability to move fluidly between strategic framing and quantitative depth.

- Experience with lean, Six Sigma, or equivalent continuous improvement frameworks applied to planning processes.

- A history of mentoring and developing senior planning talent.

You are...

- A strategic thinker who can architect a multi-year capability vision and translate it into tractable, sequenced execution.

- Technically credible across the planning value stream - able to engage substantively with specialists, challenge assumptions, and translate methodological detail into clear strategic direction.

- A natural influencer who builds trust and alignment across functions, regions, and levels - from frontline planners to executive sponsors.

- Decisive in ambiguity, with the judgment to know when to standardize, when to flex, and when to escalate.

- An outstanding communicator who moves fluidly between executive narrative and operational detail.

- Motivated by building durable, scalable systems and elevating the capability of those around them.

- Highly organized with the executional discipline to drive complex, multi-stakeholder programs to completion.

What you'll get in return...

Compensation & Financial Wellbeing

Health & Wellbeing

jobs.title: Senior Mobile Engineer - React Native, Platform/Infrastructure (all genders)
jobs.description:
Work with HelloFresh in Warsaw and its HelloTech organisation, HelloFresh’s global technology backbone with more than 1000 people, building the digital products that power our end-to-end food experience. From meal kits and ready-to-eat meals to specialty offerings like pet food and premium meat & seafood, HelloTech creates the platforms that bring tailored food solutions to millions of customers every month. Our subscription-based, direct-to-consumer model relies on technology at every step, from customer-facing apps and personalization logic to pricing, forecasting, supply chain optimization, and initiatives that help reduce food waste. While our brands operate independently to serve distinct customer needs, they are united by shared platforms, data, and operational excellence built by HelloTech.

About the role: What's in the Box

As a Senior Mobile Engineer in the Consumer Foundations tribe, you'll join the Client Platform squad and work hands-on to help evolve our mobile platform. Alongside engineering and product teammates, you'll help move our white-labeled, multi-brand application from a native brownfield React Native setup toward a more scalable greenfield architecture. This is a chance to build strong technical foundations, contribute to shared tooling, and help a growing engineering organization ship reliable mobile software.

Our stack: Core: React Native, iOS (Swift), Android (Kotlin) Architecture: Monorepos, White-labeling, shared npm packages CI/CD & Automation: Bitrise, Expo (Future) Observability & Testing: Honeycomb, Maestro E2E

What you’ll do: The Recipe

At HelloFresh we are moving away from a model where software developers just execute tickets toward one where product engineers are trusted to own customer problems. A Product Engineer takes a problem, forms a point of view, validates it with customers and data, and ships it using AI as a force multiplier.

- Contribute to Migration Work: Help execute the brownfield-to-greenfield React Native migration within our white-labeled, multi-brand application ecosystem.

- Support Monorepo Scaling: Work within our React Native monorepo to support concurrent development across multiple squads, and help maintain shared npm packages used across mobile and web.

- Strengthen CI/CD: Help maintain and improve our CI/CD pipelines in Bitrise, and contribute to the team's ongoing evaluation of a future Expo migration.

- Build Test Automation: Design and extend end-to-end test coverage using Maestro, helping raise the bar for release quality and confidence across the app.

- Improve Observability: Build and maintain tracing and dashboards in Honeycomb to help the team make data-informed decisions about app health.

- Collaborate Across Squads: Partner with your Engineering Manager and teammates to review technical solutions and bring good engineering practices into your day-to-day work.

- Support Application Health: Help investigate and resolve production issues, contributing to a culture of stability and reliability.

- Document Decisions: Write clear technical documentation — design proposals, ADRs, or lightweight write-ups — appropriate to the scope of the work.

What you’ll bring: The Ingredients

- Hands-on experience working with AI tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) beyond casual experimentation. You use AI agents every day. You have a practical sense of how the context you provide to AI tools shapes output quality, and how to set boundaries on AI-generated work.

- React Native & Native Mobile Expertise: Deep, production-tested expertise in React Native, combined with strong knowledge of both iOS and Android. You understand React Native's internal mechanics, performance profiling, native code bridging, platform-specific features and constraints, as well as the respective app store release processes. You are comfortable working across the full mobile stack to build and scale enterprise-grade applications.

- Agentic Engineering: Hands-on experience using AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) in production or near-production work. You think beyond prompts to context engineering—structuring specifications, tool configurations, and information flow so agents produce reliable output. You can decompose complex workflows across agentic components, identify unreliable outputs, and introduce the appropriate guardrails where needed.

- Scale-Minded Developer Experience: Proven track record of managing and optimizing workflows, linting, caching, and build times for large engineering organizations (50+ developers).

- Systems & Monorepo Thinker: Experience managing complex build configurations, white-label scaling, and monorepo architectures.

- High Autonomy & Accountability: You are comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy, making sound technical decisions in ambiguous situations, and supporting teams during complex production incidents.

- Deep mobile engineering expertise, with experience across the app release cycle, test automation, on-device performance and platform UX conventions.

- Exceptional Cross-Squad Influence: You have a proven ability to influence technical direction across multiple engineering teams through expertise, communication, and collaboration.

- You take full ownership. You have a bias to ship. You finish the last twenty percent.

- You have product sense and are opinionated about what should be built and why, and you can back that opinion with data and user evidence.

Above all, we are looking for individuals who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What we offer: The Toppings

- Global collaboration at scale: Collaborate with experienced engineers and product partners across HelloTech’s international teams, in a culture of active knowledge sharing.

- Technology with real-world impact: Build and operate modern systems at global scale, supporting 6+ millions of customers and complex supply chain operations.

- Technical/Product/Design leadership: Drive best practices and influence architecture/design, quality, and ways of working in an autonomous, product-led setup.

- End-to-end development/delivery: Drive decisions from problem definition to production, improving systems and enabling long-term scalability.

- Access to workspace at Warsaw Centre Point. The hub offers modern facilities including showers, breakout zones, outdoor space, cycle parking, and refreshments (coffee, soft drinks, and fruit).

Are you the missing ingredient? If this sounds like a tasty opportunity, we’d be excited to hear from you. We aim to review your profile and respond within 5 business days.

jobs.title: Head of Warehouse Operations (f/m/x)
jobs.description:
About the role: What's in the Box

‘De Kas’ in Bleiswijk is HelloFresh's flagship fulfilment site in the Netherlands, and everything that happens here directly determines whether thousands of meal boxes leave on time, complete, and at cost.

As Head of Warehouse Operations (internally called 'Warehouse Manager'), you own the pre-production operation: the critical phase that makes assembly possible. Your three teams (expedition, internal transport and reverse logistics) ensure the right products are in the right place at the right time, so that production can start on schedule and run without interruption. You'll be part of the Production Leadership Team (PLT), which brings together multiple teams that collectively shape the strategy and direction of the fulfilment centre, giving you a genuine seat at the table and a direct line of influence on how this site evolves.

What you’ll do: The Recipe

- Lead the full pre-production operation across three departments: expedition (inbound receiving), internal transport and reverse logistics; keeping product flow smooth, stock accurate and the yard running like clockwork

- Drive performance through KPIs, using minutes-per-box as your primary lens, and translate operational data into fast, grounded decisions your team can act on

- Coach, challenge and develop a team of team leads and ~100 warehouse staff, building a culture of ownership, accountability and continuous improvement

- Hold the line on safety by ensuring compliance is lived on the floor, not just documented, and that every team member goes home safe

- Own WMS governance and data quality, so that every handover to the production and assembly teams rests on a reliable foundation

- Contribute to site strategy as an active member of the Production Leadership Team, collaborating with PLT colleagues across FSQA, HSE, HR, and Production to set direction

- Take the lead on site-level projects (transitions, WMS developments, process redesigns) when the business needs someone who can both think and execute

What you’ll bring: The Ingredients

- Proven experience managing warehouse or logistics operations at scale: you've been accountable for real volume and know what it takes to keep a high-throughput site running

- Strong people leadership: you build teams, not just headcounts, and you're comfortable setting high standards and having honest conversations

- Hands-on familiarity with a Warehouse Management System: you know how to get the most out of it and where its blind spots are

- An analytical mindset with the ability to spot patterns quickly and move from insight to action without losing momentum

- Fluency in both Dutch and English, with the communication skills to lead diverse teams and collaborate across international stakeholders

- A background in e-commerce, food or FMCG is a genuine advantage: fast-moving environments are where you do your best work

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. There are many different ways of developing skills, and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What we offer: The Toppings

Compensation & Financial Wellbeing

-

- Enjoy 20% off HelloFresh and 40% off Factor_ subscriptions.

- Access the "Benefits at Work" platform for discounts on brands like Nike, Bol.com, and IKEA.

- You'll receive a HelloFresh laptop

- Build your future with a pension plan through Aegon Cappital (age-based rates, 50/50 split).

Health & Wellbeing

- Receive a 7,5% discount on additional health insurance at Zilveren Kruis (2026), plus free access to Headspace and OpenUp.

- Get discounts on ClassPass and gym memberships via Bedrijfsfitness Nederland.

Flexibility & Work-Life

- Start with 24 days of annual leave (pro-rata), plus one additional day per year of service (up to 30 days total).

- Full reimbursement for 2nd-class public transport to the office, and €0.23 per km for car/bicycle travel.

Career & Development

- Access internal/external opportunities aligned with our Job Framework, and join our cross-market mentoring program.

- A dedicated annual budget to help you keep learning, developing new skills, and growing your career.

Culture & Environment

- Enjoy fresh homemade lunches in the office (€20/month), weekly vrij-mi-bo (Friday drinks), quarterly strategy sessions, and team events.

Are you the missing ingredient? If this sounds like a tasty opportunity, we’d be excited to hear from you.

Please apply with your cv and cover letter (required). We aim to review your profile and respond within 5 business days.

jobs.title: Production Associate
jobs.description:
Location: 3331 Mount Lehman Rd, Abbotsford, V2T 5M1

Shift: AM - Friday - Tuesday 7:00 AM - 3:30 PM
PM - Thursday- Monday (4:00 PM - 12:30 PM)

About the Role

Are you ready to join an exciting and dynamic team? We are looking for a highly motivated individual to join us as a Production Associate. Reporting to a Production Team Lead, you will play a crucial role in our production process.

As a Production Associate, you will be responsible for ensuring that HelloFresh boxes are prepared with the utmost care and attention to detail. Your main responsibilities will include portioning fresh ingredients, printing and applying labels, packing meal kits and boxes, setting up workstations, and ensuring all work areas are safe, organized, clean and sanitized. Other tasks as assigned.

What you will be doing:

- Maintain a safe and healthy work environment by adhering to HelloFresh’s safety policies, wearing personal protective equipment (ppe) and clothing as required, and promptly reporting any workplace hazards to First Aid and Supervisors

- Assemble and manually pack meal kits and customer boxes according to customer specifications and HelloFresh standards with focus on accuracy, quality and freshness of ingredients

- Feed and unload food, beverage and associated products processing machines

- Lift, load and transport ingredients and boxes onto racking and onto pallets in a safe and efficient manner, following proper lifting techniques and using appropriate equipment as necessary

- Manually portion and label ingredients as per specifications ensuring accuracy in weights and labelling information. Assist machine operators and automation technicians on automated equipment to ensure efficient and effective use completion of production processes

- Operate multiple printing machines to ensure the timely and accurate production of kit labels, shipping labels, ingredient labels, recipe cards, inserts as per daily demand. Ensure accuracy of information (best before dates, allergens) and minimize over production to reduce waste

- Organize and maintain label, insert and recipe card inventory, ,provide accurate daily cycle counts of printed materials, Ensure all expired and obsolete labels are disposed of at the end of the production week

- Clean and sanitize all equipment and work areas within the facility, ensuring all waste and packaging are properly categorized and disposed and/or recycled of as per instructions and training

- Participate in ongoing training and development opportunities to enhance your skills and knowledge

- Foster a positive and respectful work environment by maintaining professional communication and behavior with coworkers and promoting a sense of teamwork and collaboration

- Work in compliance with OH&S acts and regulations.

- Use personal protective and safety equipment and clothing as directed by the employer and report workplace hazards and dangers to the supervisor or employer.

- Other duties as assigned

At a minimum, you have:

- High school diploma or equivalent

- Willing and able to push, pull, and lift up to 50lbs

- Has experience standing for prolonged periods of time including regular bending, twisting and walking

- Ability to communicate in English, both verbal and written

- Ability to prioritize, and remain calm and alert while multitasking in a fast-paced and deadline oriented environment.

- Willing and able to work in a refrigerated environment (0°C to 4°C)

- Familiar with MS Office and/or Google Apps and comfortable learning new technologies.

- Ability to work independently and within a team environment, in addition to having strong interpersonal skills.

- Flexibility to work overtime, weekends, evenings, and holidays as required

- 1 year of experience in Sanitation or Janitorial is considered an asset.

- Level 1 First Aid is considered an asset.

What you’ll get in return:

- Competitive salary and health benefits

- Shift premiums are available for afternoon and overnight shifts

- 75% discount on HelloFresh or Chefs Plate weekly box subscription

- High impact work to help feed thousands of families in Canada

- Opportunity to learn and grow

- Work with a hard-working and supportive team

jobs.title: Associate Director, Customer Compensation & Policy
jobs.description:
About the Role

Within Global Customer Experience (GCX), our mission is to advance the HelloFresh customer relationship from reactive resolution to proactive, trust-building service. The compensation function sits at the heart of that mission: it is the mechanism through which the business acknowledges failures, restores customer confidence, and, when done well, turns a bad experience into a reason to stay.

The Associate Director, Customer Compensation & Policy is responsible for the global strategy, architecture, and governance of how HelloFresh compensates customers across all markets and brands. This is not a policy maintenance role. It is a strategic function that sits at the intersection of customer economics, operational data, behavioral experimentation, and cross-functional influence.

You will own one of the most financially material and customer-sensitive levers in the business. You will shape a multi-year roadmap and hold peers in Operations, Technology, Finance, and Market Leadership accountable for the quality of inputs that determine how well and how efficiently we recover customer trust.

The ideal candidate brings a rare combination: analytical rigor sharp enough to architect a global compensation engine from first principles, and the executive presence to drive adoption across a complex, multi-market organization without formal authority over most of the people they need to move.

What You'll Own

Global Compensation Strategy & Engine Architecture

- Own the end-to-end strategic vision for how HelloFresh categorizes customer errors and determines compensation across all markets, brands, and contact channels.

- Lead the design and continuous evolution of the compensation engine: along with Tech, you’ll define the the rules, thresholds, segmentation logic, and automation frameworks that govern recovery decisions at scale.

- Define the principles that govern trade-offs between customer generosity and cost discipline and translate those principles into operational rules that hold across market complexity and brand variation.

- Partner with Technology to ensure the compensation engine is scalable, auditable, and capable of supporting dynamic, AI-assisted decisioning as the product evolves.

Experimentation & Behavioral Economics

- Set the global roadmap for compensation experimentation: A/B testing across offer types, value levels, channel timing, and segmentation variables.

- Apply behavioral economics frameworks to compensation design understanding how recovery offers shape long-term retention, repurchase behavior, and brand perception, not just immediate satisfaction.

- Define the measurement framework for experimentation: what constitutes a successful test, what confidence warrants global rollout, and how results are synthesized into durable policy change.

- Partner with Analytics & Insights to ensure test design, sample integrity, and rollout analysis meet a rigorous standard of evidence.

Financial Stewardship & Cost Governance

- Own the global compensation P&L line: tracking spend by market, error category, customer segment, and channel — and holding yourself accountable to defined cost-per-incident and avoidable-contact targets.

- Identify and close financial leakage: cases where compensation is being issued without policy justification, at incorrect values, or at the wrong frequency.

- Build the reporting infrastructure that makes compensation economics visible to GCX leadership, market GMs, and Finance — with the granularity and context needed to drive decisions.

- Define the right balance between cost optimization and customer lifetime value investment: not just 'spend less' but 'spend where it earns back.

Fraud Policy & Global Governance

- Own the global fraud and abuse prevention framework: the policies, detection logic, thresholds, and escalation paths that protect the business without creating friction for genuine customers.

- Lead the governance rhythm for policy: quarterly reviews, market exception management, escalation adjudication, and framework versioning across a multi-brand, multi-market environment.

- Act as the final authority on complex, cross-market policy gaps — resolving ambiguity with speed, consistency, and strategic clarity rather than routing decisions upward by default.

- Maintain global standards while creating principled space for market-level adaptation where local context genuinely requires it.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Stakeholder Accountability

- Represent the compensation function in senior forums translating customer economics into requirements that peers in Operations, Technology, Finance, and Market GMs must respond to.

- Hold cross-functional partners accountable for the upstream data quality, operational accuracy, and system reliability that the compensation engine depends on.

- Drive adoption of policy changes across markets and brands, building communication and change management plans that make new frameworks land — not just launch.

- Influence at VP and Director level across multiple functions; escalate only strategic blockers, not routine alignment.
jobs.requirements_raw:
What You'll Bring

Education

- MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification required.

- Undergraduate degree in Economics, Business, Engineering, or a quantitative discipline.

Experience

- 8–12 years of progressive experience in customer strategy, pricing, operations, or a directly adjacent domain with meaningful exposure to global, multi-market environments.

- Demonstrated track record of owning a financially significant operational lever and managing it with both analytical precision and strategic judgment.

- Prior experience leading and developing teams; comfort operating as a senior individual contributor and a people leader simultaneously.

- Background in subscription commerce, logistics, or consumer-facing operations strongly preferred. Familiarity with the economics of customer recovery in high-volume, low-margin environments is a distinct advantage.

Technical & Analytical

- Advanced proficiency in SQL and data analysis; able to build and pressure-test the analytical models that underpin policy decisions without delegating the logic to others.

- Fluency with experimentation methodology: test design, statistical significance, holdout analysis, and the translation of results into policy not just reporting.

- Experience working with or alongside engineering teams to define product and system requirements for rules-based or AI-assisted decisioning tools.

- Comfort with financial modeling: building the business case for compensation investment, forecasting spend impact, and tracking actuals against plan.

Leadership & Influence

- Senior executive presence: able to walk into a GM, COO, or CFO conversation with a clear point of view, defend it under pressure, and leave with alignment.

- A credible voice with peers and upward stakeholders not because of title, but because of the quality of analysis and clarity of communication.

- Structured and decisive under ambiguity: able to make a defensible call with incomplete information and adjust as evidence develops.

- Genuinely collaborative across markets and functions able to hold people to standards without damaging the relationships needed to sustain them.

What we offer

- Modern and comfortable working space with great co-workers in Berlin-Kreuzberg

- Discount for HelloFresh boxes and Convini products

- Development possibilities along with internal trainings and a yearly Learning & Development budget

- Flexible working hours including Work From Home/Work from Abroad/Sabbatical Policy, as well as a home office set up budget

- Extensive Onboarding and Buddy Program

- Social events including team events, Friday beers, company runs, book club, etc.

- Discounted fitness offers with our Urban Sports Club and John Reed partners and yoga classes

- Well-being initiatives in cooperation with Headspace and Spill

- Childcare and company pension scheme benefit

- Monthly transportation budget via NAVIT

- Own the end-to-end strategic vision for how HelloFresh categorizes customer errors and determines compensation across all markets, brands, and contact channels.

- Lead the design and continuous evolution of the compensation engine: along with Tech, you’ll define the the rules, thresholds, segmentation logic, and automation frameworks that govern recovery decisions at scale.

- Define the principles that govern trade-offs between customer generosity and cost discipline and translate those principles into operational rules that hold across market complexity and brand variation.

- Partner with Technology to ensure the compensation engine is scalable, auditable, and capable of supporting dynamic, AI-assisted decisioning as the product evolves.

Experimentation & Behavioral Economics

- Set the global roadmap for compensation experimentation: A/B testing across offer types, value levels, channel timing, and segmentation variables.

- Apply behavioral economics frameworks to compensation design understanding how recovery offers shape long-term retention, repurchase behavior, and brand perception, not just immediate satisfaction.

- Define the measurement framework for experimentation: what constitutes a successful test, what confidence warrants global rollout, and how results are synthesized into durable policy change.

- Partner with Analytics & Insights to ensure test design, sample integrity, and rollout analysis meet a rigorous standard of evidence.

Financial Stewardship & Cost Governance

- Own the global compensation P&L line: tracking spend by market, error category, customer segment, and channel — and holding yourself accountable to defined cost-per-incident and avoidable-contact targets.

- Identify and close financial leakage: cases where compensation is being issued without policy justification, at incorrect values, or at the wrong frequency.

- Build the reporting infrastructure that makes compensation economics visible to GCX leadership, market GMs, and Finance — with the granularity and context needed to drive decisions.

- Define the right balance between cost optimization and customer lifetime value investment: not just 'spend less' but 'spend where it earns back.

Fraud Policy & Global Governance

- Own the global fraud and abuse prevention framework: the policies, detection logic, thresholds, and escalation paths that protect the business without creating friction for genuine customers.

- Lead the governance rhythm for policy: quarterly reviews, market exception management, escalation adjudication, and framework versioning across a multi-brand, multi-market environment.

- Act as the final authority on complex, cross-market policy gaps — resolving ambiguity with speed, consistency, and strategic clarity rather than routing decisions upward by default.

- Maintain global standards while creating principled space for market-level adaptation where local context genuinely requires it.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Stakeholder Accountability

- Represent the compensation function in senior forums translating customer economics into requirements that peers in Operations, Technology, Finance, and Market GMs must respond to.

- Hold cross-functional partners accountable for the upstream data quality, operational accuracy, and system reliability that the compensation engine depends on.

- Drive adoption of policy changes across markets and brands, building communication and change management plans that make new frameworks land — not just launch.

- Influence at VP and Director level across multiple functions; escalate only strategic blockers, not routine alignment.

jobs.title: Director, Commercial Sales, Retail & Foodservice
jobs.description:
Director Commerial Sales, Retail & Food Service

This is a hybrid role to the NYC HelloFresh Headquarters

Factor is building the next growth platform in fresh prepared meals. We've already built one of the leading DTC meal brands in North America, and now we're extending that strength into retail and foodservice, where customers are increasingly looking for better, fresher, more convenient meals. We believe this is a category ready for real disruption, and early signals show that Factor's product, brand, and customer promise are resonating. This role sits at the center of that build - an exciting opportunity to help define a new category from the ground up.

We are hiring a Director, Commercial Sales, Retail & Foodservice to lead two of our most important New Channels growth areas. Reporting to the General Manager, New Channels, you will own the commercial P&L, build the operating playbook, and lead the sales and planning team. You'll make the portfolio-level calls across accounts, channels, pricing, trade, forecasting, and resource allocation, and partner closely with supply chain, marketing, finance, operations, and strategy to bring Factor to market at scale.

This is not a role for someone looking to manage a mature business. The right person combines CPG sales leadership, account strategy, P&L discipline, and hands-on operating ability. It is a role for a builder: someone energized by ambiguity, driven by data, and ready to help write the playbook for one of the most exciting food brands in the country.

You will...

- Own annual Retail and Foodservice revenue delivery at the portfolio level, including the commercial P&L narrative across revenue, margin, trade spend, contribution, and variance to plan.

- Lead commercial inputs into the AOP and build the multi-channel commercial roadmap in partnership with Sales & BD, Sales Strategy & Planning, Finance, Supply Chain, Operations, and Marketing.

- Set portfolio-level retailer and channel priorities across mass, club, grocery, specialty, foodservice, and future growth channels.

- Own pricing architecture, trade guardrails, and governance around JBPs, long-term agreements, and major retailer commitments.

- Partner with the Head of Sales & BD on account prioritization, new account development, customer strategy, and business case pressure-testing; support senior customer relationships and escalations as needed.

- Develop and scale the Foodservice commercial strategy, including customer prioritization, distributor / operator partnerships, route-to-market decisions, and the right resourcing model as the channel grows.

- Lead the commercial operating rhythm across sales, planning, finance, supply chain, and marketing, keeping the team aligned on priorities, risks, decisions, and handoffs.

- Sponsor S&OP from the commercial side and set the bar for forecast accuracy, trade ROI, customer meeting quality, category reviews, and new item commercialization readiness.

- Own broker governance, broker QBRs, distributor business reviews, and commercial partner performance management.

- Manage and coach the commercial team — Head of Sales & BD, Sales Strategy & Planning, and future Foodservice lead — and sequence future hiring against revenue milestones.

- Represent Retail and Foodservice priorities to senior Factor and HelloFresh leadership with clear, data-backed, decision-ready recommendations.

You are...

- A commercial builder: you have built or materially scaled commercial sales processes, teams, and customer relationships in a high-growth environment.

- P&L-oriented: you own the commercial number and the tradeoffs behind it - pricing, trade, cost-to-serve, and resource allocation - and you translate them into practical business decisions.

- Deeply analytical and data-driven: you're fluent in business cases, account economics, and forecast assumptions, and you turn that analysis into clear commercial recommendations.

- Decisive and comfortable with ambiguity: you can create a structure where no process exists yet, make calls with incomplete information, and back those decisions with clear commercial logic.

- A strong people leader: you coach, prioritize, delegate, and build accountability without needing every decision to run through you.

- Fast-moving and action-oriented: you know when to analyze, when to decide, and when to move, especially in a high-growth business where speed matters.

- Strong collaborator: you build trust quickly across supply chain, finance, marketing, operations, legal, tech, and executive stakeholders.

- A sharp communicator: you can take a complex commercial picture and land it as a clear recommendation, whether you're in front of a retail buyer, a board member, or your own team.

- Low ego and hands-on: you can operate at the strategic level while still rolling up your sleeves when the business needs it.

You have...

- 8+ years of experience in CPG commercial sales, retail sales, sales strategy, go-to-market, or related commercial leadership roles.

- Experience owning or leading retail account management across mass, club, grocery, specialty, or foodservice channels; fresh / refrigerated category experience is a strong plus.

- A track record at a DTC-to-retail brand in transition is a strong plus — someone who has lived the new-to-shelf journey.

- Proven P&L ownership, with demonstrated command of commercial budgets, trade spend, and pricing decisions.

- Experience building or scaling a commercial function from an early stage — operating cadence, account management approach, channel launch, or broker model.

- Experience managing broker networks and third-party sales resources, including governance and performance management, not just day-to-day relationship management.

- Strong understanding of retail commercialization, including category reviews, JBPs, retailer submissions, promotional planning, pricing, and new item launch requirements.

- Experience partnering with supply chain, finance, marketing, and operations to evaluate account opportunities and launch plans.

- Excellent analytical, written, and verbal communication skills; ability to present clearly to senior leadership and external customers.

- BA/BS or equivalent experience; MBA a plus.

You’ll get…

From meal kits and ready-to-eat meals to specialty offerings like pet food and premium meat & seafood, HelloTech creates the platforms that bring tailored food solutions to millions of customers every month.

Our subscription-based, direct-to-consumer model relies on technology at every step, from customer-facing apps and personalization logic to pricing, forecasting, supply chain optimization, and initiatives that help reduce food waste. While our brands operate independently to serve distinct customer needs, they are united by shared platforms, data, and operational excellence built by HelloTech.

HelloTech works in autonomous, cross-functional alliances, each owning a specific product or domain end to end. By working with our Warsaw office, you will help shape scalable, data-driven products used across our markets, working with a modern tech stack and international teams to continuously improve how people discover, order, and enjoy HelloFresh’s products, today and in the future.

About the role: What's in the Box

The Conversions Tech area enables meal brands to achieve ambitious growth targets through a seamless and high-performing conversion funnel. As a component of the Growth Alliance, this project drives growth for the HelloFresh group by powering marketing with advanced MarTech capabilities and product innovation. The focus is directed toward (re)acquisition, conversion optimization, and data-driven growth strategies.

In the capacity of a Senior Data Scientist within Conversions, the service provider contributes to shaping the intelligence that drives customized user journeys across conversion funnels. This involves executing complex feature engineering and optimization efforts, contributing to the data foundations and analytical approaches that power the decisioning platform for personalized experiences.

The provided services enable an automated engine that determines the optimal journey for a specific user at the appropriate time, based on intent, channel, and campaign context. This involves operating in a highly cross-functional environment, coordinating closely with Product, Engineering, and Marketing to design, evaluate, and scale personalization across various workstreams. This project carries direct responsibility for advancing the data strategy and improving the user experience for the HelloFresh group across global markets.

What you’ll do: The Recipe

- Build and iterate on machine learning models powering personalization that run in production behind high-traffic, performance-critical conversion pages.

- Execute decisioning models that determine the best next step in the conversion funnel for each user.

- Contribute to system design by coordinating with Engineering to ensure data science solutions integrate cleanly into the overall funnel architecture.

- Coordinate directly with Product and Engineering to shape how ML-driven decisions are embedded into the conversion funnels, including where models decide and how failures are handled.

- Direct experimentation design for decisioning models, defining success metrics, guardrails, and how results are interpreted in high-noise, high-traffic environments.

- Maintain model safety and effectiveness in production by monitoring performance, input data reliability, and latency, and iterating when issues are detected.

What you’ll bring: The Ingredients

- 5+ years of professional experience in data science or a related quantitative field.

- Strong foundation in machine learning concepts relevant to personalization and marketing communications.

- Hands-on experience with techniques such as regression, classification, clustering, recommendation systems, and experimentation.

- Practical experience designing and analyzing A/B tests and controlled experiments.

- Experience working with customer behavior data and segmentation.

- Extensive experience with operating in production environments and collaborating closely with engineers.

- Clear, structured communication skills and a collaborative mindset.

Above all, we are looking for individuals who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What we offer: The Toppings

- Global collaboration at scale: Collaborate with experienced engineers and product partners across HelloTech’s international teams, in a culture of active knowledge sharing.

- Technology with real-world impact: Build and operate modern systems at global scale, supporting 6+ millions of customers and complex supply chain operations.

- Technical/Product/Design leadership: Drive best practices and influence architecture/design, quality, and ways of working in an autonomous, product-led setup.

- End-to-end development/delivery: Drive decisions from problem definition to production, improving systems and enabling long-term scalability.

- Access to workspace at Warsaw Centre Point. The hub offers modern facilities including showers, breakout zones, outdoor space, cycle parking, and refreshments (coffee, soft drinks, and fruit).

jobs.title: Manager, Sanitation
jobs.description:
Location: Unit # 110, 4951 - 110 Avenue SE, Calgary, Alberta

Schedule: Monday to Friday (8 am to 4 pm) - flexibility required to work weekends & overnights based on business needs

About the Role

We are seeking a full-time Sanitation Manager to join our Ready-to-Eat meals production facility. Reporting to the Site Director and National Sanitation Manager, this role is responsible for overseeing all sanitation operations to ensure the facility consistently meets food safety, sanitation, and regulatory standards.

The Sanitation Manager will oversee execution of the Sanitation Program across the plant while driving continuous improvement initiatives focused on safety, efficiency, and compliance. This role is responsible for managing, coaching, and developing a team of sanitation supervisors, leads and associates, while partnering cross-functionally with Production, FSQA, Maintenance, and external sanitation contractors to support operational excellence.

What you will be doing:

- Oversee, coach, and develop a team of in-house and external sanitation supervisors, leads and associates, ensuring strong performance, accountability, and compliance with food safety and sanitation standards.

- Deliver training and ongoing coaching on chemical handling, equipment use, SSOPs, and general sanitation practices, and develop and maintain a structured sanitation training program aligned with company and regulatory requirements.

- Build and manage sanitation labour planning, including scheduling, contractor tasks review and approval, and performance management, while acting as a key sanitation representative to site leadership.

- Ensure a safe and sanitary work environment by enforcing proper cleaning, sanitation, chemical handling, equipment use, and housekeeping standards across the facility.

- Support timely production start-up by ensuring all areas and equipment are cleaned and sanitized according to established schedules.

- Maintain appropriate inventory levels of cleaning chemicals and sanitation supplies, and ensure sanitation equipment and systems are maintained through adherence to preventive maintenance and monitoring programs.

- Maintain and track the Master Sanitation Schedule (MSS) in collaboration with Production, FSQA, Maintenance, and Health & Safety teams.

- Monitor and report key sanitation metrics, including pre-operational inspections, MSS adherence, and Environmental Monitoring Program (EMP) results.

- Conduct and participate in seek-and-destroy activities and other food safety verification programs as required to identify and eliminate potential risks.

- Ensure all sanitation activities comply with HACCP principles, company standards, and applicable regulatory requirements.

- Develop, revise, and maintain SSOPs in alignment with facility equipment, infrastructure, and operational needs.

- Partner with third-party sanitation contractors and chemical suppliers to troubleshoot issues, eliminate root causes of non-conformities, and support continuous improvement.

- Conduct quarterly performance evaluations of third-party sanitation contractors and chemical suppliers.

- Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance sanitation effectiveness, efficiency, and overall food safety performance.

- All other related duties as assigned.

At a minimum, you have:

- Post-secondary education in Food Science, Biological Sciences, or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience in sanitation within a food manufacturing environment.

- Minimum 3 years of sanitation experience within food manufacturing, including at least 2 years in a supervisory role. Work experience in CFIA-inspected RTE facilities preferred.

- Experience working in high-risk/high-care food manufacturing environments, including Ready-to-Eat (RTE) and meat processing facilities, is considered a strong asset.

- Working knowledge of HACCP principles and food safety standards.

- Experience with sanitation procedures, cleaning systems, chemical handling, and Health & Safety (HSE) practices.

- Strong problem-solving skills with a data-driven approach, including root cause analysis and corrective/preventive action implementation.

- Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across all levels of the organization and with third-party sanitation contractors.

- Proficiency with Google Workspace applications, including Gmail, Google Sheets, and Google Slides.

- Proven ability to lead, coach, motivate, and develop high-performing sanitation teams.

- Flexibility to work nights and weekends as required to support business operations.

What you’ll get in return:

- Competitive salary and health benefits

- 75% discount on HelloFresh or Chefs Plate weekly box subscription

- High impact work to help feed thousands of families in Canada

- Opportunity to learn and grow

- Work with a hard-working and supportive team

Working Conditions:

It’s no surprise that as a food company, we use many ingredients that may be considered common allergens (i.e. peanuts, tree nuts, milk, etc.). Whether this role is based out of our headquarters or one of our distribution centers, it is possible that you may be exposed to such allergens in this role. If you have any concerns with being exposed to any particular food ingredients, including meat, please disclose this during the hiring process.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Cloud Infrastructure (all genders)
jobs.description:
HelloFresh Group is the world's leading integrated food solutions provider, with a global portfolio of brands spanning meal kits, ready-to-eat meals, and specialty products. From our Berlin headquarters, we build and run the technology that delivers millions of meals every week.

We welcome team players who thrive in a dynamic environment, lead with ownership, and bring diverse perspectives to the table. If you are motivated to grow in a culture that champions speed and agility, data-driven decision making, and customer centricity, we would like to hear from you.

The role

The Foundations Alliance builds the tools and infrastructure that empower engineering teams across HelloFresh. Cloud Runtime sits at the center of it: we provide a reliable and highly performant multi-cluster container platform so that every HelloFresh engineer can deploy services with 99.99% uptime, high performance, low latency, and minimal operational overhead.

As Engineering Manager for Cloud Runtime, you will lead a squad of platform engineers who own the container platform, networking, and traffic routing that more than 1,000 production services depend on across Europe, North America, and Australia and New Zealand. You will partner closely with our Product Manager to turn a defined platform strategy into a roadmap the team can execute, and you will be accountable for the reliability and cost of what we run.

This is a hands-on leadership role. Your day will not be spent writing code, but you will be close enough to the system to read a pull request, follow a debugging session, and challenge the team on any technical decision they bring you, from an architecture proposal to an incident postmortem.

What you'll do

- Lead, grow, and support a distributed squad of platform engineers, with team members based in Berlin and Poland, owning hiring, development, and performance for the team

- Build and maintain an engineering roadmap spanning one to two quarters, and make explicit trade-offs between features, timelines, and quality

- Drive our core platform commitments: expanding into a highly available platform with failover between pre-provisioned clusters, increasing adoption of our container platform and multi-region deployments, and reducing infrastructure cost through networking and compute optimisation

- Own the squad's operational metrics and be accountable for moving them

- Facilitate and role-model postmortems, and drive the follow-through on action items

- Manage relationships with key infrastructure vendors and work with Security on audit and compliance requirements

- Partner with the Observability, Release Engineering, and Security squads, where our roadmaps are tightly coupled and dependencies run in both directions

- Foster an inclusive and open working environment, and create the kind of documentation and knowledge sharing that makes the team less dependent on any single person
jobs.requirements_raw:
What you'll bring

- Experience managing a team of engineers, including hiring, performance management, and career development

- Experience leading a team that is split across more than one location, and the habits that make that work

- A strong technical background in cloud infrastructure, with hands-on experience of Kubernetes and at least one major cloud platform

- Familiarity with the surrounding ecosystem: service mesh, API gateways, infrastructure as code, GitOps-style deployment, and secrets management

- The ability to contribute technically when needed, whether that means reviewing code, pairing on a problem, or helping debug an incident

- Experience owning production systems with meaningful availability targets, including incident response and on-call practices

- Judgement about when a decision is reversible and when it is not, and a willingness to front-load design effort on the ones that are not

- Strong stakeholder management, and the ability to say no to a loud request that is not on the roadmap

- Clear written communication and strong asynchronous collaboration skills

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh Group better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences, so even if you don't tick all the boxes but think you'd thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What we offer

Compensation & Financial Wellbeing

- You’ll receive a competitive salary package, including a HelloFresh-subsidized pension scheme.

- Enjoy savings on your weekly HelloFresh box.

- Save with discount schemes with corporate benefits and Vorteile.

Health & Wellbeing

- Support your mental wellbeing with access to platforms like Headspace and Spill.

- Stay active with 24/7 office gym access, a discounted Urban Sports Club membership, and other wellbeing resources.

Flexibility & Work-Life

- Balance your life with our flexible hybrid model.

- Recharge with sabbatical leave options in addition to standard time off.

- Get to work with ease through sustainable travel perks and transportation benefits.

Career & Development

- Embrace "Learning Never Stops" with internal training, the HelloFresh Academy, and a dedicated budget for German language courses.

Culture & Environment

- Enjoy tasty in-office meal deals and fresh food options.

- We support working families with parent-friendly policies, an in-office kids corner, and an on-site babysitter.
