About the Role

As a Quality Control Associate you will take a hands-on approach to maintaining and continuously improving our product quality control processes. Reporting to the Supervisor, Quality Control , you will play a key role in ensuring our Production Associates have all essential high-quality ingredients required to make delicious and safe meal kits for our customers.

What you will be doing:

- Receive inbounding and inventory SKUs from the Warehouse department and conduct quality control inspections to ensure products adhere to required specifications.

- Work closely with the Warehouse team to achieve quality targets, in addition to performing regular inspections on packaged products for lot codes.

- Respond to Quality and/or BBD issues on the production lines

- Maintain clear and concise communication with the Operations, Procurement, and Logistics teams; in cases of product non-conformance, alongside maintaining a photo database of product non-conformances.

- Lead production associates for ingredient sorting.

- Perform quality control inspections on work-in-progress and finished products to ensure products meet Company Standards.

- Ensure accuracy and efficiency at designated ship-out stations, and complete logs and records as required.

- Work in compliance with OH&S acts and regulations.

- Use personal protective and safety equipment and clothing as directed by the employer and report workplace hazards and dangers to the supervisor or employer.

- Conduct environmental monitoring and equipment calibration verification, (Environmental sampling & ATP swabbing)

- Provide support to FSQA Supervisor.

- Perform Quality Assurance inspections as they pertain to Finished Product, Raw Materials, Water and Cleaning & Sanitation.

- Perform sensory on shelf stable raw materials.

- Monitor PRPs and PC's.

- Ensure all Out of Spec findings, as they pertain to the aforementioned, are addressed through the procedures as they pertain to "Deviation, Corrective Action & Preventative Measures", "Food Safety Assessment" and "Product Holds".

- Conduct internal inspection on a periodic basis, i.e. GMP audits and pre operational inspections.

- Ensure water samples are sent out to Accredited Laboratories on a periodic basis for analytical testing.

- Provide support to the management teams in troubleshooting and resolving problems in the Production Process.

- Ensure GMPs and Management of allergens is followed as per procedures.

- Ensure spillages are cleaned up immediately to eliminate the potential for cross contamination of allergens.

- Other duties as assigned

At a minimum, you have:

- Post-secondary education in Biological, Chemical or Food Sciences diploma

- 6 Months to 1 year experience working in QC/QA in a food processing, manufacturing or service industry

- Willing and able to push, pull, and lift up to 50lbs

- Has experience with standing for prolonged periods of time including regular bending, twisting and walking

jobs.title: Maintenance Planner/Scheduler
jobs.description:
Job Description:

The MRE Planner/Scheduler is a critical role within the maintenance organization of HelloFresh and our associated brands and is an onsite position. This role is responsible for properly reviewing work requests, evaluating scope, allocating resources, and working with impacted teams to schedule associated activities in a way that avoids costly downtime and interruptions to business operations while ensuring optimized use of our labor and material resources. Periodic review of asset metadata and development of robust job plans are critical to keep our systems accurate and our data integrity strong. This position works closely with maintenance site, regional, and organizational leadership to keep maintenance operations running smoothly. The ideal candidate will immerse themselves in the HelloFresh DNA and will help drive our people and processes to reflect our company principles.

Shift: Monday to Friday - 7:00am to 3:30pm

You will...

- Be responsible for forecasting PM work and properly load balancing daily workload allotment based on available labor and material resources.

- Be responsible for reviewing incoming maintenance requests and, with the assistance of site technicians and/or management as needed, evaluating criticality, work scope, and needed resources.

- Evaluate equipment and/or request scope and document in clear, concise, and descriptive job plans all of the requirements to complete the job effectively.

- Evaluate safety hazards and PPE requirements to ensure the safety of all maintenance staff and building associates is taken into consideration.

- Estimate required labor, materials, and tools needed, and ensure availability prior to scheduling. This includes gathering any documentation (drawings, manuals, etc.) and ensuring that they are included as part of the job package.

- Ask for assistance from technicians and/or site maintenance management as needed.

- Work with the site inventory specialist or site leadership to ensure that required parts are properly kitted and booked against the proper work request prior to scheduling.

- Communicate with site operations and maintenance leadership to ensure work is scheduled, and that all impacted parties are aware of what is being done and when. If adjustments need to be made, communicate to and work with all impacted parties.

- Review and report work backlog to management regularly to drive on-time completion of all work requests and predictive/preventive maintenance tasks.

- Review downtime data and review potential warranty issues. You will escalate potential warranty issues to the site maintenance leadership and the inventory specialist (as needed for part warranty issues).

- Ensure equipment records and metadata are correct and perform audits by walking equipment lines and checking against CMMS equipment lists to ensure that all asset data is correctly identified and in the location identified within the CMMS database.

- Create/enroll new equipment to CMMS and ensure completeness of metadata.

- Communicate with site maintenance leaders and technicians to continuously improve the planning process and associated job plans.

- You will work with other planner schedulers in the network to leverage best practices, share experiences, and help educate each other.

- Be open to other related duties as requested, such as participating in training of new MRE staff, assisting Business Operations leaders with proper use of the CMMS system, and helping launch new buildings as we continue to grow as a company.

You have...

- 5+ years of progressive experience in a maintenance environment, preferably with planning and scheduling

- A high school diploma or the equivalent education / experience.

- Experience with material handling equipment systems, with a basic understanding of installation, operation, and required general maintenance best practices.

- Proficient/Advanced knowledge of CMMS systems, preferably FMX and/or Fiix.

- Proficient in the use of standard office administrative software including document, spreadsheet, and slide presentation software (like MS Office or Google software suite).

- Proficient in reviewing data for accuracy, anomalies, and trends, and being able to discuss findings with maintenance leadership.

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

- The ability to read and understand drawings, schematics, and diagrams.

- The ability to multitask when needed.

- A high level of integrity and ethics, and excellent follow-through.

jobs.title: Loyalty Program Strategy Lead (all genders)
jobs.description:
The role

Loyalty and retention are two of the strongest levers we have for growing customer lifetime value and profit. As Lead, Loyalty & Customer Lifecycle, you own the strategy and end-to-end delivery of HelloFresh Group’s loyalty program across our global markets and brands. You decide how the program works and how it earns its keep, set the quarterly roadmap and OKRs, and own the CRM and lifecycle experience that runs across email, push and SMS.

Our team is customer-centric and data-driven. You’ll run experiments, build the financial models that quantify program cost and customer value, and analyze our data to find where the biggest gains are. You work hand-in-hand with tech and product as the commercial owner of the program, translating business questions into requirements and taking on the commercial work so engineering can stay focused on building. You also partner with Data, Product Marketing, Legal and CRM Operations to ship, and coordinate across markets with local growth and legal teams. Beyond the core program, you look after our legacy retention initiatives across markets and help local teams run their own.

This is a senior individual-contributor leadership role. You’ll set direction and lead major initiatives through influence and cross-functional partnership, not through direct reports. Your work will shape how HelloFresh Group rewards and retains its customers for years to come.

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What you’ll do

Own loyalty strategy & design

- Architect and own the end-to-end loyalty program, from how it works (points, tiers, missions, rewards) to the financial models and business cases behind it.

- Define the reward economics and program roadmap, turning company strategy into quarterly OKRs and a clear path for how the program evolves.

- Lead multi-market rollouts, including legal compliance, customer communication and migration planning.

Drive CRM & the customer lifecycle

- Own the CRM strategy for the program, covering journey design, segmentation and multi-channel campaigns across email, push and SMS.

- Design lifecycle interventions tied to key milestones such as enrollment, points thresholds, redemption nudges and churn risk.

- Manage CRM dependencies with platform and ops teams, catching eligibility, frequency and data issues before they reach customers.

Run experimentation & analytics

- Design and interpret A/B experiments for program variants, CRM campaigns and feature launches, then turn the results into decisions.

- Build and maintain financial models that quantify program cost, AOV impact and customer lifetime value, refining them as experiment data comes in.

- Define and track the KPIs that signal program health, including opt-in, redemption, engaged users, points burn and virality, and use them to spot untapped opportunities.

Build partnerships & deliver operationally

- Identify and evaluate brand partnership opportunities for the reward store, such as gift-with-purchase and co-branded rewards, building the business case by market and aligning with Corporate Partnerships.

- Evaluate and manage vendor relationships end to end, including reference calls and commercial negotiations.

- Act as the commercial partner to tech and product, owning the ad-hoc business work (scoping, analysis, requirements, trade-off calls) so delivery keeps moving.

- Resolve program issues quickly and with little customer disruption, and support local teams running legacy retention initiatives with strategic and CRM input.

Nice-to-haves

- SQL or other querying languages.

- Hands-on experience with modern CRM, experimentation, and analytics tooling. Our stack includes Iterable, SFMC, Statsig, Talon.One, Tableau, and Databricks.

jobs.title: People Technology Integrations Manager - Team Lead (All Genders)
jobs.description:
The Role

We are looking for an experienced People Technology Engineering Manager to join the HelloFresh People Technology leadership team. This role leads the Engineering discipline within People Technology and is responsible for the architecture, capability and delivery of the technical solutions that connect, automate and increasingly enhance our employee technology landscape.

Today, the squad’s primary focus is Workday integrations and connected enterprise systems. Over time, its remit will expand across workflow automation, low-code development, AI-enabled solutions and modern engineering capabilities. You will act as the engineering architect and design authority for People Technology, setting technical direction, shaping architecture and establishing standards that balance delivery speed, scalability, security, maintainability and long-term sustainability. This includes maintaining strong expertise in Workday integrations and emerging platform capabilities such as Workday Orchestrate and Extend / Build.

You will also lead, develop and performance-manage a team of engineers, building capability across integrations, automation and AI engineering. You will create a high-performing environment grounded in technical quality, accountability and continuous learning, while ensuring the squad has the skills, capacity and ways of working needed to meet both current and future demand. While you may remain hands-on where appropriate, your primary focus will be technical leadership, people development, capability building and delivery oversight.

As the senior business partner for engineering, you will represent the discipline across People Technology and work closely with the People function and stakeholders from across the Group. You will help shape roadmaps, influence prioritisation and investment decisions, and translate business needs into scalable engineering solutions. You will also play a central role in determining where AI, automation and intelligent workflows can create measurable value, both by enabling the squad to deliver faster and by building AI-enabled solutions for the wider People Technology organisation.

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We value diverse experiences and recognise there are many paths into engineering leadership. Even if you do not meet every requirement, we would still like to hear from you if you believe you would thrive in this role.

What You’ll Do

- Act as the engineering architect and design authority for People Technology, owning technical standards, patterns and architectural principles across Workday and connected enterprise systems.

- Shape the end-to-end engineering landscape and make architectural decisions that balance delivery speed, scalability, security, maintainability and long-term sustainability.

- Lead the evolution of the squad from a primarily integrations-focused team into a broader People Technology engineering capability.

- Drive adoption of modern Workday capabilities, including Workday Orchestrate, Extend, Build and future platform innovations.

- Establish AI engineering capability within the People Technology tribe and identify opportunities to apply AI, automation and intelligent workflows.

- Champion AI-assisted engineering practices that improve productivity, quality and delivery speed, while ensuring responsible security, privacy and governance.

- Lead, coach and performance-manage engineers, building capability across integrations, APIs, automation, low-code development and AI-enabled solutions.

- Plan and manage team capacity, resourcing and capability against current priorities and future demand.

- Act as the senior engineering business partner to People Technology leadership, Product Managers, Functional Leads and business stakeholders, shaping roadmaps, prioritisation and investment decisions.

- Translate business needs into scalable technical solutions, resolve complex engineering challenges and maintain oversight of technical debt, dependencies, risks and operational resilience.
jobs.requirements_raw:
What You’ll Bring

- Typically 8–12+ years of experience in integrations, systems engineering, software engineering or related technical roles.

- Deep hands-on experience with Workday integrations and the broader Workday technical ecosystem.

- Strong knowledge of APIs, middleware, enterprise integration platforms and modern integration architecture.

- Experience acting as a technical architect, design authority or senior engineering lead in a complex enterprise environment.

- Experience leading and developing technical specialists, including performance management, coaching and capability building.

- Strong knowledge of Workday Orchestrate, Extend and Build, or the ability to rapidly develop expertise in emerging Workday capabilities.

- Experience applying automation, AI-assisted development or AI-enabled solutions in an enterprise technology environment.

- Strong judgement in evaluating emerging technologies, translating them into practical business outcomes and balancing short-term delivery with long-term sustainability.

- Strong stakeholder management and business-partnering skills, with the ability to influence through clarity, judgement and technical credibility.

- Experience operating in complex, global organisations with sensitive employee data, supported by a relevant degree or equivalent practical experience and fluency in English.

What we offer

- Box Discount - Amazing discounts on 1 box per week! 75% discount on weekly HelloFresh and Chefs Plate meal kits AND 50% off weekly Factor meal box.

- Health & Wellness - Health & Dental benefits from day 1, a Health Spending Account, unlimited access to the Headspace app to meet your self-care needs, and 25% discount on GoodLife fitness memberships!

- Vacation & PTO - Time off is also an important part of self-care! We offer generous vacation and PTO to help you create a good work-life balance.

- Family Benefits - A parental leave top-up program for expectant parents.

- Growth & Development - We support your career progression, provide development opportunities, and invest in your continued learning through our organization wide L&D fund.

- Work Hard & Have Fun - From team socials to engaging company days, you’ll have plenty of opportunity to experience the fun!

- Diversity & Inclusion Initiatives - With impactful ERG’s like FreshPride, Women Empowered and LIMES, we are committed to our diversity, equity & inclusion efforts.

- Food Puns - this one is kind of a big dill if you haven’t already noticed. We even have some punny meeting room names!

Flexible Hybrid Approach

At HelloFresh, we know that flexible work arrangements are essential in enabling you to do your best work, while balancing your personal and life needs. Offering remote work flexibility, along with the opportunity to interact and collaborate in the office are all a part of creating a great employee experience.

To meet these needs, we are pleased to provide Flexible Hybrid work. Flexible Hybrid is a people-first approach that is based on choice, trust, personalization, and empowers teams to choose when and how often they work from the office and work from home, in addition to team days and company days. This means a minimum of 2 days in office per week, with most teams in office between 2-3 days a week.

#LI-HYBRID

Working Conditions

It’s no surprise that as a food company, we use many ingredients that may be considered common allergens (i.e. peanuts, tree nuts, milk, etc.). Whether this role is based out of our headquarters or one of our distribution centers, it is possible that you may be exposed to such allergens in this role. If you have any concerns with being exposed to any particular food ingredients, including meat, please disclose this during the hiring process.
